paras.en: Each year, the school hosts a Composition for Screen Showcase featuring a live ensemble performing music written by students accompanying films projected on the big screen; it’s attended by the public and industry professionals.
paras.zh: 每年，学校都会举办一场屏幕作曲展示会，现场合奏团将演奏由学生创作的音乐，伴随着大屏幕上放映的电影；公众和行业专业人士出席。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Andrew Lloyd Webber (The Phantom of the Opera); James Horner (Titanic)
paras.zh: 著名校友安德鲁·劳埃德·韦伯（《歌剧魅影》）；詹姆斯·霍纳（泰坦尼克号）

paras.en: In addition to its venerable Ivy League name, Yale boasts proximity to New York, Boston and the town of New Haven, giving students a rich cultural and artistic environment in which to take advantage of the school’s prestigious conservatory training. Yale offers a master of music, master of musical arts, doctor of musical arts and artist diploma in composition, with courses taught by concert hall composers including Katherine Balch, Martin Bresnick and Aaron Jay Kernis. While the school does not offer degree programs in media scoring, Yale’s Center for Collaborative Arts and Media helps students combine music with film, video, computer science and the visual arts. Yale’s Center for Studies in Music Technology provides students with a sophisticated recording studio and computer lab featuring software for acoustic and electroacoustic music. All students receive scholarships that cover $42,000 in tuition fees.
paras.zh: 除了其久负盛名的常春藤联盟名号外，耶鲁大学还毗邻纽约、波士顿和纽黑文镇，为学生提供了丰富的文化和艺术环境，让他们能够利用学校享有盛誉的音乐学院培训。耶鲁大学提供音乐硕士、音乐艺术硕士、音乐艺术博士和作曲艺术家文凭，课程由音乐厅作曲家凯瑟琳·巴尔奇、马丁·布雷斯尼克和亚伦·杰·克尼斯教授。虽然学校不提供媒体评分学位课程，但耶鲁大学合作艺术与媒体中心帮助学生将音乐与电影、视频、计算机科学和视觉艺术结合起来。耶鲁大学音乐技术研究中心为学生提供先进的录音室和计算机实验室，配备原声和电声音乐软件。所有学生均可获得相当于 42,000 美元学费的奖学金。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Marco Beltrami (Logan); David Lang (2008 Pulitzer winner)
paras.zh: 著名校友 Marco Beltrami（洛根）；大卫·朗（2008 年普利策奖得主）

paras.en: Curtis offers a mix of liberal arts education and conservatory training focused on instrumental performance. Foundational Studies teaches students the basics in intervals and chords, notation conventions, tuning systems, scales and modes, and various musical forms. Required courses include studies in musical cultures of the world, a survey of 20th and 21st century music techniques, as well as improvisation and electives including musical history. All students receive scholarships that cover $55,995 in tuition fees.
paras.zh: 柯蒂斯提供文科教育和专注于器乐表演的音乐学院培训的结合。基础研究教授学生音程和和弦、记谱惯例、调音系统、音阶和调式以及各种音乐形式的基础知识。必修课程包括世界音乐文化研究、20 世纪和 21 世纪音乐技巧调查、即兴创作和包括音乐史在内的选修课。所有学生均可获得相当于 55,995 美元学费的奖学金。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Leonard Bernstein (West Side Story); Jennifer Higdon (2010 Pulitzer winner for Violin Concerto)
paras.zh: 著名校友伦纳德·伯恩斯坦（《西区故事》）； Jennifer Higdon（2010 年小提琴协奏曲普利策奖得主）

paras.en: NEC’s five-year bachelor/master’s programs allow students to combine their conservatory training with academic programs from partnering institutions Harvard College or College of the Holy Cross, earning a bachelor’s degree from those schools as well as a master of music degree at NEC over a five-year period. Undergraduate students interested in media scoring can take a music technology concentration that includes classes in scoring for new media; performance with electronics or multimedia; recording and mixing; and algorithmic music. Contemporary improvisation programs delve into film music styles and techniques like film noir ensembles and cross-genre interdisciplinary scoring.
paras.zh: NEC 的五年学士/硕士课程允许学生将音乐学院培训与合作机构哈佛大学或圣十字学院的学术课程结合起来，在五年内获得这些学校的学士学位以及 NEC 的音乐硕士学位。对媒体配乐感兴趣的本科生可以选修音乐技术专业，其中包括新媒体配乐课程；电子或多媒体表演；录音和混音；和算法音乐。当代即兴创作项目深入研究电影音乐风格和技术，例如黑色电影合奏和跨流派跨学科配乐。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Stephanie Economou (Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: Dawn of Ragnarök); Coretta Scott King (classically trained soprano)
paras.zh: 著名校友 Stephanie Economou（《刺客信条：英灵殿：诸神黄昏》）；科雷塔·斯科特·金（受过古典音乐训练的女高音）

paras.en: Oberlin doesn’t offer a dedicated media scoring program, but it nonetheless has created an excellent environment in which to learn many of the skill sets and technologies that can make students into effective composers for film, games or commercials. Their TIMARA (Technology in Music and Related Arts) program teaches electronic music and sound design, computer music and multichannel media productions. The school’s Cinema and Media department is housed in the Danny DeVito & Rhea Perlman Center for Media Education and Production above the Apollo Theatre and offers production courses, film labs and soundstages that afford conservatory musicians ample room to perform student compositions.
paras.zh: 欧柏林学院不提供专门的媒体评分项目，但它仍然创造了一个绝佳的环境，让学生可以学习许多技能和技术，使学生成为有效的电影、游戏或广告作曲家。他们的 TIMARA（音乐及相关艺术技术）课程教授电子音乐和声音设计、计算机音乐和多渠道媒体制作。学校的电影和媒体系位于阿波罗剧院上方的丹尼·德维托和雷亚·帕尔曼媒体教育和制作中心，提供制作课程、电影实验室和摄影棚，为音乐学院音乐家提供足够的空间来表演学生的作品。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Jeremy Denk (pianist); Claire Chase (flutist)
paras.zh: 著名校友杰里米·登克（钢琴家）；克莱尔·蔡斯（长笛演奏家）

paras.en: Columbia College Chicago School of Audio and Music continues its comprehensive two-year MFA program, run by graduate program director Kubilay Uner for the past 12 years, and it has recently added an undergraduate Bachelor of Arts in music composition for media, led by Lee Sanders, nine-time BMI Award winner and composer for CBS’ The Amazing Race.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚学院芝加哥音频与音乐学院继续其为期 12 年的综合性 MFA 课程，该课程由研究生课程主任 Kubilay Uner 负责管理，最近又增加了媒体音乐作曲本科文学学士学位课程，由九次 BMI 奖获得者、哥伦比亚广播公司《极速前进》作曲家 Lee Sanders 领导。

paras.en: Uner has 15 students in his first-year program and 14 in the second year and says that the highly selective MFA will remain much the same as it has been in recent years. The school also is welcoming BAFTA-nominated composer Sam Hulick (video game Mass Effect) to the MFA program’s faculty. “Many in our community know Sam from his work as the owner of ReelCrafter, which is the No. 1 platform for people to put their pitch reels together in our industry,” says Uner.
paras.zh: Uner 第一年有 15 名学生，第二年有 14 名学生，他表示，严格挑选的 MFA 将与近年来的情况大致相同。学校还欢迎英国电影和电视艺术学院 (BAFTA) 提名的作曲家 Sam Hulick（电子游戏《质量效应》）加入 MFA 项目的教师队伍。 “我们社区中的许多人都从 Sam 的工作中认识了他，他是 ReelCrafter 的所有者，ReelCrafter 是我们行业中人们将卷轴组装在一起的第一平台，”Uner 说。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Tomás Videla (The House of the Spirits); Batu Sener (Ice Age: Boiling Point)
paras.zh: 著名校友 Tomás Videla（精神之家）； Batu Sener（冰河世纪：沸点）

paras.en: MSM coursework includes classes like composition forum, instrumentation and orchestration, electronic music, form and analysis, and score reading. The school’s studio facilities include the Jean Lignel Electronic Music Studio and labs, which provide digital audio workstation tools including Pro Tools, Logic and Digital Performer, as well as virtual instruments, MIDI protocol and multitrack production techniques. MSM also offers an introductory film scoring course in its pre-college curriculum, a Saturday program for students from 8 to 18 years old.
paras.zh: MSM 课程包括作曲论坛、乐器和编曲、电子音乐、形式和分析以及乐谱阅读等课程。学校的工作室设施包括 Jean Lignel 电子音乐工作室和实验室，提供数字音频工作站工具，包括 Pro Tools、Logic 和 Digital Performer，以及虚拟乐器、MIDI 协议和多轨制作技术。 MSM 还在其大学预科课程中开设了电影配乐入门课程，这是一个针对 8 至 18 岁学生的周六课程。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Angelo Badalamenti (Twin Peaks); John Corigliano (The Red Violin)
paras.zh: 著名校友 Angelo Badalamenti（双峰）；约翰·科里利亚诺（红色小提琴）

paras.en: FROST SCHOOL OF MUSIC AT UNIVERSITY OF MIAMI
paras.zh: 迈阿密大学弗罗斯特音乐学院

paras.en: Established more than 100 years ago, Frost is well known for its innovative curriculum, award-winning faculty and focus on real-world industry experience. Its Media Scoring and Production program, led by newly appointed department chair Camilo Rodriguez, combines composition, orchestration, digital audio production and hands-on studio experience with mentorship from accomplished industry professionals, including Grammy-winning and three-time Emmy-winning composer Carlos Rafael Rivera (The Queen’s Gambit, Hacks).
paras.zh: Frost 成立于 100 多年前，以其创新的课程、屡获殊荣的师资队伍和对实际行业经验的关注而闻名。其媒体配乐和制作项目由新任命的系主任卡米洛·罗德里格斯 (Camilo Rodriguez) 领导，将作曲、编曲、数字音频制作和工作室实践经验与资深行业专业人士的指导相结合，包括格莱美奖得主和三届艾美奖得主作曲家卡洛斯·拉斐尔·里维拉 (Carlos Rafael Rivera)（《女王的弃兵》、《Hacks》）。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Pat Metheny (Grammy-winning musician); Ben Folds (musician)
paras.zh: 著名校友 Pat Metheny（格莱美获奖音乐家）；本·福尔兹（音乐家）

paras.en: NYU Steinhardt’s Screen Scoring program, operated out of the Department of Music & Performing Arts, was founded and is currently run by Ronald H. Sadoff, Ph.D. “Steinhardt’s Screen Scoring program trains screen composers to think of themselves as filmmakers and storytellers at the [bachelor’s, master’s] and Ph.D. levels,” Sadoff says. “Taking advantage of all that New York City offers, students collaborate on more than 500 projects each year with peers from film and media schools, including NYU Tisch Film and Television, the NYU Game Center and Columbia University’s film school.”
paras.zh: 纽约大学斯坦哈特分校的屏幕评分项目由音乐与表演艺术系运营，由 Ronald H. Sadoff 博士创立并目前负责管理。 “斯坦哈特的屏幕评分项目训练屏幕作曲家将自己视为[学士、硕士]和博士级别的电影制作人和故事讲述者，”萨多夫说。 “充分利用纽约市提供的一切，学生们每年与来自电影和媒体学院的同学合作开展 500 多个项目，其中包括纽约大学蒂施电影电视学院、纽约大学游戏中心和哥伦比亚大学电影学院。”

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Gavin Brivik (The Pitt); Ariel Marx (Dying for Sex)
paras.zh: 著名校友 Gavin Brivik（皮特报）；阿里尔·马克思（为性而死）

paras.en: CALIFORNIA INSTITUTE OF THE ARTS (CALARTS)
paras.zh: 加州艺术学院 (CALARTS)

paras.en: CalArts offers a bachelor of fine arts in music with a specialization in composition through its Music Composition and Experimental Sound Practices program, run by Michael Pisaro-Liu. The category includes film and media scoring, among other elements, but according to Pisaro-Liu, the school has plans to offer a minor in film and media scoring starting in 2027. “It’s an art school environment, all in one building, which means that the School of Music is housed right next to schools of Arts, and Film and Video, along with theater and what we call critical studies and dance,” Pisaro-Liu says. “So it’s an environment that is, in its very nature, multimedia or across media, and film music students are in classes with art majors, film majors, dance majors and so forth. Here, your cohorts are people who are going on to become animators and filmmakers. So that’s one thing about the CalArts environment that is different from other schools.”
paras.zh: 加州艺术学院通过迈克尔·皮萨罗-刘 (Michael Pisaro-Liu) 负责的音乐作曲和实验声音实践项目提供音乐美术学士学位，并专门从事作曲。该类别包括电影和媒体配乐等内容，但根据 Pisaro-Liu 的说法，学校计划从 2027 年开始辅修电影和媒体配乐。“这是一个艺术学校环境，全部在一栋大楼内，这意味着音乐学院就位于艺术学院、电影和视频学院、戏剧学院以及我们所谓的批判研究和舞蹈学院旁边，”Pisaro-Liu 说。 “所以，从本质上讲，这是一个多媒体或跨媒体的环境，电影音乐学生的班级有艺术专业、电影专业、舞蹈专业等等。在这里，你的同伴是那些将要成为动画师和电影制作人的人。所以这是加州艺术学院环境与其他学校不同的一点。”

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Michael Skloff (Friends); Raven Chacon (2022 Pulitzer winner)
paras.zh: 著名校友 Michael Skloff（朋友）； Raven Chacon（2022 年普利策奖得主）

paras.en: Located near Silicon Valley and California’s hub of video game production, SFCM’s Technology and Applied Composition (TAC) program offers bachelor of music, master of music and professional studies certificates with tracks in film scoring, game scoring and sound design. Students learn writing and producing music for live instruments, working with ensembles ranging from solo instrumentalists to small chamber sized. The ultimate goal is for students to work individually with film directors on short films, documentaries or longer-form narrative productions.
paras.zh: SFCM 的技术与应用作曲 (TAC) 项目位于硅谷和加利福尼亚州的视频游戏制作中心附近，提供音乐学士、音乐硕士和专业研究证书，包括电影配乐、游戏配乐和声音设计。学生学习为现场乐器创作和制作音乐，与从独奏乐器演奏家到小型室内乐团的合奏团合作。最终目标是让学生与电影导演单独合作制作短片、纪录片或较长的叙事作品。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI John Adams (composer/ conductor); Isaac Stern (violinist)
paras.zh: 著名校友约翰·亚当斯（作曲家/指挥）；艾萨克·斯特恩（小提琴家）

paras.en: COLLEGE OF CONTEMPORARY MUSIC/MUSICIANS INSTITUTE
paras.zh: 当代音乐学院/音乐家学院

paras.en: While established in 1977 as the Guitar Institute of Technology and promoted initially as a school for rock ‘n’ rollers, the Musicians Institute has leveraged its location in the heart of Hollywood to make it a popular destination for musicians and composers eager to break into the film industry. Director of performance studies Daniel Levin runs the school’s media and film scoring program, which offers a bachelor’s degree in the discipline. “It’s super comprehensive,” Levin says of the program. “Students study the full gamut of theory, ear training and counterpoint orchestration.” Students ultimately complete a capstone project where they record their compositions with a studio orchestra. “Not only do they compose it, but they have to set up the Pro Tools session, to prep all the music and conduct,” Levin says. “If they do everything that they need to do according to our program, they’re pretty well set to go out and succeed in the field.”
paras.zh: 音乐家学院成立于 1977 年，当时名为吉他技术学院，最初是一所摇滚乐学校，但音乐家学院利用其位于好莱坞中心的位置，使其成为渴望进入电影业的音乐家和作曲家的热门目的地。表演研究主任丹尼尔·莱文负责学校的媒体和电影评分项目，该项目提供该学科的学士学位。 “它非常全面，”莱文谈到该计划时说道。 “学生们学习全方位的理论、听力训练和对位配器。”学生最终完成一个顶点项目，与录音室管弦乐队一起录制他们的作品。 “他们不仅要作曲，还要设置 Pro Tools 会话，准备所有音乐和指挥，”Levin 说。 “如果他们按照我们的计划做了所有需要做的事情，那么他们就已经做好了走出去并在该领域取得成功的准备。”

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Cody Matthew Johnson (Star Wars Outlaws)
paras.zh: 著名校友科迪·马修·约翰逊（《星球大战：亡命之徒》）

paras.en: Located in the San Fernando Valley, Cal State Northridge is a friendly and tremendously affordable alternative to many of the area’s better-known schools, with a reputation for preparing students for practical careers. The school’s Mike Curb College of Arts, Media, and Communication offers a bachelor of music in commercial and media writing that combines classical and jazz orchestration with contemporary digital music production, MIDI sequencing and studio software in wide use by the industry. Says Kyle Simpson, D.M., associate professor of commercial media composition: “Our media composition students gain hands-on education and real-world experience in the film, TV and video game industries through a robust internship program where they work with professional composers and orchestrators. They also have opportunities to record their original scores with fellow CSUN students and L.A. studio professionals at some of the region’s most prestigious recording studios.”
paras.zh: 加州州立大学北岭分校位于圣费尔南多谷，与该地区许多知名学校相比，是一所友好且价格极其实惠的学校，以帮助学生为实际职业做好准备而闻名。该校的 Mike Curb 艺术、媒体和传播学院提供商业和媒体写作音乐学士学位，将古典和爵士乐编曲与当代数字音乐制作、MIDI 排序和业界广泛使用的工作室软件相结合。商业媒体作曲副教授凯尔·辛普森 (Kyle Simpson) 表示：“我们的媒体作曲学生通过强大的实习计划，获得了电影、电视和视频游戏行业的实践教育和现实经验。他们与专业作曲家和管弦乐家合作。他们还有机会与 CSUN 的同学和洛杉矶工作室专业人士一起在该地区一些最负盛名的录音室录制自己的原创乐谱。”

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Diane Warren (multiple Oscar-nominated songwriter); Pinar Toprak (Captain Marvel)
paras.zh: 著名校友黛安·沃伦（多次获得奥斯卡提名的词曲作者）；皮纳尔·托普拉克（惊奇队长）

paras.en: UNT teaches visual media scoring and composition through its Division of Composition Studies in the College of Music and its Department of Media Arts. Music Composition & Media Scoring features a Master of Arts in music composition with a specialized media composition track, in addition to general computer music and interdisciplinary paths. Composition majors collaborate with student filmmakers and instrumental ensembles and present original compositions through workshops, reading sessions and the Spectrum concert series. Students also can work with cable TV station ntTV and radio station KNTU-FM on audio production, sound design and screen media.
paras.zh: UNT 通过音乐学院的作曲研究部门和媒体艺术系教授视觉媒体配乐和作曲。音乐作曲和媒体评分除了一般计算机音乐和跨学科路径之外，还设有音乐作曲文学硕士学位，并具有专门的媒体作曲轨道。作曲专业的学生与学生电影制作人和器乐合奏团合作，通过研讨会、阅读会和 Spectrum 音乐会系列来呈现原创作品。学生还可以与有线电视台 ntTV 和广播电台 KNTU-FM 合作进行音频制作、声音设计和屏幕媒体工作。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Norah Jones (Grammy-winning musician); Don Henley (The Eagles)
paras.zh: 著名校友诺拉·琼斯（格莱美获奖音乐家）；唐·亨利（老鹰队）

articles.title: Soho House Creator Nick Jones Is Reinventing the Hotel — Again
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: “London didn’t need another hotel,” says Nick Jones, as we watch the Thames flow by St. Clement, his latest argument that perhaps it did. “But I think we’ve cut through here by doing things differently.”
paras.zh: “伦敦不需要另一家酒店，”当我们看着泰晤士河流经圣克莱门特时，尼克·琼斯说道，他最新的论点是，也许伦敦确实需要另一家酒店。 “但我认为我们通过采取不同的做法已经突破了这一困境。”

paras.en: It’s a familiar claim in luxury hospitality, but Jones has form. In 1995, he opened the original Soho House in the city’s creative district, pioneering a shabby-luxury aesthetic that became a blueprint for members’ clubs worldwide. Since he stepped down as CEO in 2022, the empire he built has weathered headlines about overcrowding, declining service and the difficulty of securing tables. But whatever its fortunes today, Jones transformed London’s social scene once. Can he do it again?
paras.zh: 这是豪华酒店业中常见的说法，但琼斯有自己的风格。 1995 年，他在这座城市的创意区开设了最初的 Soho House，开创了一种破旧的奢华美学，成为全球会员俱乐部的蓝图。自 2022 年辞去首席执行官职务以来，他建立的帝国一直饱受有关过度拥挤、服务下降和抢座困难等头条新闻的影响。但无论今天的命运如何，琼斯曾经改变了伦敦的社交场景。他还能再做一次吗？

paras.en: The buzz around St. Clement has been deafening, even before its official September launch. In July, the Rolling Stones hosted an album launch in the penthouse upstairs. A crowd of 100 or so VIPs — including Daniel Craig and Sacha Baron Cohen — pogoed to “You Can’t Always Get What You Want” before drinking cocktails on a balcony with a panorama spanning Big Ben to The Shard. There was a drone show.
paras.zh: 甚至在 9 月份正式推出之前，圣克莱门特周围的喧嚣就已经震耳欲聋。七月，滚石乐队在楼上的顶层公寓举办了专辑发布会。包括丹尼尔·克雷格 (Daniel Craig) 和萨莎·拜伦·科恩 (Sacha Baron Cohen) 在内的大约 100 名贵宾在阳台上一边喝着鸡尾酒，一边欣赏着从大本钟到碎片大厦的全景，听着《你不可能总是得到你想要的》(You Can’t Always Get What You Want)。有无人机表演。

paras.en: The Serpentine Summer Party — a highlight of London’s arts scene calendar every year — had an afterparty here. Over London Fashion Week, Burberry pitched up for an official dinner. Paul Mescal and Stanley Tucci have both been spotted hanging out, and the gastronomic grandees have begun their descent too. As I tuck into a plate of freshly made pappardelle with a silky veal ragù in Café Clement ($40), I spot Financial Times critic Jay Rayner — irascible scourge of London chefs since the Soho House heyday — arching an eyebrow over the menu. Scrutiny will pick up considerably when Lunette, a rooftop restaurant helmed by Florence Knight in her first venture since Sessions Arts Club, opens in the fall.
paras.zh: 每年伦敦艺术界日历上的一大亮点——蛇形夏日派对在这里举办了一场余兴派对。伦敦时装周期间，博柏利 (Burberry) 积极争取举办官方晚宴。保罗·麦斯卡 (Paul Mescal) 和斯坦利·图奇 (Stanley Tucci) 都被发现在闲逛，两位美食大亨也开始崭露头角。当我在克莱门特咖啡馆 (Café Clement) 享用一盘新鲜制作的宽面条和柔滑的小牛肉酱（售价 40 美元）时，我发现英国《金融时报》评论家杰伊·雷纳（Jay Rayner）——自 Soho House 鼎盛时期以来伦敦厨师的暴躁祸害——对着菜单皱起了眉头。 Lunette 是一家屋顶餐厅，由 Florence Knight 掌舵，这是她继 Sessions Arts Club 之后的第一家餐厅，将于秋季开业，届时，人们的关注度将会大幅提高。

paras.en: The determination to be — as Jones puts it — “faff-free” is evident the moment you walk through the door of St. Clement. In the lobby, you’re immediately lulled by a hit of scented candle, a bespoke creation by Perfumer H. Massive tomes on Basquiat are piled by a crackling fire. Conspicuously absent is any kind of formal check-in. “Everything is done in advance on WhatsApp,” explains relationships director Serena Lightner, previously of Chiltern Firehouse. “You’re welcomed, given your key and brought straight to your room.” No stiff wait by a mahogany desk; no jet-lagged fumbling for your credit card. Rates range from $934 per night for a standard room to $5,765 for the Central River Loft.
paras.zh: 正如琼斯所说，当你走进圣克莱门特的大门的那一刻，“远离麻烦”的决心就显而易见了。在大厅里，你会立即被调香师 H 定制的香薰蜡烛所催眠。巴斯奎特的巨著被堆放在噼啪作响的火堆旁。明显缺乏任何形式的正式登记。 “一切都在 WhatsApp 上提前完成，”曾供职于 Chiltern Firehouse 的关系总监 Serena Lightner 解释道。 “我们非常欢迎您，我们会给您钥匙，并直接带您到您的房间。”无需在红木办公桌前苦苦等待；无需因时差而摸索信用卡。价格从标准间每晚 934 美元到中央河阁楼每晚 5,765 美元不等。

paras.en: Through a discreet door is Bobbi’s Bar, the hotel’s naughty corner. Here the exposed concrete and warm, if unexciting, shades of the rooms and corridors give way to dark wood paneling, glowering lamps and conspiratorial nooks and crannies, including a daybed. “I took out all the things that annoy me about hotels,” is how Jones describes his approach to St. Clement; this must have included not being able to get a nightcap, because Bobbi’s enjoys a rare 3 a.m. license. Rumors of impromptu piano sing-alongs suggest St. Clement has taken some inspiration from the vibiest London opening of last year — Guinness pilgrimage spot The Devonshire, over in Soho.
paras.zh: 穿过一扇不起眼的门就是芭比酒吧（Bobbi’s Bar），这是酒店的顽皮角落。在这里，房间和走廊的裸露混凝土和温暖（尽管平淡无奇）的色调被深色木镶板、耀眼的灯光和阴谋的角落和缝隙（包括一张沙发床）所取代。 “我去掉了酒店里所有让我烦恼的东西，”琼斯这样描述他对圣克莱门特的态度。这肯定包括无法获得睡前饮料，因为博比拥有罕见的凌晨 3 点许可证。关于即兴钢琴伴奏的传言表明，圣克莱门特从去年伦敦最热闹的开幕式——位于苏活区的吉尼斯朝圣地德文郡获得了一些灵感。

paras.en: Just down the road is the Corner Shop. Another Jones creation, it’s an achingly hip deli-cum-café-cum-wine bar, with menu items handwritten on brown paper bags and artful arrangements of pomegranates and walnuts next to some tea bags with a price tag of $20. I’d never been to a café where patrons do the meerkat move you see at parties — looking over each other’s shoulders in case someone more impressive can be spotted — but this is meerkat manor.
paras.zh: 沿着路走下去就是街角商店。这是琼斯的又一作品，它是一家极其时尚的熟食店兼​​咖啡馆兼酒吧，菜单项手写在棕色纸袋上，石榴和核桃巧妙地排列在一些茶包旁边，标价为 20 美元。我从来没有去过一家咖啡馆，那里的顾客会做出聚会上看到的猫鼬动作——互相看着对方的肩膀，以防发现更令人印象深刻的人——但这就是猫鼬庄园。

paras.en: “The staff are very relaxed,” Jones tells me — this is true, a waiter welcomes me with a gesture not far from a shoulder rub — “I want [St. Clement] to feel like home for people coming from New York and L.A.” With a 24-hour health club and spa — including a 25-meter pool flowing parallel to the Thames outside — due to open next year, there’s no doubt people traveling in and out of the city will find it a convenient as well as cool-to-be-seen-at spot. For now, Jones insists there are no plans to expand beyond the neighborhood. “The great thing is there’s only one hotel,” he says with a grin. “I can know everyone by name.”
paras.zh: “工作人员非常放松，”琼斯告诉我——这是事实，一位服务员用不远处的肩膀按摩的手势欢迎我——“我希望[圣克莱门特]给来自纽约和洛杉矶的人们带来家的感觉。” 24 小时健身俱乐部和水疗中心（包括与室外泰晤士河平行的 25 米长泳池）将于明年开放，毫无疑问，进出这座城市的人们会发现这里是一个方便且凉爽的地方。琼斯坚称，目前还没有计划将业务扩展到该社区以外的地区。 “最棒的是只有一家酒店，”他笑着说。 “我可以叫出每个人的名字。”

articles.title: 'We slept here': Flight delays linger but schedule is back on track for Monday

paras.en: U.S. flights are set to run close to normal on Monday as airlines scramble to get back on track after the Federal Aviation Administration grounded departures nationwide for more than four hours on Friday.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局周五将全国航班停飞四个多小时后，各航空公司都在争相恢复正轨，周一美国航班的运行将接近正常。

paras.en: Disruptions lingered on Sunday, but passengers were getting on their way.
paras.zh: 周日，混乱依然存在，但乘客们仍在继续上路。

paras.en: More than 1,600 U.S. flights there were canceled as of noon ET and more than 4,000 were delayed, according to FlightAware data. That was far fewer than the almost 6,700 cancellations on Saturday and more than 9,200 on Sunday when the FAA halted all departures into U.S. airports.
paras.zh: 根据 FlightAware 的数据，截至美国东部时间中午，已有 1,600 多个美国航班取消，4,000 多个航班延误。这远远少于周六取消的近 6,700 架航班以及周日 FAA 停止飞往美国机场的所有航班的 9,200 多架航班。

paras.en: "We slept here," said Beth Martin, who was trying to travel home to Birmingham, Alabama, from New York's LaGuardia Airport on Sunday at the end of her daughter's birthday trip. They were booked for Saturday night, and when delay announcements started rolling in from Delta Air Lines, they decided to make good use of the extra time: after strolling through Central Park, they went window shopping on Fifth Avenue.
paras.zh: “我们睡在这里，”贝丝·马丁说，周日，她女儿的生日旅行结束后，她正试图从纽约拉瓜迪亚机场返回阿拉巴马州伯明翰的家。他们预订了周六晚上的航班，当达美航空开始发布延误通知时，他们决定充分利用额外的时间：漫步穿过中央公园后，他们去第五大道橱窗购物。

paras.en: But when the flight was canceled, the standby list on a backup flight looked grim, and their original midtown hotel was charging about $700 for an additional night, the two of them slept at LaGuardia on Saturday. She said they found wheelchairs to sleep in outside security.
paras.zh: 但当航班取消后，备用航班的候补名单显得严峻，而他们原来的市中心酒店又要多收一晚约 700 美元，周六两人就睡在拉瓜迪亚机场。她说他们在外面的保安处找到了可以睡觉的轮椅。

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy on Saturday tied the issue to a router and work to update from copper wires, a system overseen by L3Harris Technologies, to a fiber-optic system. FAA administrator Bryan Bedford said the upgrades were part of "routine" maintenance to switch over to fiber optic.
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 周六将此问题与路由器联系起来，并努力将由 L3Harris Technologies 监管的铜线系统更新为光纤系统。美国联邦航空局局长布莱恩·贝德福德表示，升级是切换到光纤的“例行”维护的一部分。

paras.en: "We are supporting the FAA in its investigation to understand the conditions that led to the Nov. 13 ground stop of our nation's air travel," L3Harris said in a statement Saturday afternoon.
paras.zh: L3Harris 在周六下午的一份声明中表示：“我们正在支持 FAA 进行调查，以了解导致我国航空旅行于 11 月 13 日地面停止的原因。”

paras.en: Airlines waived change fees and fare differences and offered pilots and flight attendants extra pay to ease the delays.
paras.zh: 航空公司免除了改签费和票价差额，并向飞行员和空乘人员提供额外报酬以缓解延误。

paras.en: Customers told CNBC they were booked on several flights before getting on board.
paras.zh: 乘客告诉 CNBC，他们在登机前已经预订了几趟航班。

paras.en: Justine Fritz, who works in sales for a consumer goods company, was in New York for a business event on Friday. She tried five different flights before getting on a flight to Houston, then flew four hours out of her way to get back to Minneapolis after her Saturday flight was canceled. Fritz said she had so many boarding passes that TSA wouldn't let her through security at first.
paras.zh: 贾斯汀·弗里茨（Justine Fritz）在一家消费品公司从事销售工作，她周五在纽约参加一个商业活动。在登上飞往休斯顿的航班之前，她尝试了五次不同的航班，然后在周六的航班取消后，又飞了四个小时回到明尼阿波利斯。弗里茨说，她有太多登机牌，以至于运输安全管理局一开始不让她通过安检。

paras.en: "It's been bananas," she told CNBC at the gate. Fritz said she made the best of it by shopping and getting a haircut, but she's still disappointed.
paras.zh: “这就是香蕉，”她在门口告诉 CNBC。弗里茨说，她通过购物和理发充分利用了这一点，但她仍然感到失望。

paras.en: "I'm missing the first hour of the Vikings game," she said.
paras.zh: “我错过了维京人队比赛的第一个小时，”她说。

paras.en: Martin said her trip home with her daughter will take even longer. Delta booked them to Memphis, and her husband will drive the four hours from Birmingham to pick them up.
paras.zh: 马丁说她和女儿回家的时间会更长。达美航空为他们预订了飞往孟菲斯的航班，她的丈夫将从伯明翰开车四个小时来接他们。

paras.en: Shortly after the groundstop, the longest since 9/11, Duffy pushed Congress for as much as $50 billion for upgrades to the aging U.S. air traffic control system. A day later, Democratic lawmakers pushed back, citing unspent money from existing funding, which includes Congress's approval last year of $12.5 billion for airport and air traffic control improvements over five years.
paras.zh: 停地后不久，这是自 9/11 以来持续时间最长的一次，达菲敦促国会拨款 500 亿美元，用于升级老化的美国空中交通管制系统。一天后，民主党立法者以现有资金中未使用的资金为由进行反击，其中包括国会去年批准的五年内用于改善机场和空中交通管制的 125 亿美元资金。

paras.en: "Our committee, on behalf of the flying public, will hold the administration accountable for what happened to make sure this chaos does not happen again," said Reps. Rick Larsen (D.-Wash.), ranking member of the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure, and Rep. Andre Carson (D.-Ind.), ranking member of the aviation subcommittee, said in a joint statement.
paras.zh: 众议院交通和基础设施委员会高级成员众议员里克·拉森（华盛顿州民主党人）和航空小组委员会高级成员众议员安德烈·卡森（印第安纳州民主党人）在一份联合声明中表示：“我们的委员会代表飞行公众，将要求政府对所发生的事情负责，以确保这种混乱不再发生。”

articles.title: Fed 'has some work to do on inflation,' Kansas City Fed chief says

paras.en: The Federal Reserve has the tools and responsibility to address price pressures that are "running too hot," and the central bank "has some work to do on inflation," Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid said Sunday.
paras.zh: 堪萨斯城联储主席杰夫施密德周日表示，美联储有工具和责任来解决“过热”的价格压力，并且央行“在应对通胀方面还有一些工作要做”。

paras.en: Schmid, speaking to a credit union conference in Hawaii, did not specifically call for additional rate hikes, but said inflation is "uncomfortably above the 2% price stability target, and moving in the wrong direction."
paras.zh: 施密德在夏威夷举行的信用合作社会议上发表讲话时，没有特别呼吁进一步加息，但表示通胀“令人不安地高于 2% 的价格稳定目标，并且正在朝着错误的方向发展”。

paras.en: Common narratives that have recently evolved around the nature of current inflation and the Fed's ability to contain it are off-base, Schmid said.
paras.zh: 施密德表示，最近围绕当前通胀的性质和美联储遏制通胀的能力而出现的常见说法是错误的。

paras.en: First, Schmid said, the view that high inflation is a reflection of repeated supply shocks neglects that "inflation is always the result of an imbalance between supply and demand. It is in the context of strong demand that a disruption to supply drives up prices. Demand always plays a role in inflation, and the Fed, through its influence on demand, always has the tools and responsibility to address inflation."
paras.zh: 首先，施密德表示，认为高通胀是反复供给冲击的反映的观点忽视了“通胀始终是供需失衡的结果。正是在需求强劲的背景下，供给中断才会推高价格。需求总是在通胀中发挥作用，而美联储通过对需求的影响，始终拥有应对通胀的工具和责任。”

paras.en: Schmid, who is not a Federal Open Market Committee voting member this year, said he also disagrees with the narrative that the sources of demand-induced inflation right now — like the artificial intelligence buildout — are resistant to Fed policy.
paras.zh: 施密德今年不是联邦公开市场委员会的投票成员，他表示，他也不同意目前由需求引发的通胀的来源——比如人工智能的扩张——对美联储政策有抵抗力的说法。

paras.en: The Fed raised rates by a quarter-percentage point in September to 3.75%-4.00% but opted not to lift them again at last month's meeting.
paras.zh: 美联储9月份将利率提高25个百分点至3.75%-4.00%，但在上个月的会议上选择不再加息。

paras.en: After recent inflation readings came in higher than expected and comments from other Fed officials, including influential Governor Christopher Waller, interest rate futures markets are now fully priced for a quarter-point increase at December's meeting, with a small probability of a half-point hike.
paras.zh: 在最近的通胀数据高于预期以及包括颇具影响力的行长克里斯托弗·沃勒(Christopher Waller)在内的其他美联储官员发表评论后，利率期货市场现已完全定价为12月会议上加息25个基点，加息0.5个基点的可能性很小。

paras.en: "I would also push back on the idea that meeting our inflation objective requires a reaction from any particular set of prices, for example prices for AI-related technology goods," Schmid said.
paras.zh: 施密德表示：“我也会反驳这样的观点，即实现我们的通胀目标需要任何特定价格组合的反应，例如人工智能相关技术产品的价格。”

paras.en: "Both narratives — that inflation is being driven by either supply shocks or by demand that is impervious to higher interest rates — have a common core," Schmid said. "Mainly, that inflation is somehow beyond the Fed's power to control. I don't believe this to be true. The Fed does have the tools to address inflation and has the responsibility to achieve price stability. As Chairman (Kevin) Warsh said, we have work to do."
paras.zh: 施密德表示：“两种说法——通胀要么是由供应冲击驱动，要么是由不受利率上升影响的需求驱动——有一个共同的核心。” “主要是，通胀在某种程度上超出了美联储的控制能力。我不相信这是真的。美联储确实有解决通胀的工具，并且有责任实现价格稳定。正如主席（凯文）沃什所说，我们还有工作要做。”

paras.en: On Saturday, Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said she supported a steady pace of modest interest rate increases because that path of action better manages economic uncertainties.
paras.zh: 周六，波士顿联邦储备银行行长苏珊·柯林斯表示，她支持稳步适度加息，因为这种行动路径可以更好地管理经济不确定性。

paras.en: When it comes to moving monetary policy to a tighter footing, "a steady, gradual path seems appropriate to me at the moment. But I'm open-minded," Collins told reporters at a conference held by her bank on housing issues in Boston.
paras.zh: 当谈到收紧货币政策时，“目前看来，一条稳定、渐进的道路对我来说是合适的。但我持开放态度，”柯林斯在她的银行在波士顿举行的住房问题会议上对记者表示。

paras.en: "I do see the risks as two-sided on the real side of the economy," Collins said, with inflation high and gains broadening throughout the economy, while the job market was stable and could accelerate.
paras.zh: 柯林斯表示，“我确实认为经济实体方面的风险是双向的”，通胀高企，整个经济的收益扩大，而就业市场稳定并可能加速。

paras.en: At the same time, Collins said, there are ongoing risks of more shocks hitting the economy. Furthermore, "it's possible that the rise in medium to longer term rates that we've seen since the beginning of the year may actually weigh on demand more than I'm thinking," and serve as another source of restraint on economic activity, she said.
paras.zh: 与此同时，柯林斯表示，经济面临更多冲击的风险持续存在。此外，“自今年年初以来，我们看到的中长期利率上升实际上对需求的压力可能比我想象的更大”，并成为限制经济活动的另一个来源，她说。

paras.en: For now, all of that argues against the Fed shifting to a more aggressive pace of rate rises to contain inflation that has overshot the Fed's 2% target for more than five years, Collins said.
paras.zh: 柯林斯表示，目前，所有这些都反对美联储采取更激进的加息步伐来遏制通胀，通胀已经超过美联储2%的目标五年多了。

paras.en: Collins cautioned that her expectation that the Fed can move gradually "doesn't necessarily mean a particular cadence." She also reiterated that the data flow from recent months has shifted, where the Fed could end up in its current tightening cycle.
paras.zh: 柯林斯警告说，她对美联储可以逐步采取行动的预期“并不一定意味着特定的节奏”。她还重申，近几个月的数据流已经发生变化，美联储可能最终进入当前的紧缩周期。

paras.en: "I do think that the price data we've seen over the past three months — and the labor market on a stronger footing — does make me think that the path of policy rates over the, you know, next year might be a bit higher than I had thought a couple of months ago," Collins said.
paras.zh: 柯林斯表示：“我确实认为，过去三个月我们看到的价格数据，以及基础更强劲的劳动力市场，确实让我认为，明年的政策利率走势可能会比我几个月前的预期要高一些。”

articles.title: Anti-Houthi forces retreat in Yemen as Iran strikes Bahrain in attack on U.S. base

paras.en: Iran and its allies ramped up pressure on the U.S. and allied Gulf states on two fronts on Sunday, with Saudi-backed forces retreating in their battle against the Iran-aligned Houthis in Yemen and Iran itself firing drones at U.S. bases in Bahrain.
paras.zh: 周日，伊朗及其盟国在两条战线上加大了对美国和海湾盟国的压力，沙特支持的部队在也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装的战斗中撤退，而伊朗则向巴林的美国基地发射无人机。

paras.en: In Yemen, Saudi Arabia's campaign against the Houthis suffered a major setback, as its allies, fighting on behalf of the internationally recognized Yemeni government, pulled back from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to defend their temporary capital Aden on the southern coast.
paras.zh: 在也门，沙特阿拉伯打击胡塞武装的行动遭受重大挫折，其代表国际公认的也门政府作战的盟友从曼德海峡撤军，以保卫其南部海岸的临时首都亚丁。

paras.en: The announcement signaled the apparent end of a six-week government counteroffensive to drive the Houthis from the mouth of the Red Sea to secure a key oil route.
paras.zh: 这一宣布标志着政府为期六周的反攻明显结束，该反攻将胡塞武装赶出红海口，以确保一条重要的石油路线。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Iranian attacks on Bahrain, headquarters of the U.S. Fifth Fleet in the Gulf, were likely to put new pressure on U.S. President Donald Trump to resolve the war he launched nearly nine months ago.
paras.zh: 与此同时，伊朗对美国第五舰队驻海湾总部巴林的袭击可能会给美国总统唐纳德·特朗普带来新的压力，要求他解决近九个月前发动的战争。

paras.en: Since the unpopular war contributed to a defeat for his Republicans in midterm elections this month, Trump has played down the need for a diplomatic breakthrough.
paras.zh: 由于这场不受欢迎的战争导致共和党在本月的中期选举中失利，特朗普淡化了外交突破的必要性。

paras.en: Major warfare between the U.S. and Iran has calmed since the early phase of the conflict, but with diplomacy stalled there is little immediate prospect of a resolution either to the wider conflict or the war in Yemen.
paras.zh: 自冲突初期以来，美国和伊朗之间的主要战争已经平息，但由于外交陷入停滞，解决更广泛的冲突或也门战争的可能性不大。

paras.en: Sunday's announcement of a Yemeni government retreat raises the prospect of new Houthi advances towards Aden on the southern coast, base of the internationally recognized government since the Houthis drove it from the capital Sanaa more than a decade ago.
paras.zh: 也门政府周日宣布撤退，这增加了胡塞武装向南部海岸的亚丁进军的可能性，自十多年前胡塞武装将其从首都萨那赶出以来，亚丁一直是国际公认的政府基地。

paras.en: "The Southern Armed Forces announce the implementation of a redeployment operation for its forces from Dhubab Airport and the Bab el-Mandeb area, west of Taiz Governorate," the main military force fighting for Yemen's government in the south of the country said in a statement.
paras.zh: 在该国南部为也门政府作战的主要军事力量在一份声明中表示，“南方武装部队宣布从杜巴布机场和塔伊兹省以西的曼德布地区实施重新部署行动。”

paras.en: "This step is taken based on the priority of securing the capital, Aden, and the neighboring governorates, as well as strengthening the front lines and addressing existing threats."
paras.zh: “采取这一步骤是基于确保首都亚丁和邻近省份的安全，以及加强前线和应对现有威胁的优先考虑。”

paras.en: There was no immediate response from the Houthis or from Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装或沙特阿拉伯没有立即做出回应。

paras.en: The retreat signals a setback for efforts to reverse rapid gains the Houthis made in September to capture the coast along the Red Sea and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait that controls access to it.
paras.zh: 这次撤退标志着扭转胡塞武装9月迅速夺取红海沿岸和控制红海通道的曼德海峡的努力遭遇挫折。

paras.en: A Saudi-backed government offensive last month retook key positions around the strait but failed to drive the Houthis entirely away from the area or retake the city of al-Mocha further up the coast.
paras.zh: 上个月，沙特支持的政府攻势夺回了海峡周围的关键阵地，但未能将胡塞武装完全赶出该地区，也未能夺回沿海地区的摩卡市。

paras.en: The Houthis have responded by intensifying drone and missile attacks on Saudi Arabia, grounding flights with strikes on its main airports as well as setting global oil markets on edge by targeting energy facilities.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装的回应是加强对沙特阿拉伯的无人机和导弹袭击，袭击其主要机场并导致航班停飞，并以能源设施为目标，导致全球石油市场紧张。

paras.en: On Sunday, the militant group said it attacked the King Khalid International Airport and a financial center in Riyadh and two pumping stations on the East-West oil pipeline.
paras.zh: 周日，该武装组织表示，它袭击了哈立德国王国际机场、利雅得的一个金融中心以及东西石油管道上的两个泵站。

paras.en: There was no immediate Saudi confirmation.
paras.zh: 沙特没有立即证实这一消息。

paras.en: With the conflict in the Middle East disrupting oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz, Riyadh has rerouted about 4 million barrels per day of crude via the East-West Pipeline to Yanbu, equivalent to about 4% of global supply.
paras.zh: 由于中东冲突扰乱了霍尔木兹海峡的石油流动，利雅得已将每天约400万桶原油通过东西管道改道至延布，相当于全球供应量的约4%。

paras.en: Yemeni military sources said government forces around the Bab el-Mandeb had redeployed to al-Suqyah, 150 km (95 miles) west of Aden, though they were still trying to push the Houthis from nearby coastal areas.
paras.zh: 也门军方消息人士称，曼德门周围的政府军已重新部署到亚丁以西150公里（95英里）的al-Suqyah，尽管他们仍在努力将胡塞武装从附近沿海地区赶走。

paras.en: In the highlands north of Aden, where the Houthis have besieged Yemen's third-largest city, Taiz, the fighters are now positioned just outside the district of Tur al-Bahah, about 80 km (50 miles) from the city, the sources said.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，在亚丁以北的高地，胡塞武装包围了也门第三大城市塔伊兹，武装分子目前驻扎在图尔巴哈区外，距离该市约 80 公里（50 英里）。

paras.en: Humanitarian conditions are worsening in Taiz, which hosts about half of the 300,000 people displaced across Yemen by the latest fighting. Aid supplies cannot enter, and civilians cannot leave.
paras.zh: 塔伊兹的人道主义状况正在恶化，也门因最近的战斗而流离失所的 30 万人中约有一半居住在该地。援助物资无法进入，平民也无法离开。

paras.en: Fresh Iranian strikes on Bahrain, home to U.S. bases, could undermine Trump's desire to turn the page on the war following his Republicans' midterm election rout.
paras.zh: 伊朗对美国基地所在地巴林的新一轮袭击可能会削弱特朗普在共和党中期选举惨败后翻开战争新页的愿望。

paras.en: Trump has said in recent days that he might hold off from attacking Iran if the US faces no new provocations from either Tehran or the Houthis in Yemen, although he would maintain a US naval blockade on Iran, Reuters reported on Saturday.
paras.zh: 据路透社周六报道，特朗普最近几天表示，如果美国没有面临来自德黑兰或也门胡塞武装的新挑衅，他可能会推迟攻击伊朗，不过他将维持美国对伊朗的海上封锁。

paras.en: Bahrain said it intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks, the first such interceptions by its air defenses since September.
paras.zh: 巴林表示，它拦截并摧毁了伊朗的几次空袭，这是自去年9月以来巴林防空系统首次进行此类拦截。

paras.en: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said it had attacked a U.S. military base in Bahrain with six drones in retaliation for "hostile U.S. actions," Iran's Fars news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据伊朗法尔斯通讯社报道，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，他们用六架无人机袭击了巴林的一个美国军事基地，以报复“美国的敌对行动”。

paras.en: During a brief alert, Bahrain urged citizens and residents to remain calm and proceed to the nearest safe location.
paras.zh: 在短暂的警报中，巴林敦促公民和居民保持冷静，前往最近的安全地点。

paras.en: Two days earlier, the Revolutionary Guards said they had attacked a U.S. early-warning radar facility in Bahrain. The U.S. military denied this, saying it had intercepted two Iranian drones without any damage.
paras.zh: 两天前，革命卫队表示，他们袭击了美国在巴林的预警雷达设施。美国军方否认了这一说法，称其拦截了两架伊朗无人机，没有造成任何损坏。

paras.en: Crude oil has been flowing out of the Gulf in recent weeks at near pre-war levels. But attacks on ships have become a daily hazard, keeping markets jittery and prices still elevated.
paras.zh: 最近几周，原油一直以接近战前的水平流出海湾。但船只遭到袭击已成为日常危险，导致市场紧张不安，价格仍然居高不下。

paras.en: The Revolutionary Guards said two tankers were on fire on Sunday after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Reuters could not independently verify the report. The Guards typically do not acknowledge attacking ships in the strait but say it is unsafe to transit it without their permission.
paras.zh: 革命卫队表示，周日，两艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷后起火。路透社无法独立核实该报道。卫兵通常不会承认海峡内有攻击船只，但表示未经他们许可通过该海峡是不安全的。

paras.en: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi will visit Oman on Tuesday, which holds the southern coast of the Strait of Hormuz and has played a role as a mediator in the crisis, for talks with his counterpart, Iranian state media reported.
paras.zh: 据伊朗官方媒体报道，伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉奇将于周二访问阿曼，该国拥有霍尔木兹海峡南岸，并在危机中发挥了调解人的作用，并与伊朗外长进行会谈。

articles.title: Can SpaceX catch its Starship?

paras.en: SpaceX’s Starship, the largest and most ambitious rocket ever built, has finished its most consequential test yet with a historic catch.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的 Starship 是有史以来最大、最雄心勃勃的火箭，已经完成了迄今为止最重要的测试，并获得了历史性的成果。

paras.en: Elon Musk says the enormous two-stage vehicle will someday carry humans to the moon and Mars, but more immediately, Starship is central to the company’s plan to build out its Starlink satellite Internet constellation (not to mention its aim to pack a million data center satellites into orbit around Earth). But first SpaceX must show Starship can deliver on its most transformative and critical promise: full reusability.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，这种巨大的两级飞行器有一天将载人前往月球和火星，但更直接的是，Starship 是该公司建设 Starlink 卫星互联网星座计划的核心（更不用说其目标是将 100 万颗数据中心卫星送入地球轨道）。但首先 SpaceX 必须证明 Starship 能够兑现其最具变革性和最关键的承诺：完全可重复使用。

paras.en: That’s why this latest test, Flight 15, is so consequential. The Starship orbiter—officially named “Ship 42”—lifted off atop its Super Heavy booster at 5:47 P.M. EST on November 13 from the company’s Starbase site in South Texas. This test flight had a deceptively simple goal: getting Ship 42 into orbit and then returning both it and the booster back to Earth intact and essentially ready to fly again.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么这次最新的 Flight 15 测试如此重要。星舰轨道飞行器——正式名称为“Ship 42”——于下午 5:47 在其超重型助推器上升空。美国东部时间 11 月 13 日，该公司位于德克萨斯州南部的 Starbase 站点。这次试飞的目标看似简单：将 42 号飞船送入轨道，然后将其和助推器完好无损地送回地球，基本上准备好再次飞行。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: What that involves is the booster and orbiter separately reentering Earth’s atmosphere and flying back to Starbase, where the launch tower, fitted with enormous mechanical arms, can catch them. SpaceX had previously shown it can pluck the Super Heavy from the air in previous tests. But Flight 15 was the first attempt to catch the orbiter itself.
paras.zh: 这涉及到助推器和轨道飞行器分别重新进入地球大气层并飞回星际基地，在那里装有巨大机械臂的发射塔可以捕获它们。 SpaceX 此前曾在之前的测试中展示过它可以从空中捕获超重型火箭。但 15 号航班是第一次尝试捕捉轨道飞行器本身。

paras.en: After spending nearly a full day in space and circling Earth some 14 times, Ship 42 began its homecoming, firing its engines just after 3:30 P.M. EST on November 14 to deorbit and fly back to Starbase.
paras.zh: 在太空中度过了近一整天并绕地球飞行约 14 圈后，42 号飞船开始返航，在下午 3:30 左右启动了发动机。美国东部时间 11 月 14 日脱离轨道并飞回 Starbase。

paras.en: The fateful moment came with Starship’s final landing burn at 4:20 P.M as it plunged through the atmosphere. Seconds later, the orbiter performed a “belly flop” maneuver, turning end-over-end and swiveling its fiery engine plumes downward to slow and slide precisely between the awaiting giant arms. They swung closed around the midair vehicle, like chopsticks snatching the world’s largest eggroll.
paras.zh: 下午 4 点 20 分，星舰坠入大气层时最后一次着陆燃烧，这一决定性的时刻到来了。几秒钟后，轨道飞行器进行了一次“腹部翻转”动作，翻了个身，向下旋转其炽热的发动机羽流，以减速并精确地在等待的巨大手臂之间滑动。它们围绕着空中飞行器旋转，就像筷子抢走了世界上最大的蛋卷一样。

paras.en: With Starship, SpaceX has now achieved another world first, something no orbital-class rocket has done before: Bringing it back home and catching it one piece.
paras.zh: 凭借 Starship，SpaceX 现在又实现了另一个世界第一，这是以前没有轨道级火箭做过的事情：将它带回家并接住它。

paras.en: The mission began with the ignition of the 33 engines on Starship’s Super Heavy booster, which propelled the spacecraft toward orbit before the two vehicles separated. The booster was then expected to return to Starbase about six and a half minutes after liftoff for a precision catch by the tower’s awaiting mechanical arms, but instead diverted into an offshore splashdown after trouble with some of its engines.
paras.zh: 该任务从星舰超重型助推器上的 33 个发动机点火开始，在两艘飞行器分离之前将航天器推向轨道。随后，助推器预计将在升空后约六分半钟返回星际基地，并由塔上等待的机械臂精确捕捉，但在其一些发动机出现故障后，助推器转入海上溅落。

paras.en: “Slight underperformance of engines on this flight is the reason” for Super Heavy’s diversion, Musk said in an X post on Sunday, about four hours before the orbiter’s planned return.
paras.zh: 周日，距离轨道器计划返回大约四个小时，马斯克在 X 帖子中表示，“这次飞行中发动机的轻微性能不佳是超重型改道的原因”。

paras.en: Meanwhile Starship itself continued into orbit and successfully deployed 26 next-generation satellites for Starlink, SpaceX’s fast-growing Internet business. Once it’s fully operational, Starship will be able to loft Starlink satellites in far larger and more frequent batches than the firm’s retiring workhorse rocket, the Falcon 9. That will pave the way for the company’s plans to supplement Starlink with the launch of huge numbers of orbital data centers for artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Starship 本身继续进入轨道，并成功为 SpaceX 快速增长的互联网业务 Starlink 部署了 26 颗下一代卫星。一旦全面投入运营，Starship 将能够以比该公司退役的主力火箭猎鹰 9 号更大、更频繁的批量发射 Starlink 卫星。这将为该公司通过发射大量人工智能轨道数据中心来补充 Starlink 的计划铺平道路。

paras.en: Even if Flight 15 had seen a flawless recovery of both stages, the real prize remains untested: SpaceX must still show that it can rapidly turn around both the booster and orbiter for a fast return to flight. That would put the company well on its way to fulfilling Musk’s projection of roughly one Starship launch per week in the first half of 2027.
paras.zh: 即使 15 号航班的两个阶段都完美恢复，真正的奖励仍然未经考验：SpaceX 仍然必须证明它可以快速转动助推器和轨道器以快速返回飞行。这将使该公司顺利实现马斯克关于 2027 年上半年每周发射大约一艘星际飞船的计划。

paras.en: Flight 15 follows Flight 14, which saw Starship successfully reach orbit and deploy a batch of operational Starlink satellites. But that previous mission ended early because of an engine issue on Starship, leading SpaceX to bring the vehicle down in the Pacific Ocean. (The Super Heavy booster splashed down as planned in the Gulf of Mexico.) Besides demonstrating a much more audacious recovery, Flight 15 was also Starship’s longest-yet sojourn in orbit.
paras.zh: 15 号航班紧随 14 号航班之后，星舰成功进入轨道并部署了一批运行的星链卫星。但由于 Starship 的发动机问题，之前的任务提前结束，导致 SpaceX 将飞船坠入太平洋。 （超重型助推器按计划在墨西哥湾溅落。）除了展示更大胆的回收之外，15 号航班也是星舰迄今为止在轨道上停留时间最长的一次。

paras.en: The test is essential prep for Starship to meet its obligations to NASA’s Artemis program, which seeks to return U.S. astronauts to the moon before the end of 2028. SpaceX is developing a modified Human Landing System (HLS) version of Starship to potentially serve as a lunar lander, transporting crews between lunar orbit and the moon’s surface.
paras.zh: 这次测试是 Starship 履行其对 NASA 阿尔忒弥斯计划义务的重要准备，该计划旨在于 2028 年底之前让美国宇航员重返月球。SpaceX 正在开发改进版的 Starship 人类着陆系统 (HLS)，有可能充当月球着陆器，在月球轨道和月球表面之间运送宇航员。

paras.en: Before it can ferry humans on those far-flung voyages, though, Starship has to demonstrate key capabilities closer to home. During NASA’s Artemis III mission, targeted for next summer, Starship is set to launch to rendezvous and dock in low-Earth orbit with a NASA Orion spacecraft carrying four astronauts; SpaceX’s rival Blue Origin is also part of that mission, and a test version of that company’s Blue Moon Mark 2 lander will also link up with Orion.
paras.zh: 不过，在能够运送人类进行遥远的航行之前，星舰必须在离家较近的地方展示关键能力。在美国宇航局计划于明年夏天执行的阿耳忒弥斯 III 任务中，星际飞船将发射升空，与载有四名宇航员的美国宇航局猎户座飞船在近地轨道交会对接； SpaceX 的竞争对手 Blue Origin 也是该任务的一部分，该公司 Blue Moon Mark 2 着陆器的测试版本也将与猎户座连接。

paras.en: Future Starship test flights will also need to solve the challenge of in-space refueling because, for the heavy HLS, a round trip to the moon requires more fuel than a single Starship can carry into orbit.
paras.zh: 未来的星舰试飞还需要解决太空加油的挑战，因为对于重型 HLS 来说，往返月球需要的燃料比单艘星舰带入轨道的燃料还要多。

paras.en: SpaceX’s ambitions are unfolding against a changing political landscape as well, particularly in Texas, where the company’s Starbase facility is based. The state’s governor-elect Gina Hinojosa campaigned against energy-intensive data centers and has pledged to pause new approvals until stronger protections are in place.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的雄心壮志也在不断变化的政治格局中展开，尤其是在该公司 Starbase 设施所在地的德克萨斯州。该州当选州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨 (Gina Hinojosa) 发起反对能源密集型数据中心的活动，并承诺暂停新的审批，直到采取更强有力的保护措施。

paras.en: The timing is awkward for SpaceX: the company has just disclosed plans for a proposed $24-billion gas-fired power plant and supercomputing complex at Starbase and is seeking local tax incentives for the project.
paras.zh: 对于 SpaceX 来说，时机很尴尬：该公司刚刚披露了在 Starbase 建设耗资 240 亿美元的燃气发电厂和超级计算中心的计划，并正在为该项目寻求当地税收优惠。

articles.title: Scientists might have discovered what makes AI so effective at chess

paras.en: In 1997, artificial intelligence—in the form of a computer system called Deep Blue—beat the best human player at the time at chess, and it hasn’t slowed down. Every year the technology improves, but researchers are still trying to understand the source of AI’s strategic superiority. Sure, many chess engines can use a brute-force approach to evaluate a huge number of moves, but how does that shape their gameplay? A recent paper in APS Open Science highlights one likely feature, with implications as AI strategy expands its scope.
paras.zh: 1997 年，人工智能——以一种名为“深蓝”的计算机系统的形式——在国际象棋比赛中击败了当时最好的人类棋手，而且它的发展速度并没有放缓。技术每年都在进步，但研究人员仍在试图了解人工智能战略优势的来源。当然，许多国际象棋引擎可以使用强力方法来评估大量的动作，但这如何影响它们的游戏玩法呢？ APS 开放科学最近发表的一篇论文强调了一个可能的特征，随着人工智能战略扩大其范围，其影响也随之而来。

paras.en: “Probably our paper is the closest to understanding what these machines are doing,” says study senior author Vito D. P. Servedio, a physicist at Complexity Science Hub in Vienna. “Otherwise it looks like they are playing magic.”
paras.zh: “我们的论文可能是最接近理解这些机器正在做什么的，”该研究的资深作者、维也纳复杂性科学中心的物理学家 Vito D. P. Servedio 说。 “不然的话，就好像他们在变魔术一样。”

paras.en: Early chess AIs, including Deep Blue, internally played out many branches of a decision tree before making a move—a technique called tree search. Many modern chess engines, such as Stockfish and Leela, use trained neural networks to guide their tree search. The researchers collected human vs. human and Stockfish vs. Leela games from online databases. At each point in the games, they measured “strategic tension”—the number of mutual interactions possible between opposing pieces. Tension is often higher when there are more possible moves.
paras.zh: 包括深蓝在内的早期国际象棋人工智能在采取行动之前会在内部执行决策树的许多分支，这种技术称为树搜索。许多现代国际象棋引擎，例如 Stockfish 和 Leela，都使用经过训练的神经网络来指导其树搜索。研究人员从在线数据库中收集了人类对人类和 Stockfish 对 Leela 的游戏。在游戏的每个时刻，他们都会测量“战略紧张度”——对立棋子之间可能相互作用的数量。当有更多可能的动作时，紧张感往往会更高。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The scientists found that once each player had made 20 moves, the average tension in human games exceeded that of the AI games. Up to that point, people tend to rely on memorized tactics and hope the complex piece interactions will force human opponents to slip up. But after it, human tension drops below that of AI games, which remains high. As terrain becomes more unfamiliar, people may simplify their arrangement of pieces because they can’t hold complicated dynamics and multiple options in their heads. “The result makes sense,” says Merim Bilalić, a psychologist at Northumbria University in England, who wasn’t involved in the research. People need to reduce cognitive load, but “engines don’t really have that problem.”
paras.zh: 科学家发现，一旦每个玩家下了 20 步，人类游戏的平均紧张程度就超过了人工智能游戏。到目前为止，人们倾向于依赖记忆的战术，并希望复杂的棋子交互能够迫使人类对手犯错。但在此之后，人类的紧张度下降到低于人工智能游戏的水平，而人工智能游戏的紧张度仍然很高。随着地形变得越来越陌生，人们可能会简化棋子的排列，因为他们无法在头脑中保持复杂的动态和多种选择。 “结果是有道理的，”英国诺森比亚大学心理学家梅里姆·比拉利奇（Merim Bilalić）说，他没有参与这项研究。人们需要减少认知负荷，但“引擎实际上并不存在这个问题。”

paras.en: Furthermore, higher-rated human players maintained greater tension throughout their games. Tension was also greater in games with more allotted time (higher in “classical” than in “rapid” chess and lowest in “blitz” chess). And when Stockfish searched deeper trees of possible gameplay, tension increased. Though higher tension correlated with greater ability in both humans and AI, the study didn’t show that it led to, or came from, that ability.
paras.zh: 此外，评分较高的人类玩家在整个游戏过程中保持着更大的紧张感。在分配时间较多的游戏中，紧张感也更大（“经典”国际象棋中的紧张度高于“快速”国际象棋中的紧张度，而“闪电”国际象棋中的紧张度最低）。当 Stockfish 搜索更深层次的可能游戏玩法时，紧张感就会增加。尽管较高的紧张感与人类和人工智能的较高能力相关，但该研究并未表明它导致或来自于这种能力。

paras.en: Chess continues to be a fruitful model for studying cognition in humans and machines. Servedio says his team’s findings may apply to higher-stakes situations such as diplomacy, where AI might reach better outcomes but at the risk of complicating matters. “This is very dangerous because when you have high tension, systems are very unstable,” he says. “So just a small error from one of the sides will cause a disaster.”
paras.zh: 国际象棋仍然是研究人类和机器认知的富有成果的模型。 Servedio 表示，他的团队的研究结果可能适用于外交等风险更高的情况，在这些情况下，人工智能可能会取得更好的结果，但也有使事情复杂化的风险。 “这是非常危险的，因为当你处于高度紧张状态时，系统会非常不稳定，”他说。 “因此，只要一方的小错误就会造成灾难。”

articles.title: Why your brain sometimes craves sour tastes

paras.en: Adding a dash of lemon juice to a dish is among a good cook’s many tricks, but exactly why sour tickles the taste buds has long been a mystery. Now scientists have uncovered the precise neurochemistry behind this age-old culinary tip. They’ve found that sourness triggers the release of the chemical serotonin—and drowns out the signals of some other tastes, such as sweetness.
paras.zh: 在菜肴中加入少许柠檬汁是优秀厨师的众​​多技巧之一，但究竟为什么酸味会刺激味蕾长期以来一直是个谜。现在，科学家们发现了这个古老烹饪秘诀背后的精确神经化学原理。他们发现酸味会触发化学血清素的释放，并淹没其他一些味道的信号，例如甜味。

paras.en: “This has been known by chefs for ages, and what we did is use that to actually work out how things occur within the taste bud,” says neurobiologist Stephen Roper of the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine.
paras.zh: 迈阿密大学米勒医学院的神经生物学家斯蒂芬·罗珀 (Stephen Roper) 表示：“多年来，厨师们都知道这一点，我们所做的就是利用它来实际了解味蕾内的情况是如何发生的。”

paras.en: In a new study published in the Journal of Neuroscience, Roper and his team explore how taste signals make it from the tongues of mice to their brains. The researchers show that “sour” is sensed by specific cells in taste buds that then produce the neurotransmitter serotonin, which suppresses the ability of nearby cells to signal their detection of certain other tastes, including sweetness and bitterness. In turn, the “sour” signals travel to the brain via a neurological pathway dedicated to aversive tastes—in other words, tastes that cause a strong sense of dislike—while pleasant tastes such as “sweet” are sent by another pathway.
paras.zh: 在《神经科学杂志》上发表的一项新研究中，罗珀和他的团队探索了味觉信号如何从小鼠的舌头传递到大脑。研究人员表明，味蕾中的特定细胞感知到“酸味”，然后产生神经递质血清素，从而抑制附近细胞发出信号检测某些其他味道（包括甜味和苦味）的能力。反过来，“酸味”信号通过专门针对厌恶味道（换句话说，引起强烈厌恶感的味道）的神经通路传递到大脑，而“甜味”等令人愉悦的味道则通过另一条通路发送。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: It’s unclear how these two taste pathways interact, Roper says. “Hopefully my work can lead to identifying certain molecular markers that characterize these two different streams,” he says. “Once you have a molecular marker, then you can chase down those neurons.”
paras.zh: 罗珀说，目前尚不清楚这两种味觉通路如何相互作用。 “希望我的工作能够识别出表征这两种不同流的某些分子标记，”他说。 “一旦有了分子标记，你就可以追踪这些神经元。”

paras.en: The new work gives a new scientific understanding of the neurochemical processes of taste: “There is now quite a bit of mystery surrounding the question of whether sour is even a taste,” says neuroscientist Emily Liman of the University of Southern California, who wasn't involved in the new study—or if the sour-sensing cells are reacting to something else, such as the ammonium given off by cellular decay, that disrupts their pH balance in the same way.
paras.zh: 这项新研究为味觉的神经化学过程提供了新的科学认识：“酸味是否是一种味道的问题现在还存在相当大的谜团，”南加州大学的神经科学家艾米丽·利曼（Emily Liman）说，她没有参与这项新的研究，或者酸味敏感细胞是否对其他物质产生反应，例如细胞腐烂释放出的铵，从而以同样的方式破坏它们的 pH 平衡。

paras.en: Neuroscientists think the experience of taste is centered in the mammalian brain's gustatory cortex, while the limbic system—a more primitive, emotional center in the brain—assesses pleasure and aversion. Meanwhile the brain stem can trigger a reflex that causes us to immediately spit out spoiled food. But while sour tastes can indicate spoilage—in milk, for example—they don’t always do so, and many toxins don’t taste sour. Some sour flavors are appealing, such as the citrusy zing of lemonade. These conflicts are why it is such a mystery that the “sour” taste is prioritized, Roper says.
paras.zh: 神经科学家认为，味觉体验集中在哺乳动物大脑的味觉皮层，而边缘系统——大脑中更原始的情感中心——评估愉悦和厌恶。与此同时，脑干会触发一种反射，使我们立即吐出变质的食物。但是，虽然酸味可能表明腐败（例如牛奶），但并不总是如此，而且许多毒素尝起来并不酸。有些酸味很吸引人，比如柠檬水的柑橘味。罗珀说，这些冲突就是为什么优先考虑“酸”味是一个谜。

paras.en: The study shows that taste buds act like a preprocessor that can modify taste signals before they are sent to the brain. In other words, taste buds are not passive actors but shape the signals they send. Adult humans have between 2,000 and 8,000 taste buds, mostly on their tongues yet also scattered around other parts of the mouth and throat. Each taste bud has dozens of taste-sensing cells, which typically responds to just one particular taste. When the sour-sensing cells secrete serotonin, however, they overwhelm nearby cells that detect sweet, salty and umami—a basic savory taste found in mushrooms and soy sauce.
paras.zh: 研究表明，味蕾就像一个预处理器，可以在味觉信号发送到大脑之前对其进行修改。换句话说，味蕾不是被动的参与者，而是塑造它们发出的信号。成年人有 2,000 到 8,000 个味蕾，大部分位于舌头上，但也分散在口腔和喉咙的其他部位。每个味蕾都有数十个味觉细胞，通常只对一种特定的味道做出反应。然而，当酸味感受细胞分泌血清素时，它们会压倒附近检测甜味、咸味和鲜味（蘑菇和酱油中的基本咸味）的细胞。

paras.en: Roper says researchers will next map the neurological pathways that transmit the modified taste signals from the tongue to the brain to understand how the brain makes sense of all the competing tastes that can exist in a single mouthful of food.
paras.zh: 罗珀说，研究人员接下来将绘制将改变的味觉信号从舌头传输到大脑的神经通路图，以了解大脑如何理解一口食物中可能存在的所有竞争味道。

paras.en: Neuroscientist Sue Kinnamon of the University of Colorado Anschutz School of Medicine says the new study helps to resolve long-standing questions about signaling between taste cells. A key finding is that serotonin is the main neurotransmitter involved in the process rather than another neurotransmitter such as gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), which is also secreted by sour-sensing taste cells, she says.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多大学安舒茨医学院的神经科学家 Sue Kinnamon 表示，这项新研究有助于解决有关味觉细胞之间信号传导的长期存在的问题。她说，一个重要的发现是，血清素是参与该过程的主要神经递质，而不是另一种神经递质，例如γ-氨基丁酸（GABA），后者也是由酸味味觉细胞分泌的。

paras.en: “The taste bud is an exciting organ,” says Kinnamon, who was not involved in the new study. “They’re all in close proximity to each other, so it’s not surprising that they talk to one another, and that influences what we taste.”
paras.zh: “味蕾是一个令人兴奋的器官，”金纳蒙说，他没有参与这项新研究。 “它们彼此距离很近，所以它们互相交谈也就不足为奇了，这会影响我们的口味。”

articles.title: Stone Age children left fingerprints on ancient art projects
articles.author: Freda Kreier

paras.en: Children have been making art with help from grown-ups for millennia.
paras.zh: 几千年来，孩子们一直在成年人的帮助下进行艺术创作。

paras.en: Fragmented clay figurines dating as far back as 15,000 years ago, discovered in what is now Israel, preserve the fingerprints of both adults and young children. The finding suggests the grown-ups taught the kids how to shape and decorate clay, researchers report November 11 in PLOS One.
paras.zh: 在现在的以色列发现的泥人碎片可以追溯到 15,000 年前，保留了成人和幼儿的指纹。研究人员 11 月 11 日在 PLOS One 上报道称，这一发现表明大人教孩子们如何塑造和装饰粘土。

paras.en: Children’s contributions to prehistoric art and culture aren’t well understood. Concrete evidence of their involvement has been hard to find, says archaeologist Laurent Davin of the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 儿童对史前艺术和文化的贡献尚不清楚。耶路撒冷希伯来大学的考古学家劳伦特·达文说，很难找到他们参与其中的具体证据。

paras.en: In recent decades, researchers have found a handful of objects made by children — including 200,000-year-old rock art bearing child-sized handprints in Tibet and 30,000-year-old clay sculptures pockmarked with child-sized fingerprints in Czech Republic.
paras.zh: 近几十年来，研究人员发现了一些由儿童制作的物品，其中包括西藏有 20 万年历史、带有儿童大小手印的岩画，以及捷克共和国有 3 万年历史、有儿童大小手印的泥塑。

paras.en: Davin and colleagues hadn’t set out to find Stone Age children’s artwork. They were investigating whether the Natufian culture — a group of hunter-gatherers who formed some of the first permanent settlements in the Levant about 14,000 years ago — made clay art before the advent of agriculture in the region.
paras.zh: 达文和同事并没有打算寻找石器时代儿童的艺术品。他们正在调查纳图夫文化（大约 14,000 年前，一群狩猎采集者在黎凡特形成了第一个永久定居点）是否在该地区出现农业之前就制作了粘土艺术。

paras.en: The archaeologists came across the first set of fingerprints while sorting through 40 kilograms of clay collected at three Natufian sites, which range in age from 15,000 to 11,600 years old. Among tens of thousands of clay lumps, the team found some 150 fragments of sculptures, including 15 recognizable bird, gazelle and human figures. Around 60 of these pieces preserved fingerprints from where people had pinched or prodded the clay.
paras.zh: 考古学家在对三个纳图夫遗址收集的 40 公斤粘土进行分类时发现了第一组指纹，这些粘土的年龄从 15,000 岁到 11,600 岁不等。在数万块粘土块中，研究小组发现了约 150 件雕塑碎片，其中包括 15 件可辨认的鸟类、瞪羚和人物雕像。其中大约 60 件作品保存了人们捏或戳粘土时留下的指纹。

paras.en: The distances between the fingerprints’ ridges, which are influenced by age and sex, suggest that most of the figurines were made by women and children — some younger than 10. Only a few sets of fingerprints belonged to men. And the torso of one tiny human statue had both adult and child fingerprints, hinting that an elder and child had passed it back and forth. Davin suspects that the adult actively taught a child how to work the clay.
paras.zh: 指纹脊线之间的距离受年龄和性别的影响，表明大多数雕像是由妇女和儿童制作的——有些还不到 10 岁。只有几组指纹属于男性。一座微型人体雕像的躯干上有成人和儿童的指纹，这表明有一位老人和一个孩子来回经过。达文怀疑成年人主动教孩子如何制作粘土。

paras.en: This evidence of intergenerational learning so far back in time is fascinating, says archaeologist Steven Dorland of Grand Valley State University in Allendale, Mich. It demonstrates how much researchers can learn from broadening their focus beyond adult males, he says. Dorland has used pottery to understand social learning in Indigenous societies of the Great Lakes region. He has even studied children’s fingerprints on some of those artifacts.
paras.zh: 密歇根州艾伦代尔市大谷州立大学的考古学家史蒂文·多兰说，这种迄今为止代际学习的证据令人着迷。他说，这表明研究人员可以通过将关注点扩大到成年男性之外来学到很多东西。多兰利用陶器来了解五大湖地区土著社会的社会学习。他甚至研究了其中一些文物上的儿童指纹。

paras.en: The purpose of the Natufian figurines is unclear. Most of the statues are less than 2 centimeters long and don’t display signs of intense use, the team found, suggesting they weren’t treated as precious heirlooms.
paras.zh: 纳图夫人雕像的用途尚不清楚。研究小组发现，大多数雕像长度不到 2 厘米，并且没有显示出频繁使用的迹象，这表明它们没有被视为珍贵的传家宝。

paras.en: Davin suspects the figurines may have represented stories, like how kids draw Disney characters today, he says. “Maybe the idea is that the role of children here is not necessarily to learn to make figurines, but more to learn the story behind them.”
paras.zh: 达文怀疑这些雕像可能代表了故事，就像今天孩子们如何画迪士尼人物一样，他说。 “也许这个想法是，孩子们在这里的角色不一定是学习制作雕像，更多的是了解它们背​​后的故事。”

articles.title: The ‘hell chicken’ dinosaur was a real terror — to fruit
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: More than 65 million years ago, a small, beaked dinosaur dubbed the “hell chicken” was a real terror – to fruit. Reconstruction of its beak and jaw suggest it mashed up fruit much like modern parrots.
paras.zh: 超过 6500 万年前，一种被称为“地狱鸡”的小型喙恐龙确实令人恐惧。它的喙和下巴的重建表明它可以像现代鹦鹉一样捣碎水果。

paras.en: It’s the first evidence of non-avian dinosaurs evolving specialized adaptations for eating fruit, and comes at a time when flowering plants were coming into their own, researchers report October 10 in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 10 月 10 日在《自然通讯》杂志上报道，这是非鸟类恐龙进化出专门适应吃水果的第一个证据，并且出现在开花植物成熟的时期。

paras.en: In 2011, a fossil collector found much of the fossilized skeleton of an odd theropod dinosaur in eastern Montana and brought to the attention of David Evans, a paleontologist at the Royal Ontario Museum in Canada. Over the next several years, fossil collectors and paleontologists working in Montana and North and South Dakota unearthed four more partial skeletons.
paras.zh: 2011年，一位化石收藏家在蒙大拿州东部发现了一种奇怪的兽脚类恐龙的大部分化石骨架，并引起了加拿大皇家安大略博物馆古生物学家戴维·埃文斯的注意。在接下来的几年里，在蒙大拿州、北达科他州和南达科他州工作的化石收藏家和古生物学家又出土了四具部分骨骼。

paras.en: The dinosaur belonged to a particularly birdlike subgroup of beaked theropods called oviraptorosaurs that lived during the Cretaceous Period. This species probably weighed around 12 kilograms — about the size of a turkey.
paras.zh: 这种恐龙属于一种特别像鸟类的喙兽脚亚目亚群，称为偷蛋龙，生活在白垩纪时期。该物种的重量可能约为 12 公斤，相当于火鸡的大小。

paras.en: Evans and Greg Funston — a paleontologist at Stony Brook University in New York — and their colleagues named it Infernogallus jamesi, or ‘hell chicken,’ after its discovery in the Hell Creek geological formation and its overall poultrylike appearance.
paras.zh: 埃文斯和纽约石溪大学的古生物学家格雷格·芬斯顿以及他们的同事将其命名为 Infernogallus jamesi，即“地狱鸡”，因为它是在地狱溪地质构造中发现的，而且其整体外观像家禽。

paras.en: When the researchers studied Infernogallus’s skull and reconstructed the musculature, they discovered that it was no ordinary theropod. The construction of its jaw joints, muscles and palate suggest that it moved its jaw forward and back when eating rather than up and down like its chomping relatives.
paras.zh: 当研究人员研究火鸡的头骨并重建肌肉组织时，他们发现它不是普通的兽脚亚目恐龙。它的下颌关节、肌肉和上颚的结构表明，它在进食时前后移动下巴，而不是像它咀嚼的近亲那样上下移动。

paras.en: This chewing style is unique among non-avian dinosaurs but is strikingly similar to that of fruit-eating parrots. Funston and his colleagues think Infernogallus had adapted to a fruit-rich diet, deftly stripping the flesh from large seeds using its tongue and sliding jaw motions.
paras.zh: 这种咀嚼方式在非鸟类恐龙中是独一无二的，但与食果鹦鹉的咀嚼方式惊人相似。芬斯顿和他的同事认为火鸡已经适应了富含水果的饮食，能够利用舌头和滑动下巴的动作巧妙地从大种子上剥离果肉。

paras.en: These fruit-munching adaptations were surprising, Funston says. “But the more we delved into it, the more sense it made,” he says. “All the different lines of evidence seemed to converge on this one answer.”
paras.zh: 芬斯顿说，这些咀嚼水果的适应令人惊讶。 “但我们越深入研究它，它就越有意义，”他说。 “所有不同的证据似乎都集中在这个答案上。”

paras.en: Angiosperms — plants that produce flowers and fruits — were rapidly diversifying throughout the Cretaceous. Mounting evidence suggests that angiosperms were coevolving with Cretaceous animals, and that dinosaurs may have been eating their fruits. Infernogallus adds to that emerging picture. It’s possible that other ‘hell chicken’ relatives or other dinosaur groups were habitual fruit eaters too, Funston says.
paras.zh: 被子植物——产生花朵和果实的植物——在整个白垩纪迅速多样化。越来越多的证据表明，被子植物与白垩纪动物共同进化，恐龙可能一直在吃它们的果实​​。 Infernogallus 进一步丰富了这一新景象。芬斯顿说，其他“地狱鸡”亲戚或其他恐龙群体也可能习惯吃水果。

paras.en: “[The discovery] suggests that our picture of dinosaur ecology right before the Cretaceous extinction has been missing major puzzle pieces, and that dinosaurs were more diverse than we thought.”
paras.zh: “[这一发现]表明，我们对白垩纪灭绝之前的恐龙生态的了解一直缺少主要的拼图，而且恐龙比我们想象的更加多样化。”

articles.title: In National Geographic’s “Expedition: Saving Our Seas,” it’s all hands on deck
articles.author: Carolyn Gramling

paras.en: As documentaries about Earth’s accelerating climate crisis go, Expedition: Saving Our Seas is surprisingly buoyant.
paras.zh: 正如有关地球日益加剧的气候危机的纪录片所言，《远征：拯救我们的海洋》出人意料地活跃。

paras.en: The ocean covers more than two-thirds of Earth’s surface. And “as the climate heats up, our seas are under pressure like never before,” narrator Auli’i Cravalho, the voice of the title character in Disney’s Moana, says at the opening of The National Geographic Society’s new documentary. The film documents how oceanographers are racing to document and mitigate climate change’s impacts on ocean and coastal habitats.
paras.zh: 海洋覆盖了地球表面三分之二以上的面积。 “随着气候变暖，我们的海洋面临着前所未有的压力，”迪士尼影片《莫阿娜》中主角的配音奥丽伊·克拉瓦略 (Auli'i Cravalho) 在国家地理学会新纪录片的开头说道。该影片记录了海洋学家如何竞相记录和减轻气候变化对海洋和沿海栖息地的影响。

paras.en: Expedition: Saving Our Seas premieres November 13 on the National Geographic Channel at 9pm EST and streams the next day on Disney+ and Hulu.
paras.zh: 《远征：拯救我们的海洋》于美国东部时间 11 月 13 日晚上 9 点在国家地理频道首播，并于次日在 Disney+ 和 Hulu 上播出。

paras.en: Despite that solemn mission, Expedition: Saving Our Seas is full of hope — and stunning visuals. The documentary offers a window into the scientists’ wonder and joy in their work as they discover new life forms in the depths of the Southern Ocean, or successfully nurture young corals threatened by warming in the Pacific Ocean.
paras.zh: 尽管肩负着庄严的使命，《远征：拯救我们的海洋》仍然充满希望——以及令人惊叹的视觉效果。这部纪录片为我们展示了科学家们在工作中的惊奇和喜悦，因为他们在南大洋深处发现了新的生命形式，或者成功地培育了受到太平洋变暖威胁的年轻珊瑚。

paras.en: The film opens with a twist on the usual world map: At the center is one great ocean, surrounded by land. Trivia buffs know Earth has five oceans: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic. But geographic names aside, these five oceans are just one, linked by a global system of currents known as the Great Ocean Conveyor Belt.
paras.zh: 影片一开始就改变了通常的世界地图：中心是一片巨大的海洋，周围是陆地。冷知识爱好者都知道地球有五大洋：太平洋、大西洋、印度洋、南方和北极。但撇开地理名称不谈，这五个大洋只是一个大洋，由称为大洋传送带的全球洋流系统连接起来。

paras.en: “It’s this giant connected ocean that ignores all of the political boundaries, ignores all of the names we call them,” says Andrew Thurber, a biological oceanographer at the University of California, Santa Barbara, whose research is among those featured in the film.
paras.zh: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校的生物海洋学家安德鲁·瑟伯（Andrew Thurber）说：“这是一个巨大的相连海洋，它无视所有的政治界限，无视我们对它们的所有名称。”他的研究也在影片中得到了体现。

paras.en: The documentary loosely follows the current’s path as it zips around the world from project to project.
paras.zh: 这部纪录片大致追踪了当今世界的发展轨迹，从一个项目到另一个项目。

paras.en: The first project in the documentary is Thurber’s. He’s on board a research vessel in the frigid Southern Ocean, which rings Antarctica. Using a remotely-operated vehicle dubbed SuBastian, Thurber and his colleagues are scanning the seafloor, hunting for the world’s southernmost hydrothermal vent.
paras.zh: 纪录片中的第一个项目是瑟伯的。他在环绕南极洲的寒冷南大洋上的一艘科考船上。瑟伯和他的同事使用名为“苏巴斯蒂安”的远程操作车辆扫描海底，寻找世界最南端的热液喷口。

paras.en: Hydrothermal vents spew superhot, chemically-enriched seawater. In the generally nutrient-poor Southern Ocean, that makes these vents a potential food oasis to support deep sea life.
paras.zh: 热液喷口喷出超热、富含化学物质的海水。在普遍营养贫乏的南大洋，这使得这些喷口成为支持深海生物的潜在食物绿洲。

paras.en: Throughout the night, as the ROV scans the seafloor, Thurber and his colleagues stay glued to the video it sends back, oohing and aahing as never-before-seen life-forms come into view. “It was a marathon of excitement,” he says now.
paras.zh: 整个晚上，当遥控潜水器扫描海底时，瑟伯和他的同事们一直盯着它发回的视频，当前所未见的生命形式出现在视野中时，他们发出惊叹声和啊啊声。 “这是一场令人兴奋的马拉松，”他现在说道。

paras.en: Then they see it: A large black smoker, the southernmost hydrothermal vent ever found. And all around it: swarms of pregnant female krill.
paras.zh: 然后他们看到了：一个巨大的黑色烟雾，这是迄今为止发现的最南端的热液喷口。在它的周围：成群结队的怀孕雌性磷虾。

paras.en: “That blew all of our minds,” Thurber says. Krill are the keystone species of the entire Southern Ocean food web, a crucial food source for baleen whales, seals, penguins and fish. But krill are threatened by both industrial fishing and climate change. This discovery, Thurber says, helps make the case for a marine protected area, a region where fishing and other human activities should be restricted.
paras.zh: “这让我们所有人大吃一惊，”瑟伯说。磷虾是整个南大洋食物网的关键物种，是须鲸、海豹、企鹅和鱼类的重要食物来源。但磷虾同时受到工业捕捞和气候变化的威胁。瑟伯说，这一发现有助于建立海洋保护区，即应限制捕鱼和其他人类活动的区域。

paras.en: From the Southern Ocean, the Great Ocean Conveyor Belt flows thousands of kilometers to the north, where marine ecologist Maiyai Taal Hocheimy is tracking how the rising waters of the Atlantic Ocean are encroaching on Banjul, the capital of The Gambia in West Africa. Her hope is that salt-tolerant mangrove trees along the coast, with their dense network of soil-retaining roots, might help hold back the sea in the coming decades — provided that the community can be enlisted to help maintain the mangroves.
paras.zh: 大洋输送带从南大洋向北流动数千公里，海洋生态学家迈亚伊·塔尔·霍切米正在追踪大西洋上升的海水如何侵蚀西非冈比亚首都班珠尔。她希望，沿海的耐盐红树林及其密集的固土根系网络可能有助于在未来几十年内抑制海水的侵蚀——前提是社区可以参与帮助维护红树林。

paras.en: I found Hocheimy’s work especially inspiring because she is working to shape the future of oceanography. In 2017, she founded the GREAT (Gaining Research Experience in Africa for Tomorrow) Institute, the first aquatic and coastal science research institute in The Gambia. The mangrove project recruited young local scientists to help conduct the research.
paras.zh: 我发现 Hocheimy 的工作特别鼓舞人心，因为她正在努力塑造海洋学的未来。 2017年，她创立了GREAT（为明天在非洲获得研究经验）研究所，这是冈比亚第一个水生和沿海科学研究所。红树林项目招募了当地年轻的科学家来帮助进行研究。

paras.en: “The goal is to train the next generation of environmental stewards,” Hocheimy says. “We have to show that mangroves have value, so they’ll understand and want to protect them. It is their future at stake.”
paras.zh: “我们的目标是培训下一代环境管理者，”霍切米说。 “我们必须证明红树林具有价值，这样他们就会理解并想要保护红树林。这关系到他们的未来。”

paras.en: That sentiment is echoed many times in the film — the importance not only of enlisting young scientists but also centering local scientists who pose new questions that oceanographers who parachute in from other places may not think to ask, says marine biogeochemist Kristina Brown.
paras.zh: 海洋生物地球化学家克里斯蒂娜·布朗（Kristina Brown）表示，这种观点在影片中多次得到呼应——不仅要招募年轻科学家，还要集中当地科学家提出新问题，而从其他地方跳伞而来的海洋学家可能不会想问这些问题。

paras.en: In the documentary, Brown, of the University of Manitoba in Canada, co-leads an expedition to explore the waters of Sherman Basin, a large bay north of the Arctic Circle in Nunavut, Canada. This region has been hunted and fished by Inuit people for centuries.
paras.zh: 在纪录片中，加拿大曼尼托巴大学的布朗与他人共同领导了一支探险队，探索谢尔曼盆地的水域，谢尔曼盆地是加拿大努纳武特地区北极圈以北的一个大海湾。几个世纪以来，这个地区一直被因纽特人狩猎和捕鱼。

paras.en: But it might change beyond all recognition in the next few decades, Brown says. So, the local Inuit community invited her to help create the first catalog of what species are present in the waters and on the seafloor. “[It’s] the first project I’ve been involved in where the local community both defined the research questions and have brought their own unique expertise to the research project.”
paras.zh: 但布朗表示，在接下来的几十年里，情况可能会发生翻天覆地的变化。因此，当地因纽特人社区邀请她帮助创建第一个水域和海底物种目录。 “[这是]我参与的第一个项目，当地社区既定义了研究问题，又为研究项目带来了自己独特的专业知识。”

paras.en: Watching how communities around the world are increasingly taking ownership of studies in their own waters was, for me, the most exciting takeaway of this documentary.
paras.zh: 对我来说，观看世界各地的社区如何越来越多地在自己的水域进行研究是这部纪录片最令人兴奋的收获。

paras.en: “We want to democratize access to the deep sea, to enable people who haven’t had access to these kinds of tools to ask more and new questions,” says Katy Croff Bell, the founder and president of the Ocean Discovery League, a nonprofit ocean exploration group based in Saunderstown, Rhode Island.
paras.zh: 位于罗德岛州桑德斯敦的非营利性海洋探索组织海洋探索联盟的创始人兼总裁凯蒂·克罗夫·贝尔 (Katy Croff Bell) 表示：“我们希望使进入深海的途径民主化，让那些无法使用这些工具的人们能够提出更多新问题。”

paras.en: As a result of inaccessibility, little of Earth’s vast ocean has been mapped, particularly the deep sea. Bell’s organization is developing inexpensive technologies such as a hardy little camera and sensor system dubbed DORIS, for Deep Ocean Research and Imaging System. It can descend to 6,000 meters and costs less than $10,000.
paras.zh: 由于交通不便，地球上广阔的海洋，特别是深海，几乎没有被绘制出来。贝尔的组织正在开发廉价技术，例如用于深海研究和成像系统的耐用小型相机和传感器系统 DORIS。它可以下降到 6,000 米，成本不到 10,000 美元。

paras.en: Expedition: Saving Our Seas offers just a few scant minutes to each project before moving on around the globe to the next, so there’s no time to learn about each project in depth. But the overall takeaway of watching these vignettes, back to back, is that there is a young, energetic community of scientists taking on the challenge.
paras.zh: 探险：拯救我们的海洋在前往全球各地进行下一个项目之前，每个项目只提供了几分钟的时间，因此没有时间深入了解每个项目。但连续观看这些小插曲的总体收获是，有一个年轻、充满活力的科学家群体正在接受挑战。

paras.en: Mitigating climate change’s impacts on the oceans is, after all, a race against time. So it’s nice to think we might have all hands on deck.
paras.zh: 毕竟，减轻气候变化对海洋的影响是一场与时间的赛跑。因此，很高兴我们能够齐心协力。

articles.title: Strange 'Metal Potatoes' Contain a Microcosm of Life Not Seen Anywhere Else on The Seafloor, Scientists Find
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: Polymetallic nodules stud the seafloor throughout the Clarion-Clipperton Zone, and new research shows that each of these strange metal potatoes contains an entire community of microscopic life unique to this habitat.
paras.zh: 多金属结核遍布整个克拉里昂-克利珀顿区的海底，新的研究表明，这些奇怪的金属土豆中的每一个都包含着该栖息地独有的整个微观生命群落。

paras.en: There's a reason humans have named them polymetallic nodules: we're really interested in the metal part.
paras.zh: 人类将它们命名为多金属结核是有原因的：我们对金属部分非常感兴趣。

paras.en: Our society's reliance on metals like nickel, cobalt, and copper is growing rapidly, and these nodules are loaded with them, as well as iron and manganese.
paras.zh: 我们的社会对镍、钴和铜等金属的依赖正在迅速增长，这些结核中也富含这些金属，以及铁和锰。

paras.en: But polymetallic nodules are not a readily renewable resource. Though it only takes minutes to pluck a nodule from the seafloor, it took millions of years for it to form.
paras.zh: 但多金属结核并不是一种容易再生的资源。虽然从海底取出一个结核只需要几分钟，但它的形成却需要数百万年。

paras.en: Scientists are concerned this speculative industry could destroy a unique ecosystem we barely knew existed, before we get a chance to understand it.
paras.zh: 科学家们担心，在我们有机会了解这个独特的生态系统之前，这种投机性行业可能会摧毁我们几乎不知道它存在的生态系统。

paras.en: "Our findings point out that commercial mining may result in an irreversible loss of undescribed and unique biodiversity associated to nodules," says deep-sea biologist Sabine Gollner, of the Royal Netherlands Institute for Sea Research.
paras.zh: 荷兰皇家海洋研究所的深海生物学家 Sabine Gollner 表示：“我们的研究结果表明，商业采矿可能会导致与结核相关的未描述的独特生物多样性的不可逆转的损失。”

paras.en: "This needs to be considered in environmental management of deep-sea mining."
paras.zh: “深海采矿的环境管理需要考虑这一点。”

paras.en: The research is published in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《科学报告》上。

paras.en: The nodules were collected in 2019 by a crew of scientists taking part in an expedition to the Clarion-Clipperton Zone aboard the German research vessel RV Sonne, as part of the JPI Oceans Mining Impact II project.
paras.zh: 这些结核是由一群科学家于 2019 年乘坐德国科考船 RV Sonne 前往克拉里昂-克利珀顿区进行的探险活动收集的，这是 JPI 海洋采矿影响 II 项目的一部分。

paras.en: The team carefully lowered a box corer to depths of around 4 to 6 kilometers (2.5 to 3.7 miles) to take a chunk of seafloor sediment and the nodules embedded within.
paras.zh: 研究小组小心地将箱式取芯器放入约 4 至 6 公里（2.5 至 3.7 英里）的深处，取出一大块海底沉积物和嵌入其中的结核。

paras.en: For this study, the researchers examined 244 individual nodules looking for signs of life in the cracks and pores.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，研究人员检查了 244 个单独的结节，寻找裂缝和孔隙中的生命迹象。

paras.en: The nodules – and their marine inhabitants – were then frozen and taken to a lab.
paras.zh: 然后，这些结核及其海洋居民被冷冻并送往实验室。

paras.en: One hundred fifty-three of the nodules came from an area where Germany's Federal Institute for Geosciences and Natural Resources (BGR) holds an exploration contract from the International Seabed Authority. A further 91 were collected from an area where Belgian company Global Sea Mineral Resources – a subsidiary of DEME – holds an exploration contract.
paras.zh: 其中一百五十三个结核来自德国联邦地球科学和自然资源研究所 (BGR) 持有国际海底管理局勘探合同的地区。另外 91 个是从 DEME 子公司比利时公司 Global Sea Mineral Resources 持有勘探合同的地区收集到的。

paras.en: Most assessments of biodiversity in the Clarion-Clipperton Zone so far have focused on organisms living in the sediment, or clinging to the nodules' surface.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，对克拉里昂-克利珀顿区生物多样性的大多数评估都集中于生活在沉积物中或附着在结核表面的生物体。

paras.en: Much of the deep sea is covered in a fine mud, but many of the animals that live there need a more solid surface to attach to: the polymetallic nodules provide an ideal substrate for those creatures.
paras.zh: 深海的大部分地区都覆盖着细泥，但生活在那里的许多动物需要更坚固的表面来附着：多金属结核为这些生物提供了理想的基质。

paras.en: "We already knew that polymetallic nodules provide attachment surfaces for deep-sea organisms, but very little was known about the animals living inside them," marine genomicist Coral Diaz-Recio Lorenzo told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 海洋基因组学家 Coral Diaz-Recio Lorenzo 告诉 ScienceAlert：“我们已经知道多金属结核为深海生物提供了附着表面，但对生活在其中的动物知之甚少。”

paras.en: On cracking the nodules open, scientists found bustling ecosystems in miniature throughout the nooks and crannies.
paras.zh: 在打开结核时，科学家们在各个角落和缝隙中发现了熙熙攘攘的生态系统的缩影。
