paras.en: Roundworms and crustaceans were the most common inhabitants, and one species of 'armored amoeba', Thurammina, dominated its kind. In just a few nodules, they recorded bristleworms, mud dragons, tardigrades, and other less common critters.
paras.zh: 蛔虫和甲壳类动物是最常见的居民，其中一种“装甲变形虫”Thurammina 在同类中占主导地位。在几个结核中，他们记录了刚毛虫、泥龙、缓步动物和其他不太常见的生物。

paras.en: "What surprised us most was how different the communities living inside nodules were from those in nearby sediments," Diaz-Recio Lorenzo said.
paras.zh: “最让我们惊讶的是生活在结核内的群落与附近沉积物中的群落有多么不同，”迪亚兹-雷西奥·洛伦佐说。

paras.en: "Remarkably, nodule communities collected from areas separated by approximately 1,000 kilometers were more similar to one another than to the surrounding sediment communities."
paras.zh: “值得注意的是，从相距约 1,000 公里的区域收集的结核群落彼此之间比周围的沉积物群落更相似。”

paras.en: Using microscopes to look more closely at the nodules, the researchers also found the fossils of diatoms, radiolarians, and sea sponges embedded within the ancient layers.
paras.zh: 研究人员利用显微镜更仔细地观察这些结核，还发现了嵌入古代地层中的硅藻、放射虫和海绵的化石。

paras.en: "The presence of… biogenic particles within crevices indicated that at least some cavity structures were colonized by ancient organisms, although this does not necessarily demonstrate in-situ colonization at the time of incorporation," the team writes.
paras.zh: 研究小组写道：“缝隙中生物颗粒的存在表明，至少有一些空腔结构被古代生物所殖民，尽管这并不一定表明在合并时就存在原位殖民。”

paras.en: "Sponge spicules were visible in the [scanning electron microscope] images, and the presence of the Foraminifera species Saccorhiza sp., which uses sponge spicules to build its tests [shell-like structures], indicates that nodules may have provided a habitat on the seabed for millions of years."
paras.zh: “在[扫描电子显微镜]图像中可以看到海绵针，并且使用海绵针来构建其测试[壳状结构]的有孔虫物种Saccorhiza sp.的存在表明，结核可能在海底提供了数百万年的栖息地。”

paras.en: If the ISA grants approval for deep-sea mining companies to take the nodules en masse, these ancient ecosystems will be irreversibly destroyed.
paras.zh: 如果 ISA 批准深海采矿公司大规模开采结核，这些古老的生态系统将被不可逆转地破坏。

paras.en: "Because their communities differ from those in the surrounding sediments, protecting sediment habitats alone would not preserve this biodiversity," Diaz-Recio Lorenzo added.
paras.zh: “因为它们的群落与周围沉积物中的群落不同，仅保护沉积物栖息地并不能保护这种生物多样性，”迪亚兹-雷西奥·洛伦佐补充道。

paras.en: "Large-scale nodule removal could therefore result in irreversible losses of unique species and ecological communities that we are only beginning to understand."
paras.zh: “因此，大规模的结核清除可能会导致我们才刚刚开始了解的独特物种和生态群落的不可逆转的损失。”

paras.en: These distant and microscopic worlds may seem quite isolated from ours, but the reality is we have no idea yet how they play into global networks of nutrients, carbon, and ecology.
paras.zh: 这些遥远而微观的世界似乎与我们的世界相当孤立，但现实是我们还不知道它们如何参与全球营养物、碳和生态网络。

paras.en: Scientists are in a race to figure that out, before it's too late.
paras.zh: 科学家们正在竞相找出答案，以免为时已晚。

paras.en: The research has been published in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学报告》上。

articles.title: Scientists Developed Foot-Stiffening Socks That Could Make Walking Less Tiring
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Researchers have developed a sock that squeezes the ball of the foot to stiffen the arch, the part that bends when we walk, and demonstrated that it can reduce the body's energy expenditure for each step – potentially helping anyone walk for longer and with less effort.
paras.zh: 研究人员开发了一种袜子，可以挤压脚掌，使足弓变硬，足弓是我们走路时弯曲的部分，并证明它可以减少身体每一步的能量消耗——有可能帮助任何人走得更远、更省力。

paras.en: However, rather than attempting to boost walking endurance, the original motivation for the research was to investigate an evolutionary mystery: Our human feet are stiffer than those of other primates, but it has never been fully clear why.
paras.zh: 然而，这项研究的最初动机并不是试图提高行走耐力，而是为了调查一个进化之谜：我们人类的脚比其他灵长类动物的脚更僵硬，但原因从未完全清楚。

paras.en: One leading theory is that this helps us walk upright with less effort, and these latest experiments support that idea.
paras.zh: 一个主要理论是，这可以帮助我们更轻松地直立行走，而这些最新的实验支持了这一观点。

paras.en: A team from the University of Texas at Austin recruited 12 healthy participants with an average age of 28 to spend 5-minute sessions walking on a treadmill, comparing the custom stiffening socks with ordinary pairs.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的一个团队招募了 12 名平均年龄为 28 岁的健康参与者，在跑步机上行走 5 分钟，将定制的加固袜子与普通袜子进行比较。

paras.en: The results, published in Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences, show that the stiffening socks can indeed reduce energy use by keeping the foot more tightly locked.
paras.zh: 发表在《英国皇家学会学报 B：生物科学》上的研究结果表明，硬化袜确实可以通过更紧密地锁定足部来减少能量消耗。

paras.en: "These custom socks applied more pressure to the user's forefoot than commercially available socks, which in turn increased medial longitudinal arch stiffness through cross-axis coupling," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在他们发表的论文中写道：“这些定制袜子比市售袜子对使用者的前脚施加了更大的压力，从而通过横轴耦合增加了内侧纵弓刚度。”

paras.en: "Walking with foot-stiffening socks reduced whole-body metabolic rate 2 percent versus the use of commercial socks."
paras.zh: “与使用商业袜子相比，穿着足部硬化袜行走可使全身代谢率降低 2%。”

paras.en: That 2 percent reduction might not seem like a lot, but the researchers equate it to removing a 2-kilogram (4.4-pound) weight from around your waist. That's something you'd notice if you were hiking.
paras.zh: 2% 的减少看起来可能不是很多，但研究人员将其等同于从腰部减轻了 2 公斤（4.4 磅）的重量。如果你徒步旅行，你会注意到这一点。

paras.en: The tight, knitted band around the ball of the foot was designed to prevent foot splay (widening). The experiments showed the arch of the foot was stiffened lengthwise by 65 percent, but the foot was still able to bend and push off with each step.
paras.zh: 脚掌周围的紧密针织带旨在防止脚张开（变宽）。实验显示，足弓纵向变硬了 65%，但每一步脚仍然能够弯曲和推出。

paras.en: "These socks mitigated forefoot splay and stiffened the medial longitudinal arch without apparently limiting late-stance foot mobility," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“这些袜子减轻了前脚的张开并加强了内侧纵弓，而没有明显限制后期脚部的活动能力。”

paras.en: "Supporting our hypothesis, walking with stiffer feet reduced user metabolic rate by eliciting more economical ankle extensor muscle contractions."
paras.zh: “支持我们的假设，用更僵硬的脚走路会引起更经济的踝伸肌收缩，从而降低用户的新陈代谢率。”

paras.en: Observations by the researchers showed the calf muscles pushing with a little more force, but also contracting more slowly, which uses less energy overall. It's similar to shifting to a higher gear on a bike.
paras.zh: 研究人员的观察显示，小腿肌肉的推力更大，但收缩速度也更慢，总体上消耗的能量更少。这类似于在自行车上换到更高的档位。

paras.en: Energy expenditure was analyzed through breath measurements, indicating how much oxygen was breathed in and how much carbon dioxide was exhaled.
paras.zh: 通过呼吸测量来分析能量消耗，表明吸入了多少氧气和呼出了多少二氧化碳。

paras.en: "Stiffer feet theoretically make walking less effortful," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“理论上，脚越硬，走路就越省力。”

paras.en: "By resisting midfoot dorsiflexion, greater foot stiffness typically yields more mechanical work by the foot per step.
paras.zh: “通过抵抗中足背屈，更大的足部硬度通常会在每一步中产生更多的机械功。

paras.en: "In turn, leg muscles require less mechanical work to sustain steady-state walking, which may reduce whole-body metabolic rate."
paras.zh: “反过来，腿部肌肉需要更少的机械工作来维持稳态行走，这可能会降低全身代谢率。”

paras.en: Research teams have previously been frustrated in their attempts to test whether a stiffer foot means a more energy-efficient walk. Earlier experiments with rigid insoles for shoes and arch supports have failed to cut energy use.
paras.zh: 研究小组此前曾试图测试更僵硬的脚是否意味着更节能的行走，但结果却遭遇了挫败。早期使用刚性鞋垫和足弓支撑的实验未能减少能源消耗。

paras.en: It's evidence that the stiffer human foot evolved as a better way of pushing off between strides when walking on two legs, as further stiffening makes the locomotion even more efficient.
paras.zh: 有证据表明，人类的脚变得更僵硬，是在两条腿走路时更好地在步幅之间推动的方式，因为进一步僵硬可以使运动更加有效。

paras.en: These socks, or garments similar to them, may even be useful in the real world in the future – in fact, a patent for their design has already been filed.
paras.zh: 这些袜子或类似的服装甚至可能在未来的现实世界中发挥作用——事实上，它们的设计已经申请了专利。

paras.en: They could improve endurance for walkers, and perhaps make it easier for people of all levels of mobility to get around, in a simpler and cheaper way than other options.
paras.zh: 它们可以提高步行者的耐力，或许还能让各种行动能力水平的人更容易出行，而且比其他选择更简单、更便宜。

paras.en: "Rigid shoes are unable to reduce metabolic rate during walking at ecologically valid speeds, and exoskeletons are relatively expensive and difficult to use throughout daily life, despite their greater metabolic benefits," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“硬鞋无法降低以生态上有效的速度行走时的代谢率，而外骨骼相对昂贵且难以在日常生活中使用，尽管它们具有更大的代谢益处。”

paras.en: "Thus, we present foot-stiffening socks as a cheap and readily adoptable technology capable of reducing metabolic rate during walking, and perhaps running."
paras.zh: “因此，我们将足部硬化袜作为一种廉价且易于采用的技术，能够降低步行甚至跑步过程中的新陈代谢率。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《英国皇家学会学报 B：生物科学》上。

articles.title: Rare Medical Case Leaves US Man Seeing His Cat's Eyes in People's Faces After Brain Surgery
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Just when you think you've heard it all when it comes to curious medical tales, along comes the case of a 28-year-old man from the northeastern US who sees his pet cat Luna in the faces of the people he meets during the day.
paras.zh: 正当你以为自己已经听过所有奇怪的医学故事时，一名来自美国东北部的 28 岁男子的案例却出现了，他在白天遇到的人的脸上看到了他的宠物猫 Luna。

paras.en: Sometimes it happens the other way around: If the first face he sees in the morning is a person, then features from that human face get transposed onto Luna, as well as other people he encounters.
paras.zh: 有时情况恰恰相反：如果他早上看到的第一张脸是一个人，那么这张人脸的特征就会转移到卢娜以及他遇到的其他人身上。

paras.en: These rather unsettling experiences have been going on for two years, after the man (known only as Karl) had an operation to remove a tangle of blood vessels that may have caused a brain bleed (a condition known as arteriovenous malformation).
paras.zh: 在这名男子（只知道卡尔）接受手术切除可能导致脑出血（一种称为动静脉畸形的疾病）的血管缠结的手术后，这些相当令人不安的经历已经持续了两年。

paras.en: The case has been reported on in the journal Cortex, by researchers from Dartmouth College and Brigham and Women's Hospital in the US.
paras.zh: 美国达特茅斯学院和布莱根妇女医院的研究人员在《皮质》杂志上报道了这一病例。

paras.en: "These episodes often persist for several hours and occasionally last all day," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在发表的论文中写道：“这些症状通常会持续几个小时，有时会持续一整天。”

paras.en: "Aside from their unusual combinations of features, the resulting faces appear entirely coherent. The transferred features are seamlessly integrated into the viewed face rather than appearing superimposed, and they change naturally as viewpoint or distance shifts."
paras.zh: “除了不寻常的特征组合之外，生成的面部看起来完全连贯。转移的特征无缝地集成到所观看的面部中，而不是看起来重叠，并且随着视角或距离的变化，它们会自然地变化。”

paras.en: It's not a condition completely unknown to science, and it's called palinopsia, which means that something seen – so the face of a cat or a person, for example – then reappears or persists later on.
paras.zh: 这并不是一种科学上完全未知的情况，它被称为幻视，这意味着看到的东西——例如猫或人的脸——随后会重新出现或持续存在。

paras.en: This particular case is known as prosopometamorphopsia, where face distortions are involved.
paras.zh: 这种特殊情况被称为“面部变形症”，其中涉及面部扭曲。

paras.en: And face processing happens to rely heavily on the brain's right temporal lobe – part of which had to be removed during Karl's operation.
paras.zh: 而面部处理恰好严重依赖于大脑的右颞叶——其中一部分在卡尔的手术中必须被切除。

paras.en: "This case of Karl seeing his cat's features in human faces and vice versa demonstrates that individual features can be pulled from memory and influence our ongoing perception," says psychologist and brain scientist Brad Duchaine, from Dartmouth College.
paras.zh: 达特茅斯学院的心理学家兼脑科学家布拉德·杜链 (Brad Duchaine) 表示：“卡尔在人脸上看到他的猫的特征，反之亦然，这表明个体特征可以从记忆中提取出来，并影响我们持续的感知。”

paras.en: Duchaine and Karl worked together to produce an AI-generated image that represented the prosopometamorphopsia, and according to the researchers, the latest AI tools promise to be a major step forward in understanding these conditions.
paras.zh: Duchaine 和 Karl 共同制作了一幅人工智能生成的图像，代表了面部变形症，研究人员表示，最新的人工智能工具有望成为理解这些病症的重要一步。

paras.en: Images can be produced in seconds from just a few words or sentences, and then refined until they match what's showing up in someone's mind's eye.
paras.zh: 只需几句话或几个句子就可以在几秒钟内生成图像，然后进行改进，直到它们与某人脑海中出现的内容相匹配。

paras.en: "AI provides researchers like us with the ability to generate more accurate visualizations of what people are experiencing when they're having distorted visual perceptions," says Duchaine.
paras.zh: “人工智能使像我们这样的研究人员能够更准确地可视化人们在视觉感知扭曲时所经历的情况，”杜链说。

paras.en: "If you know what the person is experiencing, you can much better research what they're dealing with and try to figure out ways to control it. And now the patient can also take part in that process of creating those visualizations."
paras.zh: “如果你知道这个人正在经历什么，你就可以更好地研究他们正在处理的事情，并尝试找出控制它的方法。现在患者也可以参与创建这些可视化的过程。”

paras.en: There's an even stranger twist to the story too: This has happened before.
paras.zh: 这个故事还有一个更奇怪的转折：这种事以前发生过。

paras.en: In a 1986 case also reported in Cortex, a 58-year-old woman who was sitting on a bus looked at a fellow passenger's poodle. When she looked back at the other passengers, they all seemed to have the dog's face.
paras.zh: 1986 年，Cortex 也报道了一起案例，一名 58 岁的女性坐在公交车上，看着同车乘客的贵宾犬。当她回头看其他乘客时，他们似乎都长着狗脸。

paras.en: Again, there was an issue with damage to the brain, this time caused by a stroke, which had also left the woman with problems recognizing people she knew, and even her own apartment.
paras.zh: 再次出现了大脑损伤的问题，这次是由中风引起的，这也让这位女士在识别她认识的人，甚至是她自己的公寓时出现了问题。

paras.en: The work to understand exactly what's going on continues.
paras.zh: 准确了解正在发生的情况的工作仍在继续。

paras.en: Both the poodle and cat cases suggest that our brains process faces differently to other visual inputs, because the canine and feline characteristics only showed up there – not on trees or furniture.
paras.zh: 贵宾犬和猫的案例都表明，我们的大脑处理面孔的方式与其他视觉输入不同，因为犬科动物和猫科动物的特征只出现在那里，而不是在树或家具上。

paras.en: It's more evidence that our brains are not simply looking at what our eyes see – they're combining other information at the same time. Digging deeper will require more case studies, and quite possibly more AI.
paras.zh: 更多证据表明，我们的大脑不仅仅只是观察眼睛看到的东西，它们同时还结合了其他信息。更深入的挖掘需要更多的案例研究，很可能还需要更多的人工智能。

paras.en: "Because progress in understanding many disorders of visual perception depends on accurately characterizing what patients see, we expect photorealistic visualizations to become an increasingly valuable tool for documenting such experiences," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“由于理解许多视觉感知障碍的进展取决于准确描述患者所看到的内容，因此我们预计逼真的可视化将成为记录此类经历的越来越有价值的工具。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Cortex.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在 Cortex 上。

articles.title: NASA warns this year's Monster El Niño could be even bigger than legendary 1997 event

paras.en: NASA warns this year's Monster El NiÃ±o could be even bigger than legendary 1997 event
paras.zh: NASA 警告今年的厄尔尼诺现象可能比 1997 年传奇事件还要严重

paras.en: - NASA scientists warn that the rapidly intensifying 2026 El NiÃ±o could surpass the historic 1997-98 event, which triggered devastating weather extremes around the world. Satellite data reveal striking similarities between the two, raising the possibility of major rainfall and flooding this winter, although the exact impacts remain uncertain.
paras.zh: - NASA 科学家警告称，2026 年厄尔尼诺现象迅速加剧，可能会超过 1997-98 年历史性事件，后者在世界各地引发了毁灭性的极端天气。卫星数据显示两者之间存在惊人的相似之处，增加了今年冬天出现大降雨和洪水的可能性，尽管确切的影响仍不确定。

paras.en: NASA scientists are tracking an exceptionally powerful El Niño that could grow even larger than the historic 1997 event, which brought extreme weather to regions around the world. Using 35 years of satellite observations, researchers can now compare the rapidly developing 2026 El Niño with some of the strongest events ever recorded, revealing remarkable similarities and important differences.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局科学家正在追踪异常强大的厄尔尼诺现象，其规模可能会超过 1997 年历史性的事件，那次事件给世界各地带来了极端天气。利用 35 年的卫星观测，研究人员现在可以将快速发展的 2026 年厄尔尼诺现象与一些有史以来最强烈的事件进行比较，揭示显着的相似之处和重要的差异。

paras.en: El Niño is a recurring climate phenomenon that typically develops every two to seven years, when ocean temperatures rise above normal across parts of the equatorial Pacific. These changes can disrupt atmospheric circulation and alter weather patterns far beyond the Pacific Ocean.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象是一种反复出现的气候现象，通常每两到七年发生一次，此时赤道太平洋部分地区的海洋温度高于正常水平。这些变化会扰乱大气环流并改变太平洋以外的天气模式。

paras.en: Two of the most powerful recent El Niño events occurred in 1997-98 and 2015-16. Both had widespread consequences, including destructive fires in Indonesia and the Amazon, severe drought and crop failures in southern Africa, and intense rainfall and coastal flooding in Southern California. Now, the 2026 El Niño is emerging as another major event, with satellite data suggesting it could rival those historic episodes.
paras.zh: 最近两次最强烈的厄尔尼诺事件发生在 1997-98 年和 2015-16 年。两者都造成了广泛的后果，包括印度尼西亚和亚马逊地区的破坏性火灾、南部非洲的严重干旱和农作物歉收，以及南加州的强降雨和沿海洪水。现在，2026 年厄尔尼诺现象正在成为另一场重大事件，卫星数据表明它可能与那些历史性事件相媲美。

paras.en: How El Niño Builds Strength in the Pacific
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象如何增强太平洋地区的力量

paras.en: The development of El Niño depends on a complex interaction between ocean temperatures and atmospheric winds.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象的发展取决于海洋温度和大气风之间复杂的相互作用。

paras.en: Under normal conditions, steady trade winds push warm surface water toward the western Pacific Ocean. This causes warm water to accumulate in the west, where the ocean surface sits slightly higher than it does farther east.
paras.zh: 在正常情况下，稳定的信风将温暖的表层海水推向西太平洋。这导致温暖的水在西部积聚，那里的海面略高于东部。

paras.en: When the trade winds weaken, some of that warm water begins moving eastward across the Pacific. The shift can weaken the winds even further or occasionally cause them to reverse direction. This allows additional warm water to spread east, reinforcing the process and raising ocean temperatures and sea levels across the central and eastern Pacific.
paras.zh: 当信风减弱时，一些温暖的海水开始向东穿过太平洋。这种转变可能会进一步减弱风的强度，有时甚至会导致风向逆转。这使得更多的暖水向东扩散，加强了这一过程，并提高了太平洋中部和东部的海洋温度和海平面。

paras.en: Although the underlying process is similar each time, no two El Niño events develop in exactly the same way. Their behavior depends partly on where the warmest water accumulates and how the atmosphere responds to the changing ocean conditions.
paras.zh: 尽管每次的基本过程都很相似，但没有两次厄尔尼诺事件的发展方式完全相同。它们的行为部分取决于最温暖的水积聚的位置以及大气对不断变化的海洋条件的反应。

paras.en: "The search for the 'typical' El Niño is very elusive," said Josh Willis, project scientist for sea level missions at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL). "They're all different in terms of where they land and how their impacts play out."
paras.zh: 美国宇航局喷气推进实验室（JPL）海平面任务项目科学家乔什·威利斯（Josh Willis）表示：“寻找‘典型’厄尔尼诺现象非常难以捉摸。” “它们的着陆地点和影响如何发挥都是不同的。”

paras.en: NASA Satellites Reveal Striking Similarities to 1997
paras.zh: NASA 卫星显示与 1997 年有惊人的相似之处

paras.en: To understand how the current El Niño compares with earlier events, scientists are examining decades of satellite measurements of ocean surface height.
paras.zh: 为了了解当前的厄尔尼诺现象与早期事件的比较，科学家们正在研究数十年来卫星对海洋表面高度的测量结果。

paras.en: This technique, called satellite altimetry, measures subtle changes in the elevation of the ocean surface. Because seawater expands as it becomes warmer, unusually high sea levels in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific can reveal where heat is accumulating during El Niño.
paras.zh: 这种技术称为卫星测高，可以测量海洋表面海拔的细微变化。由于海水随着温度升高而膨胀，赤道中部和东部太平洋异常高的海平面可以揭示厄尔尼诺现象期间热量积聚的位置。

paras.en: NASA's comparison maps show differences in Pacific Ocean surface height on October 13, 1997 (left), and October 12, 2026 (right). The earlier measurements were collected by the TOPEX/Poseidon satellite, while the newer observations came from the Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich satellite. Scientists at JPL processed both datasets to make the events easier to compare.
paras.zh: NASA 的比较地图显示了 1997 年 10 月 13 日（左）和 2026 年 10 月 12 日（右）太平洋表面高度的差异。早期的测量结果是由 TOPEX/Poseidon 卫星收集的，而较新的观测结果则来自 Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich 卫星。喷气推进实验室的科学家对这两个数据集进行了处理，以使事件更容易进行比较。

paras.en: The maps use red to identify areas where the ocean surface is higher than its usual level, while white represents normal conditions and blue shows areas where sea levels are below average. To better isolate the effects of El Niño and other temporary natural changes, researchers removed variations associated with seasonal patterns and long-term trends.
paras.zh: 这些地图使用红色来标识海平面高于平常水平的区域，而白色代表正常情况，蓝色代表海平面低于平均水平的区域。为了更好地隔离厄尔尼诺现象和其他暂时自然变化的影响，研究人员消除了与季节模式和长期趋势相关的变化。

paras.en: One major advantage of these observations is their remarkable consistency. Successive satellite missions have followed nearly identical paths, with overlapping periods of operation that allow scientists to compare measurements across decades.
paras.zh: 这些观察结果的一大优点是其显着的一致性。连续的卫星任务遵循几乎相同的路径，运行周期重叠，使科学家能够比较数十年来的测量结果。

paras.en: "What's unique about altimetry is that we have a 35-year record from nearly identical satellites flying almost the same ground track, with each mission overlapping the next," Willis said. "That lets us look back in time and compare this El Niño to what happened in 1997. And right now, this one is on track to be even bigger."
paras.zh: 威利斯说：“高度测量的独特之处在于，我们拥有 35 年的记录，几乎相同的卫星在几乎相同的地面轨道上飞行，每次任务都与下一个任务重叠。” “这让我们回顾过去，将这次厄尔尼诺现象与 1997 年发生的情况进行比较。而现在，这次厄尔尼诺现象的规模可能会更大。”

paras.en: Why the 2026 El Niño Resembles a Historic Climate Giant
paras.zh: 为什么 2026 年厄尔尼诺现象类似于历史性的气候巨人

paras.en: The 2026 El Niño intensified much more abruptly than the powerful 1997-98 event. Despite that difference in timing, NASA's satellite measurements from October reveal striking similarities in how the two events are developing.
paras.zh: 2026 年的厄尔尼诺现象比 1997-98 年的厄尔尼诺现象更加突然地加剧。尽管时间上存在差异，美国宇航局十月份的卫星测量结果显示，这两个事件的发展过程有着惊人的相似之处。

paras.en: In both cases, the Pacific displays a pronounced difference in sea level (low in the west and high in the east). The observations also show elevated, unusually warm water stretching eastward along the equator until it reaches the coast of South America.
paras.zh: 在这两种情况下，太平洋都显示出明显的海平面差异（西部低，东部高）。观测结果还显示，海水升高，异常温暖，沿着赤道向东延伸，直到到达南美洲海岸。

paras.en: These similarities suggest that the 2026 event could produce weather effects resembling those experienced during the 1997-98 El Niño. That earlier episode brought substantial rainfall to California and other parts of the southern United States, raising the possibility of comparable conditions during the coming winter.
paras.zh: 这些相似之处表明 2026 年的厄尔尼诺事件可能会产生类似于 1997-98 年厄尔尼诺现象的天气影响。早些时候的那次事件给加利福尼亚州和美国南部其他地区带来了大量降雨，增加了即将到来的冬季出现类似情况的可能性。

paras.en: However, the powerful 2015-16 El Niño demonstrates why similarities in overall strength do not necessarily translate into identical weather impacts.
paras.zh: 然而，2015-16 年强大的厄尔尼诺现象证明了为什么总体强度的相似性不一定会转化为相同的天气影响。

paras.en: For that comparison, NASA scientists also examined ocean surface height measurements from October 12, 2015, recorded by the Jason-2 satellite. The data were placed alongside observations from approximately the same time of year in 1997 and 2026.
paras.zh: 为了进行比较，NASA 科学家还检查了 Jason-2 卫星记录的 2015 年 10 月 12 日以来的海洋表面高度测量值。这些数据与 1997 年和 2026 年大约同一时间的观测结果放在一起。

paras.en: Although the 2015 event also featured exceptionally warm water and elevated sea levels along the equator, that warm water did not extend toward the South American coast as strongly as it did during the other two events.
paras.zh: 尽管 2015 年的事件也出现了异常温暖的海水和赤道沿岸海平面升高，但温暖的海水并没有像其他两次事件那样强烈地向南美海岸延伸。

paras.en: The resulting rainfall patterns were different as well. During the winter of 2015-16, much of the precipitation associated with El Niño was concentrated over Central America and the southeastern United States, while Mexico experienced significant flooding.
paras.zh: 由此产生的降雨模式也不同。 2015-16年冬季，与厄尔尼诺现象相关的大部分降水集中在中美洲和美国东南部，而墨西哥则经历了严重的洪水。

paras.en: Will El Niño Bring Extreme Weather in Winter 2026-27?
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象会在 2026-27 年冬季带来极端天气吗？

paras.en: The latest observations have prompted scientists to closely monitor how the 2026 El Niño develops and what it could mean for weather conditions in the months ahead.
paras.zh: 最新的观测结果促使科学家密切关注 2026 年厄尔尼诺现象的发展情况及其对未来几个月天气状况的影响。

paras.en: In its October 8, 2026, outlook, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) estimated an 83 percent chance that strong to very strong El Niño conditions would occur during the first three months of 2027.
paras.zh: 美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 在 2026 年 10 月 8 日的展望中估计，2027 年前三个月出现强烈至极强厄尔尼诺现象的可能性为 83%。

paras.en: That forecast points to the potential for a particularly significant climate event, but it does not establish exactly where the most severe effects will occur.
paras.zh: 该预测指出了发生特别重大气候事件的可能性，但它并没有准确确定最严重的影响将发生在哪里。

paras.en: El Niño can influence weather across much of the planet by changing the movement of heat and moisture through the atmosphere. However, those effects become increasingly difficult to predict farther from the tropical Pacific, where other atmospheric processes can alter or weaken the expected patterns.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象可以通过改变大气中热量和水分的运动来影响地球大部分地区的天气。然而，在远离热带太平洋的地方，这些影响变得越来越难以预测，因为那里的其他大气过程可能会改变或削弱预期的模式。

paras.en: As a result, even the strong resemblance between the 2026 and 1997 events cannot guarantee that the coming winter will unfold in the same way.
paras.zh: 因此，即使 2026 年和 1997 年的事件非常相似，也不能保证即将到来的冬天也会以同样的方式展开。

paras.en: "There's always a bit of a dice roll here," Willis said. "Just because this El Niño looks like 1997 doesn't mean it will be exactly the same -- it's just our best guess at the moment."
paras.zh: “这里总是有一些掷骰子的事情，”威利斯说。 “仅仅因为这次厄尔尼诺现象看起来像 1997 年，并不意味着它会完全相同——这只是我们目前最好的猜测。”

paras.en: The unprecedented consistency of the satellite record gives researchers a valuable way to recognize familiar patterns and evaluate the scale of the developing El Niño. But whether 2026-27 ultimately matches the extreme weather of previous historic events will depend on how the ocean and atmosphere interact in the months ahead.
paras.zh: 卫星记录前所未有的一致性为研究人员提供了一种宝贵的方法来识别熟悉的模式并评估正在发展的厄尔尼诺现象的规模。但 2026-27 年最终是否会与之前历史事件中的极端天气相匹配，将取决于未来几个月海洋和大气如何相互作用。

paras.en: Materials provided by NASA Earth Observatory. Original written by Kathryn Hansen. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 NASA 地球观测站提供。原创作者：凯瑟琳·汉森。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: A common osteoporosis drug blocked spinal damage in a surprising new study

paras.en: A common osteoporosis drug blocked spinal damage in a surprising new study
paras.zh: 一项令人惊讶的新研究显示，一种常见的骨质疏松症药物可以阻止脊柱损伤

paras.en: - Scientists have uncovered a surprising genetic connection to spinal degeneration and found that an existing osteoporosis drug can prevent damaging mineral buildup in zebrafish spines. The discovery could pave the way for new treatments that slow or prevent a major cause of chronic back pain.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了与脊柱退化之间令人惊讶的遗传联系，并发现现有的骨质疏松症药物可以防止斑马鱼脊柱中矿物质的破坏性积聚。这一发现可能为减缓或预防慢性背痛主要原因的新疗法铺平道路。

paras.en: An existing osteoporosis drug has shown surprising promise in protecting the spine from damage, raising hopes for new treatments for chronic neck and back pain. In experiments involving zebrafish, researchers found that the medication prevented abnormal mineral deposits from forming in the spine, a process that can cause spinal tissues to harden and vertebrae to fuse together.
paras.zh: 一种现有的骨质疏松症药物在保护脊柱免受损伤方面显示出令人惊讶的前景，为慢性颈部和背部疼痛的新疗法带来了希望。在涉及斑马鱼的实验中，研究人员发现这种药物可以防止脊柱中形成异常矿物质沉积，这一过程会导致脊柱组织硬化和椎骨融合在一起。

paras.en: The discovery could help scientists tackle one of the underlying causes of back pain: the gradual deterioration of the discs that cushion the bones of the spine. Researchers also identified changes in gene activity and metabolism that appear to contribute to this damage, revealing several possible targets for future treatments.
paras.zh: 这一发现可以帮助科学家解决背痛的根本原因之一：缓冲脊柱骨骼的椎间盘逐渐退化。研究人员还发现了导致这种损害的基因活性和代谢的变化，揭示了未来治疗的几个可能的目标。

paras.en: Although the findings have not yet been confirmed in humans, they suggest that medications already used for other conditions could offer new ways to slow spinal degeneration. The research also demonstrates how zebrafish could help scientists investigate the causes of spinal disease and test potential therapies.
paras.zh: 尽管这些发现尚未在人类身上得到证实，但他们表明已经用于其他疾病的药物可以提供减缓脊柱退化的新方法。该研究还展示了斑马鱼如何帮助科学家研究脊柱疾病的原因并测试潜在的疗法。

paras.en: Most people experience back pain at some point in their lives, and one common cause is the deterioration of the spine's natural shock absorbers. These structures, called intervertebral discs, sit between the vertebrae and help the spine absorb pressure, distribute weight, and move comfortably.
paras.zh: 大多数人在一生中的某个时刻都会经历背痛，其中一个常见原因是脊柱天然减震器的退化。这些结构称为椎间盘，位于椎骨之间，帮助脊柱吸收压力、分散重量并舒适地移动。

paras.en: Over time, the discs can lose their ability to cushion the spine, a condition known as intervertebral disc degeneration (IVDD). As the discs deteriorate, they can contribute to pain, stiffness, and reduced mobility.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，椎间盘会失去缓冲脊柱的能力，这种情况称为椎间盘退变（IVDD）。随着椎间盘恶化，它们会导致疼痛、僵硬和活动能力下降。

paras.en: Despite the widespread impact and substantial economic burden of this condition, no medications are currently available that can stop or reverse the degenerative process. Surgery remains the only established long-term intervention for certain severe cases, creating an urgent need for treatments that address the underlying damage.
paras.zh: 尽管这种情况具有广泛的影响和巨大的经济负担，但目前还没有药物可以阻止或逆转退化过程。手术仍然是针对某些严重病例的唯一长期干预措施，因此迫切需要解决潜在损害的治疗方法。

paras.en: Researchers have long known that genetics influences the risk of developing spinal disc degeneration. One gene of particular interest is associated with collagen IX, a protein that helps maintain the structural integrity of spinal discs by supporting the network of fibers that holds them together. Variations affecting this gene have repeatedly been associated with disc problems that develop earlier in life.
paras.zh: 研究人员早就知道遗传因素会影响椎间盘退变的风险。一个特别令人感兴趣的基因与胶原蛋白 IX 相关，这是一种通过支持将椎间盘固定在一起的纤维网络来帮助维持椎间盘结构完整性的蛋白质。影响该基因的变异多次与生命早期出现的椎间盘问题有关。

paras.en: To investigate how these genetic changes contribute to spinal damage, scientists at the Universities of Edinburgh and Bristol turned to zebrafish. They studied fish that had been bred without a functioning copy of the gene, allowing them to observe how its absence affected the spine as the animals grew older.
paras.zh: 为了研究这些基因变化如何导致脊髓损伤，爱丁堡大学和布里斯托尔大学的科学家将目光转向斑马鱼。他们研究了在没有该基因功能的情况下培育的鱼，从而观察随着动物年龄的增长，该基因的缺失如何影响脊柱。

paras.en: A Hidden Process Causes the Spine To Harden
paras.zh: 一个隐藏的过程导致脊柱变硬

paras.en: The results revealed striking similarities between the genetically altered zebrafish and people with degenerative spinal disease.
paras.zh: 结果显示，转基因斑马鱼与患有退行性脊柱疾病的人之间存在惊人的相似之处。

paras.en: As the fish aged, abnormal mineral deposits accumulated in the tissues separating their vertebrae. This process, known as mineralization, involves minerals collecting in tissues where they do not normally belong. In the spine, the buildup can cause normally flexible structures to become unusually rigid, much like unwanted bone forming in the wrong location.
paras.zh: 随着鱼的衰老，异常的矿物质沉积物在分隔椎骨的组织中积累。这个过程被称为矿化，涉及矿物质聚集在它们通常不属于的组织中。在脊柱中，堆积物会导致通常灵活的结​​构变得异常僵硬，就像在错误的位置形成不必要的骨质一样。

paras.en: The researchers also observed spinal fusion, in which neighboring vertebrae become joined together. Such changes can interfere with the spine's normal flexibility and movement.
paras.zh: 研究人员还观察到脊柱融合，即相邻的椎骨连接在一起。这种变化会干扰脊柱的正常灵活性和运动。

paras.en: Importantly, the scientists discovered that the damage began well before the mineral deposits appeared. An underlying layer that provides structural support during spinal development started to break down first, suggesting that deterioration of this protective framework may set the stage for later hardening.
paras.zh: 重要的是，科学家们发现损害早在矿藏出现之前就开始了。在脊柱发育过程中提供结构支撑的底层首先开始分解，这表明这种保护框架的恶化可能为以后的硬化奠定基础。

paras.en: This finding could help explain how genetic changes initiate a chain reaction that eventually damages the spine.
paras.zh: 这一发现可能有助于解释基因变化如何引发连锁反应，最终损害脊柱。

paras.en: Surprising Links to Fat Metabolism and Vitamin A
paras.zh: 脂肪代谢和维生素 A 之间的惊人联系

paras.en: To understand what was happening at the molecular level, the team examined patterns of gene activity in the zebrafish. This allowed them to identify biological processes that had become unusually active or disrupted as spinal degeneration developed.
paras.zh: 为了了解分子水平上发生的情况，研究小组检查了斑马鱼的基因活动模式。这使他们能够识别随着脊柱退化的发展而变得异常活跃或中断的生物过程。

paras.en: The researchers found alterations in fat metabolism, the processes through which the body breaks down, stores, and uses fats. They also detected disturbances in a cellular signaling system called mTOR, which helps regulate cell growth, metabolism, and responses to nutrients.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现脂肪代谢（身体分解、储存和使用脂肪的过程）发生了变化。他们还检测到一种名为 mTOR 的细胞信号系统的紊乱，该系统有助于调节细胞生长、新陈代谢和对营养物质的反应。

paras.en: Additional changes involved phosphate regulation and vitamin A signaling. Phosphate is an essential mineral involved in building bones and teeth, but its accumulation in the wrong tissues can contribute to abnormal hardening. Vitamin A signaling helps control how cells develop and function.
paras.zh: 其他变化涉及磷酸盐调节和维生素 A 信号传导。磷酸盐是参与骨骼和牙齿构建的重要矿物质，但它在错误的组织中积累可能会导致异常硬化。维生素 A 信号传导有助于控制细胞的发育和功能。

paras.en: Together, these findings suggest that spinal disc degeneration involves more than the gradual wearing down of tissues. Changes in how cells process nutrients, regulate growth, and handle minerals may also play important roles.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现表明椎间盘退变不仅仅涉及组织的逐渐磨损。细胞处理营养物质、调节生长和处理矿物质方式的变化也可能发挥重要作用。

paras.en: An Osteoporosis Drug Blocks Spinal Mineral Buildup
paras.zh: 骨质疏松症药物可阻止脊柱矿物质积聚

paras.en: One of the most promising discoveries came when researchers tested ways to reduce the spinal abnormalities.
paras.zh: 当研究人员测试减少脊柱异常的方法时，最有希望的发现之一出现了。

paras.en: A medication belonging to a class of drugs called bisphosphonates successfully blocked the abnormal mineral buildup in the zebrafish. Bisphosphonates are already used to treat osteoporosis, a condition in which bones become weaker and more vulnerable to fractures. These medications help protect bones by slowing the processes that break down bone tissue.
paras.zh: 一种名为双膦酸盐的药物成功地阻止了斑马鱼体内异常的矿物质积聚。双磷酸盐已经用于治疗骨质疏松症，骨质疏松症是一种骨骼变得脆弱且更容易骨折的疾病。这些药物通过减缓骨组织的分解过程来帮助保护骨骼。

paras.en: The finding is especially intriguing because it suggests that a treatment already used in patients might also help researchers develop therapies for spinal degeneration.
paras.zh: 这一发现特别有趣，因为它表明已经用于患者的治疗方法也可能有助于研究人员开发脊柱退行性变的疗法。

paras.en: The team identified other approaches that reduced spinal damage. Limiting how much food the zebrafish consumed led to fewer spinal fusions, as did medications that suppressed fat metabolism.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现了其他减少脊柱损伤的方法。限制斑马鱼的食物摄入量会导致脊柱融合减少，抑制脂肪代谢的药物也是如此。

paras.en: These results point toward fat metabolism and phosphate regulation as potentially important targets for future drugs.
paras.zh: 这些结果表明脂肪代谢和磷酸盐调节是未来药物的潜在重要目标。

paras.en: However, the experiments were conducted in zebrafish, not humans. More research will be needed to determine whether the same biological mechanisms operate in people and whether targeting them can safely prevent or slow spinal disc degeneration. The dietary findings also do not establish that restricting food intake can prevent spinal damage in humans.
paras.zh: 然而，这些实验是在斑马鱼身上进行的，而不是在人类身上进行的。需要更多的研究来确定相同的生物机制是否在人体中发挥作用，以及针对这些机制是否可以安全地预防或减缓椎间盘退变。饮食研究结果也没有证明限制食物摄入可以预防人类脊柱损伤。

paras.en: New Hope for Chronic Back Pain Treatments
paras.zh: 慢性背痛治疗的新希望

paras.en: The study was published in the journal Communications Biology and received support from Arthritis UK and BBSRC.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《通讯生物学》杂志上，并得到了英国关节炎协会和 BBSRC 的支持。

paras.en: Dr. Erika Kague, who led the research at the University of Edinburgh's Institute of Genetics and Cancer, emphasized the potential significance of identifying treatments that target the underlying causes of spinal damage.
paras.zh: 爱丁堡大学遗传学和癌症研究所领导这项研究的埃里卡·卡格博士强调了确定针对脊柱损伤根本原因的治疗方法的潜在意义。

paras.en: "For decades, surgery has been the only real answer for disc disease. By understanding the biology that drives the spine to harden, our zebrafish studies point to several ways of slowing it down, including a drug already used safely in patients. There's more work to do, but for a condition that's affected people for generations without a treatment in sight, this is super exciting."
paras.zh: “几十年来，手术一直是治疗椎间盘疾病的唯一真正答案。通过了解促使脊柱变硬的生物学原理，我们的斑马鱼研究指出了几种减缓脊柱变硬的方法，包括一种已经在患者身上安全使用的药物。还有更多的工作要做，但对于一种影响了几代人而又看不到治疗方法的疾病来说，这是非常令人兴奋的。”

paras.en: The findings could be particularly important for the millions of people who live with persistent back pain and have limited options for preventing their condition from worsening.
paras.zh: 这些发现对于数百万患有持续性背痛且预防病情恶化的选择有限的人来说尤其重要。

paras.en: Dr. Caroline Aylott, Head of Research Delivery at Arthritis UK, highlighted the potential benefits for patients.
paras.zh: 英国关节炎研究中心负责人 Caroline Aylott 博士强调了对患者的潜在好处。

paras.en: "For the 9.5 million people across the UK living with back pain this research brings fresh hope that potential new therapeutic approaches are on the horizon.
paras.zh: “对于英国 950 万背痛患者来说，这项研究带来了新的希望，潜在的新治疗方法即将出现。

paras.en: "We are proud to fund research that is unlocking the science behind the processes leading to spinal disc degeneration. Back pain is one of the UK's most common conditions that has blighted millions over generations. Dr. Erika Kague and her team at the University of Edinburgh have uncovered important genetic evidence that could pave the way for new treatments, bringing us one step closer to a future where fewer people have to live with the daily pain and challenges that back pain can bring."
paras.zh: “我们很自豪能够资助研究，揭开导致椎间盘退变过程背后的科学原理。背痛是英国最常见的疾病之一，已经困扰了数百万人。爱丁堡大学的 Erika Kague 博士和她的团队发现了重要的遗传证据，可以为新的治疗方法铺平道路，让我们离未来更近了一步，更少的人每天都要忍受背痛带来的疼痛和挑战。”

paras.en: The research also illustrates the broader value of studying basic biological processes to understand diseases that affect large numbers of people.
paras.zh: 该研究还说明了研究基本生物过程以了解影响大量人群的疾病的更广泛价值。

paras.en: Dr. Jef Grainger, Executive Director for Bioscience Advancing Knowledge at BBSRC, said:
paras.zh: BBSRC 生物科学促进知识执行主任 Jef Grainger 博士表示：

paras.en: "This research shows how publicly funded discovery bioscience can generate the knowledge needed to address major health challenges. By revealing new knowledge of how healthy biological processes break down in aging-related spinal disc degeneration, the study opens up promising avenues for future treatment development. It's a great example of how BBSRC-supported research helps turn scientific discovery into knowledge and innovations that have the potential to improve people's lives."
paras.zh: “这项研究展示了公共资助的发现生物科学如何产生解决重大健康挑战所需的知识。通过揭示与衰老相关的椎间盘退变中健康生物过程如何分解的新知识，该研究为未来治疗开发开辟了有希望的途径。这是 BBSRC 支持的研究如何帮助将科学发现转化为有潜力改善人们生活的知识和创新的一个很好的例子。”

paras.en: By identifying genetic and metabolic changes that contribute to spinal hardening, and demonstrating that some of the damage can be prevented in zebrafish, the researchers have opened several new avenues for investigating spinal disc degeneration.
paras.zh: 通过识别导致脊柱硬化的遗传和代谢变化，并证明斑马鱼的某些损伤是可以预防的，研究人员为研究椎间盘退变开辟了几种新途径。

paras.en: For a condition that affects millions and has no approved drug capable of stopping its progression, these early findings offer an encouraging starting point for developing treatments that could one day protect the spine before serious damage occurs.
paras.zh: 对于一种影响数百万人的疾病，并且没有批准的药物能够阻止其进展，这些早期发现为开发治疗方法提供了一个令人鼓舞的起点，有朝一日可以在严重损伤发生之前保护脊柱。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Edinburgh. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由爱丁堡大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Vitamin C could help block cancer-linked chemicals in your stomach, study finds

paras.en: Vitamin C could help block cancer-linked chemicals in your stomach, study finds
paras.zh: 研究发现，维生素 C 有助于阻止胃中与癌症相关的化学物质

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered that vitamin C may help prevent potentially cancer-causing chemicals from forming in the stomach after eating foods containing nitrates and nitrites. A new mathematical model suggests that taking vitamin C after meals could reduce these harmful reactions, offering a possible new strategy for lowering cancer risk.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，维生素 C 可能有助于防止食用含有硝酸盐和亚硝酸盐的食物后胃中形成潜在的致癌化学物质。一项新的数学模型表明，饭后服用维生素 C 可以减少这些有害反应，为降低癌症风险提供了一种可能的新策略。

paras.en: Vitamin C may do more than support everyday health. New research from the University of Waterloo suggests that it could also help prevent potentially cancer-causing chemicals from forming during digestion. Using mathematical modeling, scientists investigated how vitamin C influences chemical reactions in the digestive system that have been linked to cancer risk.
paras.zh: 维生素 C 的作用不仅仅只是支持日常健康。滑铁卢大学的新研究表明，它还有助于防止消化过程中潜在致癌化学物质的形成。科学家利用数学模型研究了维生素 C 如何影响消化系统中与癌症风险相关的化学反应。

paras.en: Exposure to nitrates and nitrites has increased in North American diets over the past several decades. These compounds are found in cured meats such as bacon and salami, as well as in fruits and vegetables grown in soil or water affected by pollution. Although nitrates and nitrites contribute to important functions in the brain and cardiovascular system, they can also participate in potentially harmful reactions once they reach the stomach.
paras.zh: 过去几十年来，北美饮食中硝酸盐和亚硝酸盐的暴露量有所增加。这些化合物存在于培根和萨拉米等腌肉中，以及在受污染的土壤或水中种植的水果和蔬菜中。尽管硝酸盐和亚硝酸盐有助于大脑和心血管系统的重要功能，但一旦到达胃部，它们也会参与潜在的有害反应。

paras.en: One of these reactions, called nitrosation, can produce substances that researchers suspect may contribute to cancer development. Understanding what causes these chemicals to form, and what might prevent their formation, has been a longstanding challenge.
paras.zh: 其中一种反应称为亚硝化，可以产生研究人员怀疑可能导致癌症发展的物质。了解导致这些化学物质形成的原因以及可能阻止其形成的原因一直是一个长期的挑战。

paras.en: Why Vitamin C Could Change the Cancer Risk Equation
paras.zh: 为什么维生素 C 可以改变癌症风险方程

paras.en: "Since at least the 90s, researchers have been studying the link between cancer and these compounds, with conflicting results," said Dr. Gordon McNicol, a post-doctoral researcher in applied mathematics and the first author of the study. "Our work suggests that the presence of dietary Vitamin C may help explain these inconsistencies."
paras.zh: “至少从上世纪 90 年代开始，研究人员就一直在研究癌症与这些化合物之间的联系，但结果相互矛盾，”应用数学博士后研究员、该研究的第一作者戈登·麦克尼科尔 (Gordon McNicol) 博士说。 “我们的研究表明膳食维生素 C 的存在可能有助于解释这些不一致的现象。”

paras.en: To investigate this possibility, the researchers developed a mathematical model that simulates how nitrates and nitrites travel through the body and undergo chemical changes. The model incorporated several interconnected systems, including the salivary glands, stomach, small intestine, and plasma, the liquid portion of blood.
paras.zh: 为了研究这种可能性，研究人员开发了一个数学模型，模拟硝酸盐和亚硝酸盐如何在体内传播并发生化学变化。该模型整合了几个相互关联的系统，包括唾液腺、胃、小肠和血浆（血液的液体部分）。

paras.en: Their simulations revealed that vitamin C consumed alongside nitrates and nitrites may interfere with the formation of potentially harmful compounds. This could help explain why foods containing nitrates do not necessarily carry the same risks.
paras.zh: 他们的模拟显示，与硝酸盐和亚硝酸盐一起消耗的维生素 C 可能会干扰潜在有害化合物的形成。这可能有助于解释为什么含有硝酸盐的食物不一定具有相同的风险。

paras.en: For example, leafy vegetables such as spinach naturally contain both nitrates and vitamin C. According to the model, the presence of vitamin C could limit the chemical reactions associated with cancer risk, potentially helping explain the protective effects suggested by some dietary research.
paras.zh: 例如，菠菜等叶类蔬菜天然含有硝酸盐和维生素 C。根据该模型，维生素 C 的存在可以限制与癌症风险相关的化学反应，可能有助于解释一些饮食研究提出的保护作用。

paras.en: Could Taking Vitamin C After Meals Help?
paras.zh: 饭后服用维生素C有帮助吗？

paras.en: The researchers also explored whether vitamin C supplements might offer similar benefits when taken after eating.
paras.zh: 研究人员还探讨了饭后服用维生素 C 补充剂是否可以提供类似的益处。

paras.en: Their findings suggest that taking vitamin C after each meal could moderately reduce the formation of nitrosation products associated with cancer risk. This effect could be particularly relevant when consuming foods containing nitrates and nitrites, including processed meats such as bacon and salami.
paras.zh: 他们的研究结果表明，每餐后服用维生素 C 可以适度减少与癌症风险相关的亚硝化产物的形成。当食用含有硝酸盐和亚硝酸盐的食物（包括培根和萨拉米香肠等加工肉类）时，这种影响可能尤其重要。

paras.en: However, the results come from mathematical simulations rather than clinical trials. Although the model predicts that vitamin C can reduce the production of potentially harmful chemicals, further research is needed to determine whether this translates into a measurable reduction in cancer risk in humans.
paras.zh: 然而，结果来自数学模拟而不是临床试验。尽管该模型预测维生素 C 可以减少潜在有害化学物质的产生，但仍需要进一步研究来确定这是否会显着降低人类癌症风险。

paras.en: New Clues for Future Cancer Prevention Research
paras.zh: 未来癌症预防研究的新线索

paras.en: The researchers believe their model could help scientists better understand the complicated relationship between diet, digestive chemistry, and cancer risk. It may also provide guidance for future experiments examining how nutritional choices influence the formation of potentially harmful compounds.
paras.zh: 研究人员相信他们的模型可以帮助科学家更好地理解饮食、消化化学和癌症风险之间的复杂关系。它还可以为未来研究营养选择如何影响潜在有害化合物形成的实验提供指导。

paras.en: "This work provides a mechanistic roadmap for future clinical and laboratory studies by identifying the key interacting drivers of these potentially harmful chemical reactions, including nitrite exposure, antioxidant intake, meal timing, gastric conditions and oral microbiome activity," said Dr. Anita Layton, professor of applied mathematics and Canada 150 researcher chair. "This model can help researchers design more targeted experiments and interventions, focusing on when and in whom nitrosation is most likely to occur."
paras.zh: “这项工作通过确定这些潜在有害化学反应的关键相互作用驱动因素，包括亚硝酸盐暴露、抗氧化剂摄入、进餐时间、胃部状况和口腔微生物组活动，为未来的临床和实验室研究提供了机制路线图，”应用数学教授兼加拿大 150 研究员主席 Anita Layton 博士说。 “这个模型可以帮助研究人员设计更有针对性的实验和干预措施，重点关注亚硝化最有可能发生的时间和对象。”

paras.en: By identifying how factors such as vitamin C intake, meal timing, stomach conditions, and bacteria in the mouth interact, the model could help researchers develop more precise strategies for studying and potentially reducing cancer-related chemical reactions during digestion.
paras.zh: 通过确定维生素 C 摄入量、进餐时间、胃部状况和口腔细菌等因素如何相互作用，该模型可以帮助研究人员制定更精确的策略来研究和潜在减少消化过程中与癌症相关的化学反应。

paras.en: The study, "Vitamin C as a nitrosation inhibitor: A modelling study across dietary patterns and water quality," was published in the Journal of Theoretical Biology.
paras.zh: 该研究题为“维生素 C 作为亚硝化抑制剂：饮食模式和水质的建模研究”，发表在《理论生物学杂志》上。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Waterloo. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由滑铁卢大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.zh: - 戈登·R·麦克尼科尔、南迪塔·B·巴苏、安妮塔·T·雷顿。维生素 C 作为亚硝化抑制剂：饮食模式和水质的建模研究。理论生物学杂志，2026； 627：112444 DOI：10.1016/j.jtbi.2026.112444

articles.title: Why hasn't the 'Blaze Star' exploded yet? Astronomers weigh in on what to expect
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: For the past two years, stargazers have waited with bated breath for a "new" light to appear in the night sky, born of one of the most cataclysmic events known to occur in the cosmos — a nova explosion. But what is the "Blaze Star" T. Coronae Borealis, and why is it so difficult to predict when its overdue brightening will occur? We turned to the experts to find out.
paras.zh: 在过去的两年里，观星者们屏息以待夜空中出现“新”光，这种光是由已知宇宙中发生的最灾难性事件之一——新星爆炸而产生的。但“火焰之星”北冕座是什么？为什么很难预测它迟来的增亮何时会发生？我们向专家寻求答案。

paras.en: T. Coronae Borealis — or T CrB for short — isn't a single star, but rather a binary system containing a dense white dwarf star and a bloated red giant. Over a period of around 80 years, the white dwarf's gravity strips material from the red giant until it hits a critical threshold. Next comes a dramatic nova explosion that causes the star to flare to 1,000 times its usual brightness before gradually settling down and repeating the cycle.
paras.zh: T. Coronae Borealis（简称 T CrB）不是一颗恒星，而是一个包含一颗致密白矮星和一颗膨胀红巨星的双星系统。在大约 80 年的时间里，白矮星的引力从红巨星上剥离物质，直到达到临界阈值。接下来是一场戏剧性的新星爆炸，导致恒星耀斑亮度达到平时亮度的 1000 倍，然后逐渐稳定下来并重复这个循环。

paras.en: Why is it so challenging to predict T. CrB's nova flare?
paras.zh: 为什么预测 T. CrB 的新星耀斑如此困难？

paras.en: "T CrB *will* erupt sometime soon," Bradley Schaefer of the Louisiana State University Department of Physics and Astronomy told Space.com in an email. "Everyone is very confident on this. But we cannot make high-accuracy measures of the rate of gas falling onto the surface of the white dwarf, and we do not have a high accuracy measure of the trigger mass for the big hydrogen bomb." Schaefer continued.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州立大学物理与天文学系的 Bradley Schaefer 在一封电子邮件中告诉 Space.com：“T CrB *很快就会”爆发。” “每个人对此都非常有信心。但我们无法高精度测量气体落在白矮星表面的速率，而且我们也没有高精度测量大型氢弹的触发质量。”谢弗继续说道。

paras.en: Historical observations reveal that the last nova eruption reached Earth in 1946, which places us well inside the window for another dramatic brightening of T. CrBb. However, the unpredictability of the white dwarf's feeding makes it difficult to pin down exactly when the explosion will become visible from Earth.
paras.zh: 历史观测表明，最后一次新星爆发是在 1946 年到达地球，这使我们处于 T. CrBb 再次戏剧性增亮的窗口之内。然而，白矮星进食的不可预测性使得很难准确确定何时从地球上可以看到爆炸。

paras.en: "The exact date of the upcoming T CrB eruption depends primarily on how fast the gas coming from its companion star is accumulating on the surface of the white dwarf," explained Schaefer. "When some specific trigger mass has accumulated, then T CrB will erupt. For the last 80 years, we have been watching the gas pile up on the white dwarf surface, and we know that it must be near the trigger threshold."
paras.zh: “即将到来的 T CrB 喷发的确切日期主要取决于来自伴星的气体在白矮星表面积聚的速度有多快，”谢弗解释道。 “当一些特定的触发质量积累起来时，T CrB就会爆发。在过去的80年里，我们一直在观察气体在白矮星表面的堆积，我们知道它一定接近触发阈值。”

paras.en: Astronomers have tried to predict T CrB's brightening by comparing a recent fluctuation in the light of the distant star system to a similar event that occurred in the runup to the 1946 event.
paras.zh: 天文学家试图通过将遥远恒星系统最近的光波动与 1946 年事件前发生的类似事件进行比较来预测 T CrB 的增亮。

paras.en: "There have already been some dimming and brightening episodes that caused excitement but did not yet turn into the main event," Elizabeth Hays, lab chief at NASA's Astroparticle Physics Laboratory at the Goddard Spaceflight Center, told Space.com in an email. "It is likely that the nova will happen in the next few years but we still don't know exactly when. I can't give you a guaranteed prediction, but I will be a little surprised if it gets to 2030, or 84 years past the last eruption."
paras.zh: 美国宇航局戈达德航天中心天体粒子物理实验室的实验室主任伊丽莎白·海斯在一封电子邮件中告诉Space.com：“已经出现了一些令人兴奋的暗淡和明亮的事件，但尚未变成主要事件。” “新星很可能会在未来几年内发生，但我们仍然不知道确切的时间。我无法给你一个有保证的预测，但如果它发生到 2030 年，或者距离上次爆发 84 年，我会有点惊讶。”

paras.en: Hays notes that the intense light from the red giant dramatically outshines the dimmer white dwarf, making detailed observation challenging. There is also no way to precisely measure the temperature and pressure of the matter lurking near the surface of the smaller star. "Predicting nova explosions are a little like predicting the weather; conditions may be right but the timing of the storm can be uncertain."
paras.zh: 海斯指出，红巨星发出的强烈光线明显超过了较暗的白矮星，这使得详细观察变得具有挑战性。也没有办法精确测量潜伏在较小恒星表面附近物质的温度和压力。 “预测新星爆炸有点像预测天气；条件可能合适，但风暴发生的时间可能不确定。”

paras.en: What will happen when T CrB's nova light reaches Earth?
paras.zh: 当 T CrB 的新星光到达地球时会发生什么？

paras.en: There'll be no visual warning of the eruption before it reaches Earth, though according to Hays there could be an early flash of light in the X-ray spectrum.
paras.zh: 海斯表示，在火山喷发到达地球之前，不会出现任何视觉警告，但 X 射线光谱中可能会出现早期闪光。

paras.en: "The world's amateur astronomers have been doing an awesome job of keeping T CrB under hair-trigger monitoring roughly every minute or two, so when T CrB has brightened by around one magnitude, then alerts will spread around the world within minutes," said Schaefer.
paras.zh: 谢弗说：“世界各地的业余天文学家一直在做一项出色的工作，大约每隔一两分钟就会对 T CrB 进行一触即发的监测，因此当 T CrB 亮度增加约一个星等时，警报将在几分钟内传播到世界各地。”

paras.en: Once the call goes out, telescopes and observatories around the world will kick into gear, running pre-prepared observation programmes to capitalize on the rare and cataclysmic event. "When the nuclear runaway process starts, it will take off and peak very quickly, in less than a day."
paras.zh: 一旦呼叫发出，世界各地的望远镜和天文台将启动，运行预先准备的观测计划，以利用这一罕见的灾难性事件。 “当核失控过程开始时，它会在不到一天的时间内迅速起飞并达到峰值。”

paras.en: The nova will see the star jump from its normal brightness of magnitude +10 — which is beyond the detection limit of the naked eye — to magnitude +1.7, making it appear as if a star brighter than the North Star Polaris has suddenly burst to life in the night sky.
paras.zh: 新星将看到这颗恒星的亮度从正常的+10星等（超出了肉眼的检测极限）跃升至+1.7星等，看起来就像一颗比北极星更亮的恒星在夜空中突然爆发。

paras.en: "The brightness will fall below naked-eye visibility in dark places within a couple of days and become too faint for binoculars within about a week," said Hays. "Outside the visible band, for example, in radio, X-ray and gamma rays, light caused by the eruption will be visible for months or even years. "
paras.zh: 海斯说：“几天之内，亮度将在黑暗的地方降至肉眼可见度以下，并在大约一周内变得对于双筒望远镜来说太微弱。” “在可见光波段之外，例如射电、X射线和伽马射线，火山喷发产生的光将在数月甚至数年内可见。”

paras.en: Where can I find the Blaze Star in the night sky?
paras.zh: 夜空中哪里可以找到火焰星？

paras.en: T CrB can be found glowing close to the magnitude +4.28 star Epsilon Coronae Borealis in the constellation Corona Borealis during the early evening in November, with the constellations of Hercules and Bootes on either side.
paras.zh: 11 月傍晚时分，T CrB 会在北冕座中的 +4.28 星 Epsilon Coronae Borealis 附近发光，两侧是武仙座和牧夫座。

paras.en: It will dip below the horizon for viewers in the U.S. just a few hours after sunset, before re-emerging into the northeastern sky in the predawn hours.
paras.zh: 日落后几个小时，它将沉入美国观众的地平线以下，然后在黎明前重新出现在东北天空中。

paras.en: Want to capture a photo of T. CrB when it erupts? Then be sure to read our guide to photographing the night sky, along with our picks of the best cameras, lenses and smart telescopes that are perfect for capturing the majesty of the starry realm.
paras.zh: 想拍摄 T. CrB 喷发时的照片吗？然后，请务必阅读我们的夜空拍摄指南，以及我们精选的最适合捕捉星空领域的最佳相机、镜头和智能望远镜。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 15, 1988: The 300-foot Green Bank Telescope collapses suddenly, leaving a huge pile of wreckage in West Virginia
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 15, 1988, a 300-foot radio telescope in Green Bank, West Virginia suddenly collapsed. It happened at 9:46 p.m. on a clear night with no strong winds.
paras.zh: 1988年11月15日，西弗吉尼亚州格林班克的一座300英尺射电望远镜突然倒塌。事情发生在晚上 9 点 46 分。在一个晴朗的夜晚，没有强风。

paras.en: When the observatory staff showed up to work the next morning, they were greeted by a huge pile of wreckage. The telescope collapsed under its own weight after a key structural element called a "gusset plate" failed. This was one of four connecting plates that held the telescope's large, metal beams together. Investigators found that these gusset plates were not built to last the 26 years that this telescope had been in use.
paras.zh: 第二天早上，当天文台工作人员上班时，迎接他们的是一大堆残骸。在一个被称为“角撑板”的关键结构元件失效后，望远镜因自身重量而倒塌。这是将望远镜的大金属梁固定在一起的四个连接板之一。调查人员发现，这些角撑板的建造不能满足该望远镜使用 26 年的需要。

paras.en: Three years later, construction began on a new telescope. The Green Bank Telescope was even bigger and more sensitive, and it began science operations in 2001.
paras.zh: 三年后，一架新望远镜开始建造。绿岸望远镜更大、更灵敏，并于 2001 年开始科学运行。

paras.en: When the 300-foot telescope first debuted, it was not just the United States' largest radio observatory, but the largest such facility in the world. But its quick construction — just two years — led to it having to be significantly upgraded later.
paras.zh: 当这台 300 英尺望远镜首次亮相时，它不仅是美国最大的射电天文台，而且是世界上最大的此类设施。但它的快速建设——仅仅两年——导致后来不得不进行重大升级。

paras.en: "In 1970, the 300-foot’s surface had become so warped from maintenance crews, snow, and its own weight that a new finer-meshed aluminum surface was installed," the website for the National Radio Astronomy Observatory reads. "A larger traveling feed was also installed at the prime focus."
paras.zh: 国家射电天文台网站上写道：“1970 年，由于维护人员、积雪和自身重量，300 英尺的表面变得如此扭曲，以至于安装了新的网状更细的铝表面。” “在主要焦点处还安装了一个更大的移动馈源。”

paras.en: The collapse, however, was no one's fault. "Unforeseeable stress factors cracked a steel connector plate," wrote the NRAO.
paras.zh: 然而，崩溃并不是任何人的错。 NRAO 写道：“不可预见的应力因素使钢连接板破裂。”

paras.en: During its years of observations, the 300-foot telescope contirbuted to the discovery of dark matter and the realization that pulsars come from supernova explosions.
paras.zh: 在多年的观测中，这台 300 英尺望远镜为暗物质的发现以及脉冲星来自超新星爆炸的认识做出了贡献。

paras.en: "One of the most important products to come out of the 300-foot telescope was an all-sky survey of radio objects called the Green Bank 6cm Survey. Nearly every northern hemisphere radio object studied by any other telescope is from a catalog compiled using this telescope," reads the NRAO website.
paras.zh: NRAO 网站上写道：“300 英尺望远镜最重要的产品之一是对射电天体的全天空巡天，称为绿岸 6 厘米巡天。任何其他望远镜研究的几乎所有北半球射电天体都来自使用该望远镜编制的目录。”

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: 30 years ago, 'Space Jam' proposed the best way to resolve interplanetary disputes
articles.author: Sergio Pereira

paras.en: You just ordered a Pizza Hut and a two-liter bottle of Mountain Dew. You put on "Space Jam" to watch the greatest of all time team up with the Looney Tunes. It's a perfect evening… in 1996 or 2026.
paras.zh: 您刚刚订购了一家必胜客和一瓶两升的激浪啤酒。您播放“空中大灌篮”，观看史上最伟大的乐一通合作。这是一个完美的夜晚……无论是 1996 年还是 2026 年。

paras.en: The entire concept of "Space Jam" is so '90s that you swear you can hear Los Del Rio in the background mouthing, "Dale a tu cuerpo alegría, Macarena." As ridiculous as an intergalactic basketball match may sound, it's a perfect example of how even the strangest idea can work if you commit to it fully.
paras.zh: 《太空大灌篮》的整个概念充满了 90 年代的气息，以至于你发誓你可以听到 Los Del Rio 在背景中唱着“Dale a tucuerpo alegría, Macarena”。尽管星际篮球比赛听起来很荒谬，但它是一个完美的例子，说明如果你全力投入，即使是最奇怪的想法也能发挥作用。

paras.en: In case you thought you hallucinated the whole thing, no, you didn't, as the Looney Tunes find themselves in quite the predicament in this live-action-animation hybrid. A bunch of aliens known as the Nerdlucks arrive on Earth to abduct the Tunes and take them back as attractions to the outer-space amusement park known as Moron Mountain (shockingly nobody has claimed that subreddit, so do your thing, Internet!).
paras.zh: 如果你认为你产生了幻觉，不，你没有，因为乐一通发现自己在这部真人动画混合体中陷入了相当的困境。一群被称为 Nerdlucks 的外星人抵达地球，绑架了 Tunes，并将它们带回名为 Moron Mountain 的外太空游乐园（令人震惊的是，没有人声称拥有该 subreddit，所以做你的事吧，互联网！）。

paras.en: Being a wheeling-and-dealing wabbit, though, Bugs Bunny proposes a winner-takes-all basketball game between the Tunes and the tiny Nerdlucks. Unfortunately, the crafty aliens use their tech to steal the talent from ballers like Charles Barkley and Muggsy Bogues and turn themselves into the scary and skilled Monstars.
paras.zh: 不过，作为一只狡猾的兔子，兔八哥提议在曲调队和小书呆子队之间进行一场赢家通吃的篮球比赛。不幸的是，狡猾的外星人利用他们的技术从查尔斯·巴克利和马格西·博格斯等球员那里窃取了天赋，并将自己变成了可怕而熟练的怪物。

paras.en: So, Bugs and friends reach out to Michael Jordan, who recently switched from basketball to baseball, to help the Tune Squad win this intergalactic b-ball matchup and their freedom, because if anybody can do it, Air Jordan (Hare Jordan?) can. Oh, Bill Murray also shows up here a few times. Why? Because he can!
paras.zh: 因此，巴格斯和朋友们向最近从篮球转向棒球的迈克尔·乔丹伸出援手，帮助 Tune Squad 赢得这场星际篮球比赛并获得自由，因为如果有人能做到，飞人乔丹（Hare Jordan？） 就能做到。哦，比尔默里也在这里出现过几次。为什么？因为他可以！

paras.en: "Space Jam" is a spin on the classic sci-fi trope of resolving high-stakes conflicts through sports. In 1975, "Death Race 2000" introduced a world where people drive like hooligans and bash into each other to get ahead and win races (ironically, this is the regular experience on any public road now). Meanwhile, in the same year, "Rollerball" demonstrated how to use extreme sports as a plot device whereby brutality trumped any kind of skill in the arena.
paras.zh: 《太空大灌篮》是对通过体育运动解决高风险冲突的经典科幻比喻的一种诠释。 1975 年，《死亡竞赛 2000》引入了一个世界，人们像流氓一样开车，互相猛烈撞击，以取得领先并赢得比赛（讽刺的是，这是现在任何公共道路上的常见经历）。与此同时，同年，《Rollerball》展示了如何利用极限运动作为情节手段，让残酷战胜竞技场上的任何技巧。

paras.en: Yet "Space Jam" took this concept, cartoonified it for a family-friendly audience, and challenged the conflict resolution approaches of other alien invasion movies from 1996.
paras.zh: 然而，《太空大灌篮》采用了这一概念，将其卡通化以适合家庭观众，并挑战了 1996 年以来其他外星人入侵电影的冲突解决方法。

paras.en: While "Independence Day" saw the heroes trying to destroy the mothership and "Mars Attacks" featured humans running away from "Ack! Ack"-ing extraterrestrials with ray guns, this film used the court to settle the score. It's an innovative way to deal with interplanetary matters, that's for sure.
paras.zh: 《独立日》讲述了英雄们试图摧毁母舰的故事，而《火星袭击》则讲述了人类用射线枪逃离“阿克！阿克”的外星人的故事，而这部电影则利用法庭来解决问题。毫无疑问，这是处理行星际事务的一种创新方法。

paras.en: Here's the thing: a basketball game is incredibly fair and puts everybody on equal footing. It isn't about who has the biggest guns or most high-tech spacecraft; it's about who can best work as a team to get a result.
paras.zh: 事情是这样的：篮球比赛非常公平，让每个人都处于平等的地位。问题不在于谁拥有最大的枪支或最高科技的航天器；而在于谁拥有最大的枪支或最高科技的航天器。关键在于谁能够最好地团队合作以取得成果。

paras.en: Now, this isn't to say that the Looney Tunes and Nerdlucks ever planned on playing by the rules. Bugs challenged his opponents to a basketball contest because they were small and he knew the Tunes would have the height advantage. However, the aliens pulled a fast one by stealing b-ball talent and evolving into the brutish Monstars. Basically the cartoon version of when athletes use PEDs…
paras.zh: 现在，这并不是说乐一通和书呆子曾经计划遵守规则。巴格斯向他的对手发起了一场篮球比赛，因为他们身材矮小，而且他知道曲调队将具有身高优势。然而，外星人通过窃取篮球天赋并进化成野蛮的怪物队，取得了快速的成绩。基本上是运动员使用 PED 时的卡通版本……

paras.en: Even so, you can't argue that a basketball game gives each side a genuine chance at victory. Let's be real here for a moment: if humans were to face off against aliens in actual warfare, we would get smoked in seconds. Hell, we would probably get stuck in a tailspin of political infighting and the passing of the buck or end up destroying ourselves before the aliens even fired a single shot. On the court, though, there's no place to hide. Everybody needs to get up and slam!
paras.zh: 即便如此，你也不能说篮球比赛给双方带来了真正的胜利机会。让我们面对现实吧：如果人类在实际战争中与外星人对峙，我们很快就会被熏死。天哪，我们可能会陷入政治内斗和推卸责任的混乱之中，或者最终在外星人开一枪之前就毁掉了自己。但在球场上，却无处可藏。每个人都需要站起来猛击！

paras.en: There's also something magical about having MJ as the de facto leader of the Tune Squad. In the '90s, he was the closest thing to a real-life superhero that the world had ever seen. He broke basketball records, then headed off to another sport — baseball — to challenge himself. His love for the court never died, though, so he came back for the last dance. "Space Jam" found a clever way to blur the line between fiction and reality to elevate MJ's already iconic status.
paras.zh: 让 MJ 作为 Tune Squad 事实上的领导者也有一些神奇之处。在 90 年代，他是世界上最接近现实生活中的超级英雄的人。他打破了篮球纪录，然后转向另一项运动——棒球——来挑战自己。不过，他对球场的热爱从未消失，所以他回来参加最后一支舞。 《太空大灌篮》找到了一种巧妙的方式来模糊虚构与现实之间的界限，从而提升 MJ 已经标志性的地位。

paras.en: Sure, Jordan wasn't exactly Daniel Day-Lewis in this film, but he did his best. "He did as well as he could do," director Joe Pytka told Entertainment Weekly. "He played himself, and remember, a lot of the film is based on his life, so there were realistic references there. He was very professional; he showed up, he knew his lines, and we made it as easy as possible.”
paras.zh: 当然，乔丹并不完全是这部电影中的丹尼尔·戴·刘易斯，但他尽力了。 “他已经尽力了，”导演乔·皮特卡告诉《娱乐周刊》。 “他扮演了他自己，记住，这部电影的很多内容都是根据他的生活改编的，所以那里有现实的参考。他非常专业；他出现了，他知道他的台词，我们让这一切变得尽可能简单。”

paras.en: It's this type of dedication and professionalism that turned him into the greatest of all time. If you want to debate whether that honor belongs to LeBron James, go argue with a wall. We all watched LeBron in the 2021 sequel "Space Jam: A New Legacy," and let's just say that it makes "Morbius" look like "Casablanca" by comparison, and it deserves the flak it got.
paras.zh: 正是这种奉献精神和专业精神使他成为有史以来最伟大的球员。如果你想争论这个荣誉是否属于勒布朗·詹姆斯，那就去跟墙争论吧。我们都在 2021 年的续集《太空大灌篮：新遗产》中观看了勒布朗，我们只能说，相比之下，它让《莫比亚斯》看起来像《卡萨布兰卡》，它受到的批评是实至名归的。

paras.en: Back with the infinitely better original "Space Jam" movie, it isn't just the courtside matchup to decide the Tunes' fate that surprises, but also the aftermath. Unlike other alien movies that see extraterrestrials being vaporized in the final act, this film demonstrates the power of humility in victory.
paras.zh: 带着无限精彩的原创电影《太空大灌篮》回归，令人惊讶的不仅仅是决定曲调命运的场边对决，还有后果。与其他外星人电影在最后一幕看到外星人被蒸发不同，这部电影展示了胜利中谦逊的力量。

paras.en: MJ understands that the Monstars only did the bidding of Mr. Swackhammer (voiced by the sensational Danny DeVito) and challenges them to free themselves. After the Monstars send Swackhammer packing to the moon, they befriend the Tunes, and there's good vibes all around. The beef is settled, and the only rivalry that remains is the competitive one on the court. That's all, folks!
paras.zh: MJ 明白 Monstars 只听从了 Swackhammer 先生（由轰动一时的丹尼·德维托配音）的命令，并挑战他们释放自己。巨星将斯威克哈默送上月球后，他们与曲调成为了朋友，周围气氛良好。争端已经解决，唯一剩下的就是球场上的竞争了。就这样，伙计们！

paras.en: Instead of treating the aliens as the enemy that must be destroyed, "Space Jam" looks at these creatures as misguided and simply following instructions. They aren't bad guys; they're foot soldiers. Once they break free from Swackhammer's shackles, everybody gets along. And hey, maybe Marvin the Martian also put in a good word for them.
paras.zh: 《太空大灌篮》并没有将外星人视为必须消灭的敌人，而是将这些生物视为被误导的生物，只是简单地遵循指示。他们不是坏人；他们是坏人。他们是步兵。一旦他们挣脱了斯瓦克哈默的束缚，大家就和睦相处了。嘿，也许火星人马文也为他们说了好话。

paras.en: It's a testament to the quality of "Space Jam" that everybody still talks about it 30 years later, but nobody can even remember Steven Spielberg's "Disclosure Day" from a few months ago.
paras.zh: 30年后每个人仍然在谈论它，这证明了《空中大灌篮》的质量，但没有人记得史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格几个月前的“披露日”。

paras.en: In 1996, aliens were all the rage (and a little overexposed if we're being honest) but "Space Jam" still managed to find a unique and compelling angle that stood out from everything else around it. Not only that, but it also paid tribute to one of the greatest sportsmen to have ever walked the planet.
paras.zh: 1996 年，外星人风靡一时（老实说，有点曝光过度），但《太空大灌篮》仍然设法找到了一个独特且引人注目的角度，从周围的其他一切中脱颖而出。不仅如此，它还向地球上最伟大的运动员之一致敬。

paras.en: This wasn't just a slam dunk in cinema; it was boomshakalaka!
paras.zh: 这不仅仅是电影界的大灌篮；这是轰沙卡拉卡！

paras.en: "Space Jam" is available to watch on HBO Max.
paras.zh: 《太空大灌篮》可在 HBO Max 上观看。

paras.en: Sergio Pereira is a scriptwriter and entertainment journalist covering movies, TV, video games, and comic books. His work has appeared in Looper, /Film, CBR, Screen Rant, IGN, and SYFY Wire. Sergio lives in sunny Johannesburg, South Africa with a clan of Chihuahuas that rule his bed and life.
paras.zh: Sergio Pereira 是一位编剧和娱乐记者，报道电影、电视、视频游戏和漫画书。他的作品曾出现在 Looper、/Film、CBR、Screen Rant、IGN 和 SYFY Wire 上。塞尔吉奥生活在阳光明媚的南非约翰内斯堡，和一个吉娃娃家族一起统治着他的床和生活。
