articles.title: Cork Takes the Heat So DRACO’s Data Can Survive
articles.author: Amorim Cork Solutions

paras.en: Mozelos, Portugal, September 2, 2026 – Amorim Cork Solutions is contributing its P50 cork-based thermal protection material to DRACO, a European Space Agency (ESA) mission designed to capture rare in-flight data on how satellites break apart during atmospheric reentry.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙莫泽洛斯，2026 年 9 月 2 日 – Amorim Cork Solutions 正在向 DRACO 贡献其 P50 软木热防护材料，DRACO 是欧洲航天局 (ESA) 的一项任务，旨在捕获有关卫星在重返大气层期间如何分解的罕见飞行数据。

paras.en: Scheduled for launch in 2027, DRACO, short for Destructive Reentry Assessment Container Object, will deliberately reenter Earth’s atmosphere and break apart. Around 200 sensors and four cameras will record what happens to the spacecraft throughout the process, generating data that could help improve reentry models and support the development of safer, more sustainable spacecraft.
paras.zh: DRACO（破坏性再入评估容器物体的缩写）计划于 2027 年发射，将故意重新进入地球大气层并解体。大约 200 个传感器和四个摄像头将记录航天器在整个过程中发生的情况，生成有助于改进再入模型并支持开发更安全、更可持续的航天器的数据。

paras.en: At the heart of this unusual engineering challenge is a 40 cm survival capsule. While the spacecraft around it is designed to break apart, the capsule must survive long enough to preserve and transmit the mission’s critical scientific data. Its heat shield will use Amorim P50, a cork-based ablative thermal protection material developed for demanding aerospace environments.
paras.zh: 这项不同寻常的工程挑战的核心是一个 40 厘米的救生舱。虽然它周围的航天器被设计为会分解，但太空舱必须存活足够长的时间才能保存和传输任务的关键科学数据。其隔热罩将使用 Amorim P50，这是一种基于软木的烧蚀热防护材料，专为要求苛刻的航空航天环境而开发。

paras.en: During reentry, DRACO will encounter intense thermal and mechanical conditions as the spacecraft progressively breaks apart. Data collected by its sensors and cameras will be processed onboard, with the most valuable information transferred to the survival capsule.
paras.zh: 在重返大气层期间，随着航天器逐渐解体，DRACO 将遇到强烈的热和机械条件。其传感器和摄像头收集的数据将在船上进行处理，最有价值的信息将传输到救生舱中。

paras.en: Protecting that capsule is therefore essential to the mission.
paras.zh: 因此，保护​​该太空舱对于此次任务至关重要。

paras.en: The von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics (VKI), which is responsible for key aspects of the capsule’s design, aerothermodynamics, and thermal protection development and validation, selected Amorim P50 for its heat shield.
paras.zh: 冯卡门流体动力学研究所 (VKI) 负责胶囊设计、空气热力学以及热防护开发和验证的关键方面，选择 Amorim P50 作为其隔热罩。

paras.en: P50 is a lightweight, cork-based ablative material designed to provide thermal protection in demanding aerospace applications. Its selection for DRACO builds on approximately 15 years of collaboration between Amorim and VKI in the field of aerothermodynamics and thermal protection.
paras.zh: P50 是一种轻质软木烧蚀材料，旨在为要求苛刻的航空航天应用提供热保护。 DRACO 的选择建立在 Amorim 和 VKI 在空气热力学和热防护领域约 15 年的合作基础上。

paras.en: “DRACO represents a remarkable engineering challenge: designing a spacecraft to break apart while ensuring that the knowledge generated during that process survives,” said Sofia Paixão, Global Technical & Product Manager at Amorim Cork Solutions. “We are proud to see Amorim P50 contributing to that challenge and to a mission that could deepen our understanding of atmospheric reentry and help inform the design of future spacecraft.”
paras.zh: Amorim Cork Solutions 全球技术和产品经理 Sofia Paixão 表示：“DRACO 代表了一项非凡的工程挑战：设计一艘能够分解的航天器，同时确保该过程中产生的知识得以保存。” “我们很自豪看到 Amorim P50 为这一挑战和任务做出贡献，该任务可以加深我们对大气层再入的理解，并有助于为未来航天器的设计提供信息。”

paras.en: Ahead of the mission, the capsule’s thermal protection system has undergone experimental validation at VKI.
paras.zh: 在执行任务之前，太空舱的热保护系统已在 VKI 进行了实验验证。

paras.en: A half-scale version of the capsule was exposed to plasma flows in VKI’s facilities to reproduce key aspects of the aerothermal environment expected during atmospheric reentry. The tests allowed the team to evaluate the heat shield and overall thermal protection design under reentry-like conditions before progressing toward the full-scale capsule.
paras.zh: 半比例版本的太空舱在 VKI 设施中暴露于等离子流中，以重现大气再入期间预期的气热环境的关键方面。这些测试使团队能够在类似重返大气层的条件下评估隔热罩和整体热防护设计，然后再进入全尺寸太空舱。

paras.en: “We have extensively tested P50 within the DRACO programme. It is a highly insulating, robust, and predictable ablative material that is readily available on the commercial market,” said Dr. Bernd Helber, Research Expert in Aerothermochemistry at the von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics (VKI).
paras.zh: “我们在 DRACO 计划中对 P50 进行了广泛的测试。它是一种高度绝缘、坚固且可预测的烧蚀材料，在商业市场上很容易买到，”冯卡门流体动力学研究所 (VKI) 空气热化学研究专家 Bernd Helber 博士说。

paras.en: The DRACO mission is not the first time Amorim P50 has been used by VKI for an experimental reentry spacecraft. The material was previously selected for QARMAN, the QubeSat for Aerothermodynamic Research and Measurements on AblatioN, developed by VKI to collect data during atmospheric reentry.
paras.zh: DRACO 任务并不是 VKI 第一次将 Amorim P50 用于实验性再入航天器。该材料之前曾被用于QARMAN（用于空气热力学研究和烧蚀测量的QubeSat）选择，该卫星由VKI 开发，用于收集大气再入过程中的数据。

paras.en: DRACO marks the next chapter in this long-standing collaboration, bringing cork-based thermal protection technology to a new European mission with an ambitious scientific objective.
paras.zh: DRACO 标志着这一长期合作的新篇章，将基于软木塞的热防护技术带入新的欧洲使命，实现雄心勃勃的科学目标。

paras.en: Once DRACO begins its final descent, its sensors and cameras will document the spacecraft’s breakup and transfer the most important information to the protected capsule.
paras.zh: 一旦 DRACO 开始最后的下降，它的传感器和摄像机将记录航天器的解体并将最重要的信息传输到受保护的太空舱。

paras.en: The data collected by DRACO is expected to provide valuable insight into how spacecraft structures and materials behave during atmospheric reentry. The findings will help improve reentry models and support ESA’s work on Design for Demise, an approach aimed at designing spacecraft so that they break up more completely during reentry, reducing the risk posed by surviving debris.
paras.zh: DRACO 收集的数据预计将为航天器结构和材料在重返大气层期间的行为提供有价值的见解。这些发现将有助于改进再入模型，并支持欧空局的“死亡设计”工作，该方法旨在设计航天器，使其在再入过程中更彻底地解体，从而降低残存碎片带来的风险。

paras.en: The mission contributes to ESA’s broader Zero Debris approach, which aims to significantly reduce the creation of debris in Earth and lunar orbits by 2030.
paras.zh: 该任务为欧空局更广泛的零碎片方法做出了贡献，该方法的目标是到 2030 年大幅减少地球和月球轨道上碎片的产生。

paras.en: For Amorim Cork Solutions, DRACO further demonstrates the role cork-based thermal protection materials can play in demanding space applications, combining the natural thermal properties of cork with engineered solutions developed to perform under extreme conditions.
paras.zh: 对于阿莫林软木解决方案，DRACO 进一步展示了基于软木的热防护材料在要求苛刻的空间应用中可以发挥的作用，将软木的自然热性能与为在极端条件下运行而开发的工程解决方案相结合。

articles.title: CesiumAstro Secures $730 Million in Janus Henderson-Led Series D at a Valuation Above $4.5 Billion; Unveils Synchronicity Satellite Constellation Following Fully Successful Element-1 Mission
articles.author: CesiumAstro

paras.en: CesiumAstro Inc., a global leader in space and defense communications systems and satellites, today announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion. The financing brings CesiumAstro’s total capital announced in 2026 to more than $1.2 billion and supports its expansion into developing and operating its own satellite infrastructure.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro Inc. 是太空和国防通信系统及卫星领域的全球领导者，今天宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元。此次融资使 CesiumAstro 宣布的 2026 年总资本超过 12 亿美元，并支持其扩张至开发和运营自己的卫星基础设施。

paras.en: The company also announced Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation for commercial, sovereign, and defense missions. The announcement follows the launch of CesiumAstro’s first satellite Element-1, and the start of its on-orbit operations.
paras.zh: 该公司还宣布了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座，用于商业、主权和国防任务。该公告是在 CesiumAstro 的第一颗卫星 Element-1 发射并开始在轨运行之后发布的。

paras.en: This expansion builds on three strategic acquisitions that have strengthened CesiumAstro’s vertical integration from semiconductors to mission operations, helping accelerate the development and deployment of Synchronicity. The company is also expanding its engineering and manufacturing operations worldwide. As part of that effort, CesiumAstro has announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its Austin-area headquarters, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space.
paras.zh: 此次扩张建立在三项战略收购的基础上，这些收购加强了 CesiumAstro 从半导体到任务运营的垂直整合，有助于加速 Synchronicity 的开发和部署。该公司还在全球范围内扩展其工程和制造业务。作为这一努力的一部分，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元来扩建其奥斯汀地区总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。

paras.en: The equity round was led by Janus Henderson, with participation from Insight Partners, Sands Capital, Sumitomo Corporation of Americas, Woven Capital – Toyota’s Growth Fund, Incharge Capital, Magnetar, AV, and NewSpace Capital, alongside $100 million in debt financing provided through the Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) and JPMorgan.
paras.zh: 此轮股权融资由 Janus Henderson 领投，Insight Partners、Sands Capital、Sumitomo Corporation of Americas、Woven Capital – 丰田成长基金、Incharge Capital、Magnetar、AV 和 NewSpace Capital 参与，此外还通过美国进出口银行 (EXIM) 和摩根大通提供了 1 亿美元的债务融资。

paras.en: The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: 新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: “For nearly a decade, we have invested in the engineering, intellectual property, manufacturing infrastructure, and the talented people required to build an enduring space technology company,” said Shey Sabripour, Founder and CEO of CesiumAstro. “With our technology proven on orbit, on the ground and in the air, a significantly expanded set of capabilities, and more than $1.2 billion in new capital raised this year, we are positioned to take the next major step in our growth.”
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 创始人兼首席执行官 Shey Saripour 表示：“近十年来，我们在工程、知识产权、制造基础设施和人才方面进行了投资，以建立一家持久的太空技术公司。” “凭借我们在轨道、地面和空中验证的技术、显着扩展的能力以及今年筹集的超过 12 亿美元的新资本，我们已准备好在增长方面迈出下一个重大步骤。”

paras.en: “Shey Sabripour is an extraordinary entrepreneur, and CesiumAstro is poised to revolutionize the space communications industry. This industry is at an inflection point; legacy solutions are not equipped for the demands of today’s customers,” said Aaron Schaechterle, Portfolio Manager, Janus Henderson. “When we met Shey and his team, it became clear that CesiumAstro provides transformative technology that is critical to the industry’s future. This investment was originated through the Janus Henderson Ascent platform, which was created to provide private market capital to visionary companies that redefine their industries and to support these companies on the journey from private to public markets.”
paras.zh: Janus Henderson 产品组合经理 Aaron Schaechterle 表示：“Shey Sabripour 是一位杰出的企业家，CesiumAstro 有望彻底改变太空通信行业。这个行业正处于拐点；传统解决方案无法满足当今客户的需求。” “当我们见到 Shey 和他的团队时，我们发现 CesiumAstro 提供的变革性技术对行业的未来至关重要。这项投资源自 Janus Henderson Ascent 平台，该平台的创建是为了向有远见的公司提供私募市场资本，重新定义其行业，并支持这些公司从私募市场走向公开市场。”

paras.en: Introducing Synchronicity: A 737-Satellite, AI-Enabled Constellation
paras.zh: 引入同步性：由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座

paras.en: Synchronicity takes CesiumAstro beyond supplying advanced space technologies and complete spacecraft to developing and operating its own integrated space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 同步性使 CesiumAstro 不仅提供先进的空间技术和完整的航天器，还开发和运营自己的综合空间基础设施。

paras.en: The constellation is designed around a dynamically managed, multi-beam, multi-frequency architecture supporting Ku-, Ka-, and V-band communications, advanced edge compute, and multi-orbit operations. This unified system aims to deliver more flexible, resilient, and adaptable connectivity across a broad range of commercial and national security missions.
paras.zh: 该星座围绕动态管理、多波束、多频率架构设计，支持 Ku、Ka 和 V 频段通信、高级边缘计算和多轨道操作。这个统一的系统旨在为广泛的商业和国家安全任务提供更灵活、有弹性和适应性强的连接。

paras.en: AI is integrated throughout the architecture, enabling network optimization, dynamic allocation of communications resources, and autonomous adaptation to changing mission requirements and operating conditions. Edge processing capabilities are intended to bring compute closer to where data is generated, reducing dependence on terrestrial infrastructure and supporting increasingly time-sensitive applications.
paras.zh: 人工智能集成在整个架构中，可实现网络优化、通信资源的动态分配以及自主适应不断变化的任务要求和操作条件。边缘处理功能旨在使计算更接近数据生成的地方，减少对地面基础设施的依赖并支持对时间日益敏感的应用程序。

paras.en: Unlike architectures assembled from independently sourced components, Synchronicity will leverage CesiumAstro’s vertically integrated technology portfolio, including custom silicon, best-in-class active phased arrays, software-defined payloads, advanced processors, spacecraft, mission software, and terminals for air, ground, mobility, and maritime platforms. This approach enables system-wide performance optimization.
paras.zh: 与由独立采购的组件组装而成的架构不同，Synchronicity 将利用 CesiumAstro 的垂直集成技术组合，包括定制芯片、一流的有源相控阵、软件定义的有效载荷、先进处理器、航天器、任务软件以及空中、地面、移动和海上平台的终端。这种方法可以实现系统范围的性能优化。

paras.en: “Synchronicity is the culmination of the technology stack we have methodically built since CesiumAstro was founded,” said Sabripour. “We designed the silicon, the active phased array, the payload, processors, the spacecraft, ground terminals, and the network as one system. That vertical integration gives us the ability to build capabilities in space that evolve as mission requirements, technology, and operating conditions change.”
paras.zh: “同步性是我们自 CesiumAstro 成立以来有条不紊地构建的技术堆栈的顶峰，”Saripour 说。 “我们将芯片、有源相控阵、有效载荷、处理器、航天器、地面终端和网络设计为一个系统。这种垂直整合使我们能够在太空中构建随着任务要求、技术和操作条件的变化而发展的能力。”

paras.en: Three Strategic Acquisitions Expand CesiumAstro’s Capabilities
paras.zh: 三项战略收购扩大了 CesiumAstro 的能力

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has brought critical semiconductor, mission software, and artificial intelligence capabilities together through three acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr.
paras.zh: 在过去 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项收购将关键的半导体、任务软件和人工智能能力整合在一起：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr。

paras.en: Jariet Technologies — A leading millimeter-wave RF System-on-Chip (RF-SoC) semiconductor company specializing in advanced solutions for satellite communications, electronic warfare, and radar systems. The acquisition strengthens CesiumAstro’s technology portfolio with advanced mixed-signal semiconductors, digital signal processing, and digital beamforming capabilities, enabling greater performance and control across its communications payloads, active phased arrays, and spacecraft.
paras.zh: Jariet Technologies — 一家领先的毫米波射频片上系统 (RF-SoC) 半导体公司，专注于卫星通信、电子战和雷达系统的先进解决方案。此次收购增强了 CesiumAstro 的技术组合，包括先进的混合信号半导体、数字信号处理和数字波束形成功能，从而实现其通信有效载荷、有源相控阵和航天器的更高性能和控制。

paras.en: 1Aardvark — A company specializing in mission software, algorithms, and systems engineering for national defense programs. The acquisition expands CesiumAstro’s autonomous mission capabilities, enabling spacecraft to dynamically respond to changing conditions, operate with greater resilience, and maintain mission effectiveness in contested or connectivity-constrained environments.
paras.zh: 1Aardvark — 一家专门从事国防项目任务软件、算法和系统工程的公司。此次收购扩大了CesiumAstro的自主任务能力，使航天器能够动态响应不断变化的条件，以更大的弹性运行，并在有争议或连接受限的环境中保持任务有效性。

paras.en: Vidrovr — An AI company specializing in real-time multimodal signal analysis. The acquisition accelerates CesiumAstro’s integration of AI into space communications and sensing systems, enabling intelligent RF optimization, autonomous satellite operations, and reconfigurable edge compute across its space and defense platforms.
paras.zh: Vidrovr — 一家专门从事实时多模态信号分析的人工智能公司。此次收购加速了 CesiumAstro 将人工智能集成到空间通信和传感系统中，从而在其空间和国防平台上实现智能射频优化、自主卫星操作以及可重新配置的边缘计算。

paras.en: Element: A Decade of Engineering Proven on Orbit
paras.zh: 元素：在轨道上经过十年验证的工程

paras.en: CesiumAstro successfully launched and began on-orbit operation of Element-1 in October 2026.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 于 2026 年 10 月成功发射 Element-1 并开始在轨运行。

paras.en: Element-1 integrates CesiumAstro’s proprietary communications payloads, active phased array technology, compute systems, and spacecraft engineering in an operational satellite. The mission validates nearly a decade of investment in proprietary intellectual property, specialized engineering expertise, and in-house manufacturing capabilities.
paras.zh: Element-1 在一颗运行卫星中集成了 CesiumAstro 专有的通信有效载荷、有源相控阵技术、计算系统和航天器工程。该任务验证了近十年来在专有知识产权、专业工程专业知识和内部制造能力方面的投资。

paras.en: Element-1 is the first of eight planned spacecraft, with seven more launches secured for the next deployment phase. The Element program also advances CesiumAstro’s space-based edge processing and compute capabilities, enabling data to be processed closer to its source and supporting more intelligent, responsive, and autonomous missions.
paras.zh: Element-1 是计划中的八艘航天器中的第一艘，下一部署阶段还有七次发射。 Element 计划还提升了 CesiumAstro 的天基边缘处理和计算能力，使数据能够在更接近其来源的地方进行处理，并支持更智能、响应更快和自主的任务。

paras.en: Expanding Global Operations and Manufacturing Capacity
paras.zh: 扩大全球运营和制造能力

paras.en: In Texas, CesiumAstro announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its global headquarters in Austin, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space. The expansion will support precision electronics and spacecraft manufacturing, engineering, integration, and test, with plans to add 550 jobs and grow the Austin-area workforce to more than 1,000 employees by 2030.
paras.zh: 在德克萨斯州，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元，以扩建其位于奥斯汀的全球总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。此次扩建将支持精密电子和航天器制造、工程、集成和测试，计划到 2030 年增加 550 个就业岗位，并将奥斯汀地区的员工人数增加到 1,000 多人。

paras.en: Across the United States, the company is investing hundreds of millions of dollars to expand its engineering, manufacturing, and operational capabilities, with additional facilities in Colorado, California, Alabama, Florida, and the Washington, D.C. area.
paras.zh: 在美国各地，该公司正在投资数亿美元来扩大其工程、制造和运营能力，并在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州和华盛顿特区设立了额外的工厂。

paras.en: In Europe and Asia, the company is expanding its presence, with operations in the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, Taiwan, Singapore, and Japan.
paras.zh: 在欧洲和亚洲，该公司正在扩大其业务，在英国、德国、瑞士、台湾、新加坡和日本开展业务。

paras.en: These expansions will support scaled production of its communications and sensing systems, advanced compute technologies, and spacecraft, as well as development and deployment of its next-generation space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 这些扩建将支持其通信和传感系统、先进计算技术和航天器的规模生产，以及下一代空间基础设施的开发和部署。

articles.title: Commercial Space Federation Welcomes CesiumAstro as a New Associate Member
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: November 13, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome CesiumAstro as its newest Associate Member. A global leader in advanced connectivity solutions for the space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. CesiumAstro’s addition further strengthens CSF’s diverse membership and the Federation’s work to advance a competitive, innovative, and sustainable U.S. commercial space economy.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联合会 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 CesiumAstro 成为其最新准会员。 CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。 CesiumAstro 的加入进一步加强了 CSF 的多元化成员资格以及联合会推动竞争性、创新性和可持续的美国商业太空经济的工作。

paras.en: CesiumAstro is a lobal leader in advanced connectivity solutions for space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. Its full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads and advanced computing systems. CesiumAstro maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards. Headquartered near Austin, Texas, the company operates additional facilities in Colorado, California, Washington, D.C., Florida, the United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Taiwan, and Japan.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，CesiumAstro 提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。其全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。 CesiumAstro 保持与内部设计、制造和测试能力的完全垂直整合，并通过了 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证。该公司总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近，在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、华盛顿特区、佛罗里达州、英国、德国、新加坡、台湾和日本设有其他工厂。

paras.en: CesiumAstro recently announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation. The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 最近宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元，并推出了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划中的 737 颗卫星、支持人工智能的星座。新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has expanded its capabilities through three strategic acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr, strengthening the company’s capabilities across semiconductor technology, mission software, and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项战略收购扩大了其能力：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr，增强了公司在半导体技术、任务软件和人工智能方面的能力。

paras.en: CesiumAstro’s full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads, and advanced compute systems. The company maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 的全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。该公司与通过 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证的内部设计、制造和测试能力保持完整的垂直整合。

paras.en: “A thriving commercial economy in low Earth orbit needs reliable communications and a clear path from development to operations. CesiumAstro is joining CSF’s Commercial LEO Council to bring our communications expertise to that effort. We look forward to advancing policies that encourage investment, expand government use of commercial services, and support companies building the next generation of space infrastructure.”
paras.zh: “近地轨道上蓬勃发展的商业经济需要可靠的通信以及从开发到运营的清晰路径。CesiumAstro 正在加入 CSF 的商业 LEO 委员会，将我们的通信专业知识用于这一努力。我们期待推进鼓励投资、扩大政府对商业服务的使用以及支持企业建设下一代空间基础设施的政策。”

paras.en: – Josh Ingersoll, Director of Spectrum and Regulatory Affairs at CesiumAstro
paras.zh: – Josh Ingersoll，CesiumAstro 频谱和监管事务总监

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: COP31: Climate finance falls short as calls grow for polluters to pay

paras.en: COP31: Climate finance falls short as calls grow for polluters to pay
paras.zh: COP31：随着要求污染者付费的呼声越来越高，气候融资出现短缺

paras.en: From emotional appeals for climate justice to high-stakes negotiations over billions of dollars, finance dominated discussions at COP31 on Friday. UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned that even tripling adaptation funding for vulnerable countries would meet less than a third of their needs, as pressure mounted on wealthy nations and major polluters to pay their fair share.
paras.zh: 从对气候正义的情感诉求到数十亿美元的高风险谈判，金融问题主导了周五 COP31 的讨论。联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告说，即使向脆弱国家提供三倍的适应资金也只能满足不到三分之一的需求，因为富裕国家和主要污染者支付公平份额的压力越来越大。

paras.en: - Climate finance: Guterres calls for reforms to an international financial system he says is failing vulnerable countries.
paras.zh: - 气候金融：古特雷斯呼吁对国际金融体系进行改革，他认为该体系正在让脆弱国家失望。

paras.en: - New investments: A $10 billion initiative aims to finance climate projects in emerging markets.
paras.zh: - 新投资：一项 100 亿美元的计划旨在为新兴市场的气候项目提供资金。

paras.en: - On the ground: UN experts highlight support for disaster-hit communities, farmers and innovative insurance schemes.
paras.zh: - 实地：联合国专家强调对受灾社区、农民和创新保险计划的支持。

paras.en: - Negotiations: COP31 Presidency circulates first outline of a possible political declaration, with climate finance and fossil fuels remaining among the key unresolved issues.
paras.zh: - 谈判：COP31主席团分发了可能的政治宣言的第一份大纲，其中气候融资和化石燃料仍然是未解决的关键问题。

paras.en: Some demonstrators held signs demanding that “polluters pay”. Others, dressed as chefs, offered a recipe for climate action: debt cancellation as the secret ingredient.
paras.zh: 一些示威者举着标语，要求“污染者付费”。其他人则打扮成厨师，提出了气候行动的秘诀：取消债务作为秘方。

paras.en: Along the corridors and waterways of the COP31 venue in Antalya, protesters from across the globe gathered to demand climate justice. Some fought back tears, while others wept openly, recounting the lives and livelihoods already lost to climate change.
paras.zh: 沿着安塔利亚 COP31 会场的走廊和水道，来自世界各地的抗议者聚集在一起，要求气候正义。一些人忍住泪水，另一些人则公开哭泣，讲述因气候变化而失去的生命和生计。

paras.en: Speaking of Lake Chad, where drought and fluctuating water levels have devastated communities and displaced families, a Nigerian activist questioned why his country, which has contributed little to global emissions, faces far higher borrowing costs than wealthier nations to cope with climate impacts.
paras.zh: 谈到乍得湖，那里的干旱和水位波动给社区和流离失所的家庭造成了严重破坏，一位尼日利亚活动人士质疑，为什么他的国家对全球排放贡献甚少，却面临比富裕国家高得多的借贷成本来应对气候影响。

paras.en: Similar concerns echoed through Friday's finance discussions, as the Secretary-General warned that climate disasters were erasing decades of development gains and pushing vulnerable countries deeper into debt.
paras.zh: 周五的金融讨论中也出现了类似的担忧，秘书长警告说，气候灾难正在抹去数十年的发展成果，并使脆弱国家陷入更深的债务。

paras.en: “Even tripling adaptation finance would meet less than 30 per cent of what is needed,” he told journalists at his final COP press conference as Secretary-General before leaving office at the end of the year.
paras.zh: “即使将适应资金增加两倍，也只能满足不到所需资金的 30%，”他在年底离任前作为秘书长的最后一次 COP 新闻发布会上对记者表示。

paras.en: The consequences, he argued, extend far beyond the environment.
paras.zh: 他认为，其后果远远超出了环境范围。

paras.en: The future of our planet cannot be negotiated on the terms of those profiting from its destruction – UN chief António Guterres
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯：我们星球的未来不能按照那些从破坏地球中获利的人的条件进行谈判

paras.en: “You cannot build peace on a burning planet,” he said. “You cannot eradicate poverty when climate disasters keep throwing people back into it.”
paras.zh: “你无法在一个燃烧的星球上建立和平，”他说。 “当气候灾难不断让人们重新陷入贫困时，你就无法消除贫困。”

paras.en: Climate action, he insisted, must remain central to the UN's work, requiring a faster transition away from fossil fuels and a challenge to the “powerful interests” standing in the way.
paras.zh: 他坚持认为，气候行动必须仍然是联合国工作的核心，需要更快地摆脱化石燃料，并对阻碍的“强大利益”提出挑战。

paras.en: “The future of our planet cannot be negotiated on the terms of those profiting from its destruction.”
paras.zh: “我们星球的未来不能根据那些从其破坏中获利的人的条件进行谈判。”

paras.en: But finding the money to protect vulnerable countries is another battle. The UN chief revealed that he had met with the heads of international climate funds earlier on Friday, urging them to cut through the bureaucracy that makes financial assistance so difficult to access, particularly for countries with limited resources.
paras.zh: 但寻找资金来保护脆弱国家则是另一场战斗。联合国秘书长透露，他于周五早些时候会见了国际气候基金负责人，敦促他们消除官僚主义，因为官僚主义使财政援助难以获得，特别是对于资源有限的国家而言。

paras.en: He also questioned the fairness of a global financial system designed after the Second World War, when many developing countries had little say in shaping it.
paras.zh: 他还质疑二战后设计的全球金融体系的公平性，当时许多发展中国家在塑造这一体系方面几乎没有发言权。

paras.en: Changing that system, he argued, could also help unlock more funding. A dollar invested in the capital of a development bank, for example, could generate eight to ten dollars in financing, while greater use of guarantees could attract private investment.
paras.zh: 他认为，改变这一制度也有助于释放更多资金。例如，投资于开发银行资本的一美元可以产生八到十美元的融资，而更多地使用担保可以吸引私人投资。

paras.en: At a ministerial meeting, UN climate chief Simon Stiell described the consequences of leaving things as they are.
paras.zh: 在一次部长级会议上，联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔描述了保持现状的后果。

paras.en: “Many developing countries are trapped in a downward loop of debt, disaster, and devastating capital costs,” he said. “Climate finance must help countries break free.”
paras.zh: “许多发展中国家陷入了债务、灾难和毁灭性资本成本的恶性循环，”他说。 “气候融资必须帮助各国摆脱困境。”

paras.en: Under existing agreements, developed countries are expected to lead efforts to mobilize at least $300 billion a year for developing nations by 2035, as part of a broader $1.3 trillion goal.
paras.zh: 根据现有协议，预计发达国家将带头努力，到 2035 年每年为发展中国家筹集至少 3000 亿美元，作为更广泛的 1.3 万亿美元目标的一部分。

paras.en: But an assessment highlighted at COP31 suggests that, on current trends, annual climate finance could fall $840 billion short of that larger target.
paras.zh: 但 COP31 强调的一项评估表明，按照目前的趋势，年度气候融资可能比这一更大目标少 8,400 亿美元。

paras.en: Fresh efforts to close the gap emerged on Friday. Development finance institutions from Britain, Norway and Canada announced plans to mobilize $10 billion for climate projects in emerging markets by 2030.
paras.zh: 周五出现了缩小差距的新举措。英国、挪威和加拿大的发展金融机构宣布，计划到 2030 年为新兴市场的气候项目筹集 100 亿美元。

paras.en: Protecting livelihoods before and after disaster
paras.zh: 保护灾前和灾后的生计

paras.en: For millions of farmers, climate finance can mean the difference between adapting to a changing climate and losing everything when disaster strikes.
paras.zh: 对于数百万农民来说，气候融资可能意味着适应气候变化和在灾难发生时失去一切之间的区别。

paras.en: Kaveh Zahedi, from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), told UN News that only around five per cent of climate-related development finance goes to agriculture, and that share is declining.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 的卡维·扎赫迪 (Kaveh Zahedi) 告诉《联合国新闻》，与气候相关的发展资金中只有约 5% 用于农业，而且这一比例正在下降。

paras.en: Yet investing in adaptation can help farmers restore degraded land, use water more efficiently and grow crops better able to withstand droughts and floods, as increasingly unpredictable weather and El Niño are threatening food production.
paras.zh: 然而，随着越来越难以预测的天气和厄尔尼诺现象正在威胁粮食生产，对适应措施的投资可以帮助农民恢复退化的土地，更有效地利用水资源，种植能够更好地抵御干旱和洪水的作物。

paras.en: “The biggest risk is not investing in agriculture,” he warned. "Because then you’re risking food insecurity. You're risking an increase in hunger.”
paras.zh: “最大的风险不是投资农业，”他警告说。 “因为那样你就会面临粮食不安全的风险。你就会面临饥饿加剧的风险。”

paras.en: But even with better preparation, some disasters cannot be avoided. And when they strike, how quickly money arrives can make all the difference.
paras.zh: 但即使准备得更好，一些灾难也无法避免。当他们罢工时，资金到达的速度会产生重大影响。

paras.en: Imagine a farmer in Fiji whose fields have just been battered by a cyclone. The crops are gone; bills remain. And the next harvest may be months away.
paras.zh: 想象一下斐济的一位农民，他的田地刚刚被飓风袭击。庄稼没了；账单仍然存在。下一次收获可能还需要几个月的时间。

paras.en: An innovative insurance scheme is helping farmers recover without waiting for lengthy damage assessments.
paras.zh: 一项创新的保险计划正在帮助农民恢复健康，而无需等待漫长的损失评估。

paras.en: Known as parametric insurance, it provides payouts when predefined conditions, such as wind speed or rainfall, are reached.
paras.zh: 它被称为参数保险，当达到预定义条件（例如风速或降雨量）时提供赔付。

paras.en: Sinja Buri, from the United Nations University Institute for Environment and Human Security, explained why speed matters.
paras.zh: 联合国大学环境与人类安全研究所的 Sinja Buri 解释了速度为何如此重要。

paras.en: “The longer it takes for him to receive support, the longer it will take to recover. And the costs will even be higher,” she said.
paras.zh: “他获得支持的时间越长，恢复的时间就越长。而且成本也会更高，”她说。

paras.en: The programme operates across eight Pacific countries, with tens of thousands of people benefiting so far.
paras.zh: 该计划在八个太平洋国家开展，迄今为止已有数万人受益。

paras.en: But tackling climate change is not just about spending money.
paras.zh: 但应对气候变化不仅仅是花钱。

paras.en: “Climate action is a good investment and it is profitable,” Hunter Lovins, founder of the NGO Natural Capitalism Solutions, told UN News.
paras.zh: “气候行动是一项很好的投资，而且是有利可图的，”非政府组织自然资本主义解决方案创始人亨特·洛文斯告诉联合国新闻。

paras.en: With fuel prices soaring in the United States, Ms. Lovins pointed to her own electric car, charged by solar panels at home, as an example of how renewable energy can cut costs and reduce dependence on volatile oil prices.
paras.zh: 随着美国燃油价格的飙升，洛文斯女士以她自己的电动汽车为例，该汽车由家里的太阳能电池板充电，作为可再生能源如何降低成本并减少对波动油价的依赖的例子。

paras.en: She has also seen its benefits during a disaster. When floods cut off her community in Colorado and left neighbours without electricity for more than a week, her home solar-powered home remained. Neighbours even brought their frozen food to her freezer.
paras.zh: 她还在灾难期间看到了它的好处。当洪水切断了她在科罗拉多州的社区并导致邻居断电一个多星期时，她家的太阳能房屋仍然存在。邻居甚至把冷冻食品送到她的冰箱里。

paras.en: “This is real security in your community,” she said.
paras.zh: “这才是社区真正的安全，”她说。

paras.en: Ms. Lovins now helps organize community-led climate initiatives with more than 1,000 organizers across 57 countries, encouraging people to adopt solutions without waiting for governments.
paras.zh: Lovins 女士现在帮助 57 个国家的 1,000 多名组织者组织社区主导的气候倡议，鼓励人们采取解决方案，而无需等待政府。

paras.en: “You don't have to wait on a government. Let’s do it.”
paras.zh: “你不必等待政府。让我们去做吧。”

paras.en: An emotional farewell with a rallying cry
paras.zh: 带着战斗口号的情感告别

paras.en: Elsewhere at COP31, the spirit of the protests found its way into a plenary hall, where civil society representatives had gathered to bid farewell to Mr. Guterres at his last climate summit as UN Secretary-General.
paras.zh: 在 COP31 的其他地方，抗议精神进入了全体会议厅，民间社会代表聚集在一起，向古特雷斯先生作为联合国秘书长的最后一次气候峰会告别。

paras.en: For nearly a decade, they said, he had been their “champion”, “the best spokesperson they could have wished for”. And they wanted him to know it.
paras.zh: 他们说，近十年来，他一直是他们的“冠军”、“他们所希望的最好的代言人”。他们想让他知道这一点。

paras.en: There was a “Make Polluters Pay” award, an emotional standing ovation and even an invitation to return to a future COP wearing an NGO badge, this time as one of them.
paras.zh: 有一个“让污染者付出代价”奖，全场起立鼓掌，甚至还邀请未来的缔约方会议佩戴非政府组织徽章，这次是作为其中之一。

paras.en: The gathering soon took on the familiar sounds of a climate demonstration. Cries of “Make polluters pay!” echoed around the room, joined by another chant: “SG! SG! SG!”
paras.zh: 集会很快就出现了熟悉的气候示威声音。 “让污染者付出代价！”的呼喊房间里回响着，伴随着另一声呼喊：“SG！SG！SG！”

paras.en: Mr. Guterres, visibly moved by the reception, returned to the issue that had dominated the day. Fossil fuel companies, he argued, should be taxed on their extraordinary profits to help those suffering from a crisis they did little to cause.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生显然被这次招待会所感动，他又回到了当天主导的问题。他认为，化石燃料公司应该对其超额利润征税，以帮助那些遭受他们未曾造成的危机的人们。

paras.en: “We face lobbies. We face powers that are putting pressure on governments,” he warned, urging activists to keep up the pressure of their own.
paras.zh: “我们面临着游说团体。我们面临着向政府施加压力的权力，”他警告说，并敦促活动人士继续施加自己的压力。

paras.en: As the UN chief prepared to leave his final COP, the message ringing through the hall was clear. The battle for climate justice will go on, and Mr. Guterres “will not stop fighting”.
paras.zh: 当联合国秘书长准备离开他的最后一次缔约方会议时，大厅里响起的信息是明确的。气候正义之战将继续下去，古特雷斯先生“不会停止战斗”。

paras.en: - Adaptation finance: Countries disagree over how to measure progress towards tripling funding by 2035, including which baseline to use.
paras.zh: - 适应融资：各国对于如何衡量到 2035 年资金增加两倍的进展情况存在分歧，包括使用哪个基准。

paras.en: - Who pays?: Developing countries want stronger commitments from wealthy nations, while others favour mobilizing private investment.
paras.zh: - 谁付钱？：发展中国家希望富裕国家做出更强有力的承诺，而其他国家则倾向于动员私人投资。

paras.en: - Loss and Damage: Negotiators remain divided over predictable funding and assistance for vulnerable communities.
paras.zh: - 损失和损害：谈判者对于为弱势社区提供可预测的资金和援助仍存在分歧。

paras.en: - Political Outcome: The COP31 Presidency has circulated proposals for a possible final agreement, with finance and fossil fuels among the unresolved issues.
paras.zh: - 政治结果：COP31 主席团已分发了可能达成最终协议的提案，其中未解决的问题包括金融和化石燃料问题。

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount

paras.en: Security Council LIVE: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
paras.zh: 安理会直播：随着霍尔木兹航运面临的威胁加剧，脆弱的海湾平静受到考验

paras.en: Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge. Iran has all but closed the Strait of Hormuz, which carried a fifth of the world’s oil before the conflict. Attacks on shipping are rising, and efforts to stop a return to full-scale fighting have yet to produce a deal. The Security Council is meeting at Bahrain’s request to discuss the threat to regional and maritime security. Follow live below – and for full meetings coverage year round, go here.
paras.zh: 以色列和美国对伊朗的袭击引发地区战争近九个月后，海湾地区仍处于危险边缘。伊朗几乎关闭了霍尔木兹海峡，该海峡在冲突前运载着世界五分之一的石油。对航运的袭击不断增加，阻止全面战斗重新爆发的努力尚未达成协议。安理会应巴林的要求召开会议，讨论地区和海上安全面临的威胁。关注下面的实时直播 - 要了解全年的完整会议报道，请访问此处。

paras.en: - The war began on 28 February. Iran then struck US military assets and other targets in six Gulf States and Jordan
paras.zh: - 战争于 2 月 28 日开始。伊朗随后袭击了美国在六个海湾国家和约旦的军事资产和其他目标

paras.en: - In March, the council adopted resolution 2817, which condemned Iran’s attacks and its threats to navigation. China and Russia abstained
paras.zh: - 3月，安理会通过了第2817号决议，谴责伊朗的袭击及其对航行的威胁。中国和俄罗斯弃权

paras.en: - A 60-day US–Iran ceasefire, mediated by Pakistan in June, lapsed in August without a peace deal
paras.zh: - 6月由巴基斯坦斡旋达成的为期60天的美伊停火协议于8月失效，未达成和平协议

paras.en: - Transits through Hormuz remain around 65 per cent below pre-conflict levels, according to UK Maritime Trade Operations, and October saw the most incidents since the war began
paras.zh: - 根据英国海事贸易运营部的数据，通过霍尔木兹海峡的过境量仍比冲突前水平低 65% 左右，10 月份发生的事件数量是自战争开始以来最多的

paras.en: - Transits through the Bab al-Mandab Strait are down by roughly a quarter since the Houthis declared a blockade on Saudi-linked shipping in July
paras.zh: - 自胡塞武装7月宣布封锁与沙特有关的航运以来，通过曼德海峡的运输量减少了约四分之一

articles.title: Nadia Murad: ‘Day by day, I took my story back’

paras.en: Nadia Murad: ‘Day by day, I took my story back’
paras.zh: 纳迪亚·穆拉德：“日复一日，我收回了我的故事”

paras.en: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Nadia Murad has spent years telling the world about the atrocities committed against her and the Yazidi community by militants from the terrorist group, ISIL.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔和平奖获得者纳迪亚·穆拉德多年来一直向世界讲述恐怖组织“伊斯兰国”武装分子对她和雅兹迪社区犯下的暴行。

paras.en: But now, she wants to tell her story beyond survival, having broken the stigma surrounding conflict-related sexual violence and moved on from her pioneering role as the first UN Goodwill Ambassador for the Dignity of Survivors of Human Trafficking, just over two years ago.
paras.zh: 但现在，她想讲述自己超越生存的故事，打破了与冲突有关的性暴力的耻辱，并从两年多前担任首任联合国人口贩运幸存者尊严亲善大使的先驱角色中走出来。

paras.en: Over eight years of powerful advocacy working with the UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) – she ensured that survivors are recognised not simply as victims, but as leaders with the power to shape change.
paras.zh: 在与联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室 (UNODC) 合作的八年多里，她确保幸存者不仅被视为受害者，而且被视为有能力塑造变革的领导者。

paras.en: This week, Ms. Murad returned to UN Headquarters in New York, for a packed event at the UN Bookshop focused on her new memoir, I Choose My Beginning – a deeply personal account of rebuilding her life.
paras.zh: 本周，穆拉德女士返回纽约联合国总部，在联合国书店参加了一场拥挤的活动，重点关注她的新回忆录《我选择我的开始》——这是一部关于她重建生活的深刻个人记述。

paras.en: ISIL, also known by the Arabic moniker Daesh, conducted a genocidal campaign beginning in August 2014 against the Yazidis, whose historic homeland is the Sinjar region of northern Iraq.
paras.zh: ISIL，也被称为达伊沙，从 2014 年 8 月开始对雅兹迪人发动种族灭绝行动，雅兹迪人的历史家园是伊拉克北部的辛贾尔地区。

paras.en: Ms. Murad’s first book, The Last Girl: My Story of Captivity and My Fight Against the Islamic State, focused on that 2014 genocide where six of her brothers were murdered and she was taken into sexual slavery in Mosul – one of over 6,000 Yazidi women taken captive, according to UN figures. She escaped after three months, reaching a camp in Kurdistan and was then resettled in Germany.
paras.zh: 穆拉德女士的第一本书《最后的女孩：我的囚禁故事和我对抗伊斯兰国的斗争》主要讲述了 2014 年的种族灭绝事件，当时她的六名兄弟被谋杀，而她在摩苏尔沦为性奴隶——根据联合国数据，她是被俘虏的 6,000 多名雅兹迪妇女之一。三个月后她逃脱，到达库尔德斯坦的一个营地，然后在德国重新定居。

paras.en: With her new book, she said, she wanted to explore a different part of her journey – one centred on healing, relationships, love and the possibility of building a future.
paras.zh: 她说，通过她的新书，她想探索她旅程的不同部分——以治愈、人际关系、爱和建设未来的可能性为中心。

paras.en: “I was just another story – part of a global community of survivors of rape, men, women and children from all around the world” she said, recalling the early years of her advocacy.
paras.zh: “我只是另一个故事——来自世界各地的强奸幸存者、男人、女人和儿童的全球社区的一部分”，她回忆起她早年的倡导活动时说道。

paras.en: She described how repeated public appearances and interviews left her feeling that she was disappearing into activism.
paras.zh: 她描述了多次公开露面和采访如何让她感觉自己正在消失在激进主义之中。

paras.en: At certain point, Ms. Murad felt that she had lost herself – the girl who grew up on a farm, in a big family, was gone.
paras.zh: 在某个时刻，穆拉德女士觉得她迷失了自己——那个在农场、大家庭长大的女孩已经消失了。

paras.en: “I was disappearing, even physically, my hair was falling, I was losing weight, not sleeping, not eating” – but the fact that her niece and best friend was still in captivity kept her going, with the hope it would help rescue her.
paras.zh: “我在消失，甚至在身体上，我的头发在脱落，我在减肥，不睡觉，不吃东西”——但她的侄女和最好的朋友仍然被囚禁的事实让她坚持下去，希望这能帮助营救她。

paras.en: “Day by day, I took it back piece by piece, I built it. - Nadia Murad
paras.zh: “日复一日，我一点一点地把它拿回来，我建造了它。——纳迪亚·穆拉德

paras.en: When her niece Kathrine was killed, she lost faith in humanity for the first time. “I couldn’t do it anymore.”
paras.zh: 当她的侄女凯瑟琳被杀时，她第一次对人性失去了信心。 “我不能再这么做了。”

paras.en: Her family came together to remind her that she could feel safe again, get educated and pursue life beyond activism. “Finding love also changed me”, Ms. Murad explained.
paras.zh: 她的家人聚集在一起提醒她，她可以再次感到安全，接受教育并追求超越激进主义的生活。 “寻找爱情也改变了我”，穆拉德女士解释道。

paras.en: In her book she writes that the first time she told her story, she felt it did not belong to her. “Day by day, I took it back piece by piece, I built it.”
paras.zh: 她在书中写道，第一次讲述自己的故事时，她觉得这不属于她。 “日复一日，我把它一块一块地拿回来，我建造了它。”

paras.en: “What they did to us was their legacy,” she said of ISIL’s three-year rule of terror, which “was the permanent mark that rape leaves on your body, on your mind.”
paras.zh: “他们对我们所做的就是他们的遗产，”她在谈到“伊斯兰国”三年的恐怖统治时说道，“这是强奸在你的身体和思想上留下的永久印记。”

paras.en: Survivors are blameless but you will always wrestle with your own memories: “I didn’t do anything wrong. The world failed me”, she added.
paras.zh: 幸存者是无可指责的，但你总是会与自己的记忆作斗争：“我没有做错任何事。世界辜负了我，”她补充道。

paras.en: Nadia Murad came to the UN Security Council in 2015 to testify, and she recounted the atrocities committed against the Yazidi community and called for international action against human trafficking and sexual violence in conflict.
paras.zh: 纳迪亚·穆拉德 (Nadia Murad) 于 2015 年来到联合国安理会作证，她讲述了针对雅兹迪社区犯下的暴行，并呼吁国际社会采取行动打击冲突中的人口贩运和性暴力。

paras.en: The UN system has sought to address sexual violence not only as a consequence of conflict, but as a crime that must be prevented and prosecuted.
paras.zh: 联合国系统不仅将性暴力视为冲突的后果，而且将其视为必须预防和起诉的犯罪行为。

paras.en: For Ms. Murad, the response must go further: survivors must be seen not only through the violence they have endured, but as individuals with ideas – and the capacity to lead change.
paras.zh: 对于穆拉德女士来说，应对措施必须更进一步：不仅必须通过所遭受的暴力来看待幸存者，而且还必须将他们视为有想法和领导变革能力的个人。

paras.en: Ms. Murad also called for survivors to be included in policy discussions as leaders and experts: “If we keep treating them as just victims and expect them to just never recover, we’re never going to prevent this from happening,” she told the audience.
paras.zh: 穆拉德女士还呼吁让幸存者作为领导者和专家参与政策讨论：“如果我们继续将他们视为受害者，并期望他们永远无法康复，我们就永远无法阻止这种情况的发生，”她告诉观众。

paras.en: Academy Award-winning actress and current UNODC Goodwill Ambassador to Combat Trafficking, Mira Sorvino, was at the bookshop too and praised Ms. Murad for challenging the tendency to see survivors only in relation to their trauma.
paras.zh: 奥斯卡奖获奖女演员、现任毒品和犯罪问题办公室打击贩运亲善大使米拉·索维诺 (Mira Sorvino) 也在书店，她赞扬穆拉德女士挑战了只看到幸存者所受创伤的倾向。

paras.en: Ms. Sorvino, who also serves on the board of trustees of the UN Voluntary Trust Fund for Victims of Trafficking in Persons, said Ms. Murad had transformed unimaginable suffering and trauma into a source of strength and inspiration for others.
paras.zh: 索维诺女士也是联合国人口贩运受害者自愿信托基金的董事会成员，她说穆拉德女士将难以想象的痛苦和创伤转化为他人力量和灵感的源泉。

paras.en: “She’s basically taking ownership of all the negativity of her life, and all the kind of public fascination that feeds on distress and feeds on trauma (…) and turned this on its head”.
paras.zh: “她基本上掌控了自己生活中的所有消极情绪，以及所有以痛苦和创伤为食的公众迷恋（……），并扭转了这一局面”。

paras.en: “Her story is not the terrible things that were inflicted on her,” Ms. Sorvino said, reflecting on the message of the new book. Rather, it is about reclaiming life and rebuilding in the face of what happened.
paras.zh: “她的故事并不是发生在她身上的可怕事情，”索维诺女士在反思新书所传达的信息时说道。相反，它是关于面对所发生的事情恢复生活和重建。

paras.en: “Unfortunately, Nadia can’t be the last girl – as conflicts and atrocities continue – but that doesn’t mean it’s not worth fighting for,” she added.
paras.zh: “不幸的是，纳迪亚不可能成为最后一个女孩——因为冲突和暴行仍在继续——但这并不意味着不值得为之奋斗，”她补充道。

paras.en: Ms. Sorvino shared her own experience as a survivor of sexual violence, saying that Ms. Murad’s courage had given her strength and underscored the importance of speaking out.
paras.zh: 索维诺女士分享了她作为性暴力幸存者的经历，称穆拉德女士的勇气给了她力量，并强调了发声的重要性。

paras.en: In her book, Ms. Murad writes: “Survivors, though, are changing. We are becoming bolder and more vocal, less likely to let the stigma of rape push us into some dark, silent hole.”
paras.zh: 穆拉德女士在她的书中写道：“不过，幸存者正在发生变化。我们变得更加大胆、更加敢于发声，不太可能让强奸的耻辱将我们推入黑暗、沉默的深渊。”

articles.title: Scotland edge out Australia in Nations Championship

paras.en: Nations Championship: Scotland edge out Australia at Murrayfield to move above Wales in Northern Hemisphere table
paras.zh: 国家锦标赛：苏格兰在默里菲尔德击败澳大利亚，在北半球积分榜上超越威尔士

paras.en: Scotland beat Australia 15-12 but couldn't secure a bonus point; Head coach Gregor Townsend said: "Defensively, that's one of the best performances I've seen in the last couple of years"; Scotland move above Wales into fourth in the Northern Hemisphere table
paras.zh: 苏格兰15-12击败澳大利亚，但未能获得加分；主教练格雷戈尔​​·汤森德说：“在防守方面，这是我在过去几年中看到的最好的表现之一”；苏格兰超越威尔士，在北半球排行榜上升至第四位

paras.en: Scotland eked out a hard-fought 15-12 win over Australia but were unable to get the bonus point they craved in a Nations Championship match that failed to catch fire.
paras.zh: 苏格兰队苦战15-12战胜澳大利亚队，但未能在国锦赛上获得他们渴望的加分，这场比赛也未能如火如荼地进行。

paras.en: First-half scores from Matt Fagerson and Jack Dempsey gave the Scots the edge at the break, with Harry Potter responding for the Wallabies.
paras.zh: 上半场马特·法格森和杰克·登普西的进球让苏格兰队在中场休息时取得了优势，哈利·波特为小袋鼠队做出了回应。

paras.en: Finn Russell's late penalty eventually gave the Scots some breathing space before Max Jorgensen's 80th-minute try offered the visitors a glimmer of hope but the Scots held on for a win that elevated them above Wales into fourth place in the Northern Hemisphere table.
paras.zh: 芬·拉塞尔最后时刻的点球最终给了苏格兰队一些喘息的机会，而马克斯·乔根森在第 80 分钟的射门给客队带来了一线希望，但苏格兰队最终赢得了一场胜利，超越威尔士队跃居北半球积分榜第四位。

paras.en: "When we saw the rain half an hour before kick off, you still hope you'll be able to move the ball. You could tell defences were coming off the line a bit quicker, knowing they could pressure the ball carrier," Scotland head coach Gregor Townsend told ITV,
paras.zh: “当我们在开球前半小时看到下雨时，你仍然希望能够转移球。你可以看出防守队员的速度更快了，因为他们知道他们可以给持球者施加压力，”苏格兰主教练格雷戈尔​​·汤森德告诉英国独立电视台，

paras.en: "Both teams had to adjust and I thought we did that well. Defensively, that's one of the best performances I've seen in the last couple of years. Set after set we were putting them under pressure.
paras.zh: “两支球队都必须进行调整，我认为我们做得很好。防守方面，这是我在过去几年中看到的最好的表现之一。一场又一场我们给他们带来了压力。

paras.en: "We were on that edge of physicality but disciplined, hitting hard in the tackle, putting pressure on, listening to the referee, getting back onside. That makes it hard for the opposition to get into our 22m, which was a learning from last week.
paras.zh: “我们处于体力的边缘，但纪律严明，在铲断中用力击打，施加压力，听取裁判的意见，回到场上。这使得对手很难进入我们的22m，这是上周的教训。

paras.en: "It was just constant effort. Today, we showed we can play another game, too."
paras.zh: “这只是不断的努力。今天，我们证明了我们也可以玩另一场比赛。”

articles.title: Arsenal's wait for home WSL win goes on after Earps masterclass

paras.en: Arsenal Women vs London City Lionesses; Barclays Women's Super League
paras.zh: 阿森纳女足对阵伦敦城狮队；巴克莱女子超级联赛

paras.en: Arsenal Women vs London City Lionesses. Barclays Women's Super League.
paras.zh: 阿森纳女足对阵伦敦城狮队。巴克莱女子超级联赛。

paras.en: Arsenal 1-1 London City Lionesses: Gunners remain winless at home in the WSL after inspired Mary Earps denies them victory
paras.zh: 阿森纳 1-1 伦敦城狮队：在鼓舞人心的玛丽·厄普斯否认他们的胜利后，枪手在 WSL 主场仍然没有获胜

paras.en: Report and free match highlights as Arsenal's wait for a home WSL win goes on after a 1-1 draw against London City Lionesses; the Gunners have now drawn all five games at the Emirates this season; Frida Maanum's early strike was immediately cancelled out by Izzy Goodwin
paras.zh: 在 1-1 战平伦敦城狮队后，阿森纳仍在等待 WSL 主场胜利，报道和免费比赛精彩片段；枪手本赛季在酋长球场的五场比赛全部打平；弗里达·马纳姆 (Frida Maanum) 早期的进攻立即被伊兹·古德温 (Izzy Goodwin) 取消

paras.en: Arsenal's wait for a home WSL win continues as they drew 1-1 against London City Lionesses on Sunday - their fifth draw in a row at the Emirates this season - with an inspired Mary Earps denying the Gunners victory.
paras.zh: 阿森纳仍在等待主场 WSL 胜利，周日他们以 1-1 战平伦敦城狮队，这是他们本赛季在酋长球场连续第五次战平，但充满灵感的玛丽·厄普斯否认了枪手的胜利。

paras.en: While the result extends Arsenal's unbeaten home run to 24 league matches, it is becoming an increasing concern and a spectre on the shoulder that the Gunners have been unable to secure three points at the Emirates this year.
paras.zh: 虽然这一结果使阿森纳的不败本垒打延续到了24场联赛，但枪手今年在酋长球场无法拿到三分，这正成为越来越多的担忧和恐惧。

paras.en: It was two early goals that decided the fixture too. Frida Maanum scored for a second game in a row - having netted against Barcelona in the Champions League in midweek - slotting home from an Alessia Russo cross to put Arsenal ahead.
paras.zh: 早期的两个进球也决定了比赛的胜负。弗里达·马努姆在周中欧冠对阵巴塞罗那的比赛中连续第二场进球，接阿莱西亚·鲁索的传中破门得分，帮助阿森纳取得领先。

paras.en: But a minute later, London City were level. Leah Williamson lost the run of the lively Izzy Goodwin, and the striker lashed into the roof of the net.
paras.zh: 但一分钟后，伦敦城扳平。利亚·威廉姆森失去了活泼的伊兹·古德温的奔跑能力，这位前锋击中了网顶。

paras.en: - As it happened | Teams | Stats | Live table
paras.zh: - 事情发生了|团队|统计 |直播桌

paras.en: - Transfer Centre LIVE! | WSL news and transfers | FREE WSL highlights
paras.zh: - 换乘中心上线！ | WSL 新闻和转会 |免费 WSL 亮点

paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看 WSL 比赛直播📱

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 WSL 比赛📺

paras.en: From then on, it was a goalkeeping masterclass from former England No 1 Earps especially that kept Arsenal from scoring another with her counterpart Misa Rodriguez also making her fair share of saves, albeit not as frequently.
paras.zh: 从那时起，前英格兰一号厄普斯的门将大师级表现尤其阻止了阿森纳再次进球，而她的对手米萨·罗德里格斯也做出了相当多的扑救，尽管不那么频繁。

paras.en: The Gunners simply could not find a way past the inspired London City stopper as Lionesses boss Sarina Wiegman watched on from the stands.
paras.zh: 枪手根本找不到突破这位充满灵感的伦敦城门将的方法，母狮队主帅萨琳娜·维格曼在看台上观看比赛。

paras.en: The pick of her string of world-class saves came when she tipped a Maanum shot onto the crossbar. It came shortly after substitute Delphine Cascarino had also rattled the woodwork at the other end.
paras.zh: 当她将马努姆的一脚射门击中横梁时，她完成了一系列世界级的扑救。就在替补球员德尔菲娜·卡斯卡里诺（Delphine Cascarino）也敲响了另一端的木架后不久。

paras.en: The result does little to improve either side's WSL standings, and Arsenal's hopes of finishing in the Champions League places takes another hit. They are sixth on 14 points - already six behind London City in third.
paras.zh: 这一结果对于提高双方的 WSL 排名都没有什么帮助，阿森纳获得欧冠席位的希望再次受到打击。他们积 14 分排名第六，已经落后第三名伦敦城 6 分。

paras.en: 10: GOAL! A sweeping move is finished by Maanum after Russo's cutback to give Arsenal the lead.
paras.zh: 10：目标！在鲁索的回撤后，马努姆完成了一次横扫，帮助阿森纳取得领先。

paras.en: 11: GOAL! London City immediately equalise as Goodwin fires into the roof of the net.
paras.zh: 11：目标！随着古德温的射门入网，伦敦城立即扳平比分。

paras.en: 22: SAVE! Earps makes a good stop to deny Lisa Baum, who cuts in from the right-hand side.
paras.zh: 22：保存！厄普斯出色地拦截了从右侧切入的丽莎·鲍姆。

paras.en: 27: SAVE! Misa Rodriguez on hand this time to deny Alexia Putellas.
paras.zh: 27：保存！米萨·罗德里格斯这次在场阻止了亚历克西娅·普特拉斯。

paras.en: 29: SAVE! Again from Earps! This time it's a flying effort to keep out another Baum shot.
paras.zh: 29：保存！又是来自厄普斯！这一次，鲍姆的另一次射门被飞身扑出。

paras.en: 68: CROSSBAR! Cascarino pings an effort off the top of the woodwork.
paras.zh: 68：横杆！卡斯卡里诺的一脚射门击中了门框。

paras.en: 77: DOUBLE SAVE! Earps pulls off another brilliant double save, first to deny Smith then Maanum.
paras.zh: 77：双重保存！厄普斯再次完成了精彩的双重扑救，首先扑出了史密斯，然后扑出了马纳姆。

paras.en: 85: CROSSBAR! Earps fingertips a Maanum shot onto the crossbar.
paras.zh: 85：横杆！厄普斯指尖一脚，马努姆的射门击中横梁。

paras.en: How's your luck? Arsenal face dazzling Earps as home woes continues
paras.zh: 你的运气怎么样？主场困境继续，阿森纳面对令人眼花缭乱的厄普斯

paras.en: Analysis from Sky Sports' Charlotte Marsh at the Emirates:
paras.zh: 天空体育的夏洛特·马什在酋长球场的分析：

paras.en: Before Sunday's game, Sky Sports asked whether Arsenal have lost their fear factor at the Emirates this season.
paras.zh: 在周日的比赛之前，天空体育询问阿森纳本赛季是否已经在酋长球场失去了恐惧因素。

paras.en: The answer surely has to be yes. Teams have come to the Emirates and sat in a low block that the Gunners have been unable to break down more than once.
paras.zh: 答案肯定是肯定的。球队来到酋长球场后，陷入了低位，枪手不止一次无法突破。

paras.en: London City were never going to do that. It's not in their DNA. They closer resemble the Barcelona team Arsenal faced on Thursday where, funnily enough, they drew 1-1.
paras.zh: 伦敦城永远不会这样做。这不存在于他们的 DNA 中。他们更像是周四阿森纳对阵巴塞罗那的球队，有趣的是，他们1-1战平。

paras.en: But what they might not have been banking on was an ingenious performance from Earps. While Arsenal did not have to worry about defenders sitting back, they did face a goalkeeper putting in one of the performances of the season. How's your luck?
paras.zh: 但他们可能没有指望厄普斯的巧妙表演。虽然阿森纳不必担心后卫的防守，但他们确实面临着一名本赛季表现出色的门将。你的运气怎么样？

paras.en: She made eight saves as Arsenal continued to pepper her goal - her most in the WSL since 2017 - and the second-most in the WSL this season after the goalkeeper that replaces her at Man Utd, Phallon Tullis-Joyce.
paras.zh: 她完成了八次扑救，帮助阿森纳继续进球——这是她自 2017 年以来在 WSL 中最多的一次扑救，也是本赛季 WSL 中第二多的扑救，仅次于在曼联接替她的门将法伦·图利斯-乔伊斯。

paras.en: When asked how she found the game, Earps told Sky Sports: "Tiring. It's a big point away from home.
paras.zh: 当被问及她如何看待这场比赛时，厄普斯告诉天空体育：“很累。这是客场的一场重要比赛。

paras.en: "Either team could have won it in terms of chances. Happy with the point - would have liked three. All the girls put their bodies on the line. I love defending. It was tough today and I thought we did a good job."
paras.zh: “就机会而言，任何一支球队都可以赢得比赛。对这一点感到满意 - 本来希望三分。所有女孩都把自己的身体放在线上。我喜欢防守。今天很艰难，我认为我们做得很好。”

paras.en: It was perhaps made all the sweeter for her that her former England boss Sarina Wiegman was watching on. It is well-documented how she departed the national team, but it certainly showed the Lionesses head coach what she was missing.
paras.zh: 也许对她来说，前英格兰主帅萨琳娜·维格曼的注视让她更加甜蜜。她如何离开国家队的情况有据可查，但这无疑向母狮主教练展示了她所缺少的东西。

paras.en: Earps has had to bide her time at London City, with Elene Lete continuing to be the No 1 until recently. The former England No 1 has now started in three games, and while she is yet to keep a clean sheet, she will have staked a huge claim to the permeant spot with her performance on Sunday.
paras.zh: 厄普斯不得不在伦敦城等待时机，而埃琳·莱特直到最近才继续保持第一。这位前英格兰一号门将目前已在三场比赛中首发，虽然她尚未保持不失球，但她将凭借周日的表现赢得永久席位。

articles.title: Microsoft services hit by major outage across the world
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: A massive global outage impacting more than a dozen Microsoft cloud services, including Outlook email and Teams messaging stretched into Friday as the tech giant struggled to restore the service, which is critical to the day-to-day functions of governments, schools and businesses around the world.
paras.zh: 全球范围内的大规模宕机影响了包括 Outlook 电子邮件和 Teams 消息传递在内的十多项微软云服务，该服务一直持续到周五，这家科技巨头正在努力恢复该服务，而该服务对于世界各地政府、学校和企业的日常运作至关重要。

paras.en: Starting around 12:50 p.m. ET Thursday, Microsoft began warning users of its products on social media that it was “investigating reports of users experiencing issues accessing Exchange Online,” its cloud email service.
paras.zh: 中午 12:50 左右开始美国东部时间周四，微软开始在社交媒体上警告其产品的用户，称其正在“调查用户在访问其云电子邮件服务 Exchange Online 时遇到问题的报告”。

paras.en: By the time workers were arriving at the office on Friday morning, Microsoft said it was still working on the problem.
paras.zh: 当周五早上工作人员到达办公室时，微软表示仍在解决该问题。

paras.en: Microsoft said in its latest update about 7 a.m. ET that it was seeing “encouraging recovery progress in Europe, with service availability and email delivery performance improving across a growing portion of affected Microsoft 365 infrastructure. “
paras.zh: 微软在美国东部时间上午 7 点左右的最新更新中表示，“欧洲的恢复进展令人鼓舞，受影响的 Microsoft 365 基础设施中越来越多的部分的服务可用性和电子邮件传送性能都得到了改善。”

paras.en: It added that “North America is also improving; however, some users may still experience intermittent issues as recovery actions continue.”
paras.zh: 它补充说，“北美地区也在改善；但是，随着恢复行动的继续，一些用户可能仍然会遇到间歇性问题。”

paras.en: Hours earlier the tech giant had warned that attempts “to improve serviceability” were “not taking as expected,” it said in an update on X overnight.
paras.zh: 几小时前，这家科技巨头在 X 隔夜更新中警告称，“提高可维护性”的尝试“没有达到预期”。

paras.en: Some on the social media platform derided the technical responses, or hoped email would be down Friday for a possible day off.
paras.zh: 社交媒体平台上的一些人嘲笑了技术回应，或者希望周五能关闭电子邮件，以便可能休息一天。

paras.en: There are few products as pervasive inside global companies as Outlook email.
paras.zh: 很少有产品像 Outlook 电子邮件一样在跨国公司中如此普及。

paras.en: Email traffic to many of the tech giant’s 450 million users came to a halt around midday, with email programs freezing and crashing, and mobile devices unable to refresh inboxes or send messages.
paras.zh: 这家科技巨头 4.5 亿用户中的许多用户的电子邮件流量在中午左右停止，电子邮件程序冻结和崩溃，移动设备无法刷新收件箱或发送消息。

paras.en: The problems also affected Microsoft’s non-commercial consumer products, according to a notice on its website. “This issue impacts Outlook.com, OneDrive, OneNote To Do, Teams, and Microsoft 365 for the web.”
paras.zh: 根据微软网站上的通知，这些问题还影响了微软的非商业消费产品。 “此问题影响 Outlook.com、OneDrive、OneNote To Do、Teams 和 Microsoft 365 网页版。”

paras.en: Throughout the day the problems spread. As of 11 p.m. ET on Thursday, Microsoft’s online status pages said its corporate services Exchange Online, Copilot, Microsoft Planner, Sharepoint, Microsoft To Do, Windows 365, cloud printing services, and mobile device management programs were all experiencing issues.
paras.zh: 一整天，问题都在蔓延。截至晚上 11 点美国东部时间周四，微软的在线状态页面表示，其企业服务 Exchange Online、Copilot、Microsoft Planner、Sharepoint、Microsoft To Do、Windows 365、云打印服务和移动设备管理程序都遇到了问题。

paras.en: The problem caused chaos in workplaces around the world. At one, truck manufacturer Workhouse Group, it forced the company to delay its earnings report which was set to be released on Thursday afternoon.
paras.zh: 这个问题在世界各地的工作场所造成了混乱。其中之一是卡车制造商 Workhouse Group，它迫使该公司推迟原定于周四下午发布的收益报告。

paras.en: In a statement, Workhorse said: “The rescheduling is due to business disruptions caused by the global Microsoft outages taking place today.”
paras.zh: Workhorse 在一份声明中表示：“此次重新安排是由于微软今天发生的全球服务中断导致业务中断。”

paras.en: The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner’s Office, the L.A. County Sheriff’s Department and other government agencies in California said their communications were impacted by the outage, NBC Los Angeles reported. In Washington, email services at federal agencies and on Capitol Hill were impacted.
paras.zh: 据 NBC Los Angeles 报道，洛杉矶县法医办公室、洛杉矶县治安部门和加州其他政府机构表示，他们的通信受到了此次故障的影响。在华盛顿，联邦机构和国会山的电子邮件服务受到影响。

paras.en: In Colorado, the Arapahoe County Sheriff’s Office said the outage was affecting online bond payments for people being held in its detention facility. “Until Outlook email is restored, anyone needing to post bond for immediate release must do so in person at the jail,” it said on social media.
paras.zh: 在科罗拉多州，阿拉帕霍县治安官办公室表示，停电影响了拘留设施中被关押人员的在线押金支付。它在社交媒体上表示：“在 Outlook 电子邮件恢复之前，任何需要交纳保证金以立即获释的人都必须亲自到监狱办理。”

paras.en: Throughout most of the day, Microsoft has said it has been working on the issue. By 2:50 p.m. ET, the company wrote on social media that it was “testing a configuration change” to its cloud servers in order to try to restore services.
paras.zh: 微软在一天的大部分时间里都表示，它一直在研究这个问题。下午 2:50 之前东部时间，该公司在社交媒体上写道，它正在对其云服务器“测试配置更改”，以尝试恢复服务。

paras.en: By 4:40 p.m. ET, the company said it was restarting “affected servers to return them to service.”
paras.zh: 下午 4:40 之前东部时间，该公司表示正在重新启动“受影响的服务器以使其恢复服务”。

paras.en: Microsoft explained a few minutes later in another post on X that a “core process on affected servers is becoming overwhelmed, causing capacity loss.”
paras.zh: 几分钟后，微软在 X 上的另一篇文章中解释说，“受影响服务器上的核心进程正在变得不堪重负，导致容量损失。”

paras.en: The company also said it was “shifting traffic” around in order to relieve overwhelmed servers that remained online.
paras.zh: 该公司还表示，正在“转移流量”，以缓解仍处于在线状态的不堪重负的服务器。

paras.en: But then not long after, the company again said, “The servers we returned to service can become unresponsive again once they receive traffic; we’re analyzing diagnostic data to determine what’s triggering the behavior.”
paras.zh: 但不久之后，该公司再次表示，“我们恢复服务的服务器一旦收到流量可能会再次变得无响应；我们正在分析诊断数据以确定是什么触发了该行为。”

paras.en: The updates continued into the night. At 11:36 p.m., Microsoft said it its efforts to improve server stability were ongoing, but that while it was “observing partial recovery across regions in which we’ve applied these adjustments” that didn’t result in “sustained recovery.”
paras.zh: 更新一直持续到晚上。晚上 11 点 36 分，微软表示，其提高服务器稳定性的努力仍在继续，但虽然它“观察到我们应用这些调整的地区的部分恢复情况”，但并没有带来“持续恢复”。

paras.en: NBC News attempted to reach Microsoft representatives through multiple phone numbers listed on the company’s press releases and through a phone number to its investor relations department, however the company has not commented in response.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻试图通过该公司新闻稿中列出的多个电话号码以及投资者关系部门的电话号码联系微软代表，但该公司尚未做出回应。

paras.en: An email sent to a public relations firm that represents Microsoft from a personal non-Outlook or Microsoft based email address quickly bounced back, with an error message reading that the server was “unavailable or unable to receive mail.”
paras.zh: 从个人非 Outlook 或基于 Microsoft 的电子邮件地址发送到代表 Microsoft 的公关公司的电子邮件很快被退回，并显示一条错误消息，指出服务器“不可用或无法接收邮件”。

paras.en: In a statement to Bloomberg News, a Microsoft spokesperson said: “We appreciate our customers’ patience while we work to restore services as soon as possible.”
paras.zh: 微软发言人在给彭博新闻社的一份声明中表示：“我们感谢客户的耐心等待，我们将努力尽快恢复服务。”

paras.en: Major outages, such as Microsoft’s, are not unprecedented but have become increasingly rare. In 2024, a glitch with a security program led to Windows devices around the world freezing, causing them displaying Microsoft’s well-known “blue screen of death” error. That issue brought airlines, companies, and critical systems to a halt.
paras.zh: 像微软这样的重大中断并非史无前例，但已经变得越来越罕见。 2024 年，安全程序的故障导致世界各地的 Windows 设备死机，导致它们显示微软著名的“蓝屏死机”错误。该问题导致航空公司、公司和关键系统陷入瘫痪。

paras.en: Some of Microsoft’s other critical cloud services, such as its Azure cloud computing platform, that powers many websites and apps, remained online and did not have any additional issues.
paras.zh: 微软的一些其他关键云服务，例如为许多网站和应用程序提供支持的 Azure 云计算平台，仍然保持在线状态，没有出现任何其他问题。

articles.title: Pope Leo makes emotional return to his ‘beloved diocese of Chiclayo’
articles.author: Corky Siemaszko

paras.en: LIMA, Peru — Pope Leo XIV made a triumphant return Friday to the Peruvian city of Chiclayo, where he served as bishop for eight years and was affectionately nicknamed “Padre Roberto.”
paras.zh: 秘鲁利马——周五，教皇利奥十四世凯旋返回秘鲁城市奇克拉约，他在那里担任主教八年，被亲切地称为“罗伯托神父”。

paras.en: Leo arrived in a plane decorated with “#LeoXFliesHome” stickers and he was greeted with a sign at the airport bearing the same message. A small dance troupe performed before him as he stepped onto the tarmac.
paras.zh: Leo 乘坐的飞机上装饰着“#LeoXFliesHome”贴纸，在机场迎接他的是带有相同信息的标牌。当他踏上停机坪时，一个小型舞蹈团在他面前表演。

paras.en: He will stay in the area until Sunday to lead eight events, including a private dinner with the priests who once reported to him as bishop.
paras.zh: 他将留在该地区直到周日，领导八项活动，包括与曾经向他报告主教的神父们举行私人晚宴。

paras.en: The crowds greeting Leo in Peru’s fourth-largest city were smaller than the estimated 3 million or so who welcomed the pope when he arrived Wednesday in Lima, the country’s capital.
paras.zh: 在秘鲁第四大城市迎接利奥的人群比周三教皇抵达该国首都利马时估计的 300 万人左右要少。

paras.en: The Vatican estimated that 1 million people had lined the motorcade route to the Mass and that 500,000 attended.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈估计，前往弥撒的车队路线上有 100 万人，其中 50 万人参加。

paras.en: But their enthusiasm more than made up for their smaller numbers as the former Bishop Robert Prevost of Chiclayo returned to this coastal city of nearly 700,000 as the leader of the Catholic Church.
paras.zh: 但随着奇克拉约前主教罗伯特·普雷沃斯特作为天主教会领袖回到这座拥有近 70 万人口的沿海城市，他们的热情足以弥补人数较少的问题。

paras.en: As he toured in an open-air popemobile at the Pampas de Pimentel, a vast desert plain just outside Chiclayo, the crowd erupted in cheers, many waving white-and-yellow Vatican flags.
paras.zh: 当他乘坐露天教皇专车在奇克拉约郊外的潘帕斯皮门特尔沙漠平原巡演时，人群爆发出欢呼声，许多人挥舞着白色和黄色的梵蒂冈旗帜。

paras.en: Some had been waiting since last night to catch a glimpse of the pontiff, many of them forced to walk as lines of cars had blocked the roads where vendors sold hats, mini pope dolls and sweet Peruvian bread.
paras.zh: 有些人从昨晚起就一直在等待一睹教皇的风采，其中许多人被迫步行，因为道路被汽车堵塞，小贩们在那里出售帽子、迷你教皇玩偶和秘鲁甜面包。

paras.en: Maria Esther Chozo Reyes, 76, said she had taken a 12-hour bus ride from Lima and arrived Thursday afternoon before she camped overnight. “He knows the people of Chiclayo and he’s lived here, he’s made his mission here,” she told The Associated Press. “We really need his blessing.”
paras.zh: 76 岁的玛丽亚·埃丝特·乔佐·雷耶斯 (Maria Esther Chozo Reyes) 说，她从利马乘坐 12 小时的巴士抵达周四下午，然后露营过夜。 “他了解奇克拉约的人民，他住在这里，他在这里完成了他的使命，”她告诉美联社。 “我们真的需要他的祝福。”

paras.en: Thanking the people for their love and support, in his sermon Leo said it was a blessing to be in his former home.
paras.zh: 利奥在布道中感谢人们的爱和支持，他说能够回到他以前的家是一件幸事。

paras.en: “As I look at your faces, a prayer of thanksgiving to the Lord arises in my heart for the blessing you have been and continue to be in my life,” he said, adding that his lung cancer diagnosis and surgery to remove part of one lung exactly a month ago had been a time of trial.
paras.zh: 他说：“当我看着你们的脸时，我心里升起了对上帝的感恩祈祷，感谢你们一直并继续在我的生命中赐福。”他补充说，一个月前他被诊断出患有肺癌，并接受了部分肺切除手术，这对他来说是一段考验的时期。

paras.en: Leo’s sojourn to Chiclayo is midway through the final leg of his 12-day visit to South America, a historic trip that included stops in Argentina and Uruguay. And it’s the most sentimental part of his journey.
paras.zh: Leo 对奇克拉约的逗留正处于他为期 12 天的南美洲之行的最后一站，这次历史性的旅行包括在阿根廷和乌拉圭停留。这是他旅程中最感伤的部分。

paras.en: For while Leo was born in Chicago and English is his mother tongue, the first words he uttered from the balcony of St. Peter’s Basilica were a shoutout in Spanish to his “beloved Diocese of Chiclayo.”
paras.zh: 虽然利奥出生在芝加哥，英语是他的母语，但他在圣彼得大教堂的阳台上说的第一句话是用西班牙语向他“心爱的奇克拉约教区”喊叫。

paras.en: During his time in that city, Leo often repeated a joke: “Chicago, Chiclayo, what difference is there? Only one letter.”
paras.zh: 在这座城市期间，利奥经常重复一个笑话：“芝加哥，奇克拉约，有什么区别？只有一个字母。”

paras.en: Setting aside the fact that it’s actually two letters, Leo quickly became a beloved figure in Chiclayo by championing social justice issues, embracing the poor and venturing into the local prison to say Mass.
paras.zh: 抛开这实际上是两个字母的事实不谈，利奥很快就成为奇克拉约受人爱戴的人物，他倡导社会正义问题，拥抱穷人，并冒险进入当地监狱做弥撒。

paras.en: During the pandemic, Leo endeared himself to many by launching a fundraising drive to raise money for a badly-needed oxygen production plant.
paras.zh: 在大流行期间，利奥发起了一项筹款活动，为急需的制氧厂筹集资金，赢得了许多人的喜爱。

paras.en: When Cyclone Maku hit the area in March 2023, Leo was photographed wading through the floodwaters to get supplies to the destitute and distributing food at soup kitchens.
paras.zh: 2023 年 3 月，当飓风“马库”袭击该地区时，Leo 被拍到趟过洪水，为穷人获取物资，并在施粥处分发食物。

paras.en: At Christmastime, Leo would drive a pickup truck laden with gifts into remote villages around Chiclayo and join family celebrations.
paras.zh: 圣诞节期间，利奥会驾驶一辆满载礼物的皮卡车前往奇克拉约周围的偏远村庄，参加家庭庆祝活动。

paras.en: Leo spent two decades as a missionary, priest and finally as a bishop in Peru and became a citizen in 2015. During his two decades in the country, he was also a strident critic of then- Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori’s authoritarian regime.
paras.zh: 利奥在秘鲁担任传教士、神父，最后成为主教，并于 2015 年成为公民。在秘鲁的 20 年间，他也是当时秘鲁总统阿尔贝托·藤森独裁政权的尖锐批评者。

paras.en: The return to his former adoptive home after adjusting to life at the Vatican appeared to lead to an amusing moment of confusion for the multilingual pontiff in Lima earlier on Friday, as he mistakenly began to deliver remarks in Italian, before correcting himself and switching to Spanish.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，在适应了梵蒂冈的生活后，回到了他以前的收养家庭，这似乎给利马的多语言教宗带来了一个有趣的困惑时刻，因为他错误地开始用意大利语发表讲话，然后纠正自己并改用西班牙语。

paras.en: “Oh, sorry, I’m speaking Italian,” he told the crowd. “Here, at home, and I’m speaking Italian.”
paras.zh: “哦，抱歉，我说的是意大利语，”他对人群说道。 “在这里，在家里，我说的是意大利语。”

paras.en: On Thursday, Leo delivered a speech while sitting beside Fujimori’s daughter, recently-elected Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori, at Lima’s Gran Teatro Nacional performing arts center.
paras.zh: 周四，里奥在利马国家大剧院表演艺术中心发表讲话，坐在藤森的女儿、最近当选的秘鲁总统藤森惠子旁边。

paras.en: Leo urged the country’s leaders to cultivate honesty and integrity to strengthen public trust --- and called on officeholders to listen to their constituents.
paras.zh: 利奥敦促国家领导人培养诚实和正直，以增强公众信任，并呼吁官员倾听选民的声音。

paras.en: “Today I understand how much of this land remains with me and how much of my own story also belongs to you,” Leo said.
paras.zh: “今天我明白了这片土地有多少属于我，我自己的故事也有多少属于你，”利奥说。

paras.en: There was thunderous applause when Leo referred to Peru as “my homeland.”
paras.zh: 当利奥称秘鲁为“我的祖国”时，全场响起雷鸣般的掌声。

paras.en: And Leo appeared to have tears in his eyes as he sang the Peruvian national anthem along with a children’s choir.
paras.zh: 里奥与儿童合唱团一起唱秘鲁国歌时，眼里似乎含着泪水。

paras.en: Claudio Lavanga reported from Lima and Corky Siemaszko from New York.
paras.zh: Claudio Lavanga 从利马报道，Corky Siemaszko 从纽约报道。

articles.title: Southeast Asian leaders open annual summit with major conflicts topping the agenda
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: MANILA, Philippines — Southeast Asian leaders opened their annual summit in the Philippine capital Manila on Sunday for three days of talks, including dialogues with world leaders led by U.S. President Donald Trump, whose crucial trip to Asia could help boost his standing after his party’s defeat in the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 菲律宾马尼拉——周日，东南亚领导人在菲律宾首都马尼拉举行了年度峰会，为期三天的会谈包括与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普领导的世界领导人的对话，特朗普的重要亚洲之行可能有助于提高他的政党在中期选举中失利后的地位。

paras.en: The talks by the leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and their expanded discussions with Asian and Western heads of state would focus on the world’s most troubling conflicts led by the war in the Middle East, according to drafts of post-summit communiques seen by The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 美联社看到的峰会后公报草稿显示，东南亚国家联盟领导人的会谈以及与亚洲和西方国家元首的扩大讨论将集中讨论中东战争引发的世界上最令人不安的冲突。

paras.en: Trump is expected to land in Manila with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Tuesday afternoon, after the main ASEAN summit meetings have concluded and Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. turns over the regional bloc’s rotating annual leadership to Singapore, Philippine officials said.
paras.zh: 菲律宾官员称，在东盟主要峰会结束、菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯将东盟年度轮值领导权移交给新加坡之后，特朗普预计将于周二下午与美国国务卿马可·卢比奥一起抵达马尼拉。

paras.en: The ASEAN leaders are likely to renew calls for self-restraint and peaceful resolutions of conflicts, including longstanding disputes in the South China Sea and a civil war in Myanmar. They are also expected to press efforts to shield their economies and citizens from continuing fallout from intractable global conflicts.
paras.zh: 东盟领导人可能会再次呼吁自我克制并和平解决冲突，包括南海长期争端和缅甸内战。预计他们还将努力保护本国经济和公民免受棘手的全球冲突的持续影响。

paras.en: “We reaffirmed our shared commitment to upholding international law, including the United Nations Charter,” the leaders’ draft statement says.
paras.zh: 领导人声明草案称：“我们重申了维护国际法，包括《联合国宪章》的共同承诺。”

paras.en: The statement also underlines the “importance of the peaceful resolution of disputes, upholding freedom of navigation and overflight and other lawful uses of the sea, including the right of transit passage in straits used for international navigation.”
paras.zh: 声明还强调“和平解决争端、维护航行和飞越自由以及其他合法使用海洋的重要性，包括在用于国际航行的海峡的过境通行权”。

paras.en: Marcos said it’s crucial that despite the 11-nation regional bloc’s diversity, it has remained committed to remaining united in the face of headwinds.
paras.zh: 马科斯表示，至关重要的是，尽管这个由 11 个国家组成的地区集团具有多样性，但面对逆风仍致力于保持团结。

paras.en: “That commitment matters even more as the waters around us turn on shifting tides, geopolitical tensions, economic uncertainty, new technologies, climate change and transnational threats,” Marcos said in his opening remarks before ASEAN counterparts in a heavily secured convention center by Manila Bay.
paras.zh: 马科斯在马尼拉湾戒备森严的会议中心向东盟同行致开幕词时表示：“随着我们周围海域的潮流不断变化、地缘政治紧张局势、经济不确定性、新技术、气候变化和跨国威胁，这一承诺变得更加重要。”

paras.en: Marcos warned problems across the world “are reshaping our region faster than any one country can respond to alone.”
paras.zh: 马科斯警告说，世界各地的问题“正在重塑我们地区，其速度之快超过任何一个国家单独应对的速度”。

paras.en: But unity has been an elusive objective in ASEAN, a diverse bloc of democracies and authoritarian states, many of which are aligned with the United States or China.
paras.zh: 但东盟是一个由民主国家和威权国家组成的多元化集团，其中许多国家与美国或中国结盟，团结一直是一个难以实现的目标。

paras.en: ASEAN is known more for photo-ops projecting unity, cultural pomp and pageantry than for effectively dealing with the region’s conflicts, including Myanmar and the South China Sea.
paras.zh: 东盟更多地以展示团结、文化盛况和盛况的拍照活动而闻名，而不是因为有效处理包括缅甸和南中国海在内的地区冲突而闻名。

paras.en: Trump will join three key meetings late Tuesday, including a meeting of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue consisting of the United States, Japan, Australia and India, a grouping largely seen as a counterweight to China. He also will take part in a special summit with ASEAN leaders over cocktails, according to Philippine officials.
paras.zh: 特朗普将于周二晚些时候参加三场重要会议，其中包括由美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度组成的四边安全对话会议，该组织在很大程度上被视为制衡中国。据菲律宾官员称，他还将参加与东盟领导人举行的特别峰会并举行鸡尾酒会。

paras.en: Trump will meet Wednesday with Marcos, who will receive him with a red-carpet welcome and a state luncheon at Manila’s presidential palace. They are expected to renew a commitment to their countries’ decades-old treaty alliance before flying separately to Shenzhen city in China for the APEC summit hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping.
paras.zh: 特朗普将于周三会见马科斯，马科斯将在马尼拉总统府举行红地毯欢迎仪式并举行国宴。预计他们将重申对两国已有数十年历史的条约联盟的承诺，然后分别飞往中国深圳参加中国国家主席习近平主持的亚太经合组织峰会。

paras.en: “The short stop in Manila will help reassure allies and partners that they aren’t being forgotten before he jets off to Shenzhen to focus on meetings with Xi,” U.S.-based geopolitical analyst Greg Poling said.
paras.zh: 美国地缘政治分析师格雷格·波林表示：“在马尼拉短暂停留将有助于让盟友和合作伙伴放心，在他飞往深圳集中精力与习近平会晤之前，他们不会被遗忘。”

paras.en: He added that the midterm electoral setback suffered by Republicans will hound Trump in Asia.
paras.zh: 他补充说，共和党在中期选举中遭受的挫折将在亚洲困扰特朗普。

paras.en: “In China, the administration has been trying to lower expectations; there will be no substantive progress made between Trump and Xi,” Poling said. “With Trump politically weakened after the midterm drubbing here, it is likely that the Chinese side will be even less interested in making any compromises.”
paras.zh: “在中国，政府一直试图降低预期；特朗普和习近平之间不会取得实质性进展，”波林说。 “由于特朗普在中期选举惨败后在政治上被削弱，中方可能更不愿意做出任何妥协。”

paras.en: China will be represented in the Manila summit by its premier, Li Qiang, who will meet ASEAN leaders on Monday but leave before Trump arrives, Philippine officials said.
paras.zh: 菲律宾官员表示，中国总理李强将代表中国出席马尼拉峰会，他将于周一会见东盟领导人，但在特朗普抵达之前离开。

articles.title: Soaring cost of essentials is severely testing democracies, economist says
articles.author: Gareth Hutchens

paras.en: Isabella Weber, an associate professor of economics, says the soaring cost of essentials is severely testing democracies.
paras.zh: 经济学副教授伊莎贝拉·韦伯表示，生活必需品成本飙升正在严峻考验民主国家。

paras.en: In a new book, she says policymakers need to make affordability the centre of "anti-fascist economics".
paras.zh: 她在一本新书中表示，政策制定者需要将负担能力作为“反法西斯经济学”的中心。

paras.en: Dr Weber says it would require "structuralist measures" that change the ways in which we provision the essentials in society.
paras.zh: 韦伯博士表示，这需要“结构主义措施”来改变我们提供社会必需品的方式。

paras.en: Isabella Weber, a rising-star German economist, says it's something we need to pursue again.
paras.zh: 德国经济学家后起之秀伊莎贝拉·韦伯表示，这是我们需要再次追求的目标。

paras.en: She says fascism has made a comeback. Our economic and political systems have stopped making our lives better and people are furious about it.
paras.zh: 她说法西斯主义卷土重来。我们的经济和政治制度已经不再让我们的生活变得更好，人们对此感到愤怒。

paras.en: She says illiberal forces are exploiting voters' anger and, rather than addressing the material causes of their pain, are deliberately redirecting people's rage towards migrants and other minorities, and promising that salvation can be found in nationalism, ethnic purity, or patriarchy.
paras.zh: 她说，非自由势力正在利用选民的愤怒，而不是解决他们痛苦的物质原因，而是故意将人们的愤怒转向移民和其他少数群体，并承诺可以在民族主义、种族纯洁性或父权制中找到救赎。

paras.en: To combat the phenomenon, she argues, we have to make life's essentials affordable again, housing, food, energy, water, health care, transport, so the foundations for a dignified life are available to everyone, no matter your household income or class.
paras.zh: 她认为，为了应对这一现象，我们必须再次让生活必需品变得负担得起，包括住房、食品、能源、水、医疗保健、交通，这样每个人都可以获得有尊严的生活的基础，无论你的家庭收入或阶层如何。

paras.en: "It's funny that today we think of anti-fascist economics as provocative," she told the ABC Business Daily podcast.
paras.zh: “有趣的是，今天我们认为反法西斯经济学具有挑衅性，”她告诉美国广播公司商业日报播客。

paras.en: "In the 1940s it was actually a mainstream point for economists to say that economics had a role to play in 'Never Again'.
paras.zh: “在 20 世纪 40 年代，经济学家认为经济学在《不再》中发挥了作用，这实际上是经济学家的主流观点。

paras.en: "I would argue that today we are [once again] in a deep crisis of democracy around the Western world. The extreme right is on the rise. Democracy is as unstable as it has been since the 40s.
paras.zh: “我认为，今天我们（再次）陷入了西方世界的深刻民主危机。极右势力正在崛起。民主与 20 世纪 40 年代以来一样不稳定。

paras.en: "I think people are very clear. They're saying they can't take the status quo anymore," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为人们非常清楚。他们说他们不能再接受现状了，”她说。

paras.en: An article, a pile-on, and the aftermath
paras.zh: 一篇文章，一堆，以及后果

paras.en: Dr Weber, an associate professor of economics at the University of Massachusetts, Amherst, shot to prominence (or notoriety) in December 2021.
paras.zh: 韦伯博士是马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校的经济学副教授，于 2021 年 12 月声名鹊起（或声名狼藉）。

paras.en: She published an op-ed in The Guardian arguing that, in the wake of the COVID lockdowns, it could be worth using temporary and strategic price controls on certain products to prevent large companies in systemically significant sectors from exploiting the chaos to make windfall profits (and sending higher prices through the system).
paras.zh: 她在《卫报》上发表了一篇专栏文章，认为在新冠疫情封锁之后，可能值得对某些产品使用临时和战略性的价格控制，以防止具有系统重要性的行业中的大公司利用混乱来赚取暴利（并通过系统发送更高的价格）。

paras.en: She said they were a standard tool of economic management in the 1940s. They had been used to prevent inflation spiking dangerously in the transitional years when warfare economies were shifting back from a supply-constrained world with pent-up consumer demand (and high household savings) to post-war peacetime economies when domestic supply had recovered.
paras.zh: 她说它们是 20 世纪 40 年代经济管理的标准工具。在过渡时期，它们被用来防止通货膨胀危险地飙升，当时战争经济正在从消费需求被压抑（以及家庭储蓄高）的供应受限世界转向国内供应恢复的战后和平时期经济。
