articles.title: What Seeded Life on Earth? New Research Challenges the Longstanding Theory That Comets Brought the Ingredients to Our Planet

paras.en: The question of how life started on Earth has proven to be almost as enigmatic as finding organisms on alien worlds. A longstanding theory posits that comets delivered the molecular ingredients that kickstarted life when they smacked into our planet during its youth. But new research suggests that this popular scenario is extremely unlikely.
paras.zh: 事实证明，地球上生命是如何起源的问题几乎和在异星世界中发现生物一样扑朔迷离。一种长期存在的理论认为，彗星在地球早期撞击地球时，带来了开启生命的分子成分。但一项新研究表明，这种广为接受的假说极不可能成立。

paras.en: In a study published October 28 in the journal Scientific Reports, researchers ran computer simulations of the celestial mail service and found that successful deliveries would have been rare, if not impossible. While the findings reorient discussions on the origin of life on Earth, they also posit a slightly more likely place where comets could’ve brought biologically useful organic molecules: our next-door neighbor, Mars.
paras.zh: 在10月28日发表于《科学报告》杂志上的一项研究中，研究人员对“天体邮递服务”进行了计算机模拟，发现成功的递送将非常罕见，甚至不可能。这些发现不仅为关于地球生命起源的讨论提供了新的方向，还提出一个彗星可能将具有生物学意义的有机分子带到那里、可能性略高的地点：我们的邻居火星。

paras.en: The team investigated the potential delivery of hydrogen cyanide (HCN), a molecule with hydrogen, carbon and nitrogen, that would’ve been made with leftovers from the solar system’s formation 4.6 billion years ago. It has been detected on many comets and can be a precursor for many of life’s essential building blocks, including lipids, sugars and nucleotides. That’s because the carbon-containing, or organic, molecule has an extremely strong chemical bond that can drive subsequent reactions. The bond also makes it very stable, and thus more likely than other organics to survive an impact.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “So, if things look bad for hydrogen cyanide, then we think it’s going to be much harder for other, more complicated molecules that are more likely to be broken down during these impacts,” lead author Richard Anslow, a planetary scientist who conducted the research at the University of Cambridge in England, tells Science News’ Skyler Ware.
paras.zh: “因此，如果氰化氢的情况看起来不妙，那么我们认为，对于其他更复杂的分子来说，情况会更加严峻，因为这些分子在撞击过程中更有可能被分解。”在英国剑桥大学开展这项研究的行星科学家、第一作者理查德·安斯洛（Richard Anslow）对《科学新闻》的斯凯勒·韦尔（Skyler Ware）表示。

paras.en: Comets, sometimes dubbed “dirty snowballs,” are masses of frozen gases, rock and dust located primarily in the outer solar system. When their orbit brings them closer to the sun, their materials get heated up and form a glowing head, as well as a tail that streaks across the sky.
paras.zh: 彗星有时被称为“脏雪球”，是由冰冻气体、岩石和尘埃组成的物质，主要位于太阳系外围。当它们的轨道使它们更接近太阳时，它们的物质会被加热，形成一个发光的彗头，以及一条在天空中划过长线的彗尾。

paras.en: And things did indeed look bad. Anslow and colleagues analyzed comet impact simulations, interactions between the atmosphere and comets, and models of the origin and evolution of comets. They found that comets likely wouldn’t have been able to supply enough HCN needed to seed life on Earth.
paras.zh: 情况确实不妙。Anslow和同事们分析了彗星撞击模拟、大气层与彗星之间的相互作用以及彗星起源和演化的模型。他们发现，彗星可能无法提供足够的HCN来播种地球上的生命。

paras.en: For starters, the rate at which the so-called dirty snowballs crashed into our planet quickly dwindled during its first 500 million years, so there were few opportunities for one carrying HCN to have landed here. Most of their simulations—54 percent—resulted in zero impacts. The remainder provided at least one collision, though only a “tiny minority” resulted in up to three collisions, Anslow tells CNN’s Jacopo Prisco.
paras.zh: 首先，在地球的最初5亿年里，所谓的“脏雪球”撞击地球的频率迅速下降，因此携带HCN的“脏雪球”降落到地球上的机会寥寥无几。他们的大多数模拟（54%）都未产生任何撞击。其余的模拟显示至少发生一次碰撞，但只有“极少数”模拟显示发生多达三次碰撞，Anslow告诉CNN的Jacopo Prisco。

paras.en: What’s more, when comet strikes did take place, most dirty snowballs traveled too fast and at too sharp an angle relative to Earth’s atmosphere; impact likely would have vaporized any hitchhiking HCN. And even if some molecules survived but landed in the ocean, they would have diluted quickly, probably before any life-related chemistry could take place. “It’s really this sort of high-temperature pressure chemistry happening immediately post impact” that makes HCN less beneficial for prebiotic chemistry, Anslow tells Chemical & Engineering News’ Ana Georgescu.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Still, “we can’t rule out confidently that there was never a successful impact—there could have been one of these fluke impacts,” he tells CNN. But there are also other post-impact criteria that would have had to be met, such as the presence of liquid water nearby and other life-supporting chemicals, he adds.
paras.zh: 然而，他向CNN表示：“我们不能有把握地排除从未发生过成功的撞击——可能发生过一次这样的偶然撞击。” 但他补充说，还有其他必须满足的撞击后条件，例如附近存在液态水和其他维持生命的化学物质。

paras.en: While this alignment of conditions seems practically impossible on our planet, the researchers suggest it could have been more likely on Mars. Their simulations show that comets had a greater chance of successfully reaching the Red Planet’s surface—due to the planet’s smaller size and thinner atmosphere—when the solar system was young.
paras.zh: 虽然在我们的星球上，这些条件同时具备似乎几乎不可能，但研究人员认为，在火星上，这种情况可能更有可能发生。他们的模拟表明，在太阳系早期，由于火星的体积较小、大气层较薄，彗星成功抵达火星表面的几率更大。

paras.en: “This is not to say it definitely happened on Mars, of course, but suggests it would be unlikely if it happened on Earth and didn’t happen on Mars,” Anslow says in a statement. “Or the other, perhaps more likely, alternative is that it didn’t happen on either planet.”
paras.zh: “当然，这并不是说它肯定发生在火星上，但它表明，如果它发生在地球上而没有发生在火星上，那就不太可能。”Anslow在一份声明中表示。“或者另一种也许更有可能的解释是，它在两个星球上都没有发生过。”

paras.en: However, the team did not consider the possibility of HCN undergoing chemical reactions on the comets themselves to produce sturdier biologically relevant compounds before they plunged into Earth’s atmosphere, Queenie Hoi Shan Chan, a planetary scientist at the Royal Holloway University of London who did not participate in the study, tells CNN.
paras.zh: 然而，伦敦皇家霍洛威大学的行星科学家Queenie Hoi Shan Chan告诉CNN，该团队没有考虑到HCN在彗星上发生化学反应的可能性，即在HCN进入地球大气层之前，在彗星上就生成了更稳定的、与生物学相关的化合物。Queenie Hoi Shan Chan没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: Either way, something must have happened to kickstart the incredibly diverse life forms that now populate our planet. Anslow and his colleagues point to other possibilities, such as asteroids—which were more frequent terrestrial visitors—or precursors simply taking shape on Earth without extraterrestrial support.
paras.zh: 无论如何，一定发生了某种事情，才引发了如今遍布我们星球的、令人难以置信的丰富多样的生命形式。安斯洛和他的同事们指出了其他可能性，例如小行星（它们是更频繁的地球访客），或者前体物质在没有外星支持的情况下在地球上自行形成。

articles.title: Astronomers Found a Mysterious Object Orbiting Far Beyond Pluto. It Could Be a New Dwarf Planet Hidden in Our Solar System

paras.en: Matthew Holman, a senior astrophysicist at the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory, was sifting through data from the Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile when something odd caught his eye. Running a custom-made computer program, he and his colleague Kevin Napier had already spotted more than 2,000 little bright dots in the telescope data, corresponding to newly discovered small objects in the distant solar system. But this one was different: It seemed to be big.
paras.zh: 史密森天体物理观测台的高级天体物理学家马修·霍尔曼（Matthew Holman）正在筛选智利维拉·鲁宾天文台（Vera C. Rubin Observatory）的数据，这时，一个奇怪的现象引起了他的注意。他和同事凯文·纳皮尔（Kevin Napier）运行一款定制的计算机程序，已经在望远镜数据中发现了2000多个小亮点，它们对应于在遥远的太阳系中新发现的小天体。但这个不一样：它看起来很大。

paras.en: Holman managed his expectations. After all, astronomers in the business of finding distant objects are used to disappointment. “We all have ‘found Mars’ … in terms of a false positive,” Holman tells Smithsonian magazine. They find a bright object that seems really big, then, with a closer look, learn that it’s nothing very remarkable after all. “We’re all really cautious when you see something that looks like it’s large.”
paras.zh: 霍尔曼控制了自己的期望。毕竟，从事寻找遥远天体工作的天文学家早已习惯于失望。“我们都‘发现过火星’……但那只是误报。”霍尔曼告诉《史密森尼》杂志。他们发现一个看起来非常大的明亮天体，然后仔细观察，发现它毕竟没什么特别之处。“当我们看到看起来很大的东西时，我们都会非常谨慎。”

paras.en: Still, this object grabbed Holman’s attention, so he tried to verify it with Napier and Rubin solar system lead scientist Mario Jurić. They found the celestial body in previous photos of the sky throughout the past decade, which helped them zero in on its orbital path—and the more historical data they found, the more confident they became.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这个天体还是引起了霍尔曼的注意，因此他试图与纳皮尔和鲁宾太阳系首席科学家马里奥·尤里奇（Mario Jurić）一起对其进行验证。他们在过去十年中拍摄的天空照片中发现了这颗天体，这帮助他们确定了它的轨道路径——他们找到的历史数据越多，就越有信心。

paras.en: “We know that it’s real,” Holman says. “Every time you look at the predicted location, there it is.” They even found it in photographic plates from 1937, stored in the Harvard plate stacks, he says.
paras.zh: “我们知道它是真实存在的，”霍尔曼说。“每次你查看预测位置时，它都在那里。” 他说，他们甚至在收藏于哈佛大学玻璃底片库的1937年玻璃底片中发现了它。

paras.en: The object, called 2026 ED138, is 46 times farther from the sun than Earth is, and it takes 281.1 years to complete an orbit. Now, the central question is whether it’s big enough to be classified as a new dwarf planet, which would put it among the rare ranks of only five other objects in our solar system.
paras.zh: 该天体名为2026 ED138，距离太阳比地球远46倍，绕太阳一周需要281.1年。现在，关键问题在于它是否足够大，可以被归类为一颗新的矮行星，这将使其跻身于太阳系中仅有其他五个天体的稀有行列。

paras.en: “This is incredibly exciting,” Paul Byrne, a planetary scientist at the Washington University in St. Louis who was not involved in the discovery, tells National Geographic’s Robin George Andrews. “It heralds a new era of solar system and planetary science.”
paras.zh: “这太令人兴奋了。”圣路易斯华盛顿大学的行星科学家保罗·伯恩（Paul Byrne）在接受《国家地理》记者罗宾·乔治·安德鲁斯（Robin George Andrews）采访时表示。他并未参与此次发现。“它预示着太阳系和行星科学的新时代的到来。”

paras.en: Dwarf planets are smaller planets that orbit a star and have a nearly round shape, which happens naturally with objects above a certain size, as their gravitational force pulls evenly on all sides. But dwarf planets are not large enough for their gravity to clear their orbital paths of similar-size debris—the eight planets of our solar system, meanwhile, have achieved that feat. (Pluto’s designation was changed from planet to dwarf planet in 2006 for this reason—its orbit is littered with icy Kuiper Belt objects.)
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: ED138 is likely big enough to be round and, therefore, a dwarf planet—estimates for its size currently range from 370 miles to 930 miles across. But astronomers will have to confirm that measurement, and from the object’s brightness alone, that’s impossible. A highly reflective, smaller object, perhaps covered in gleaming ice caps, might appear just as bright as a less reflective, duller body that’s much larger.
paras.zh: ED138可能大到足以呈圆形，因此是一颗矮行星——目前对其大小的估计范围为直径370英里至930英里。但天文学家必须确认这一测量结果，而仅凭该天体的亮度是无法做到的。一个高反射率的较小天体，或许覆盖着闪闪发光的冰盖，其亮度可能与一个反射率较低、亮度较暗但大得多的天体一样。

paras.en: Astronomers have two ways to get the required data. They could observe the world in infrared light, which reveals the thermal energy that it emits after being warmed by the sun. “From that you can figure out how big it is, because we know approximately what temperature it should have,” Holman says.
paras.zh: 天文学家有两种方法可以获得所需的数据。他们可以用红外光观察世界，红外光可以揭示世界在被太阳加热后所辐射的热能。“通过这种方式，你可以推断出它的体积，因为我们大致知道它应该具有的温度。”霍尔曼说。

paras.en: Alternatively, astronomers could watch the dwarf planet candidate pass in front of a star. If they know how much light comes from that star and how fast ED138 is moving, they can calculate the body’s size based on how long it obscures the light.
paras.zh: 或者，天文学家可以观察这颗候选矮行星从一颗恒星前方经过。如果他们知道那颗恒星发出的光量以及ED138的移动速度，就可以根据它遮挡光线的时间长短来计算天体的尺寸。

paras.en: Holman says people are working on making those observations with telescopes such as the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA). The dwarf planet candidate isn’t extremely easy to see at the moment, he adds, but “in the next few months it will be, and people will try.”
paras.zh: 霍尔曼表示，人们正在使用阿塔卡马大型毫米/亚毫米阵列（ALMA）等望远镜进行这些观测。他补充说，目前还很难看到这颗矮行星候选者，但“在接下来的几个月里，它将变得容易观测，人们也会尝试。”

paras.en: Right now, astronomers recognize five dwarf planets: Pluto, Eris, Makemake and Haumea in the distant Kuiper Belt, and Ceres in the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter. Experts have long suspected that there could be more of these objects, but many of them could have highly elliptical orbits that keep them too far away for us to see most of the time. What we observe is potentially the “tip of the iceberg of a few that are in the close part of their orbit,” Holman says. “There must be a lot that we just haven’t yet detected.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The discovery also hints at a relatively unexplored area of our solar system—the region that’s in front of the dense, starry core of the Milky Way from our perspective. It’s harder to pick out objects against all the background light in that zone, and ED138 has been traveling through it for the past 25 to 30 years, Holman notes. “There’s a swath on the sky where we really don’t have a good idea of what is there,” he adds.
paras.zh: 这一发现还暗示了太阳系中一个相对未被探索的区域——从我们的视角来看，该区域位于银河系密集星核的前方。霍尔曼指出，在该区域，由于背景光线较多，因此更难辨别出天体，而ED138在过去的25至30年里一直在该区域穿行。他补充说：“天空中有一片区域，我们对那里有什么真的不太清楚。”

paras.en: What’s more, ED138 is in the southern hemisphere’s sky, and a lot of astronomical observations have focused on the northern hemisphere. But Rubin is poised to help change that: The new telescope, which has the world’s largest digital camera and captured its first images last year, is one of several observatories operating out of Chile’s Atacama Desert.
paras.zh: 此外，ED138位于南半球的天空中，而许多天文观测都集中在北半球。但鲁宾望远镜有望帮助改变这一局面：这台新望远镜配备了世界上最大的数码相机，去年拍摄了首批图像，是智利阿塔卡马沙漠中运行的数台天文望远镜之一。

paras.en: “Rubin is giving us an unprecedented capacity to explore the sky through a combination of speed, depth and precision,” Jurić says in a statement.
paras.zh: “通过速度、深度和精度的结合，Rubin为我们提供了前所未有的探索天空的能力。”Jurić在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: “I was surprised that it found such an object so early,” Megan Schwamb, a planetary scientist at Queen’s University Belfast in Northern Ireland and a member of the Rubin solar system operations team, tells CNN’s Jacopo Prisco. “This was not on my bingo card for this year.”
paras.zh: “我很惊讶它这么早就能发现这样的天体。”北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特皇后大学的行星科学家、鲁宾太阳系观测项目团队成员梅根·施瓦姆（Megan Schwamb）对CNN的雅各波·普里斯科（Jacopo Prisco）表示。“这不在我今年的宾果卡上。”

paras.en: Understanding more about how and where ED138 formed could reveal new details about the early days of the solar system. And its existence offers a clear reminder that surprising objects remain to be found on the fringes of our planetary neighborhood.
paras.zh: 进一步了解ED138是如何以及在哪里形成的，可能会揭示有关太阳系早期的新细节。它的存在清楚地提醒我们，在行星邻域的边缘地带仍有令人惊奇的天体有待发现。

paras.en: “Is there a Mars- or Earth-size or bigger object out there?” Holman says. “That’s not ruled out.”
paras.zh: “那里是否存在火星或地球大小，甚至更大的天体？” 霍尔曼说，“这并非不可能。”

articles.title: Designed to Be Unsinkable, the World's Fastest Ocean Liner Finally Hits the Ocean Floor. The 53,330-Ton S.S. 'United States' Is Now the World's Largest Artificial Reef

paras.en: On June 29, 1952, a state-of-the-art ocean liner, nearly 1,000 feet long, opened up to the public. Some 70,000 people flooded to its berth in New York City to catch a glimpse of the S.S. United States before it hit the Atlantic for its maiden voyage.
paras.zh: 1952 年 6 月 29 日，一艘近 1000 英尺长的最先进的远洋客轮向公众开放。在美国号抵达大西洋进行处女航之前，约有 7 万人涌向其位于纽约市的泊位，一睹它的风采。

paras.en: Almost immediately, the liner proved worthy of the intense interest. On July 3, 1952, the S.S. United States reached England in a record-breaking three days, 10 hours and 40 minutes, a speed that has yet to be surpassed to this day by any passenger liner. In its 17-year run, the ship would go on to host numerous notables, including Marilyn Monroe, Walt Disney, Salvador Dalí and even the Mona Lisa, after the painting’s one and only trip to the United States.
paras.zh: 几乎立刻，事实证明这艘客轮值得人们强烈关注。 1952 年 7 月 3 日，美国号以创纪录的三天 10 小时 40 分钟抵达英国，这一速度至今还没有任何客轮能够超越。在其 17 年的运营中，这艘船继续接待了众多名人，包括玛丽莲·梦露、华特·迪士尼、萨尔瓦多·达利，甚至是《蒙娜丽莎》在这幅画作唯一一次前往美国之后。

paras.en: On Wednesday, more than 70 years after its record-setting maiden voyage, crowds once again came out in droves to see the legendary liner depart on one last journey. This time, the S.S. United States was heading to the bottom of the sea for a new life as an artificial reef and diving destination in the Gulf of Mexico.
paras.zh: 周三，在其创纪录的首航 70 多年后，人们再次成群结队地前来观看这艘传奇客轮的最后一次旅程。这次，美国号作为墨西哥湾的人工鱼礁和潜水目的地，驶向海底，开始新的生活。

paras.en: Designed by the prolific 20th century naval architect William Francis Gibbs, the ocean liner represented the peak of post-World War II maritime technology. Over 100 feet longer than the Titanic, the United States contained no wood except the ship’s grand pianos, built with fire-resistant mahogany. “She will have more aluminum in her than Mr. Gibbs cares to say, a design feature that will contribute to the dual goal of strength and relative lightness,” George Horne reported for the New York Times in 1951. “There are other metals that are even more secret.” In fact, its construction was kept entirely out of the public eye.
paras.zh: 这艘远洋客轮由 20 世纪多产的海军建筑师威廉·弗朗西斯·吉布斯 (William Francis Gibbs) 设计，代表了二战后航海技术的顶峰。美国号比泰坦尼克号长 100 多英尺，除了船上用耐火桃花心木建造的三角钢琴外，没有任何木材。 1951 年，乔治·霍恩 (George Horne) 为《纽约时报》报道说：“她体内的铝含量将比吉布斯先生所说的还要多，这一设计特点将有助于实现强度和相对轻盈的双重目标。”“还有其他金属，甚至更加秘密。”事实上，它的建设完全远离公众的视线。

paras.en: Throughout the 1950s and ‘60s, the liner completed more than 800 journeys across the Atlantic, carrying more than 1 million passengers, including many celebrities and politicians.
paras.zh: 整个 20 世纪 50 年代和 60 年代，这艘客轮完成了 800 多次横渡大西洋的旅程，载运了超过 100 万名乘客，其中包括许多名人和政界人士。

paras.en: Throughout its 17-year tenure, the S.S. United States carried four presidents: Harry Truman, Dwight Eisenhower, John F. Kennedy and a young Bill Clinton, who took it to study at Oxford University as a Rhodes Scholar in 1968.
paras.zh: 在其17年的运营期内，美国号曾搭载过四位总统：哈里·杜鲁门、德怀特·艾森豪威尔、约翰·F·肯尼迪和年轻的比尔·克林顿。1968年，比尔·克林顿作为罗德学者搭乘该船前往牛津大学学习。

paras.en: With its intricately designed interior featuring patriotic art, amenities including a movie theater and its unparalleled speed, the S.S. United States provided many passengers with lasting memories.
paras.zh: 凭借其精心设计的爱国艺术内饰、电影院等设施以及无与伦比的速度，美国号给许多乘客留下了持久的回忆。

paras.en: “The ship going at this incredible speed—it was almost dangerous sometimes for a kid my size to go out on the deck,” Warren Jones, a board member for the nonprofit S.S. United States Conservancy who sailed on the liner as a child, tells FOX Weather’s Julian Atienza and Brandy Campbell. “Those engines, you felt the vibrations and sailed past the Statue of Liberty. It was unforgettable.”
paras.zh: “这艘船以令人难以置信的速度行驶——对于一个像我这样大的孩子来说，有时在甲板上几乎是危险的，”非营利组织 S.S. United States Conservancy 的董事会成员沃伦·琼斯（Warren Jones）告诉福克斯天气的朱利安·阿蒂恩扎（Julian Atienza）和布兰迪·坎贝尔（Brandy Campbell），他小时候曾在这艘游轮上航行。 “那些引擎，你感受到振动并驶过自由女神像。这是令人难忘的。”

paras.en: But as airline travel became more accessible, the age of luxury ocean liners soon drew to a close. In 1969, the S.S. United States was abruptly decommissioned. Even crew members were shocked by its sudden withdrawal from service. Several left personal belongings on board, assuming they would go back to work the next day, only to show up to locked gangway doors.
paras.zh: 但随着航空旅行变得更加便捷，豪华远洋客轮的时代很快就结束了。 1969年，美国号突然退役。就连机组人员也对其突然退出服务感到震惊。一些人将个人物品留在了船上，以为他们第二天会回去工作，结果却出现在上锁的舷梯门前。

paras.en: For the next nine years, it languished as a reserve ship for the U.S. Navy, ready to for action if the need arose. But there was no need, and in 1978, the ship was put up for sale.
paras.zh: 在接下来的九年里，它作为美国海军的预备役舰船闲置着，随时准备在需要时投入行动。但并没有出现这种情况，1978年，这艘船被挂牌出售。

paras.en: In the following decades, the ship passed from port to port, from owner to owner, each with different plans for the ship: floating condominiums, hazardous waste removal in Ukraine, a revived cruise liner. But no idea garnered enough money or momentum to last. By 2024, the ship had foundered on a Philadelphia pier for decades.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几十年里，这艘船从一个港口辗转到另一个港口，从一个船东转到另一个船东，每个船东对这艘船都有不同的计划：水上公寓、在乌克兰清除危险废物、重振邮轮业务。但没有一个想法能筹集到足够的资金或获得足够的势头以持续下去。到2024年，这艘船已经在费城的一个码头上搁浅了几十年。

paras.en: When the pier’s landlord raised the daily dockage fee to $1,700—$620,500 per year—the S.S. United States was evicted and faced the possibility of getting scrapped. Instead, Florida’s Okaloosa County purchased the ship for $1 million, with plans to turn it into the world’s largest artificial reef. The county already has a fleet of sunken ships off its coast, but the S.S. United States is its crowning jewel.
paras.zh: 当码头的业主将每日停泊费上调至1700美元（即每年620500美元）时，“美国号”被驱逐，并面临被拆解的命运。然而，佛罗里达州奥卡卢萨县以100万美元的价格买下了这艘船，并计划将其改造成世界上最大的人工礁石。该县沿海已经有一批沉船，但“美国号”是其中的佼佼者。

paras.en: Officials expect the liner-turned-reef will become home to a variety of marine species, including red snapper, grouper, amberjack, mackerel and tuna. The ship will also be open to divers.
paras.zh: 官员们预计，这艘变身为礁石的客轮将成为各种海洋生物的栖息地，包括红鲷、石斑鱼、琥珀鱼、鲭鱼和金枪鱼。这艘船也将向潜水员开放。

paras.en: “She’s being reefed and will remain intact and will become a vibrant and dynamic marine habitat,” Susan Gibbs, the conservancy’s president and granddaughter of the ship’s designer, tells the Guardian’s Richard Luscombe.
paras.zh: “它正在被改造为人工礁，将保持完好无损，并成为一个充满活力和生机的海洋栖息地。”保护协会主席兼该船设计师的孙女苏珊·吉布斯（Susan Gibbs）对《卫报》的理查德·拉斯科姆（Richard Luscombe）表示。

paras.en: The conservancy plans to run a museum adjacent to the pier where diving expeditions will set out, featuring the ship’s iconic smokestacks, alongside other parts of the ship’s interior and a collection of artifacts and memorabilia.
paras.zh: 保护协会计划在码头附近开设一座博物馆，作为潜水探险的出发地，博物馆将展出这艘船标志性的烟囱，以及船内其他部分，还有一批文物和纪念品。

paras.en: Unlike the liner’s legendary maiden voyage, the trip from Philadelphia to the ocean floor was far from speedy. After a handful of false starts and a last-ditch lawsuit, it took months of preparation at a port in Alabama to ready the vessel for its voyage to the bottom of the sea, the New York Times’ Jesse Pesta reports.
paras.zh: 与这艘邮轮传奇般的处女航不同，从费城到海底的旅程远非一帆风顺。据《纽约时报》的Jesse Pesta报道，经过几次夭折的尝试和最后一刻的诉讼，在阿拉巴马州的一个港口花了数月的准备时间，才使这艘船为驶向海底的航程做好准备。

paras.en: Workers removed the ship’s wiring, ductwork, glass and anything that could potentially pose a danger to divers or marine life. They also cut strategic passages through the ship’s interior to create open pathways that would reduce stagnant water and enable divers to easily pass in and out. Finally, they removed off the ship’s two iconic, six-story smokestacks, earmarked for the future museum. The S.S. United States was finally ready for sinking.
paras.zh: 工人拆除了船上的电线、管道、玻璃以及任何可能对潜水员或海洋生物构成潜在危险的物品。他们还在船体内开辟了战略通道，形成开放式通道，以减少积水，并让潜水员能够轻松进出。最后，他们拆除了该船的两座标志性的六层烟囱，并将其留作未来博物馆的展品。“美国号”终于准备好沉入海底了。

paras.en: On Wednesday afternoon, the ship set out from Destin, Florida. A crew cut holes in the ship and removed more than 400 portholes. Water flooded in, but as night descended, it still hadn’t sunk.
paras.zh: 周三下午，这艘船从佛罗里达州德斯廷启航。船员在船上凿出洞来，并拆除了400多个舷窗。海水涌入，但直到夜幕降临，它仍未沉没。

paras.en: “She was designed to be unsinkable, and that fact has definitely given our crews some challenges today,” Nick Tomecek, a spokesperson for Okaloosa County, told ABC 6.
paras.zh: “这艘船的设计是永不沉没的，这一事实无疑给我们的船员带来了不少挑战。”奥卡卢萨县发言人Nick Tomecek对ABC 6表示。

paras.en: Or, as William Francis Gibbs once bragged, “You can’t set her on fire, you can’t sink her and you can’t catch her.”
paras.zh: 或者，正如威廉·弗朗西斯·吉布斯（William Francis Gibbs）曾夸耀的那样：“你烧不着她，沉不了她，也抓不住她。”

paras.en: But in the end, only two of those bold claims held true. At 8:59 p.m. Central time, the S.S. United States slipped below the waves, starting a new chapter as a home for marine life and a destination for divers from across the world.
paras.zh: 但最终，这些大胆的说法中只有两项成真。中部时间晚上8点59分，“美国号”沉入波涛之下，开启了作为海洋生物栖息地和世界各地潜水者游览胜地的新篇章。

articles.title: The 21 Best REI Holiday Sale Outdoor Deals (2026)
articles.author: Scott Gilbertson

paras.en: REI's 2026 Holiday Sale kicked off November 13 and lasts until November 23 this year. There are plenty of great deals to help you restock your backpacking, hiking, biking, camping, outdoor-loving gear quiver. REI members can use the code HOLIDAY2026 to save an extra 20 percent off one full-price item, and an extra 20 percent off one REI Outlet item. Below are the best deals on all our favorite tents, backpacks, sleeping bags, pads, cookware, outdoor apparel, and more.
paras.zh: REI 的 2026 年假日促销活动于 11 月 13 日开始，今年将持续到 11 月 23 日。有很多超值优惠可以帮助您补充背包、远足、骑自行车、露营、户外运动的装备。 REI 会员可以使用代码 HOLIDAY2026 购买一件全价商品可额外享受 20% 的折扣，购买一件 REI Outlet 商品还可享受额外 20% 的折扣。以下是我们最喜欢的所有帐篷、背包、睡袋、垫子、炊具、户外服装等的最佳优惠。

paras.en: There are also sales at Backcountry.com and some of our favorite cottage industry brands like Six Moon Designs, Zenbivy, and more. Not sure what you need? Check out our many outdoor gear guides.
paras.zh: Backcountry.com 和一些我们最喜欢的家庭手工业品牌（如 Six Moon Designs、Zenbivy 等）也有销售。不确定您需要什么？查看我们的许多户外装备指南。

paras.en: The 650 Down Jacket is one of the best budget three-season puffer jackets you can buy, more so at this price. At 10.9 ounces, it's reasonably lightweight and has large hand pockets and some very nice internal pockets for stashing a hat or gloves. The kids' version is also on sale in a nice yellow color that's handy for spotting your child in the snow.
paras.zh: 650 羽绒服是您可以购买的最经济实惠的三季羽绒服之一，在这个价格上更是如此。它重 10.9 盎司，重量相当轻，有很大的插手口袋和一些非常漂亮的内部口袋，可以存放帽子或手套。儿童版也有售，颜色为漂亮的黄色，可以方便地在雪地里发现您的孩子。

paras.en: The Ghost Whisperer Down Jacket is my top pick for a backpacking puffer jacket. It weighs just 6.7 ounces for a men's medium (7.3 ounces for the men's large I tested), packs down to a tiny little thing (stuffing into its own pocket), and the 1,000-fill-power goose down offers one of the best warmth-to-weight ratios on the market. The men's version is technically on sale right now, but the only size available is small and XXL.
paras.zh: Ghost Whisperer 羽绒服是我首选的背包羽绒服。男式中号羽绒服的重量仅为 6.7 盎司（我测试的男式大号羽绒服的重量为 7.3 盎司），折叠起来就像一个小东西（塞进自己的口袋里），1,000 蓬松度的鹅绒提供了市场上最佳的保暖重量比之一。严格来说，男款目前正在销售，但唯一可用的尺码是小号和 XXL 号。

paras.en: This is my favorite puffer jacket, especially in the shoulder seasons when temps dip a little lower. It features 4.5 ounces of 1,000-fill down (men’s medium), which is half the weight of the overall jacket. The internal TILT lining (short for Thermo Ionic Lining Technology) may or may not do anything; I haven't been able to devise an effective test, but even if it did nothing, the amount of 1,000-fill-power down combined with the scant weight makes this an appealing option for ultralighters. The 7D fabric (which is what keeps the weight low) does need babying, but I haven't had any issues in over a year of use.
paras.zh: 这是我最喜欢的羽绒服，尤其是在气温稍低的肩季。它采用 4.5 盎司 1,000 填充羽绒（男士中号），是整个夹克重量的一半。内部 TILT 衬里（热离子衬里技术的缩写）可能会也可能不会做任何事情；我无法设计出有效的测试，但即使它没有起到任何作用，1,000 蓬松度的羽绒量加上较轻的重量，使其成为超轻者的一个有吸引力的选择。 7D 面料（保持低重量的原因）确实需要呵护，但在一年多的使用中我没有遇到任何问题。

paras.en: This is great deal on a very warm down parka. It's thigh-length, which helps keep drafts up your back to a minimum, and it fits pretty well, though it's definitely boxy (what do you want from a 650-down-fill parka that's designed primarily to keep you warm?). I did find that the main two-way zipper can be fiddly, and does sometimes snag, but it's hardly a deal-breaker, especially at this price.
paras.zh: 对于一件非常保暖的羽绒派克大衣来说，这是非常划算的。它长至大腿，有助于将背部的气流降至最低，而且非常合身，尽管它绝对是四四方方的（您想要一款主要为保暖而设计的 650 羽绒填充派克大衣吗？）。我确实发现主要的双向拉链可能很麻烦，有时会被绊倒，但这并不是一个破坏性的事情，尤其是在这个价格下。

paras.en: Six Moon Design's Lunar Solo is one of the best single-wall ultralight solo tents you can buy. It's not without its quirks (read the pitching tips), but if you want something more than a tarp, that still weighs just 26 ounces (740 grams), this one is hard to beat. Use the Code YULEHIKE to get the 25 percent off.
paras.zh: Six Moon Design 的 Lunar Solo 是您可以买到的最好的单壁超轻单人帐篷之一。它并非没有怪癖（请阅读投球技巧），但如果您想要的不仅仅是防水布，它的重量仍然只有 26 盎司（740 克），那么这款产品是无与伦比的。使用代码 YULEHIKE 可享受 25% 的折扣。

paras.en: Nemo's Hornet tents are some of the lightest freestanding tents around. The 1-person model is my go-to for situations where I might have to pitch on rock or concrete slabs (like staying in towns on a longer bikepacking trip). It's roomy enough for you and all your gear, light enough at 2.25 pounds (without stakes), and packs down remarkably small. It's also held up well in storms, though you will want some extra guy-outs if the wind is really howling (I like Zpacks 1.2-mm dyneema cord for lightweight guylines).
paras.zh: Nemo 的 Hornet 帐篷是周围最轻的独立式帐篷之一。当我可能需要在岩石或混凝土板上投球（例如在城镇进行较长的自行车旅行）时，我会选择单人模型。它足够宽敞，可以容纳您和您的所有装备，重量仅为 2.25 磅（不含桩），重量足够轻，并且打包后非常小。它在暴风雨中也能保持良好的状态，但如果风真的很大，你会需要一些额外的拉线（我喜欢 Zpacks 1.2 毫米迪尼玛线，用于轻型拉线）。

paras.en: This is the bikepacking version of Big Agnes' popular Copper Spur tent. The only difference, aside from color, is that the pole segments on this model are shorter (to make it easier to store on a bike). The Copper Spur line is very nearly the lightest freestanding tent around (it's just slightly heavier than the Hornet above), and if you happen to use it with trekking poles, you get what I think is the best feature, the covered awning modification for the vestibule. While this is the best deal, the 2-person model is also on sale for 20 percent off.
paras.zh: 这是 Big Agnes 广受欢迎的 Copper Spur 帐篷的自行车背包版本。除了颜色之外，唯一的区别是该型号的杆段较短（以便更容易存放在自行车上）。 Copper Spur 系列几乎是最轻的独立式帐篷（它只比上面的 Hornet 稍重），如果您碰巧将其与登山杖一起使用，您会得到我认为最好的功能，即前厅的遮盖遮阳篷修改。虽然这是最优惠的价格，但 2 人型号也可享受 20% 的折扣。

paras.en: This is one of my favorite ultralight sleeping bags. There are lighter quilts out there, but when you need the warmth of a mummy bag on those colder nights, this is what I use. It also has the smallest pack size of any bag I've tested in this temperature range. With the included compression sack, this thing is truly tiny. The down fill is PFC-free, 850+ hydrophobic down. The zippers are on the small side, but they slide well and rarely (if ever) snag on the bag. I've slept in this bag down to 20 degrees and never been the least bit cold.
paras.zh: 这是我最喜欢的超轻睡袋之一。市面上有更轻的被子，但当你在寒冷的夜晚需要妈咪包的温暖时，这就是我用的。它的包装尺寸也是我在此温度范围内测试过的所有袋子中最小的。有了附带的压缩袋，这个东西真的很小。羽绒填充物不含 PFC，疏水性 850+ 羽绒。拉链虽小，但滑动良好，很少（如果有的话）卡在包上。我在最低 20 度的温度下都睡在这个袋子里，从未感到一丝寒冷。

paras.en: Closed-cell foam pads like the Therm-a-Rest Z-Lite Sol are a must-have. They weigh next to nothing (10 ounces for the small), fold up small enough to lash to the outside of any pack, and double as a chair, extra padding on cold nights, table, you name it. I am too old and too soft to be the sort of ultra-minimalist who gets by with just a Z-Lite, but I still have one around on almost every trip I take.
paras.zh: Therm-a-Rest Z-Lite Sol 等闭孔泡沫垫是必备品。它们的重量几乎为零（小号的重 10 盎司），折叠起来足够小，可以绑在任何背包的外面，还可以用作椅子，在寒冷的夜晚提供额外的填充物，桌子，凡是您能想到的。我年纪太大了，也太软弱了，无法成为那种只带着 Z-Lite 的极简主义者，但我几乎每次旅行时都会带着它。

paras.en: Nemo's Tensor-insulated sleeping pads have the best R-value-to-weight ratio of anything I've tested. The Tensor All-Season featured here sports an R-value of 5.4 and weighs 18.2 ounces. That alone is impressive, but what I love about the Tensor is that it's thick, comfortable, and most importantly, nearly silent. The lighter Trail model is also on sale at REI. Its R-value is only 2.8, though.
paras.zh: Nemo 的 Tensor 隔热睡垫在我测试过的所有产品中具有最佳的 R 值与重量比。这里介绍的 Tensor All-Season 的 R 值为 5.4，重量为 18.2 盎司。仅这一点就令人印象深刻，但我喜欢 Tensor 的是它厚实、舒适，最重要的是，它几乎安静。更轻的 Trail 型号也在 REI 出售。但其 R 值仅为 2.8。

paras.en: I don't usually bring a chair backpacking—I just sit on the ground. But for some reason, I do love a chair when I'm bikepacking, which is where I've used this Nemo the most. It's quite pricey, but it's very light and packs down to a tiny package. The genius part of this chair is that the cover is also a mat that keeps it from sinking into soft ground.
paras.zh: 我背包旅行时通常不会带椅子——我只是坐在地上。但出于某种原因，我在骑自行车旅行时确实喜欢一把椅子，这是我最常使用 Nemo 的地方。它的价格相当昂贵，但它非常轻，并且可以压缩成一个小包装。这把椅子的天才之处在于，椅套也是一个垫子，可以防止它陷入松软的地面。

paras.en: The thing to keep in mind when you shop REI-brand gear is the company's basic proposition: You get 90 percent of the designer item for 70 percent of the price. It's a strategy that works quite well and has generated some really great, affordable gear. This chair is a good example of that. It's not as nice as the Nemo above—it does wobble a bit, side to side, when you move—but it's still comfortable and half the price.
paras.zh: 当您购买 REI 品牌的装备时，要记住的是该公司的基本主张：您可以以 70% 的价格买到 90% 的设计师产品。这是一个非常有效的策略，并且已经产生了一些非常出色、价格实惠的装备。这把椅子就是一个很好的例子。它不像上面的 Nemo 那么好——当你移动时，它确实会左右摇晃——但它仍然很舒适，而且价格只有一半。

paras.en: I sincerely hope you never have any need for one of these Sea to Summit bug head nets, but if you do, boy do you. I once did not have one and tried to go backpacking in Michigan’s UP in early May. I lasted about two hours. When I got home, I bought one of these and … still haven't ventured back to that marshy bog of a hike. But I could, and possibly even retain some of my sanity thanks to this thing.
paras.zh: 我真诚地希望您永远不需要这些 Sea to Summit 虫头网，但如果您需要，孩子，您就需要。我曾经没有，五月初尝试去密歇根州的UP背包旅行。我持续了大约两个小时。当我回到家时，我买了其中一个，但……仍然没有冒险回到那片沼泽地徒步旅行。但多亏了这件事，我可以，甚至可能保持一些理智。

paras.en: What I said about the chair above goes for this pack as well; it's an excellent value, especially on sale. I was surprised by how comfortable this thing is, especially because, to look at it, the straps are very lightweight and there's almost no padding. It still managed to carry loads up to 10 pounds without straining my shoulders, and the side stash pockets are fabulously large—big enough for a Nalgene bottle or rain jacket. The Flash 22 is made of 70-denier recycled ripstop nylon, which is on the lighter side, but mine has held up well, even coming through some rough canyon hikes in Utah without any more than mud stains.
paras.zh: 我对上面的椅子所说的也适用于这个包；它物超所值，尤其是在打折时。我对这个东西的舒适程度感到惊讶，尤其是因为，从它的外观来看，带子非常轻，而且几乎没有填充物。它仍然能够承载 10 磅的重量，而不会拉伤我的肩膀，而且侧面的储物袋非常大，足以容纳 Nalgene 水瓶或雨衣。 Flash 22 由 70 旦再生防撕裂尼龙制成，重量较轻，但我的这款鞋表现良好，甚至在犹他州经历了一些崎岖的峡谷徒步旅行，除了泥渍之外没有任何其他痕迹。

paras.en: These two pots are my go-to cooking vessels for larger group meals. I find they're just about perfect for boiling up enough water to rehydrate four servings. I don't take the bowls and silverware into the backcountry, but they're handy for camping.
paras.zh: 这两个锅是我用于大型团体聚餐的首选烹饪容器。我发现它们非常适合煮沸足够的水以补充四份食物的水分。我不会把碗和银器带到偏远地区，但它们在露营时很方便。

paras.en: The Stash is our favorite all-in-one backcountry cook system. The heat diffuser design is what speeds up boil times (Jetboil claims 2.5 minutes, which I was only able to match indoors in still air), but the real appeal here to me is the way this kit all packs down into itself. For weekend trips, this is the simplest system I've tested when it comes to cooking for two.
paras.zh: Stash 是我们最喜欢的一体化野外烹饪系统。热扩散器设计加快了煮沸时间（Jetboil 声称煮沸时间为 2.5 分钟，我只能在室内静止空气中匹配），但对我来说真正有吸引力的是该套件的所有包装方式。对于周末旅行，这是我测试过的最简单的系统，可以为两个人做饭。

paras.en: These dry bags from Sea to Summit have double-stitched, tape-sealed seams that have held up well over the years. I also really like the external lash loops that make it easy to strap to anything with a tie-down anchor.
paras.zh: 这些从 Sea 到 Summit 的干燥袋采用双缝胶带密封接缝，多年来一直保持良好状态。我也非常喜欢外部睫毛环，它可以轻松地用系紧锚固定在任何东西上。

paras.en: I like these dry bags for organizing things in my pack. They're not dry bags in the sense that you can submerge them and your gear will be fine, but the 30D silnylon with PCF-free DWR easily sheds a little rain. And they make finding your stuff easy. I put all my cooking gear in a red bag (red for fire), all my water-filtering stuff in a blue bag for, wait for it, water—and so on. I find the 3- and 5-liter bags the most useful, but you can get all the way up to 35L.
paras.zh: 我喜欢这些干燥袋来整理我的背包中的东西。它们不是干燥包，因为您可以将它们浸入水中，您的装备也不会受到影响，但不含 PCF DWR 的 30D 硅胶很容易被雨水淋湿。它们可以让你轻松找到东西。我把所有的烹饪用具放在一个红色的袋子里（红色代表火），所有的水过滤材料放在一个蓝色的袋子里，等等，水——等等。我发现 3 升和 5 升的袋子最有用，但你可以一直装到 35 升。

paras.en: I've noticed that, when trying to lighten their load with a smaller, lighter-weight backpack, people then struggle to fit all their gear. The answer for sleeping bags and clothing is this compression stuff sack, which takes my favorite sleeping bag (the Sea to Summit Spark above) and smashes it down to about half the size of the included stuff sack. You can do the same thing to clothing, especially puffer jackets, but also fleece and merino to some extent, to free up more room in your pack.
paras.zh: 我注意到，当人们试图用更小、更轻的背包减轻负担时，他们会很难装下所有装备。睡袋和衣服的答案是这个压缩物品袋，它把我最喜欢的睡袋（上面的 Sea to Summit Spark）压缩到所含物品袋大小的一半左右。您可以对衣服（尤其是羽绒服）做同样的事情，但在某种程度上也可以对羊毛和美利奴羊毛进行处理，以腾出更多空间在您的背包中。

paras.en: REI’s Big Haul duffel is a durable, water-resistant, gear-swallowing bag for carrying, well, just about everything. It's one of our favorite ways to schlep your gear when flying. It hits the right balance of robust build materials and pockets without being too heavy to lug around all day. The strap system is cleverly customizable, and you can convert it to a backpack.
paras.zh: REI 的 Big Haul 行李袋是一款耐用、防水、可容纳装备的包，可以携带几乎所有物品。这是我们在飞行时最喜欢的携带装备的方式之一。它在坚固的构造材料和口袋之间达到了适当的平衡，而又不会太重而无法整天携带。背带系统可巧妙定制，您可以将其转换为背包。

paras.en: Once upon a time, in a galaxy far, far away, I traveled around Southeast Asia with an early version of this Osprey pack, living out of it for almost a year. It stood up well to the abuse of overland travel—more than once, I watched a bus driver tie it to the roof of a bus by cinching it down with a rope, pulling with all his weight right down the middle of my pack, like a cheese cutter. The Farpoint survived, and my gear inside did as well, thanks in part to the thickly padded sides, which provide considerable extra cushioning.
paras.zh: 曾几何时，在一个遥远的星系中，我带着这款鱼鹰背包的早期版本环游东南亚，并在其中生活了将近一年。它经受住了陆路旅行的滥用——不止一次，我看到一个公交车司机用绳子把它绑在公交车的车顶上，用他所有的重量把它拉到我背包的中间，就像奶酪切刀一样。 Farpoint 幸存了下来，我里面的装备也幸免于难，这在一定程度上要归功于厚厚的衬垫侧面，它提供了相当大的额外缓冲。

articles.title: It’s Time to Run an Audit of All the Cloud Storage Links You’ve Shared
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Cloud storage certainly has a lot going for it. For a start, if you drop your laptop into the sink, it's likely that a lot of your important work will be backed up somewhere in the cloud, as long as you’re using services such as Google Drive, OneDrive, and iCloud.
paras.zh: 云存储当然有很多好处。首先，如果您将笔记本电脑扔进水槽，只要您使用 Google Drive、OneDrive 和 iCloud 等服务，您的许多重要工作很可能都会备份到云中的某个位置。

paras.en: Then there's file sharing: Not too many years ago, swapping large amounts of data with other people meant dragging and dropping and running around with USB drives (and perhaps even mailing them). Now, via a couple of clicks and a link, you can share just about anything with just about anyone, anywhere in the world.
paras.zh: 然后是文件共享：不久前，与其他人交换大量数据意味着拖放和使用 USB 驱动器运行（甚至可能邮寄它们）。现在，只需点击几下和一个链接，您就可以与世界上任何地方的任何人分享任何内容。

paras.en: However, this comes with security risks attached. You don't want those links making their way to anyone they weren't intended for; otherwise, they’ve got access to your files and folders. They could potentially see what’s in them and maybe even make changes or delete files, depending on the permissions you’ve set.
paras.zh: 然而，这也伴随着安全风险。您不希望这些链接被无意中发送给任何人；否则，他们就可以访问您的文件和文件夹。他们可能会看到其中的内容，甚至可能会更改或删除文件，具体取决于您设置的权限。

paras.en: It’s worth emphasizing that sharing files through these cloud storage services isn't inherently insecure—these shared links are actually very well protected by default. However, the longer they stick around, the bigger the risk gets. Your links could get mistakenly forwarded in an email, or one of your contacts could have their email account hacked.
paras.zh: 值得强调的是，通过这些云存储服务共享文件本质上并不是不安全的——这些共享链接实际上默认受到很好的保护。然而，他们停留的时间越长，风险就越大。您的链接可能会在电子邮件中被错误转发，或者您的联系人之一的电子邮件帐户可能被黑客入侵。

paras.en: With that in mind, it’s prudent to run a regular audit on the cloud-sharing links you’ve got active. It shouldn’t take long: The apps involved usually make this pretty straightforward. Once you’ve closed a link down, no one else can get to it.
paras.zh: 考虑到这一点，谨慎的做法是对您活跃的云共享链接进行定期审核。这不会花很长时间：所涉及的应用程序通常使这变得非常简单。一旦您关闭链接，其他人就无法访问它。

paras.en: If you head to the Microsoft OneDrive portal on the web, you’ll see a Shared link in the navigation pane on the left: Click this, then select By you up at the top of the file list to see everything you’ve shared with other people. Use the Modified header if you want to sort the files and folders by the oldest or most recent.
paras.zh: 如果您前往网络上的 Microsoft OneDrive 门户，您将在左侧的导航窗格中看到一个共享链接：单击此链接，然后选择文件列表顶部的“由您提供”以查看您与其他人共享的所有内容。如果您想按最旧或最新对文件和文件夹进行排序，请使用“已修改”标题。

paras.en: Click the three dots next to any file or folder, then Manage access to control who can get to it. If you've shared the file with specific people, you can remove some or all of them; if the file or folder is shared more widely with just a link, clicking the trash can gets rid of it. You can also open up Office files to manage access there.
paras.zh: 单击任何文件或文件夹旁边的三个点，然后单击管理访问权限以控制谁可以访问它。如果您已与特定人员共享该文件，则可以删除其中部分或全部；如果仅通过链接更广泛地共享文件或文件夹，则单击垃圾桶即可将其删除。您还可以打开 Office 文件来管理那里的访问。

paras.en: It’s worth knowing that when you opt to share a file in OneDrive on the web (via the three dots and Share), if you click the cog icon on the Share panel, you can set an expiration date for the sharing—which saves you the trouble of having to tidy it up afterward.
paras.zh: 值得一提的是，当您选择在网络上的 OneDrive 中共享文件（通过三个点和共享）时，如果您单击“共享”面板上的齿轮图标，您可以设置共享的到期日期，这样您就可以省去事后清理的麻烦。

paras.en: If iCloud Drive is your cloud storage service of choice, once you’ve got the main interface up on the web, you can click Shared on the navigation pane on the left to go straight to the files and folders you’re sharing with other people. There’s no easy way to sort them, but you can use the search box up in the top right corner.
paras.zh: 如果您选择 iCloud Drive 云存储服务，则在网络上打开主界面后，您可以单击左侧导航窗格中的“共享”，直接转到您与其他人共享的文件和文件夹。没有简单的方法对它们进行排序，但您可以使用右上角的搜索框。

paras.en: Click the three dots next to a file or folder, then Managed Shared File to make changes. The next screen lets you block access for specific contacts and change permissions (from editing to just viewing, for example). If you want to cancel the sharing altogether, click Stop sharing.
paras.zh: 单击文件或文件夹旁边的三个点，然后单击托管共享文件以进行更改。下一个屏幕可让您阻止特定联系人的访问并更改权限（例如，从编辑到仅查看）。如果您想完全取消共享，请单击“停止共享”。

paras.en: Unlike OneDrive, iCloud doesn’t give you any way of putting expiration periods on shared links, so you have to clear them up manually.
paras.zh: 与 OneDrive 不同，iCloud 不为您提供任何在共享链接上设置过期期限的方法，因此您必须手动清除它们。

paras.en: Dropbox is one of the more aggressive services when it comes to tidying up shared links, and if you use the Dropbox app you might see reminders to review the files and folders you’ve shared with others. From Dropbox on the web, click Shared in the left-hand navigation pane to see files and folders you’re currently sharing.
paras.zh: 在整理共享链接方面，Dropbox 是更积极的服务之一，如果您使用 Dropbox 应用，您可能会看到提醒，以查看您与他人共享的文件和文件夹。在网络版 Dropbox 中，单击左侧导航窗格中的“共享”以查看您当前正在共享的文件和文件夹。

paras.en: You can get quite a detailed breakdown here, including by Files or by Folders. Click the three dots next to any entry, then Share, to see the current sharing options: You can remove access for contacts one by one, or click the cog icon (top left) to find the Unshare button that ends all sharing completely.
paras.zh: 您可以在这里获得非常详细的分类，包括按文件或文件夹分类。单击任何条目旁边的三个点，然后单击“共享”，查看当前的共享选项：您可以一一删除联系人的访问权限，或单击齿轮图标（左上角）找到“取消共享”按钮，该按钮可完全结束所有共享。

paras.en: Dropbox does have link expiration features built in: If you open the share settings whenever you’re sharing a file or folder, you’ll see Link expiry as one of the options. It’s an easy way to keep things tidy, provided the people you’re sharing the file or folder with get around to viewing it in time.
paras.zh: Dropbox 确实内置了链接过期功能：如果您在共享文件或文件夹时打开共享设置，您会看到链接过期作为选项之一。如果您与之共享文件或文件夹的人能够及时查看它，这是保持事情整洁的简单方法。

paras.en: Google Drive isn't quite as on top of shared links as other cloud storage services. If you open up the web portal, there’s no easy-to-access list of everything you've shared. The closest thing to it is clicking the People filter and then choosing contacts to see files and folders you've shared with them specifically. If you pick Anyone with the link from the drop-down list, you’ll see everything shared with a simple link.
paras.zh: Google Drive 并不像其他云存储服务那样位于共享链接之上。如果您打开门户网站，则不会看到您共享的所有内容的易于访问的列表。最接近的是单击“人员”过滤器，然后选择联系人以查看您专门与他们共享的文件和文件夹。如果您从下拉列表中选择“有链接的任何人”，您将看到通过简单链接共享的所有内容。

paras.en: To change the sharing settings for a file or folder, click on the three dots, then Share. Click the cog icon on the panel that pops up, then you can remove contacts as needed and turn the visible link off.
paras.zh: 要更改文件或文件夹的共享设置，请单击三个点，然后单击“共享”。单击弹出面板上的齿轮图标，然后您可以根据需要删除联系人并关闭可见链接。

paras.en: As with iCloud, there’s no link expiration feature you can rely on here, so shared files and folders can’t be set to become unshared after a certain time has elapsed. It’s a shame Google doesn’t make it as easy as it could be.
paras.zh: 与 iCloud 一样，这里没有您可以依赖的链接过期功能，因此共享文件和文件夹无法设置为在经过一定时间后变为不共享。遗憾的是谷歌并没有让它变得尽可能简单。

articles.title: 10 Best Early Black Friday Headphone Deals (2026): Up to 50% Off
articles.author: Harry Rabinowitz

paras.en: Right now is a great time to buy a new pair of headphones. Brands have largely finished launching their latest models for the year, leaving some great discounts on older generations. As part of early Black Friday deals, I'm even seeing some of the latest and greatest models on sale for the first time. I've been reviewing headphones for more than four years, and I'm currently eyeing the 50-percent-off deals on older Sony headphones in particular.
paras.zh: 现在是购买一副新耳机的好时机。各大品牌基本上已经推出了今年的最新型号，为老一代产品留下了一些很大的折扣。作为早期黑色星期五促销的一部分，我什至第一次看到一些最新、最好的型号在打折。我对耳机的评测已经有四年多了，目前我特别关注旧款索尼耳机的 50% 折扣优惠。

paras.en: All the deals below are WIRED-tested products we stand by, including wireless earbuds and over-ear headphones. For more early Black Friday deals, check out our guides to the Best Early Black Friday TV Deals and the Best Early Black Friday Mattress Deals.
paras.zh: 以下所有优惠都是我们支持的经过有线测试的产品，包括无线耳塞和耳罩式耳机。有关更多早期黑色星期五优惠，请查看我们的最佳早期黑色星期五电视优惠和最佳早期黑色星期五床垫优惠指南。

paras.en: Updated November 14: I added new products on sale from Nothing, CMF, and Shokz, and removed products no longer on sale from Bose, Google, and Beats.
paras.zh: 11 月 14 日更新：我添加了 Nothing、CMF 和 Shokz 的新促销产品，并删除了 Bose、Google 和 Beats 不再促销的产品。

paras.en: Apple AirPods Pro 3 are the best wireless earbuds not only for anyone with an iPhone—but also for anyone who wants to keep things simple. They sound great and have some of the best active-noise-canceling (ANC) and transparency modes on the market. They also seamlessly sync with all of your Apple devices. While 20 percent off isn't the best price I've seen for them, it's still a solid discount.
paras.zh: Apple AirPods Pro 3 是最好的无线耳机，不仅适合任何拥有 iPhone 的人，而且适合任何想要简单的人。它们听起来很棒，并且拥有市场上最好的主动降噪 (ANC) 和通透模式。它们还可以与您的所有 Apple 设备无缝同步。虽然 20% 的折扣并不是我见过的最优惠价格，但仍然是一个不错的折扣。

paras.en: The Nothing Ear (3a) are one of our favorite pairs of earbuds under $100, and 30 percent off is the biggest discount I've ever seen for them so far. They have a semi-transparent design and bold colors that stand out from the crowd (particularly the yellow version). While the automated noise-canceling isn't the best, it's hard to fault them at this new low price.
paras.zh: Nothing Ear (3a) 是我们最喜欢的 100 美元以下耳机之一，30% 的折扣是迄今为止我见过的最大折扣。它们具有半透明的设计和大胆的色彩，在人群中脱颖而出（尤其是黄色版本）。虽然自动降噪功能并不是最好的，但在如此低的价格下很难挑剔它们。

paras.en: The Shokz OpenFit open ear headphones were one of my favorites before the newer clip-on open earbud design started becoming more popular. This is the lowest price I've ever seen the Shokz model go for. They wrap around the top and back of your ear and rest there, leaving your inner ear clear to hear the outside world around you. The OpenFit 2+ have great sound quality (for open ear headphones, that is), long battery life, and wireless charging support.
paras.zh: 在新型夹式开放式耳塞设计开始变得更流行之前，Shokz OpenFit 开放式耳机是我的最爱之一。这是我见过的 Shokz 型号的最低价格。它们缠绕在您的耳朵顶部和后面并停留在那里，让您的内耳清晰地听到周围的外部世界。 OpenFit 2+ 具有出色的音质（对于开放式耳机而言）、较长的电池寿命和无线充电支持。

paras.en: The more premium XM6 and the newly revived, cheaper XM4C have effectively replaced the Sony WH-1000XM5. But I am still seeing the blue colorway of these excellent headphones at the lowest price I've clocked for these sunsetting cans. When they launched in 2022, they were our top pick for over-ear headphones. They remain excellent and far outperform other options at this limited price.
paras.zh: 更优质的 XM6 和新近复兴、更便宜的 XM4C 已经有效取代了索尼 WH-1000XM5。但我仍然以我所见过的这些日落罐的最低价格看到了这些出色的蓝色耳机。当它们于 2022 年推出时，它们是我们头戴式耳机的首选。它们仍然非常出色，并且在这个有限的价格下远远优于其他选择。

paras.en: The Nothing Headphone (1) are a home run in looks and sound, and they are at their lowest price ever ahead of Black Friday. They’re solid noise cancelers with a bold, transparent design on the ear cups that's somehow techy, retro, and futuristic-looking. Among their best features are the on-ear controls, namely the clicky wheel that adjusts volume and the flat rocker paddle that you can push back and forth to move to the previous track or skip ahead, respectively.
paras.zh: Nothing 耳机 (1) 在外观和声音方面都堪称全垒打，而且在黑色星期五之前价格处于历史最低水平。它们是坚固的噪音消除器，耳罩上采用大胆、透明的设计，具有科技感、复古感和未来感。它们最好的功能之一是贴耳式控件，即调节音量的点击轮和可以前后推动以分别移动到上一曲目或向前跳过的扁平摇杆。

paras.en: The budget Nothing Headphone (a) and premium Nothing Headphone (1) Pro are also on sale, but the Headphone (1) is the most appealing deal in my view.
paras.zh: 经济型Nothing Headphone (a) 和高级Nothing Headphone (1) Pro 也在促销，但在我看来，Headphone (1) 是最具吸引力的交易。

paras.en: Sony recently launched the WH-CN730N to replace these headphones, hence the rock-bottom price of 50 percent off. While these headphones can't compete with most specs of more premium options on this list, they're ultra-lightweight at just 192 grams. That and 35 hours of battery life with ANC on is nothing to scoff at.
paras.zh: 索尼最近推出了 WH-CN730N 来替代这些耳机，因此价格最低可享受 50% 的折扣。虽然这些耳机无法与此列表中的大多数高级选项竞争，但它们超轻，仅重 192 克。加上 ANC 打开时 35 小时的电池续航时间，这没什么值得嘲笑的。

paras.en: Want to spend even less on headphones? CMF is Nothing's sub-brand focused on stylish designs at a lower price point, and this is the best deal I've seen on its Headphone Pro over-ear cans. Frankly, $49 is a steal for these headphones, considering they are comfortable, sound surprisingly good, and have noise-canceling and long battery life.
paras.zh: 想要在耳机上花更少的钱吗？ CMF 是 Nothing 的子品牌，专注于以较低价格进行时尚设计，这是我在其 Headphone Pro 耳罩上看到的最优惠的价格。坦率地说，考虑到这些耳机佩戴起来很舒适、音质出奇的好、并且具有降噪功能和较长的电池寿命，49 美元的价格还是很便宜的。

paras.en: Want the best ANC over-ear headphones? Look no further than the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen). They are the benchmark to which I compare other ANC headphones. Plus, they are comfortable, premium, and sound excellent.
paras.zh: 想要最好的 ANC 耳罩式耳机吗？ Bose QuietComfort Ultra 耳机（第二代）就是您的最佳选择。它们是我比较其他 ANC 耳机的基准。此外，它们舒适、优质且音质极佳。

paras.en: My top over-ear headphone pick, the best-in-class Sony WH-1000XM6 is matching the lowest price I've seen. These headphones are amazing across the board, with their high comfort, superior sound quality, and great noise-canceling capability.
paras.zh: 我最喜欢的头戴式耳机是同类中最好的索尼 WH-1000XM6，它的价格是我见过的最低价格。这些耳机在各方面都令人惊叹，具有高舒适度、卓越的音质和出色的降噪能力。

paras.en: AirPods Max 2 are excellent over-ear headphones for Apple fans, but the $550 sticker price is frankly absurd. Thankfully, they are almost always a little bit on sale, including now. This is far from the best deal I've seen on these headphones, and I do expect the price to dip further during Black Friday sales events, so I would add them to my cart and wait to pull the trigger.
paras.zh: AirPods Max 2 对于苹果粉丝来说是一款出色的耳罩式耳机，但 550 美元的标价坦率地说是荒谬的。值得庆幸的是，它们几乎总是有一点折扣，包括现在。这远不是我在这些耳机上见过的最好的交易，我确实预计黑色星期五销售活动期间价格会进一步下跌，所以我会将它们添加到我的购物车并等待扣动扳机。

articles.title: In Banff, a Grizzly Bear Known as ‘the Boss’ Rules the National Park
articles.author: Ian Austen

paras.en: To the scientists and wardens of Banff National Park he is grizzly bear 122. But to everyone who lives in or near Canada’s oldest national park, and many of its 4.5 million annual visitors, he is the Boss.
paras.zh: 对于班夫国家公园的科学家和管理员来说，他是灰熊 122。但对于生活在加拿大最古老的国家公园内或附近的每个人，以及每年 450 万游客中的许多人来说，他是老板。

paras.en: He has been struck by a freight train without apparent ill effect. He has shrugged off being hit by cars. Scientists have confirmed that he killed and snacked on a black bear at least once, and he is believed to have fathered many, if not most, of the bears in his 2,000-square-kilometer territory.
paras.zh: 他被货运列车撞到，但没有造成明显的不良影响。他对被汽车撞倒不以为然。科学家们已经证实，他至少杀死过一头黑熊并以它为食，据信他是他 2000 平方公里领土上许多（如果不是大多数）黑熊的父亲。

paras.en: Most of all, the Boss has become Canada’s 700-pound celebrity bear king. When he strolls along the Trans-Canada Highway looking for dandelions, “bear jams” swiftly follow. His battles with a rival bear known as Split Lip are legendary. (He caused the split lip.) His annual awakening from hibernation, usually in March, is reported by news outlets across Alberta.
paras.zh: 最重要的是，Boss 已成为加拿大 700 磅重的名人熊王。当他沿着横贯加拿大的高速公路漫步寻找蒲公英时，“熊果酱”很快就出现了。他与对手“裂唇”熊的战斗颇具传奇色彩。 （他导致嘴唇裂开。） 每年，通常在三月，艾伯塔省各地的新闻媒体都会报道他从冬眠中醒来。

paras.en: Galleries in Banff and neighboring Canmore ship giant photos of him worldwide. His image appears on fridge magnets, T-shirts and tote bags. A local restaurant is named for him, its main dining room dominated by a scrap metal sculpture of the bear.
paras.zh: 班夫和邻近的坎莫尔的画廊将他的巨幅照片传播到世界各地。他的形象出现在冰箱贴、T 恤和手提袋上。当地一家餐厅以他的名字命名，其主餐厅以废金属熊雕塑为主。

paras.en: But despite his fearsome demeanor, enhanced by four-inch claws, few bear experts consider the Boss a threat to park visitors or residents. Rather, they fear his celebrity and the legions of fans it have created, may be the biggest threat to his life and his dominance.
paras.zh: 尽管它的举止令人生畏，四英寸的爪子增强了它的威力，但很少有熊专家认为它对公园游客或居民构成威胁。相反，他们担心他的名气和由此产生的大批粉丝可能是对他的生命和统治地位的最大威胁。

articles.title: In Europe, an Emboldened Iran Contributes to a Sense of Anxiety
articles.author: Michael D. Shear

paras.en: On Veterans Day this past week, President Trump declared that his decision to go to war with Iran had been a complete success.
paras.zh: 上周的退伍军人节，特朗普总统宣布他与伊朗开战的决定取得了圆满成功。

paras.en: “When this conflict is over, and it will be soon,” he said, speaking on a blustery morning from Arlington National Cemetery outside Washington, “the entire world will be a much safer and better place, more peaceful place.”
paras.zh: “当这场冲突结束时，而且很快就会结束，”他在华盛顿郊外的阿灵顿国家公墓的一个狂风大作的早晨说道，“整个世界将变得更加安全、更加美好、更加和平。”

paras.en: A growing number of attempted terrorist attacks across the continent and in Britain, including a foiled plot against a major American military base, arson attacks on Jewish community sites and cyberattacks that raised temperatures in refrigerators and blood banks are rattling national security officials and unnerving the public. Many have been attributed to Iran or to proxies acting on its behalf.
paras.zh: 欧洲大陆和英国境内越来越多的恐怖袭击未遂事件，包括针对美国主要军事基地的阴谋被挫败、对犹太社区场所的纵火袭击以及导致冰箱和血库温度升高的网络攻击，这些都让国家安全官员感到不安，也让公众感到不安。许多事件被认为是伊朗或代表其行事的代理人所为。

paras.en: The sense of global unease was heightened when the U.S. government grounded all air travel for hours on Friday in what officials later said was a technical issue.
paras.zh: 周五，美国政府因技术问题而将所有航空旅行停飞数小时，这加剧了全球的不安感。

paras.en: European residents had already grown frustrated before the most recent round of turmoil. The economic consequences of the war that Mr. Trump and the Israeli government started against Iran in February have piled up: Gas prices are higher because of disruptions of oil deliveries through the Strait of Hormuz. Groceries cost more. Heating homes in winter has become far less affordable.
paras.zh: 在最近一轮动荡之前，欧洲居民已经感到沮丧。特朗普和以色列政府二月份对伊朗发动的战争造成的经济后果不断累积：由于霍尔木兹海峡的石油运输中断，天然气价格上涨。杂货费用更高。冬天的房屋供暖已经变得越来越难以负担。

paras.en: And in recent weeks, the effect has grown darker as security officials have accused Iran or its proxies of conducting a series of terrorism-related plots. In September, U.S. prosecutors say, an Iraqi man, an Iranian operative and a senior operative for an Iran proxy group in a New York jail plotted to attack R.A.F. Fairford, an air base in England used by American bombers. They did not succeed, but the effort prompted a major security incident.
paras.zh: 最近几周，随着安全官员指责伊朗或其代理人实施了一系列与恐怖主义有关的阴谋，这种影响变得更加严重。 9月，美国检察官称，纽约一所监狱中的一名伊拉克男子、一名伊朗特工和一名伊朗代理人组织的高级特工密谋袭击英国皇家空军。费尔福德是美国轰炸机使用的英国空军基地。他们没有成功，但这一努力引发了一​​场重大安全事件。

articles.title: Is Italy the Model for Europe’s Future?
articles.author: Jason Horowitz

paras.en: When I first moved to Rome, I spent my time living in the past.
paras.zh: 当我第一次搬到罗马时，我一直生活在过去。

paras.en: At the turn of the century, I drifted through a vintage postcard of postwar Italy: old women sitting around tables they had dragged into the street, old men playing cards in caps, cats arching their backs on the hoods of snub-nosed Fiats.
paras.zh: 世纪之交，我无意中看到一张战后意大利的老式明信片：老妇人围坐在被拖到街上的桌子旁，老男人戴着帽子打牌，猫在扁鼻子菲亚特汽车的引擎盖上拱起背。

paras.en: As newspapers filled with talk of Silvio Berlusconi, a media mogul with ambitions and appetites worthy of a Roman emperor, my meanderings inevitably took me toward Tiber Island, a sliver of land in the middle of the river that divides Rome.
paras.zh: 当报纸上充斥着关于西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼（Silvio Berlusconi）的报道时，这位媒体大亨有着堪比罗马皇帝的野心和胃口，我的蜿蜒之旅不可避免地把我带到了台伯岛，这是分隔罗马的河中央的一小片土地。

paras.en: An ancient bridge on the island’s left bank had a strange statue of weather-beaten faces positioned back-to-back as if they couldn’t stand one another. The heads rose out of the shared torso of a square pillar and represented Janus, Rome’s god of the past and future, the deity of transitions and change.
paras.zh: 岛左岸的一座古桥上有一尊奇怪的雕像，雕像上的饱经风霜的面孔背靠背排列，仿佛彼此无法忍受。这些头像从一根方形柱子的共同躯干中升起，代表罗马的过去和未来之神、过渡和变革之神雅努斯。

paras.en: Back then, I didn’t see the change around me, but now, more than a quarter-century later, after spending decades reporting on Italian politics and changes across Europe, I have come to understand that I was living in the future.
paras.zh: 当时，我没有看到周围的变化，但现在，四分之一个多世纪后，在花了几十年时间报道意大利政治和整个欧洲的变化之后，我开始明白我生活在未来。

paras.en: In the time since, I have seen an Italianization of politics all around the continent, with coalitions of small parties resulting in instability, with fed-up voters desperate for new saviors. But more than anything, I have seen — in Britain, France, Germany — countries following the Italian model by allowing the far right into the political mainstream.
paras.zh: 从那时起，我看到整个非洲大陆的政治意大利化，小党派联盟导致不稳定，厌倦的选民迫切需要新的救世主。但最重要的是，我看到英国、法国、德国等国家效仿意大利模式，允许极右翼分子进入政治主流。

articles.title: Filipino Singer Carmelle Storms to Victory in Eurovision Asia Debut in Bangkok
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Filipino singer Carmelle won the first Asian edition of the Eurovision Song Contest on Saturday (Nov. 14) with a fiery performance of her dance-pop song “Sobra-Sobra.”
paras.zh: 周六（11 月 14 日），菲律宾歌手 Carmelle 凭借她的流行舞曲《Sobra-Sobra》的火热表演赢得了首届亚洲版欧洲歌唱大赛冠军。

paras.en: The 19-year-old beat 10 other acts in the grand final in Bangkok, with the winner chosen through votes from national juries in participating countries and viewers worldwide.
paras.zh: 这位 19 岁的歌手在曼谷举行的总决赛中击败了其他 10 名艺人，获胜者是通过参赛国的国家评审团和全世界观众投票选出的。

paras.en: After her victory, Carmelle said her song celebrated female empowerment and was intended as “a tribute to all Filipino women.”
paras.zh: 卡梅尔获胜后表示，她的歌曲颂扬了女性赋权，旨在“向所有菲律宾女性致敬”。

paras.en: “I made history, since this was the first time,” she told The Associated Press. “It’s such a big responsibility for me, because this one is a global stage, so thank you everybody who voted for me.”
paras.zh: “我创造了历史，因为这是第一次，”她告诉美联社。 “这对我来说是一项重大责任，因为这是一个全球舞台，所以感谢所有投票给我的人。”

paras.en: Thai duo Mang x Daou finished second with an energetic performance of the romantic pop song “Aroma.” Vietnam’s Tóc Tiên placed third with a lively, stylish rendition of “Em Tiên.”
paras.zh: 泰国组合 Mang x Daou 凭借充满活力的浪漫流行歌曲《Aroma》表演获得第二名。越南选手 Tóc Tiên 凭借活泼、时尚的“Em Tiên”表演获得第三名。

paras.en: Malaysia’s Aina Abdul took fourth with her powerful ballad “Bluest Sky.” Thinla of Laos finished fifth with “Bae,” a playful dance track that had the audience dancing whenever it was replayed during the show.
paras.zh: 马来西亚的艾娜·阿卜杜勒 (Aina Abdul) 凭借她有力的民谣《最蓝的天空》获得第四名。老挝的 Thinla 凭借《Bae》获得第五名，这是一首俏皮的舞曲，每当演出期间重播时，观众都会跟着跳舞。

paras.en: Bhutan, South Korea, Mongolia, Nepal, Cambodia and Bangladesh also competed.
paras.zh: 不丹、韩国、蒙古、尼泊尔、柬埔寨和孟加拉国也参加了比赛。

paras.en: Contestants made their entrances aboard tuk-tuks, the motorized three-wheeled vehicles common in Bangkok’s tourist districts. They waved national flags as thousands of fans cheered inside the city-center venue.
paras.zh: 参赛者乘坐嘟嘟车参赛，嘟嘟车是曼谷旅游区常见的机动三轮车辆。他们挥舞着国旗，成千上万的球迷在市中心的场馆内欢呼。

paras.en: Bulgarian singer Dara appeared as a special guest, performing “Bangaranga,” the song with which she won the 70th Eurovision Song Contest in Vienna earlier this year.
paras.zh: 保加利亚歌手达拉 (Dara) 作为特邀嘉宾亮相，演唱了《Bangaranga》，她凭借这首歌赢得了今年早些时候在维也纳举行的第 70 届欧洲歌唱大赛。

paras.en: The European contest seeks to put music before politics but has repeatedly been caught up in international conflicts. Russia was expelled in 2022 following its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 欧洲大赛力求将音乐置于政治之上，但屡次陷入国际冲突。俄罗斯在全面入侵乌克兰后于 2022 年被驱逐。

paras.en: The Israel-Hamas war in Gaza has also roiled the competition, prompting protests outside contest venues and leading organizers to restrict political flag-waving.
paras.zh: 以色列和哈马斯在加沙的战争也扰乱了比赛，引发了比赛场地外的抗议活动，并导致组织者限制政治旗帜的挥舞。

paras.en: Five longtime participants — Spain, the Netherlands, Ireland, Iceland and Slovenia — boycotted this year’s European competition over Israel’s participation.
paras.zh: 五个长期参与者——西班牙、荷兰、爱尔兰、冰岛和斯洛文尼亚——因以色列的参赛而抵制今年的欧洲比赛。

paras.en: Eurovision Asia appeared less overshadowed by politics, said Eurovision historian Dean Vuletic, who attended the show in Bangkok.
paras.zh: 出席曼谷演出的欧洲电视网历史学家迪安·武莱蒂克 (Dean Vuletic) 表示，欧洲电视网亚洲似乎没有那么受到政治影响。

paras.en: He said an analysis of voting patterns might reveal political tendencies among participating countries.
paras.zh: 他说，对投票模式的分析可能会揭示参与国之间的政治倾向。

paras.en: “But for now I can say it was a very beautiful atmosphere inside the venue and it was a great window into the musical cultures of Asia.”
paras.zh: “但现在我可以说，场馆内的气氛非常美丽，是了解亚洲音乐文化的一个很好的窗口。”

articles.title: BTS & ROSÉ Lead a Big Night for K-Pop at 2026 Kids’ Choice Awards: Full Winners List
articles.author: Paul Grein

paras.en: Kids love K-Pop. That was abundantly clear from the results at the 2026 Kids’ Choice Awards, which aired on CBS for the first time on Saturday (Nov. 14). BTS won three major awards, though they weren’t at Television City in Hollywood for the taping, nor did they accept any of their awards by video, as ROSÉ and “global girl group” KATSEYE did.
paras.zh: 孩子们喜欢韩国流行音乐。从周六（11 月 14 日）哥伦比亚广播公司首次播出的 2026 年儿童选择奖结果中可以清楚地看出这一点。 BTS 赢得了三项主要奖项，尽管他们没有在好莱坞电视城进行录制，也没有像 ROSÉ 和“全球女子组合”KATSEYE 那样通过视频接受任何奖项。

paras.en: BTS won favorite group for a record-extending fifth time; favorite song (“Swim”) for a second time and favorite album (ARIRANG) for the first time. In the favorite song category, BTS had won five years ago for “Dynamite.” The only other group or duo to win twice in the category is One Direction (back-to-back awards in 2013-14 for “What Makes You Beautiful” and “Story of My Life”). (The Kids’ Choice Awards originated in 1987.)
paras.zh: BTS 第五次赢得最受欢迎组合；第二次最喜欢的歌曲（“Swim”）和第一次最喜欢的专辑（ARIRANG）。在最受欢迎的歌曲类别中，防弹少年团五年前凭借《Dynamite》赢得了冠军。唯一在该类别中两次获奖的团体或组合是 One Direction（2013-14 年度凭借“What Makes You Beautiful”和“Story of My Life”连续获奖）。 （儿童选择奖起源于 1987 年。）

paras.en: ROSÉ became the first K-Pop star to win favorite female artist. She beat, among others, Ariana Grande, who has won a record five times in this category; Taylor Swift, who has won three times; and Miley Cyrus, who has won twice.
paras.zh: ROSÉ 成为第一位赢得最受欢迎女艺人奖的韩国流行歌星。她击败了爱莉安娜·格兰德（Ariana Grande）等人，后者在该类别中五次获胜，创下了纪录。泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift)，曾三次获奖；还有两次获胜的麦莉赛勒斯。

paras.en: ROSÉ’s Blackpink colleague JENNIE shared the award for favorite music collaboration with Tame Impala for their smash “Dracula.”
paras.zh: ROSÉ 的 Blackpink 同事 JENNIE 与 Tame Impala 凭借热门歌曲《Dracula》分享了最受欢迎音乐合作奖。

paras.en: KPop Demon Hunters also won multiple awards. “Golden” won favorite song from a movie (beating Swift’s “I Knew It, I Knew You” from Toy Story 5, among others). The actors who voiced Rumi and Jinu in that movie won for favorite female and male animated voices from a movie, respectively.
paras.zh: 韩国流行音乐恶魔猎手也获得了多项奖项。 《Golden》赢得了最受欢迎的电影歌曲（击败了《玩具总动员 5》中斯威夫特的《I Knew It, I Knew You》等）。在那部电影中为鲁米和吉努配音的演员分别获得了电影中最喜爱的女性和男性动画配音奖。

paras.en: Alex Warren was a good-natured host of the fast-paced show, which ran just 90 minutes. In one quick bit, he was costumed like a janitor, mopping up the slime. Only a dozen of the many awards were presented on the show. The producers program the show with the winners who were willing and able to appear. If you watched the show, you would have had no idea that BTS had a big night.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·沃伦 (Alex Warren) 是这档快节奏节目的好心主持人，节目时长仅为 90 分钟。很快，他就打扮得像个看门人，正在擦拭粘液。节目中仅颁发了众多奖项中的十几个。制片人将愿意并能够出席的获奖者选为节目的制作人。如果你看过这个节目，你就不会知道 BTS 度过了一个重要的夜晚。

paras.en: Nor would you have known that Bruno Mars won favorite male artist for the second year in a row; that Sombr won favorite new male artist; or that Olivia Dean‘s “Man I Need” took favorite viral song. “Man I Need” is expected to be a top contender for record and song of the year at the 2027 Grammy Awards.
paras.zh: 您也不会知道布鲁诺·马尔斯连续第二年荣获最受欢迎男艺人奖； Sombr 赢得了最受欢迎的新男艺人；或者奥利维亚·迪恩 (Olivia Dean) 的《Man I Need》成为最受欢迎的病毒歌曲。 《Man I Need》预计将成为 2027 年格莱美奖年度唱片和年度歌曲的有力竞争者。

paras.en: KATSEYE won favorite female breakout artist/group. Bini, a Filipino girl group, won favorite global music star.
paras.zh: KATSEYE 荣获最受欢迎女性突破艺术家/团体奖。菲律宾女子组合 Bini 荣获全球最受欢迎音乐明星奖。

paras.en: Several music performances brightened the show. Ashe performed her current top 30 Hot 100 hit, “Stop the Wedding!,” wearing a beautiful wedding gown, with her hair perfectly coiffed. No matter: She was doused with slime at the end of the performance like just about everyone else.
paras.zh: 几场音乐表演为演出增添了亮点。阿什穿着漂亮的婚纱，头发精心梳理，演唱了她目前排名前 30 的热门 100 热门单曲《Stop the Wedding!》。不管怎样：在表演结束时，她和其他人一样浑身沾满了粘液。

paras.en: Jamie Miller performed “Babydoll,” which has been No. 1 on the Official U.K. Singles Chart for four weeks and is climbing the Hot 100. Sofi Tukker performed “Tsunami.” JYT performed briefly at the end of the opening segment, which focused on dance hits over the decades, stretching back to the 1980s. (The 1970s are now officially ancient history to today’s kids.)
paras.zh: 杰米·米勒 (Jamie Miller) 演唱的《Babydoll》已连续四个星期在英国官方单曲排行榜上排名第一，并且正在攀升至热门 100 强。索菲·塔克 (Sofi Tukker) 演唱的《海啸》(Tsunami)。 JYT 在开场部分的最后进行了简短的表演，重点关注了几十年来（可追溯到 20 世纪 80 年代）的热门舞曲。 （对于今天的孩子来说，20 世纪 70 年代现在已正式成为古老的历史。）

paras.en: A few other music and music-adjacent stars were enlisted as presenters, including Stella Lefty (who was slimed), Ice Spice and Teyana Taylor. TV veteran Keke Palmer looked around the fancy set and made a knowing comment: “I’ve watched a lot of Kids’ Choice Awards. Y’all have some money this year. I see you, CBS.”
paras.zh: 其他一些音乐和音乐相关明星也被邀请担任主持人，包括 Stella Lefty（瘦身者）、Ice Spice 和 Teyana Taylor。电视资深人士 Keke Palmer 环视了豪华的布景，做出了一句会意的评论：“我看了很多儿童选择奖。今年你们都有钱了。我看到你了，CBS。”

paras.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day won favorite movie, and its stars, Tom Holland and Zendaya, won favorite movie actor and actress, respectively.
paras.zh: 《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》赢得了最受欢迎电影奖，其主演汤姆·赫兰德和赞达亚分别获得了最喜爱电影男演员和女演员奖。

paras.en: Howie Mandel accepted America’s Got Talent’s award for favorite TV show reality competition. He got off a funny line, saying his castmates were supposed to be there too, and were supposed to fly to Los Angeles on Friday. He feigned confusion as to why they didn’t make it, saying he even emailed them on Thursday to remind them. Yes, we’ve had a rough week.
paras.zh: 豪伊·曼德尔 (Howie Mandel) 接受了《美国达人秀》颁发的最受喜爱电视节目真人秀奖。他说了一句有趣的话，说他的剧组成员也应该在那里，并且应该在周五飞往洛杉矶。他假装很困惑为什么他们没有成功，说他甚至在周四给他们发了电子邮件提醒他们。是的，我们度过了艰难的一周。

paras.en: Chris Pratt received the King of Comedy Award. He opened his remarks with a funny line. “My four kids were the greatest thing that ever happened to me – until tonight,” eyeing the miniature orange blimp he received. “This is the closest I’ll ever get to an Oscar. When I was a kid, I got in trouble for making kids laugh and now I’m getting an award for it.”
paras.zh: 克里斯·帕拉特荣获喜剧之王奖。他用一句有趣的话开始了他的讲话。 “直到今晚，我的四个孩子是我经历过的最伟大的事情，”他看着他收到的橙色微型飞艇。 “这是我距离奥斯卡奖最近的一次。当我还是个孩子的时候，我因为逗孩子们笑而惹上麻烦，现在我却因此获得了奖项。”

paras.en: The show was rated PG, which is hard to imagine. If this wasn’t G-rated entertainment I don’t know what is. Yes, there was an ocean of slime, but the messaging was consistently positive, as when Pratt said that jokes can make people laugh, but they can also hurt people and that “kind comedy is the best kind of comedy.”
paras.zh: 该剧被评为PG，这是很难想象的。如果这不是 G 级娱乐，我不知道什么才是。是的，有一片粘液海洋，但传达的信息始终是积极的，正如普拉特说笑话可以让人发笑，但它们也可以伤害人，“善良的喜剧是最好的喜剧”。

paras.en: Here’s a full list of winners from the 2026 Kids’ Choice Awards.
paras.zh: 以下是 2026 年儿童选择奖的完整获奖者名单。

articles.title: Phil Collins Tells Rock Hall Crowd: ‘You Haven’t Heard the Last of Me’
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Phil Collins was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame as a solo artist on Saturday (Nov. 14), and used his acceptance speech to tell the crowd he isn’t done yet.
paras.zh: 菲尔·柯林斯 (Phil Collins) 于周六（11 月 14 日）作为独唱艺术家入选摇滚名人堂，并在获奖感言中告诉观众他的任务还没有结束。

paras.en: “You haven’t heard the last of me,” Collins said during the ceremony at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. “I promise you that.”
paras.zh: “你还没有听到我最后的声音，”柯林斯在洛杉矶孔雀剧院举行的仪式上说道。 “我向你保证。”

paras.en: The honor marks Collins’ second induction. He entered the Hall in 2010 as a member of Genesis, making him one of a small number of two-time inductees.
paras.zh: 这项荣誉标志着柯林斯的第二次入职。他于 2010 年作为 Genesis 成员进入名人堂，成为少数两次入选名人堂的人之一。

paras.en: Travis Barker inducted Collins, highlighting his impact as a drummer. “I remember hearing the drums for the first time and being blown away,” the Blink-182 drummer said of “In the Air Tonight.” “That sound changed everything. It helped define the sound of drums in the eighties, and you can still hear Phil’s influence today.”
paras.zh: 特拉维斯·巴克 (Travis Barker) 介绍了柯林斯 (Collins)，强调了他作为鼓手的影响力。 “我记得第一次听到鼓声时就被震撼了，”Blink-182 鼓手谈到“In the Air Tonight”时说道。 “这种声音改变了一切。它帮助定义了八十年代的鼓声，今天你仍然可以听到菲尔的影响。”

paras.en: Barker also pointed to Collins’ success with both Genesis and his solo career. “He wasn’t just successful at both,” he said, “he was one of the best at both.”
paras.zh: 巴克还指出了柯林斯在《创世纪》和他的个人事业上取得的成功。 “他不仅在这两方面都取得了成功，”他说，“他还是这两方面最出色的人之一。”

paras.en: Collins did not perform at the ceremony. He said earlier this year that he had declined an invitation to play because he wasn’t “match-fit” enough to rehearse and sing properly, though he did not rule out returning to the stage. Cynthia Erivo performed “In the Air Tonight” in his place, with Barker on drums.
paras.zh: 柯林斯没有在仪式上表演。他今年早些时候表示，他拒绝了演出邀请，因为他“身体状况”不够好，无法正常排练和唱歌，但他并不排除重返舞台的可能性。辛西娅·埃里沃 (Cynthia Erivo) 代替他演奏了《今夜在空中》(In the Air Tonight)，巴克担任鼓手。

paras.en: In his speech, Collins said he felt unprepared following a night of more polished addresses, and opened by telling the audience he’s “really not as bad as it looks.” He said his career began with a single goal: “I grew up wanting to play drums. Everything else has been a happy accident.”
paras.zh: 柯林斯在演讲中表示，经过一晚的精彩演讲后，他感到毫无准备，并首先告诉观众他“实际上并不像看上去那么糟糕”。他说他的职业生涯始于一个目标：“我从小就想打鼓。其他一切都是一次愉快的意外。”

paras.en: Collins credited his assistant with saving his life, saying he needed to name her despite her dislike of attention. “I’m not joking when I say without her I wouldn’t be here,” he said. “I’d be in a box six feet under.” He said she had told him what he was doing was bad for him and what to do about it, adding that he’s “a well man now.”
paras.zh: 柯林斯称赞他的助手救了他的命，并表示尽管她不喜欢受到关注，但他还是需要说出她的名字。 “当我说没有她我就不会在这里时，我不是在开玩笑，”他说。 “我会在一个六英尺以下的盒子里。”他说她告诉他他所做的事情对他不好以及该怎么做，并补充说他“现在是一个健康的人”。

paras.en: He also thanked longtime manager Tony Smith, Atlantic Records’ Ahmet and Nesuhi Ertegun, and Virgin Records founder Richard Branson, who he said “took me under their wing and they saw something that was worth nurturing,” as well as “my three ex-wives, because they’ve loved me through the years and given me five great children.” His daughter, actress Lily Collins, attended the ceremony with him.
paras.zh: 他还感谢长期担任经理人的托尼·史密斯、大西洋唱片公司的艾哈迈德和内苏希·厄特根，以及维珍唱片公司的创始人理查德·布兰森，他说他们“把我置于他们的羽翼之下，他们看到了值得培养的东西”，以及“我的三位前妻，因为她们多年来一直爱着我，给了我五个很棒的孩子。”他的女儿、演员莉莉·柯林斯与他一起出席了颁奖典礼。

paras.en: Collins closed by naming Eric Clapton and Robert Plant among the musicians he has played with. “These guys were heroes to me,” he said.
paras.zh: 柯林斯最后提到埃里克·克莱普顿和罗伯特·普兰特是他合作过的音乐家之一。 “这些人对我来说是英雄，”他说。

paras.en: The induction follows years of health issues for the 75-year-old musician. A 2007 spinal injury caused nerve damage that left him unable to grip a drumstick, and he has since undergone knee surgeries and dealt with ongoing mobility problems. His son Nic played drums on Genesis’ 2021-22 farewell tour, with Collins singing from a seated position. Collins told the BBC in January that he now has a 24-hour live-in nurse.
paras.zh: 这位 75 岁的音乐家多年来一直面临健康问题。 2007 年，脊椎受伤导致神经损伤，导致他无法握住鸡腿，此后他接受了膝盖手术并解决了持续存在的行动问题。他的儿子尼克在 Genesis 2021-22 告别巡演中打鼓，柯林斯则坐着唱歌。柯林斯一月份告诉 BBC，他现在有一名 24 小时驻院护士。

paras.en: As a solo artist, Collins scored seven No. 1 hits on the Billboard Hot 100, including “Against All Odds (Take a Look at Me Now),” “Sussudio,” “One More Night” and “Another Day in Paradise.” His albums No Jacket Required and …But Seriously both topped the Billboard 200.
paras.zh: 作为一名独唱歌手，柯林斯在公告牌百强单曲榜上获得了七首单曲第一名，其中包括《Against All Odds (Take a Look at Me Now)》、《Sussudio》、《One More Night》和《Another Day in Paradise》。他的专辑《No Jacket Need》和《...But Seriously》均名列 Billboard 200 榜首。

paras.en: The 2026 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony airs Dec. 8 from 8-11 p.m. ET on ABC and streams on Disney+ the following day.
paras.zh: 2026 年摇滚名人堂入会仪式将于 12 月 8 日晚上 8 点至 11 点播出。 ET 在 ABC 播出，并于次日在 Disney+ 播出。

articles.title: Bowen Yang Makes Surprise ‘SNL’ Appearance as Jensen Huang as John Mulaney Pokes at FAA Ground Stop and Microsoft Outage in Cold Open
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Bowen Yang made a surprise appearance on Saturday Night Live to portray former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to warn a group of tech billionaires about how to decipher between “a woman who would actually want to have sex with you and a woman who is clearly a spy.”
paras.zh: 杨博文出人意料地出现在《周六夜现场》中，扮演英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋，警告一群科技亿万富翁如何辨别“一个真正想和你发生性关系的女人和一个明显是间谍的女人”。

paras.en: John Mulaney, who served as the host of the episode, kicked off the cold open by welcoming the group of moguls, including Sam Altman (Ben Marshall), Peter Thiel (James Austin Johnson), Elon Musk (Jeremy Culhane), Mark Zuckerberg (Andrew Dismukes) and Dario Amodei (Jane Wickline).
paras.zh: 担任本集主持人的约翰·木兰尼以欢迎包括萨姆·奥尔特曼（本·马歇尔饰）、彼得·泰尔（詹姆斯·奥斯汀·约翰逊饰）、埃隆·马斯克（杰里米·卡尔哈恩饰）、马克·扎克伯格（安德鲁·迪斯穆克斯饰）和达里奥·阿莫迪（简·威克兰饰）等大亨的方式拉开了冷场。

paras.en: “We are here to discuss an extremely sensitive matter of national security,” Mulaney began.
paras.zh: “我们来这里是为了讨论一个极其敏感的国家安全问题，”穆拉尼开始说道。

paras.en: “America needs you to learn the difference between a woman who would actually want to have sex with you and a woman who is clearly a spy,” he said. “Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned this week after he was caught having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.”
paras.zh: “美国需要你了解真正想与你发生性关系的女人和明显是间谍的女人之间的区别，”他说。 “前英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因被发现与一名涉嫌中国间谍有染而于本周辞职。”

paras.en: “What do you think the lesson is here?” he asked, to which Wickline’s Amodei responded, “Never date a Chinese woman.” Dismukes’ Zuckerberg offered, “Never date a human woman.”
paras.zh: “你认为这里的教训是什么？”他问道，Wickline 的阿莫代回答说：“永远不要和中国女人约会。” Dismukes 的扎克伯格提出，“永远不要和人类女性约会。”

paras.en: “Never date anyone unless they become the Anti-Christ,” Johnson’s Thiel said. Mulaney joked that he needed to “chill with the Anti-Christ stuff,” which prompted him to respond, “Show us some respect. We do a lot for this country. Name one time technology has let us down.”
paras.zh: “永远不要和任何人约会，除非他们成为反基督者，”约翰逊的蒂尔说。穆拉尼开玩笑说，他需要“对反基督的东西冷静下来”，这促使他回应道，“向我们展示一些尊重。我们为这个国家做了很多事情。列举一次技术让我们失望的事情。”

paras.en: The comedian then pointed to current events: “Yesterday, when every plane in America was grounded.” Thiel asked for “one more” example, which Mulaney affirmed, “The day before that when Microsoft Outlook went dark!”
paras.zh: 这位喜剧演员随后指出了时事：“昨天，美国所有飞机都停飞了。”蒂尔要求提供“另一个”例子，穆拉尼证实了这一点，“前一天，微软 Outlook 黑屏了！”

paras.en: He then showed the tech billionaires a few venn diagrams to try and spell things out for the men, making way for Yang’s surprise return. “You know what, maybe what would help is if I hand it over to someone who learned this lesson the hard way,” Mulaney said, as the former SNL star then entered the scene.
paras.zh: 然后，他向科技亿万富翁展示了几张维恩图，试图为他们解释清楚，为杨的意外回归让路。 “你知道吗，如果我把它交给一个经历过惨痛教训的人，也许会有所帮助，”穆拉尼说道，这位前《周六夜现场》明星随后进入现场。

paras.en: “It’s me! Jensen ‘hide your wife’ Huang!” Yang said. “When you invite Jensen over, you know it’s about to go down.”
paras.zh: “是我！Jensen‘藏你老婆’黄！”杨说。 “当你邀请詹森过来时，你就知道事情即将发生。”

paras.en: He joked, “Fellas, don’t be like me. Remember, women don’t like guys like us. That’s how we became guys like us.”
paras.zh: 他开玩笑说：“伙计们，别像我一样。记住，女人不喜欢像我们这样的男人。这就是我们成为像我们这样的男人的原因。”

paras.en: Yang exited the SNL cast last December, with Saturday’s cameo marking his first appearance on the show since he left. He departed the series mid-season 51 with a heartfelt farewell sketch alongside Ariana Grande.
paras.zh: 杨去年 12 月退出了 SNL 演员阵容，周六的客串标志着他离开后首次出现在节目中。他在第 51 季中期离开时，与爱莉安娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 一起进行了衷心的告别小品。

paras.en: Later in the Dec. 14 episode, Yang also appeared in a sketch as Mary Todd Lincoln, the role he began performing on Broadway this September in Oh, Mary! He sang a spoof of “And I Am Telling You I’m Not Going,” which prompted Mulaney to joke, “Wow! Now that’ll turn Abraham straight again.”
paras.zh: 后来在 12 月 14 日的剧集中，杨还在小品中饰演玛丽·托德·林肯，他于今年 9 月在百老汇的《哦，玛丽！》中开始扮演这个角色。他唱了一首恶搞的《And I Am Telling You I'm Not Going》，这让木兰尼开玩笑说：“哇！这会让亚伯拉罕再次变直。”

paras.en: It was also announced in the episode that Amanda Seyfried will host the Dec. 5 episode of SNL, with Don Toliver as musical guest.
paras.zh: 该剧集还宣布阿曼达·塞弗里德 (Amanda Seyfried) 将主持 12 月 5 日的 SNL，唐·托利弗 (Don Toliver) 将担任音乐嘉宾。

paras.en: During Mulaney’s monologue, he did a light Robert F. Kennedy Jr. impression, which merely turned out to be more of a criticism of the United States Secretary of Health and Human Services.
paras.zh: 在木兰尼的独白中，他给人一种小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的印象，结果更多的是对美国卫生与公众服务部部长的批评。

paras.en: He started by explaining that as a father, he often is around a lot of toddlers. “Whenever I’m with my son’s 4-year-old, 5-year-old friends, whenever I’m with a group of toddlers at art camp, preschool play dates, there’s always at least one little kid who for some reason, has a very scratchy or hoarse voice.”
paras.zh: 他首先解释说，作为一名父亲，他经常和很多幼儿在一起。 “每当我和儿子 4 岁、5 岁的朋友在一起时，每当我和一群幼儿一起参加艺术营、学前班玩耍时，总会有至少一个小孩由于某种原因声音变得沙哑或沙哑。”

paras.en: “Whenever a few are at my house, there’s always one like, ‘Do you have water balloons?’ Like, ‘Do you live alone?'” Mulaney said, continuing to repeat questions that his children’s friends ask him, using a raspy voice while saying, “I’m the U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services. My father was a good man, and I’m a lousy man, but I have same name. Am I good if I have same name as father?”
paras.zh: “只要有几个人来我家，总会有人问，‘你有水气球吗？’比如，‘你一个人住吗？’”木兰尼说，一边继续重复孩子们的朋友问他的问题，一边用沙哑的声音说，“我是美国卫生与公众服务部部长。我父亲是个好人，我是个坏人，但我有相同的名字。如果我和父亲同名，我好吗？”

paras.en: Mulaney continued his impression, “No, please, let me be in charge of your bone and your tummy. Please allow me to control how your blood feels in your butt and everywhere. Stop the science! Robitussin taken during menstruation will cause telekinesis. This is clear from the pamphlets in my rental car.’”
paras.zh: 穆拉尼继续他的印象，“不，拜托，让我负责你的骨头和你的肚子。请允许我控制你屁股和到处的血液感觉。停止科学！在月经期间服用罗比辛会导致心灵遥感。这一点从我租来的车上的小册子上可以清楚地看出。”

paras.en: He then returned to his own voice, continuing to criticize RFK Jr. “I have right-wing friends that used to be down with him, no one likes him. You dumbass: Your thing can’t be the measles.”
paras.zh: 然后他又恢复了自己的声音，继续批评小罗伯特·肯尼迪，“我有一些右翼朋友曾经对他很不满，没有人喜欢他。你这个笨蛋：你的事不可能是麻疹。”

paras.en: Mulaney previously served as an SNL writer from 2008-2012. Although he was never a castmember, he has since returned to the show multiple times since his departure, making a plethora of cameos and hosting seven times.
