paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Yeah. It sounds like Jared Kushner has an almost impossible task here, doing something that I think he wants to do but Vladimir Putin obviously doesn't, to bring Europe in these talks.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：是的。听起来贾里德·库什纳在这里面临着一项几乎不可能完成的任务，做一些我认为他想做但弗拉基米尔·普京显然不想做的事情，让欧洲参与这些谈判。

paras.en: TAYLOR: So Kushner and Witkoff have a flawed way of thinking about these negotiations. They think that if they just offer suggestions or offerings or carrots or gifts to Putin, he'll come around to their point of view. That's wrong, A. As you know, Putin responds to strength, not to gifts. And so that's not going to get them anywhere.
paras.zh: 泰勒：所以库什纳和威特科夫对这些谈判的思考方式是有缺陷的。他们认为，如果他们只是向普京提供建议、奉献、胡萝卜或礼物，他就会接受他们的观点。这是错误的，A。正如你所知，普京回应的是实力，而不是礼物。所以这不会让他们有任何进展。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: But strength, that could be something that is dangerous to the world, isn't it? Showing a force of strength to Vladimir Putin sounds like it could be dangerous to everyone.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：但是力量，这可能对世界来说是危险的，不是吗？向弗拉基米尔·普京展示力量听起来可能对每个人来说都是危险的。

paras.en: TAYLOR: It's going to be dangerous to the Russians if they continue. The Russians know - Putin knows that if he lashes out at anybody in NATO, it's curtains for him. There is no way that the Russians are going to go after NATO. So NATO needs to be strong, Europeans need to be strong, Ukrainians are strong and the U.S. should be supportive.
paras.zh: 泰勒：如果俄罗斯人继续这样做，那将是危险的。俄罗斯人知道——普京知道，如果他猛烈抨击北约的任何人，那他就完蛋了。俄罗斯人不可能追击北约。因此，北约需要强大，欧洲需要强大，乌克兰需要强大，美国应该提供支持。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Ambassador, I remember back in 2022, Vladimir Putin expected this so-called special military operation to last anywhere from three to 10 days, or weeks at worst. Come February, it'll be five years. What are the chances that Vladimir Putin can be convinced that maybe he cannot win this war?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：大使，我记得早在 2022 年，弗拉基米尔·普京预计这次所谓的特别军事行动将持续 3 到 10 天，最坏的情况是几周。到了二月，就五年了。弗拉基米尔·普京确信他可能无法赢得这场战争的可能性有多大？

paras.en: TAYLOR: He's going to come to that conclusion, A. I'm convinced. He sees the refineries that are burning in his country. The Ukrainians are going deep after them. I don't know if his generals are telling him, but he's losing 50,000 troops in a month. That can't go on. You know, when Putin understands that, he will figure this out. The U.S. elections, A, are going to be a message to him that says the U.S. is supportive of Ukraine. Three percent of Americans support Russia. This is going to become clear to him that he cannot win this.
paras.zh: 泰勒：他会得出这样的结论，A。我相信。他看到他的国家正在燃烧的炼油厂。乌克兰人正在深入追击他们。我不知道他的将军们是否告诉他，但他一个月内就损失了 50,000 名士兵。这样下去不行了。你知道，当普京明白这一点时，他就会解决这个问题。美国大选，A，将向他传达一个信息：美国支持乌克兰。百分之三的美国人支持俄罗斯。他将清楚地意识到他无法赢得这场比赛。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: You think he will arrive to that conclusion, or someone has to pressure him or convince him to arrive there?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：你认为他会得出这个结论，还是必须有人向他施加压力或说服他才能得出这个结论？

paras.en: TAYLOR: I think someone has to pressure him to convince him. The Ukrainians are doing that on the battlefield. John Ratcliffe, you recall, the head of the CIA, went to Moscow to try to tell Putin this. Putin wouldn't listen, but he's hearing it from his generals.
paras.zh: 泰勒：我认为必须有人向他施加压力才能说服他。乌克兰人正在战场上这样做。你记得，约翰·拉特克利夫，中央情报局局长，前往莫斯科试图告诉普京这一点。普京不会听，但他从他的将军们那里听到了这一点。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: All right. William Taylor is a former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine, now with the Atlantic Council. Ambassador, thank you very much.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：好的。威廉·泰勒是前美国驻乌克兰大使，现任大西洋理事会成员。大使，非常感谢您。

articles.title: Former Ukrainian foreign minister discusses how to bridge gaps between Ukraine, Russia
articles.author: A Martínez

paras.en: Former Ukrainian foreign minister discusses how to bridge gaps between Ukraine, Russia
paras.zh: 乌克兰前外长讨论如何弥合乌克兰与俄罗斯之间的分歧

paras.en: NPR's A Martinez asks Ukraine's former Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba for his proposals to close gaps in talks between Russia, Ukraine and Europe.
paras.zh: 美国国家公共广播电台的马丁内斯向乌克兰前外长德米特罗·库莱巴询问有关缩小俄罗斯、乌克兰和欧洲之间谈判分歧的建议。

paras.en: Let's hear from a former Ukrainian official with extensive experience negotiating on behalf of the country. Dmytro Kuleba was foreign minister for Ukraine from 2020 to 2024. Today, he's a senior fellow at the Harvard Kennedy School's Belfer Center. Minister, Russia and Ukraine agreed, at least in principle, to a large-scale prisoner exchange as part of these talks. They've done that before. Were you hoping for more progress to be made with these talks?
paras.zh: 让我们听听一位拥有丰富代表国家谈判经验的前乌克兰官员的看法。德米特罗·库莱巴 (Dmytro Kuleba) 在 2020 年至 2024 年期间担任乌克兰外交部长。如今，他是哈佛大学肯尼迪学院贝尔弗中心的高级研究员。作为会谈的一部分，俄罗斯和乌克兰至少在原则上同意大规模交换囚犯。他们以前就这么做过。您是否希望这些会谈取得更多进展？

paras.en: DMYTRO KULEBA: No, I didn't. And I actually have to say that prisoner swaps should be taking place outside of the scope of political negotiations as a part of regular humanitarian effort. But I don't see any driver behind Russia's position that has changed recently in the trajectory of genuine negotiations in good faith.
paras.zh: DMYTRO KULEBA： 不，我没有。事实上我不得不说，囚犯交换应该在政治谈判范围之外进行，作为常规人道主义努力的一部分。但我认为俄罗斯立场背后的任何推动因素最近在真诚谈判的轨道上没有发生改变。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: So as far as making progress toward ending the war, these prisoner exchanges to you means nothing?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：那么就结束战争的进展而言，这些囚犯交换对你来说毫无意义？

paras.en: KULEBA: Well, prisoners exchange means the world to every Ukrainian because our people are coming back home to their family from Russian prisons, where they're subjected to torture and disregarding treatment. So it's a big deal. But it has zero impact on the progress on the political track towards ending the conflict.
paras.zh: 库列巴：嗯，囚犯交换对每个乌克兰人来说意义重大，因为我们的人民正在从俄罗斯监狱回到家人身边，他们在那里遭受酷刑和无视待遇。所以这是一件大事。但这对结束冲突的政治进程的影响为零。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: When it comes to Europe's role in these talks, we know that Vladimir Putin does not want Europe involved. And the U.S. has said that NATO allies are essential to a lasting peace. Is there a way for U.S. envoys to persuade Russia, to persuade Vladimir Putin to accept European involvement in these talks?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：当谈到欧洲在这些谈判中的作用时，我们知道弗拉基米尔·普京不希望欧洲参与其中。美国表示，北约盟国对于持久和平至关重要。美国特使有办法说服俄罗斯、说服弗拉基米尔·普京接受欧洲参与这些谈判吗？

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: If European presence in these talks doesn't cost Russia anything, why doesn't the U.S. basically just hold Vladimir Putin's hands to the fire on this and insist on them being there?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：如果欧洲参加这些谈判不会让俄罗斯付出任何代价，那么美国为什么不直接阻止普京并坚持让他们参加呢？

paras.en: KULEBA: Could you give me one example from the last two years when the United States held President Putin's arms to the fire?
paras.zh: 库莱巴：你能给我举一个过去两年美国将普京总统的手臂付之一炬的例子吗？

paras.en: KULEBA: That's not the way this administration treats President Putin. They actually more kind of care for his hands than want to cause harm to them.
paras.zh: 库莱巴：这不是本届政府对待普京总统的方式。他们实际上更关心他的手，而不是想要伤害他的手。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: So if you know that, minister - and obviously, Vladimir Putin probably knows that - then what are the chances that any progress can be made? All he has to do is just continue to hold the line.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：部长，如果您知道这一点——显然弗拉基米尔·普京可能也知道这一点——那么取得进展的可能性有多大？他所要做的就是继续坚守阵地。

paras.en: KULEBA: Well, that's exactly what he has been doing for the last two years. And this is what I believe, regrettably, he will continue to do in the coming years. He just needs to continue engaging with his - engage the United States, court President Trump in a way that will give him enough of a reason to believe that an agreement is possible, and that Putin is seeking an agreement but just needs to be accommodated on one or two more points.
paras.zh: 库莱巴：嗯，这正是他过去两年一直在做的事情。遗憾的是，我相信这就是他在未来几年将继续做的事情。他只需要继续与美国接触，向特朗普总统示好，让他有足够的理由相信达成协议是可能的，而普京正在寻求达成协议，但只需要在一两点上得到满足。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Do you think that Democratic control of the new Congress, the upcoming Congress, will somehow alter the course of these talks or maybe the future of U.S. support for Ukraine?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：您认为民主党对新国会、即将召开的国会的控制会以某种方式改变这些谈判的进程，或者可能改变美国对乌克兰支持的未来吗？

paras.en: KULEBA: Well, foreign policy, especially in negotiations with foreign leaders, stays firmly in the hands of the president of the United States of America. So, yes, of course I expect a reinvigorated role of Congress on the Ukrainian file. But I believe President Trump will continue his policies.
paras.zh: 库莱巴：外交政策，特别是与外国领导人的谈判，牢牢掌握在美利坚合众国总统手中。所以，是的，我当然希望国会在乌克兰档案中发挥新的作用。但我相信特朗普总统将继续他的政策。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Dmytro Kuleba served as Ukraine's foreign minister from 2020 to 2024. He's now at the Harvard Kennedy School's Belfer Center. Minister, thank you very much for your time.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：德米特罗·库莱巴 (Dmytro Kuleba) 在 2020 年至 2024 年期间担任乌克兰外交部长。他现在在哈佛大学肯尼迪学院贝尔弗中心工作。部长，非常感谢您抽出时间。

articles.title: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
paras.zh: 科罗姆赢得密西西比州参议员竞选。并且，白宫警告民主党未来的调查

paras.en: Democrat Scott Colom has won the U.S. Senate seat from Mississippi, defeating Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by just a few thousand votes. Colom will be the first Black Senator from the state in nearly 150 years. His win expands the Democratic majority in the new Congress to 55 seats. The Alaska race is still undecided.
paras.zh: 民主党人斯科特·科洛姆以几千票击败共和党参议员辛迪·海德·史密斯，赢得了密西西比州的美国参议院席位。科罗姆将成为近 150 年来第一位来自该州的黑人参议员。他的胜利使民主党在新国会中的多数席位扩大到 55 个。阿拉斯加的比赛仍悬而未决。

paras.en: - 🎧 Colom's win highlights growing voter concerns about affordability and the impact of the war in Iran, Elise Catrion Gregg of the Gulf States Newsroom and Mississippi Public Broadcasting tells Up First. During her campaign, Hyde-Smith relied on her record and President Trump's support, which Gregg says is no longer a winning strategy. This race signals a potential national shift, showing that the South is becoming a viable target for Democrats, Gregg says.
paras.zh: - 海湾国家新闻室和密西西比州公共广播公司的埃莉斯·卡特里恩·格雷格 (Elise Catrion Gregg) 告诉《Up First》，科罗姆的胜利突显了选民对负担能力和伊朗战争影响日益增长的担忧。在竞选期间，海德·史密斯依靠自己的记录和特朗普总统的支持，格雷格表示这不再是制胜策略。格雷格说，这场竞选标志着潜在的全国性转变，表明南方正在成为民主党的可行目标。

paras.en: - ➡️ A U.S. Supreme Court ruling this year weakened the Voting Rights Act, raising the possibility of a record drop in Black Congressional representation. The Democratic blue wave lessened the expected decline, but an NPR analysis shows that Black representation in the U.S. House is still slated to decrease with the incoming Congress.
paras.zh: - ➡️美国最高法院今年的一项裁决削弱了投票权法案，增加了黑人国会代表人数创纪录下降的可能性。民主党的蓝色浪潮减轻了预期的下降，但美国公共广播电台的分析显示，随着国会的上届，美国众议院的黑人代表人数仍将减少。

paras.en: The White House is warning Democrats that their planned investigations into administration officials could cross the line into "blatant criminality." White House Counsel Will Scharf said in a letter to Rep. Robert Garcia, who is expected to lead the House Oversight Committee next year, that the administration is monitoring "abusive and capricious threats" from Democrats. The letter concludes by saying that "the administration will not be extorted and will not be cowed by unlawful process, motivated by animus, pettiness, hatred or any other unlawful motive to intimidate, penalize or interfere with the lawful functioning of government." Garcia said Democrats will not be deterred by threats from the Department of Justice or Trump's lawyers.
paras.zh: 白宫警告民主党人，他们计划对政府官员进行的调查可能会跨越“公然犯罪”的界限。白宫法律顾问威尔·沙夫在给明年将领导众议院监督委员会的众议员罗伯特·加西亚的一封信中表示，政府正在监视来自民主党的“滥用和反复无常的威胁”。信中最后表示，“政府不会因敌意、狭隘、仇恨或任何其他非法动机而受到勒索，也不会被非法程序吓倒，从而恐吓、惩罚或干扰政府的合法运作。”加西亚表示，民主党不会被司法部或特朗普律师的威胁吓倒。

paras.en: - 🎧 The administration's arguments may buy time and push Democrats to go to court to enforce their subpoenas, NPR's Tamara Keith says. She adds that the White House letter gives a preview of the legal arguments the administration might use next year. But more importantly, Keith says that it signals that the White House and Justice Department won't accept congressional investigations and oversight without a fight.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的塔玛拉·基思 (Tamara Keith) 表示，政府的论点可能会赢得时间，并促使民主党人上法庭执行传票。她补充说，白宫的信函预览了政府明年可能使用的法律论据。但更重要的是，基思表示，这表明白宫和司法部不会不战而屈人之兵地接受国会的调查和监督。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a significant prisoner swap after two days of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi. Trump's envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff are now in Moscow today to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and attempt to make more headway to end the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 经过美国斡旋在阿布扎比举行两天会谈后，俄罗斯和乌克兰同意进行重大囚犯交换。特朗普的特使贾里德·库什纳和史蒂夫·威特科夫今天在莫斯科会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，并试图在结束乌克兰战争方面取得更多进展。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Charles Maynes says that, going into the talks in Abu Dhabi, U.S. officials were exploring Article 5-like guarantees for Ukraine, similar to NATO's collective security defense. A move like this would be significant if implemented, but Moscow has already rejected the concept of a "NATO lite" status for Ukraine and its full NATO membership. Kushner said that, in Moscow, he aims to brief Putin directly and persuade him to involve Europeans in discussions about European security. European leaders, concerned about potential deals made without their input, are expected to join Kushner and Witkoff after these talks, when they'll meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Ireland.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的查尔斯·梅恩斯 (Charles Maynes) 表示，在阿布扎比举行会谈时，美国官员正在探索对乌克兰提供类似第 5 条的保障，类似于北约的集体安全防御。如果实施的话，这样的举措将意义重大，但莫斯科已经拒绝了乌克兰及其正式北约成员的“北约精简”地位的概念。库什纳表示，他在莫斯科的目标是直接向普京通报情况，并说服他让欧洲人参与有关欧洲安全的讨论。欧洲领导人担心在没有他们参与的情况下达成的潜在协议，预计将在这些会谈后加入库什纳和维特科夫的行列，届时他们将在爱尔兰会见乌克兰总统泽连斯基。

paras.en: Abdul El-Sayed has made history as the first Muslim elected to the U.S. Senate. The 42-year-old progressive from Michigan is already calling for a new direction for his party and urging President Trump to collaborate on actionable solutions. El-Sayed said that voters have temporarily entrusted Democrats with power, but warns that they risk losing that trust if they don't act boldly. As the senator-elect comes into the new role, he is advocating for new Democratic leadership in Congress, an end to the war in Iran, the passage of "Medicare for All" and the abolishment of ICE. While he acknowledges the challenge Senate Democrats face with a majority that's a few seats shy of being filibuster-proof, he remains open to working with his new Republican colleagues. In conversation with Morning Edition's Leila Fadel, El-Sayed reflects on the recent elections, the future of the Democratic Party and the need for impactful legislation in the upcoming years.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜勒·赛义德创造了历史，成为第一位当选美国参议院的穆斯林。这位来自密歇根州的 42 岁进步人士已经在呼吁为他的政党制定新的方向，并敦促特朗普总统合作制定可行的解决方案。埃尔-赛义德表示，选民暂时将权力托付给民主党，但他警告说，如果他们不大胆采取行动，他们就有可能失去这种信任。随着这位当选参议员就任新角色，他主张在国会建立新的民主党领导层、结束伊朗战争、通过“全民医疗保险”以及废除 ICE。虽然他承认参议院民主党面临着多数席位的挑战，距离阻止阻挠议案还差几个席位，但他仍然愿意与他的新共和党同事合作。在与早间版的莱拉·法德尔的对话中，埃尔赛义德反思了最近的选举、民主党的未来以及未来几年制定有影响力的立法的必要性。

paras.en: Watch or listen to the interview or read the article about their discussion.
paras.zh: 观看或收听采访或阅读有关他们讨论的文章。

paras.en: The average price for a new vehicle in the U.S. has hit a record high of $51,109, according to Kelley Blue Book. This figure is about $500 above the previous record set in December 2025. For years, car prices have remained high, primarily due to supply chain issues stemming from the pandemic. But there's some good news: While that new high sets a record, it only represents a 2.1% increase over the past year. This means the price is rising more slowly. If you're in the market for a car, here's what to know:
paras.zh: 根据凯利蓝皮书 (Kelley Blue Book) 的数据，美国新车的平均价格已创下 51,109 美元的历史新高。这一数字比 2025 年 12 月创下的纪录高出约 500 美元。多年来，汽车价格一直居高不下，主要是由于疫情引发的供应链问题。但有一些好消息：虽然这一新高创下了纪录，但仅代表过去一年的 2.1% 增长。这意味着价格上涨速度更加缓慢。如果您正在市场上买车，请了解以下信息：

paras.en: - 🚗 Used cars are also more expensive. The average used car now costs close to $27,00, 6% higher than last year, according to Cox Automotive.
paras.zh: - 🚗 二手车也更贵。据 Cox Automotive 称，现在二手车的平均价格接近 27 美元，比去年上涨 6%。

paras.en: - 🚗 New vehicles cost more partly because it takes more money for automakers to make them. Tariffs on steel, aluminum and imported goods from Canada affect American automakers, who assemble the vehicles on both sides of the border. Computer chips used in sensors and electronics also cost more, thanks to competing demand from data centers.
paras.zh: - 🚗 新车成本更高，部分原因是汽车制造商制造它们需要更多资金。对钢铁、铝和来自加拿大的进口商品征收关税影响了在边境两侧组装车辆的美国汽车制造商。由于数据中心的竞争需求，传感器和电子产品中使用的计算机芯片的成本也更高。

paras.en: - 🚗 Americans tend to prefer larger vehicles, such as SUVs and trucks, which often come with a higher price tag, according to Kelley Blue Book.
paras.zh: - 🚗 根据凯利蓝皮书，美国人往往更喜欢大型车辆，例如 SUV 和卡车，这些车辆的价格通常较高。

paras.en: - 🚗 Drivers today tend not to want entry-level cars. Instead, they are increasingly drawn to more expensive features, like 360-degree cameras, heated seats and parking assist systems.
paras.zh: - 🚗 如今的驾驶员往往不想要入门级汽车。相反，他们越来越被更昂贵的功能所吸引，例如 360 度摄像头、加热座椅和停车辅助系统。

paras.en: - Actor Stacy Keach has died at the age of 85 after a long battle with a serious heart condition and heart failure. His diverse roles included policemen, cowboys and Shakespearean characters.
paras.zh: - 演员史黛西·基奇 (Stacy Keach) 在与严重的心脏病和心力衰竭进行长期斗争后去世，享年 85 岁。他扮演的角色多种多样，包括警察、牛仔和莎士比亚的角色。

paras.en: - In this week's Far-Flung Postcards, NPR's Ricci Shryock sends greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers practice for their country's historic hosting of the Youth Olympic Games.
paras.zh: - 在本周的远方明信片中，NPR 的 Ricci Shryock 从塞内加尔发来问候，那里的霹雳舞者正在为该国历史性地主办青奥会进行练习。

paras.en: - Russia's top independent newspaper, Novaya Gazeta, is shutting down after more than 30 years due to Kremlin pressure from the Ukraine war and censorship laws.
paras.zh: - 由于乌克兰战争和审查法的克里姆林宫压力，俄罗斯顶级独立报纸《新报》在运营了 30 多年后即将关闭。

articles.title: Benches clear in chaotic postgame brawl after Louisville Cardinals top North Carolina Tar Heels

paras.en: The Louisville Cardinals managed to beat the North Carolina Tar Heels 16-14 after a late interception ended UNC's hopes of taking the lead.
paras.zh: 路易斯维尔红雀队在最后时刻的拦截终结了北卡罗来纳大学取得领先的希望，最终以 16-14 击败了北卡罗来纳焦油脚跟队。

paras.en: While that sounds exciting, it's no match for the all-out brawl that erupted as the clock wound down to zero.
paras.zh: 虽然这听起来很令人兴奋，但它无法与当时钟倒计时至零时爆发的全面争吵相比。

paras.en: With just over a minute to go, UNC's Travis Burgess seemed to have thrown a pass that would move the Tar Heels close to midfield; however, it wound up in the arms of a Cardinal.
paras.zh: 比赛还剩一分多钟时，北卡罗来纳大学的特拉维斯·伯吉斯 (Travis Burgess) 似乎传出了一脚传球，将柏油脚跟队移至中场附近。然而，它最终落入了一位红衣主教的怀抱。

paras.en: Bummer. That's it. Game over. Everyone can leave. Nothing else to see.
paras.zh: 真糟糕。就是这样。游戏结束。每个人都可以离开。没什么可看的。

paras.en: Well, any fans who did stick around saw something wild. As the Cardinals took a knee for the final time, tempers started flaring.
paras.zh: 好吧，任何留下来的粉丝都看到了一些疯狂的东西。当红雀队最后一次单膝下跪时，球队的脾气开始爆发。

paras.en: Then they kept flaring, and really never stopped.
paras.zh: 然后它们一直在燃烧，而且从未停止过。

paras.en: We also got one of my favorite things, which is officials trying to break up a brawl by blowing their whistles and throwing flags.
paras.zh: 我们还得到了我最喜欢的事情之一，那就是官员们试图通过吹口哨和投掷旗帜来平息争吵。

paras.en: Seriously? In that melee, do you really think whistling away like a London Bobby is going to do anything?
paras.zh: 严重地？在那场混战中，你真的认为像伦敦鲍比那样吹口哨会有什么作用吗？

paras.en: Now you don't just have a brawl on your hands. You have a brawl, a total racket and a bunch of flags you've got to go and pick up.
paras.zh: 现在你们手上不只是吵架了。你们会发生争吵、吵闹和一堆旗帜，你们必须去捡起来。

paras.en: So, did any of that improve the situation in any measurable way?
paras.zh: 那么，这些措施是否以任何可衡量的方式改善了情况呢？

paras.en: Of course, with that much mayhem, there's not much the officiating can do (or would want to do), and it will be interesting to see if there's any supplemental discipline coming.
paras.zh: 当然，面对如此多的混乱，裁判能做的（或想做的）并不多，看看是否会有任何补充纪律将会很有趣。

paras.en: The Tar Heels likely don’t need any, because they’re probably in for a rough few days.
paras.zh: 焦油脚后跟队可能不需要任何东西，因为他们可能会度过艰难的几天。

paras.en: It was a bad night on several fronts for Bill Belichick's boys. Something tells me it won't be a fun week as the 5-5 Tar Heels prepare to take on Virginia next weekend.
paras.zh: 对于比尔·贝利切克的孩子们来说，从多个方面来说，这都是一个糟糕的夜晚。有件事告诉我，这不会是有趣的一周，因为 5-5 Tar Heels 队准备在下周末迎战弗吉尼亚队。

articles.title: Masked dirt bike riders swarm SUV in brazen NYC street attack, sparking police crackdown

paras.en: New York City officials are warning a group of masked dirt bike riders that arrests could be imminent after video captured a chaotic confrontation in which several riders surrounded and attacked a vehicle on a busy Staten Island street.
paras.zh: 纽约市官员警告一群蒙面越野车骑手，他们可能很快就会被逮捕，因为视频捕捉到了在繁忙的斯塔顿岛街道上发生的一场混乱冲突，几名骑手包围并袭击了一辆汽车。

paras.en: The crackdown follows a Wednesday incident on Richmond Avenue in Staten Island's Bulls Head neighborhood, where video showed several masked riders swarming a white SUV stopped at a traffic light.
paras.zh: 此次打击行动是在周三史泰登岛公牛头附近的里士满大道上发生的一起事件之后进行的，视频显示几名蒙面骑手涌入一辆停在红绿灯处的白色SUV。

paras.en: In the video obtained by Fox News Digital, several individuals appeared to kick and strike the vehicle, while another appeared to throw an object at it. As the driver attempted to leave, the SUV appeared to run over a dirt bike that had been positioned in front of the vehicle.
paras.zh: 在福克斯新闻数字频道获得的视频中，有几个人似乎踢并击打了车辆，而另一个人似乎向车辆扔了一个物体。当司机试图离开时，SUV似乎碾压了一辆停在车辆前面的越野车。

paras.en: During a news conference Thursday, NYPD Assistant Chief John Buttacavoli warned those involved that police were gathering intelligence and working to identify the suspects.
paras.zh: 在周四的新闻发布会上，纽约警察局助理局长约翰·布塔卡沃利警告相关人员，警方正在收集情报并努力识别嫌疑人。

paras.en: "We know who you are, and you will be getting a knock on your door very soon," Buttacavoli said, emphasizing that the behavior had escalated from a quality-of-life concern into criminal activity.
paras.zh: 布塔卡沃利说：“我们知道你是谁，很快就会有人来敲你的门。”他强调这种行为已经从对生活质量的担忧升级为犯罪活动。

paras.en: "It stops here. We're taking action," he added.
paras.zh: “事情到此为止。我们正在采取行动，”他补充道。

paras.en: Staten Island District Attorney Michael McMahon also condemned the riders, accusing them of intimidating motorists and putting innocent people at risk.
paras.zh: 史泰登岛地区检察官迈克尔·麦克马洪也谴责了这些骑手，指责他们恐吓驾车者，并将无辜者置于危险之中。

paras.en: "Like a plague of locusts, they descend upon drivers who are just going about their business here on Staten Island," McMahon said. "They're jackals, they're teenage terrorists, and it's not going to be tolerated here in our borough."
paras.zh: 麦克马洪说：“就像一场蝗灾一样，它们袭击了正在史泰登岛处理业务的司机。” “他们是豺狼，他们是青少年恐怖分子，我们的行政区不会容忍这种行为。”

paras.en: McMahon called the behavior "simply outrageous," adding that no one had been seriously injured, based on the information available to officials.
paras.zh: 麦克马洪称这种行为“简直令人愤慨”，并补充说，根据官员掌握的信息，没有人受重伤。

paras.en: Wednesday's incident was part of a broader pattern of dangerous behavior involving motorized bikes, according to Staten Island Borough President Vito Fossella.
paras.zh: 史泰登岛区长维托·福塞拉 (Vito Fossella) 表示，周三的事件是涉及机动自行车的更广泛危险行为的一部分。

paras.en: Fossella described the riders as a "bunch of punks who are literally terrorizing drivers" as motorists went about their daily routines.
paras.zh: 福塞拉将这些乘客描述为“一群在驾车者日常生活中恐吓司机的小混混”。

paras.en: "Enough. This game is over," Fossella said.
paras.zh: “够了。这场比赛结束了。”福塞拉说道。

paras.en: The borough president also warned parents that their children were putting innocent motorists at risk.
paras.zh: 区长还警告家长们，他们的孩子正在将无辜的驾车者置于危险之中。

paras.en: "Your kid is terrorizing innocent people when they're just going about their business. It's wrong, and it needs to stop," Fossella said.
paras.zh: 福塞拉说：“你的孩子在做自己的事情时正在恐吓无辜的人。这是错误的，需要停止。”

paras.en: McMahon warned that parents could face legal or financial consequences if their children use illegal motorized vehicles to intimidate or injure others, including potential civil liability if someone is hurt.
paras.zh: 麦克马洪警告说，如果孩子使用非法机动车辆恐吓或伤害他人，父母可能会面临法律或经济后果，包括如果有人受伤则可能承担民事责任。

paras.en: "Parents also must take responsibility for their children," McMahon's office said in a separate statement.
paras.zh: 麦克马洪办公室在另一份声明中表示：“父母也必须对孩子负责。”

paras.en: Police have assembled a task force to address the problem and will continue confiscating illegally operated motorized bikes, according to Buttacavoli. He said officers had already identified several individuals and seized numerous bikes this year.
paras.zh: 布塔卡沃利表示，警方已经组建了一个特别工作组来解决这个问题，并将继续没收非法运营的机动自行车。他说，今年警方已经查明了几人的身份，并查获了多辆自行车。

paras.en: The NYPD also reminded residents that certain motorized vehicles must be registered, insured and operated by licensed drivers.
paras.zh: 纽约警察局还提醒居民，某些机动车辆必须由有执照的驾驶员注册、投保和操作。

paras.en: State Assemblyman Mike Reilly, R-Staten Island, said he plans to introduce legislation in January that would hold parents financially responsible for minors caught recklessly operating certain motorized vehicles, according to the New York Post.
paras.zh: 据《纽约邮报》报道，史坦顿岛州议员迈克·赖利 (Mike Reilly) 表示，他计划在一月份提出立法，要求父母对鲁莽驾驶某些机动车辆的未成年人承担经济责任。

paras.en: The proposal would impose fines ranging from $250 to $1,500, the paper reported.
paras.zh: 据该报报道，该提案将处以 250 美元至 1,500 美元不等的罚款。

paras.en: The incident remains under investigation, and no arrests have been announced.
paras.zh: 该事件仍在调查中，尚未宣布逮捕任何人。

articles.title: Arch Manning turns Death Valley into LSU’s funeral as Texas buries Lane Kiffin’s CFP hopes

paras.en: BATON ROUGE, La. — Turns out, the Texas Longhorns had one last drive left in them, on a night when nothing was going Arch Manning's way.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日——事实证明，德克萨斯长角牛队还剩下最后一击，而在这个夜晚，阿奇·曼宁的表现却毫无进展。

paras.en: What we witnessed on Saturday night inside Tiger Stadium will be remembered for quite some time, by both Texas and LSU fans.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州和路易斯安那州立大学的球迷将在很长一段时间内记住我们周六晚上在老虎体育场内目睹的一切。

paras.en: What started as a party for the Tiger faithful turned into a funeral for the LSU 2026 season that will leave folks in Louisiana wondering how they could give this one away to the Longhorns.
paras.zh: 一开始是为老虎队球迷举办的一场派对，后来变成了路易斯安那州立大学 2026 赛季的葬礼，这让路易斯安那州的人们想知道如何才能把这个派对送给长角牛队。

paras.en: The pressure entering this one was heavy on both sides. Texas could not afford another loss and feel totally safe in making the postseason, while a fourth loss for LSU would put an end to their CFP hopes, even if they were already hanging by a thread.
paras.zh: 进入这一关，双方的压力都很大。德克萨斯州无法承受再次失利，并且对进入季后赛感到完全安全，而路易斯安那州立大学的第四次失利将终结他们的 CFP 希望，即使他们已经命悬一线。

paras.en: Was there some hesitation among LSU fans to get overly excited about this one? If you were wondering why, the final drive of this game all but proved their point that Lane Kiffin is the same guy who could not win the big game at Ole Miss, and now as head coach of the Tigers.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州立大学的球迷是否会犹豫是否要对这一比赛感到过度兴奋？如果你想知道为什么，这场比赛的最后一击几乎证明了他们的观点，即莱恩·基芬（Lane Kiffin）就是那个无法在密西西比大学赢得大赛的人，现在担任老虎队的主教练。

paras.en: Maybe that's because Sam Leavitt had three interceptions through three quarters tonight, and it's hard to trust this LSU offense at times. It wasn’t if the other side was any better though, with Arch Manning throwing three of his own.
paras.zh: 也许这是因为萨姆·莱维特今晚在三节比赛中被拦截了三次，有时很难相信路易斯安那州立大学的进攻。不过，并不是对方的表现更好，阿奇·曼宁自己也投出了三分。

paras.en: It had to end this way for the Tigers, at the hands of Louisiana native
paras.zh: 老虎队必须以这种方式结束，在路易斯安那州本地人的手中

paras.en: Why not? This is LSU football we're talking about here, with a head coach that has spent over $40 million on its roster this season. You bet that Kiffin and his staff felt the pressure in the week leading up to this one, and rightfully so.
paras.zh: 为什么不呢？我们在这里谈论的是路易斯安那州立大学足球队，其主教练本赛季在球队阵容上花费了超过 4000 万美元。你敢打赌，基芬和他的员工在这之前的一周感受到了压力，这是理所当然的。

paras.en: This was a game in which both teams could not afford to lose, even though that swayed more in the direction of LSU given their three losses.
paras.zh: 这是一场两支球队都不能输的比赛，尽管考虑到路易斯安那州立大学的三场失利，这场比赛更倾向于路易斯安那州立大学。

paras.en: As day turned into night, the craziness began for both teams. Multiple interceptions, special teams blunders and some interesting play calling on each side of the field.
paras.zh: 随着白天变成黑夜，两支球队都开始了疯狂的比赛。多次拦截、特种部队的失误以及场上双方的一些有趣的比赛。

paras.en: But, it was Arch Manning that had the ball with just over two minutes remaining in a game that set offenses back years up until the final drive of the game. If there’s one thing we’ve learned about the Texas Longhorns this season, it’s that we can’t put anything past them.
paras.zh: 但是，正是阿奇·曼宁在比赛还剩两分钟多的时候拿球，让进攻倒退了好几年，直到比赛的最后一击。如果说我们本赛季从德克萨斯长角牛队学到了一件事，那就是我们无法超越他们。

paras.en: A 12-play, 58-yard drive would seal the deal for a Texas team that had one last chance to pull off a miracle in Baton Rouge.
paras.zh: 一场 12 场比赛、58 码的冲球将为德克萨斯州球队敲定这笔交易，他们还有最后一次机会在巴吞鲁日创造奇迹。

paras.en: Arch Manning hit Raleek Brown on a swing pass that caught the LSU defense off guard, and Brown fought his way into the end zone to secure Texas’ 22-21 win, drawing a roar from a Texas crowd that had essentially taken over the southern end of Tiger Stadium.
paras.zh: 阿奇·曼宁 (Arch Manning) 的一记摇摆传球击中了拉里克·布朗 (Raleek Brown)，让路易斯安那州立大学的防守措手不及，布朗奋力杀入达阵区，确保德克萨斯州以 22-21 获胜，引起了几乎占领了老虎体育场南端的德克萨斯州人群的欢呼。

paras.en: Just when you thought the Longhorns were done, the defense gave this team one last chance to pull off what many will remember as one of the best moments of Arch Manning's college career. Let me be clear that this Texas offense looked putrid at times, getting torched along the line of scrimmage, while Manning would end the game with three interceptions.
paras.zh: 就在你以为长角牛队完蛋的时候，防守给了这支球队最后一次机会，让他们完成了阿奇·曼宁大学生涯中最美好的时刻之一。让我明确一点，德克萨斯州的进攻有时看起来很腐烂，沿着争球线被烧毁，而曼宁以三次拦截结束了比赛。

paras.en: But, all it took was one legendary drive for a quarterback that will be remembered for a number of inconsistencies in college.
paras.zh: 但是，这位四分卫所需要的只是一次传奇般的突破，而这将因大学期间的一些不一致而被人们铭记。

paras.en: Arch Manning delivers at the most important time, ends the Tigers
paras.zh: 阿奇·曼宁在最重要的时刻完成了任务，终结了老虎队

paras.en: On Saturday night, none of that mattered when Manning grabbed Steve Sarkisian during the post-game interview with ESPN. His interceptions will be remembered by those who cover him on a daily basis, but the touchdown pass will live on forever in Texas lore.
paras.zh: 周六晚上，当曼宁在接受 ESPN 赛后采访时抓住了史蒂夫·萨尔基西安时，一切都不再重要了。他的拦截将被那些每天报道他的人记住，但达阵传球将永远留在德克萨斯州的传说中。

paras.en: As Sarkisian and Manning headed towards the Texas end zone to greet the fans who made the chaotic trip to Baton Rouge, you could once again see what once again looked like disbelief come across the face of the starting quarterback.
paras.zh: 当萨尔基西安和曼宁前往德克萨斯端区迎接那些混乱地前往巴吞鲁日的球迷时，你可以再次看到首发四分卫脸上再次出现难以置信的表情。

paras.en: Not that Arch thought he couldn’t do it. But more so, the fact that so many things were not going his way leading up to that final drive.
paras.zh: 阿奇并不是认为他做不到。但更重要的是，事实上，在最后一次驾驶之前，很多事情都没有按照他的意愿进行。

paras.en: "Holy sh-t," Manning proclaimed as he bent over in the end zone during the postgame celebration.
paras.zh: “天哪，”曼宁在赛后庆祝活动中在达阵区弯腰时喊道。

paras.en: On the other hand, LSU finds itself done with any talk of playing in the college football playoff. A roster worth over $40 million will now be sitting at home while others fight for a national championship, to the dismay of Tiger fans that bought into the words of their head coach.
paras.zh: 另一方面，路易斯安那州立大学发现自己不再谈论参加大学橄榄球季后赛。现在，一支价值超过 4000 万美元的阵容将坐在家里，而其他人则为全国冠军而战，这让相信主教练的话的老虎队球迷感到沮丧。

paras.en: Fool you once, shame on you. Fool you four times, you're just out of luck.
paras.zh: 骗你一次，真丢脸。骗你四次，你只是运气不好。

paras.en: Arch Manning delivered a dagger to his home state on Saturday night, just when those around the college football community thought the Longhorns were done in Baton Rouge.
paras.zh: 周六晚上，阿奇·曼宁向他的家乡送出了一把匕首，而此时大学橄榄球界的人们都认为长角牛队在巴吞鲁日已经完蛋了。

paras.en: We got the ending we deserved after sitting through that offensive disaster for nearly an entire game.
paras.zh: 在经历了几乎整场比赛的进攻灾难后，我们得到了应有的结局。

paras.en: For the Texas Longhorns, the season continues and a run towards the college football playoff might have started weeks ago.
paras.zh: 对于德克萨斯长角牛队来说，赛季仍在继续，大学橄榄球季后赛可能在几周前就已经开始了。

paras.en: But tonight inside Tiger Stadium, Arch Manning and Steve Sarkisian dialed up a drive that will be remembered forever in Austin.
paras.zh: 但今晚在老虎体育场内，阿奇·曼宁和史蒂夫·萨尔基西安打出了一记将在奥斯汀永远铭记的球。

paras.en: And, it was the Tigers that brought out another side of a Manning that we have not seen before.
paras.zh: 而且，正是老虎队展现了曼宁的另一面，这是我们以前从未见过的。

paras.en: Texas' season will more than likely continue into late December.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州的产季很可能会持续到 12 月底。

paras.en: Lane Kiffin is going to have a hard time answering this one at the local quarterback club once this season finally ends.
paras.zh: 一旦本赛季最终结束，莱恩·基芬将很难在当地四分卫俱乐部回答这个问题。

articles.title: Anthony Albanese apologises for hot-mic gaffe after Coalition criticises ‘locker-room talk’
articles.author: Tom McIlroy in Manila

paras.en: Anthony Albanese has apologised for a hot-mic gaffe at the UN climate talks in Turkey, saying he regretted being overheard discussing mobile phone radiation and “dicks” in a candid conversation.
paras.zh: 安东尼·艾博尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 为在土耳其举行的联合国气候谈判中的麦克风失态道歉，并表示他很遗憾有人在坦诚的谈话中无意中听到他讨论手机辐射和“鸡巴”。

paras.en: “I of course regret that. I apologise,” Albanese said during a visit to the Australian warship HMAS Stalwart in the Philippines on Sunday.
paras.zh: “我当然对此感到遗憾。我道歉，”阿尔巴内塞周日在菲律宾访问澳大利亚军舰“坚定号”时说道。

paras.en: “This was a private conversation, we thought, between two friends having a bit of light-hearted banter.”
paras.zh: “我们认为，这是一次私人谈话，两个朋友之间有一些轻松的玩笑。”

paras.en: Ahead of a meeting at the Cop31 climate summit in Antalya on Friday, Albanese and the climate change minister, Chris Bowen, were caught on camera discussing which pocket they use to keep their mobile phone.
paras.zh: 周五在安塔利亚举行的第 31 届缔约方会议气候峰会之前，阿尔巴尼斯和气候变化部长克里斯·鲍文 (Chris Bowen) 被镜头拍到讨论他们用哪个口袋来存放手机。

paras.en: Albanese can be heard telling Bowen that he should store his phone away from his heart because “it can interfere with your rhythm”. Laughing, Bowen asks whether the advice was because a phone can be “a little bit radioactive”.
paras.zh: 可以听到阿尔巴尼斯告诉鲍文，他应该把手机放在远离心脏的地方，因为“它会干扰你的节奏”。鲍文笑着问道，这个建议是否是因为手机可能“有一点放射性”。

paras.en: Albanese says “it makes absolute sense”, before Bowen replies that he was more conscious of putting his phone in his pants pocket. The prime minister asks: “Because of your dick?”
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯说“这绝对有道理”，然后鲍文回答说他更自觉地将手机放在裤子口袋里。首相问：“因为你的鸡鸡？”

paras.en: Bowen agrees and says: “Arguably more important than the heart.”
paras.zh: 鲍文对此表示同意并说道：“可以说比心脏更重要。”

paras.en: On Sunday, Albanese played down the incident which occurred ahead of a meeting with business leaders in Antalya.
paras.zh: 周日，阿尔巴内塞淡化了在安塔利亚与商界领袖会面之前发生的事件。

paras.en: “No one was hurt or harmed. We weren’t having private banter which criticised anyone,” he said.
paras.zh: “没有人受伤或受伤。我们没有私下开玩笑批评任何人，”他说。

paras.en: The speedy apology is in contrast to previous gaffes by Albanese, including long-running controversy over comments about the gift of melons from Japan’s prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, on a podcast.
paras.zh: 这次迅速的道歉与阿尔巴内斯之前的失态形成鲜明对比，其中包括因日本首相高市早苗在播客上关于赠送甜瓜的评论而引发的长期争议。

paras.en: Albanese previously apologised for saying he would “shag” Australian singer Kylie Minogue in the same episode of the Bush Deep podcast.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯此前曾因在布什深渊播客的同一集中“与澳大利亚歌手凯莉·米洛发生性关系”而道歉。

paras.en: The melons comment risked becoming an international incident, as Albanese repeatedly insisted the comments and his corresponding hand gestures were not a reference to breasts.
paras.zh: 瓜类的评论有可能成为国际事件，因为阿尔巴尼斯一再坚称这些评论和他相应的手势并不是指乳房。

paras.en: Japan’s government sent a diplomatic cable to Australia in July, days after the podcast originally aired, claiming there had been “sensationalised reporting in the Australian media” and saying they detected no “ill intention” in Albanese’s statement.
paras.zh: 播客最初播出几天后，日本政府于 7 月向澳大利亚发送了一份外交电报，声称“澳大利亚媒体进行了耸人听闻的报道”，并表示他们在阿尔巴内塞的声明中没有发现“恶意”。

paras.en: The Coalition on Sunday criticised Albanese and Bowen’s comments.
paras.zh: 周日，联盟党批评了阿尔巴尼斯和鲍文的言论。

paras.en: Opposition frontbencher James Paterson said the remarks were unfortunate, telling News24 they could damage impressions of Australia on the world stage.
paras.zh: 反对党前座议员詹姆斯·帕特森表示，这些言论很不幸，他告诉 News24，这些言论可能会损害澳大利亚在世界舞台上的印象。

paras.en: “That locker-room talk like that has a time and a place and it’s not at international summits when you’re the prime minister of Australia talking to your energy minister,” he said.
paras.zh: “像这样的更衣室谈话是有时间和地点的，而且不是在国际峰会上，当你作为澳大利亚总理与你的能源部长交谈时，”他说。

paras.en: But the employment minister, Amanda Rishworth, dismissed the criticism, saying the comments were a joke.
paras.zh: 但就业部长阿曼达·里什沃思驳斥了这些批评，称这些评论是一个笑话。

paras.en: “This is a private conversation in between meetings,” she said.
paras.zh: “这是会议间隙的私人谈话，”她说。

paras.en: “I know that a hot-mic incident is very exciting for people ... but really, there are bigger issues to tackle and discuss.”
paras.zh: “我知道热门麦克风事件对人们来说非常令人兴奋......但实际上，还有更大的问题需要解决和讨论。”

paras.en: Earlier a spokesperson for the prime minister said the hot-mic comments were “a joke in between meetings”.
paras.zh: 早些时候，首相发言人表示，这些热议言论是“会议间隙的玩笑”。

paras.en: Albanese is in the Philippines for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit and high-level diplomatic meetings, including with the US president, Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞正在菲律宾参加东南亚国家联盟峰会和高级别外交会议，其中包括与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的会议。

paras.en: He will hold formal bilateral talks with the Filipino president, Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr, on Sunday and visited a Jollibee fast food restaurant to celebrate the chain’s expansion to Australia.
paras.zh: 他将于周日与菲律宾总统小费迪南德·“邦邦”·马科斯举行正式双边会谈，并参观一家快乐蜂快餐店，庆祝该连锁店向澳大利亚扩张。

articles.title: World leaders head to Asia for back-to-back diplomatic summits
articles.author: Oliver Holmes and Rebecca Bailey

paras.en: The global political centre of gravity will be firmly in Asia this week as world leaders fly in for back-to-back high-level summits against the backdrop of the tussle for influence between the superpowers China and the US.
paras.zh: 本周，在超级大国中美争夺影响力的背景下，世界领导人将连续飞来参加高层峰会，全球政治重心将牢牢落在亚洲。

paras.en: Beijing will have the home advantage when it welcomes Donald Trump to its southern technology hub of Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) leaders’ meeting. It starts two weeks after the US leader lost midterm elections.
paras.zh: 当北京欢迎唐纳德·特朗普来到南部科技中心深圳参加亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议时，北京将拥有主场优势。故事始于美国领导人中期选举失败两周后。

paras.en: The summit also comes after an awkward-at-best revelation that the head of Nvidia, the US chipmaker that for a long time was the world’s most valuable company, was having an affair with a woman US intelligence suspects was a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 这次峰会召开之前，还发生了一件尴尬的事情：美国芯片制造商英伟达(Nvidia)的负责人与一名美国情报部门怀疑是中国间谍的女性有染。英伟达是一家长期以来一直是世界上最有价值公司的美国芯片制造商。

paras.en: Apec represents more than 60% of global GDP and has primarily promoted free trade and multilateralism. This year’s meeting could be defined, however, by the confirmed trilateral meeting between Trump, the Chinese president, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin of Russia.
paras.zh: APEC占全球GDP的60%以上，主要推动自由贸易和多边主义。然而，今年的会议可以由特朗普、中国国家主席、习近平和俄罗斯弗拉基米尔·普京之间已确认的三边会议来定义。

paras.en: The three-way meeting has been likened to a modern-day Yalta, when in 1945 then US president, Franklin D Roosevelt, Britain’s Winston Churchill and the Soviet leader Joseph Stalin met in Crimea to carve up Europe after the second world war. However, analysts say a “Yalta 2.0” that issues edicts on Ukraine and Taiwan without their involvement is unlikely.
paras.zh: 这次三方会议被比作现代的雅尔塔，1945 年，时任美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福、英国温斯顿·丘吉尔和苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林在克里米亚会面，瓜分第二次世界大战后的欧洲。然而，分析人士表示，在乌克兰和台湾不参与的情况下颁布针对乌克兰和台湾的法令的“雅尔塔2.0”不太可能出现。

paras.en: Xiaoyu Pu, an associate professor at the University of Nevada’s department of political science, said a three-way meeting “might be more symbolic than substantive, although symbolism itself matters in great-power diplomacy.
paras.zh: 内华达大学政治学系副教授濮晓宇表示，三方会晤“可能更具象征意义，而非实质性意义，尽管象征意义本身在大国外交中很重要。

paras.en: “Trump appears interested in nuclear arms control and denuclearisation. Xi’s priority is likely to maintain a stable relationship with Washington while preserving China’s strategic partnership with Russia. Putin, meanwhile, wants to maintain his bargaining leverage over Ukraine.”
paras.zh: “特朗普似乎对核军控和无核化感兴趣。习近平的首要任务可能是与华盛顿保持稳定的关系，同时维护中国与俄罗斯的战略伙伴关系。与此同时，普京希望保持他在乌克兰问题上的讨价还价筹码。”

paras.en: Apec begins on Wednesday and follows a flurry of other diplomatic gatherings, chief among them the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) meeting in the Philippines, starting on Sunday, which Trump will attend.
paras.zh: 亚太经合组织将于周三开幕，随后还将举行一系列其他外交会议，其中最主要的是将于周日在菲律宾举行的东南亚国家联盟（东盟）会议，特朗普将出席该会议。

paras.en: While he is in Manila, US officials will hold a sidelines meeting of the so-called Quad – Australia, India, Japan and the US. In addition, a Francophone summit, which includes the Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney, and the French president, Emmanuel Macron, is happening concurrently in Cambodia.
paras.zh: 当他在马尼拉期间，美国官员将举行所谓的澳大利亚、印度、日本和美国四方会议的场外会议。此外，包括加拿大总理马克·卡尼和法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在内的法语国家峰会也在柬埔寨同时举行。

paras.en: Critical global issues at all these summits will include AI supply chains and governance, tariff reductions and the green energy transition. Trump’s focus has been on denuclearisation. A key regional focus will be on the South China Sea, where Beijing has built massive military outposts in disputed waters, as well as the gigantic Indonesian forest fire haze blanketing the region.
paras.zh: 所有这些峰会上的关键全球问题将包括人工智能供应链和治理、关税削减和绿色能源转型。特朗普的重点一直是无核化。该地区的一个关键焦点将是南海，北京在有争议的水域建立了大规模的军事前哨，以及覆盖该地区的巨大的印度尼西亚森林火灾烟雾。

paras.en: The humanitarian and security crisis in Myanmar has become a perennial issue, as is status of Taiwan, which China does not recognise. The self-ruled island is sending the founder of the tech hardware company Acer as its envoy to Apec.
paras.zh: 缅甸的人道主义和安全危机已成为一个长期存在的问题，台湾的地位也是如此，中国不承认台湾的地位。这个自治岛屿将派遣科技硬件公司宏碁的创始人作为其出席亚太经合组织的特使。

paras.en: For well over a decade, Washington’s engagement in the region has been coloured by concern over the rise of China, with the then president Barack Obama telling Australia’s parliament in 2011 that the US was “a Pacific power, and we are here to stay” – a policy known as the “pivot to Asia”.
paras.zh: 十多年来，华盛顿在该地区的参与一直受到对中国崛起的担忧影响，时任总统巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 2011 年向澳大利亚议会表示，美国是“太平洋大国，我们将继续留下来” — — 这一政策被称为“重返亚洲”。

paras.en: The strategy of intense diplomacy and trade deals was adopted by Joe Biden, who hoped to gather allies on the continent who wanted to balance their relationships with both superpowers.
paras.zh: 乔·拜登采取了密集外交和贸易协议的策略，他希望聚集非洲大陆上想要平衡与两个超级大国关系的盟友。

paras.en: Some analysts see Trump’s transactional style in Asia as a continuation of the pivot policy. Still, the president’s volatility and unpredictability have spooked smaller nations, who regard China as a more predictable partner.
paras.zh: 一些分析人士认为，特朗普在亚洲的交易风格是战略重心政策的延续。尽管如此，总统的反复无常和不可预测性还是吓坏了小国，这些国家将中国视为更可预测的合作伙伴。

paras.en: Jayant Menon, an economist at Singapore’s Iseas-Yusof Ishak Institute, said that countries in south-east Asia had been “laying the groundwork for a future with reduced dependence on the United States” by seeking deals elsewhere, including with each other and the EU.
paras.zh: 新加坡尤索夫伊萨研究所经济学家贾扬特·梅农(Jayant Menon)表示，东南亚国家一直在通过寻求其他地方的交易，包括相互之间以及与欧盟之间的交易，“为未来减少对美国的依赖奠定基础”。

paras.en: “Amid persistent uncertainty and an administration determined to levy tariffs by any legal means, south-east Asia’s ability to ride out another round of tariffs depends on deeper regional integration and diversification beyond the US market,” he wrote this month in the East Asia Forum.
paras.zh: 他本月在东亚论坛上写道：“在持续的不确定性和政府决心通过任何合法手段征收关税的情况下，东南亚能否安然度过新一轮关税，取决于美国市场以外更深层次的区域一体化和多元化。”

paras.en: Beijing’s more predictable policies do not necessarily make it any more palatable for its regional neighbours, however, and the Chinese premier, Li Qiang, could have tough talks when he goes to Manila for the Asean summit, especially on the South China Sea.
paras.zh: 然而，北京更加可预测的政策并不一定会使其更容易被地区邻国接受，而且中国总理李强在前往马尼拉参加东盟峰会时可能会进行艰难的谈判，特别是在南海问题上。

paras.en: China’s top diplomat, Wang Yi, recently urged Manila to rein in Filipino politicians who he said had repeatedly “smeared” Beijing, after public outcries in the country over the disputed waters.
paras.zh: 中国最高外交官王毅最近敦促马尼拉控制菲律宾政界人士，他称这些政界人士在菲律宾公众对争议海域的抗议后多次“抹黑”北京。

paras.en: Brunei, China, Malaysia, the Philippines, Taiwan and Vietnam have been locked in decades-long territorial standoffs in the busy waterway, which could sit on deposits of oil and gas. Washington has sent military ships on “freedom of navigation operations”, despite Chinese outcries, although US-linked crises in Iran, Ukraine, Venezuela, and Palestine and Israel have sucked up Washington’s focus under Trump’s second term.
paras.zh: 文莱、中国、马来西亚、菲律宾、台湾和越南在这条繁忙的水道上陷入了长达数十年的领土对峙，该水道可能蕴藏着石油和天然气。尽管中国强烈抗议，华盛顿仍派遣军舰进行“航行自由行动”，尽管伊朗、乌克兰、委内瑞拉、巴勒斯坦和以色列等与美国相关的危机已经吸引了特朗普第二任期内华盛顿的注意力。

paras.en: A decades-long attempt to sign a South China Sea pact is not expected to happen at this year’s Asean summit, as previously hoped. Despite monthly meetings, negotiations will have to continue next year, when Asean’s leadership rotates to Singapore.
paras.zh: 长达数十年的签署南海协议的尝试预计不会像之前希望的那样在今年的东盟峰会上发生。尽管每月举行会议，但明年东盟领导层轮流到新加坡时，谈判仍需继续。

paras.en: Diplomats at the Asean summit will also be focusing on Myanmar, which is seeking reintegration. Each country in the group is assessing how to deal with their isolated neighbour. The timing of summits this week coincides with a judgment in the international court of justice on Thursday that could find Myanmar responsible for genocide. The coup leader, Min Aung Hlaing, remains barred from Asean but is allowed to send a representative.
paras.zh: 出席东盟峰会的外交官们还将关注正在寻求重新融入的缅甸。该组织中的每个国家都在评估如何应对其孤立的邻国。本周峰会的时间恰逢国际法院周四做出的判决，该判决可能会认定缅甸应对种族灭绝负责。政变领导人敏昂莱仍被禁止进入东盟，但可以派出一名代表。

paras.en: Asia’s week of diplomacy will be followed next month by the G20 summit in Miami, Florida, which Xi is expected to attend if US and Chinese relations continue to hold steady.
paras.zh: 亚洲外交周结束后，下个月将在佛罗里达州迈阿密举行 G20 峰会，如果中美关系继续保持稳定，预计习近平将出席峰会。

articles.title: Anthony Albanese welcomes Trump-Xi-Putin summit – even as European leaders express reservations
articles.author: Tom McIlroy in Manila

paras.en: Australia has endorsed this week’s historic summit between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in China, even as European leaders warn that the US president must not make major concessions over the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚支持唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京本周在中国举行的历史性峰会，尽管欧洲领导人警告美国总统不得在乌克兰战争问题上做出重大让步。

paras.en: The three-way summit is planned to take place in Shenzhen, where the leaders will gather for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) meeting. Likened to the 1945 summit at Yalta, the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, has warned the talks must not lead to a redistribution of influence among world powers or the abandonment of his country, more than four years into the war sparked by Putin’s full-scale invasion.
paras.zh: 三方峰会计划在深圳举行，领导人将齐聚深圳参加亚太经合组织（APEC）会议。与 1945 年雅尔塔峰会相比，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 警告说，在普京全面入侵引发战争四年多之后，这次会谈绝不能导致世界大国之间影响力的重新分配或放弃乌克兰。

paras.en: Speaking in Manila on Sunday, the Australian prime minister, Anthony Albanese, welcomed the talks taking place but insisted the clear message to Putin was that the war should end.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯周日在马尼拉发表讲话，对会谈的举行表示欢迎，但坚称向普京传达的明确信息是战争应该结束。

paras.en: Albanese, in the Philippines before a meeting of Quad leaders and talks with south-east Asian leaders at the Asean summit, left open the possibility of joining an Apec group photo with Putin if China wished for it to go ahead.
paras.zh: 在四方领导人会议以及东盟峰会上与东南亚领导人举行会谈之前，阿尔巴内塞在菲律宾表示，如果中国希望的话，他有可能与普京一起参加亚太经合组织合影。

paras.en: “We think that dialogue is a good thing and we await the outcome of that dialogue,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们认为对话是一件好事，我们等待对话的结果，”他说。

paras.en: “It’s obviously quite significant, the fact that President Trump will be at Asean as well as at Apec, and that we’ll have a Quad leaders meeting as well.
paras.zh: “这显然非常重要，特朗普总统将出席东盟和亚太经合组织，而且我们还将举行四方领导人会议。

paras.en: “We want to see something constructive come out of that, including we want to see a de-escalation in the conflicts around the world.”
paras.zh: “我们希望看到一些建设性的结果，包括我们希望看到世界各地的冲突缓和。”

paras.en: German’s chancellor, Friedrich Merz, expressed hesitation about the talks at a meeting of EU leaders on Friday.
paras.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨在周五的欧盟领导人会议上对此次谈判表示犹豫。

paras.en: “I want to state our message to the US very clearly once again: please, no surprises,” he said. “Stay on Team Europe and Team Ukraine, and let us work together for a genuine peace in Ukraine.”
paras.zh: “我想再次非常明确地向美国传达我们的信息：请不要感到意外，”他说。 “留在欧洲队和乌克兰队，让我们共同努力实现乌克兰的真正和平。”

paras.en: France’s president, Emmanuel Macron, warned against forcing “an unjust peace” on Ukraine and, by extension, all of Europe.
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙警告不要将“不公正的和平”强加给乌克兰乃至整个欧洲。

paras.en: “That is the spirit of defeat,” Macron said. “That is a recipe for another war.”
paras.zh: “这就是失败精神，”马克龙说。 “这会引发另一场战争。”

paras.en: Zelensky has warned that the meeting must not turn into “Yalta 2, 3, 4”, invoking the conference in Crimea when the then US president, Franklin D Roosevelt, Britain’s Winston Churchill and the Soviet leader Joseph Stalin carved up influence across war-ravaged Europe.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基警告说，这次会议绝不能变成“雅尔塔2、3、4”，他援引了当时的美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林在克里米亚举行的会议，在饱受战争蹂躏的欧洲瓜分影响力。

paras.en: The historian Timothy Garton Ash has called the trilateral summit, organised after a proposal by Putin last month, “a sort of parody” of Yalta, even as analysts say decisions on the future of Ukraine or China’s ambitions to take control of Taiwan without their involvement is unlikely.
paras.zh: 历史学家蒂莫西·加顿·阿什 (Timothy Garton Ash) 称，在普京上个月提议后组织的三边峰会是对雅尔塔的“一种模仿”，尽管分析人士表示，在没有中国参与的情况下，不太可能就乌克兰的未来或中国控制台湾的野心做出决定。

paras.en: Albanese said the summit would not undercut a growing push by countries including Australia and Canada for middle powers to have greater influence in world affairs.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内斯表示，这次峰会不会削弱澳大利亚和加拿大等国家日益推动中等强国在世界事务中发挥更大影响力的努力。

paras.en: “We’ll continue to engage with like-minded countries,” he said. “There are two super powers in the world.
paras.zh: “我们将继续与志同道合的国家接触，”他说。 “世界上有两个超级大国。

paras.en: “What’s important about the struggle of the people of Ukraine is that they’re not just standing up for their own sovereignty; they’re standing up for the international rule of law.”
paras.zh: “乌克兰人民的斗争重要的是，他们不仅维护自己的主权；他们还维护国际法治。”

paras.en: Asked if he would join the so-called “family photo” of Apec leaders if Putin took part, Albanese said he would consider the wishes of China as the host nation. But he said the Russian president should know Australia’s opposition to the invasion.
paras.zh: 当被问及如果普京参加亚太经合组织领导人所谓的“全家福”时，阿尔巴内塞表示，他会考虑东道国中国的意愿。但他表示，俄罗斯总统应该了解澳大利亚对入侵的反对。

paras.en: “If he’s in a room where I am, I’m sure they’ll hear my contribution,” Albanese said.
paras.zh: “如果他和我在一个房间里，我相信他们会听到我的贡献，”阿尔巴内斯说。

paras.en: After the G20 foreign ministers’ meeting, Australia’s Penny Wong joined with European and Canadian counterparts to avoid a group photo. It was cancelled by US officials when a third of participants declined to stand alongside the Russian foreign minister, Sergei Lavrov.
paras.zh: G20外长会议结束后，澳大利亚外长黄英贤与欧洲和加拿大外长一起避免合影。由于三分之一的参与者拒绝与俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫站在一起，美国官员取消了此次活动。

paras.en: Albanese signed a new defence agreement with the Philippines on Sunday, visiting the supply ship HMAS Stalwart in the Port of Manila. Australia is helping to strengthen the Philippines’ defensive capability against Chinese aggression.
paras.zh: 周日，阿尔巴尼斯参观了马尼拉港的“坚定号”补给舰，与菲律宾签署了一项新的防务协议。澳大利亚正在帮助加强菲律宾抵御中国侵略的防御能力。

paras.en: More freedom-of-navigation naval exercises are planned in an attempt to counter Beijing’s efforts to influence the South and East China seas.
paras.zh: 计划举行更多自由航行的海军演习，以对抗北京影响南海和东海的努力。

articles.title: My mother told me I would die if I sought treatment for Ebola - I am proof you can survive

paras.en: When Dr Raymond Kasereka Kamwanga told his family he suspected he had Ebola and was going to a treatment centre in the city of Butembo in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, his family were horrified.
paras.zh: 当雷蒙德·卡塞雷卡·卡姆旺加医生告诉家人他怀疑自己感染了埃博拉病毒并准备前往刚果民主共和国东部布滕博市的一个治疗中心时，他的家人感到震惊。

paras.en: They regarded the specialised unit as a "death house" as not many patients do recover - especially those admitted in the late stages of the illness. His 50-year-old mother was in tears, pleading with him not to go there.
paras.zh: 他们将专门的病房视为“死亡之家”，因为没有多少患者能够康复，尤其是那些在疾病晚期入院的患者。他50岁的母亲泪流满面，恳求他不要去那里。

paras.en: "Why are you choosing to die at the Ebola treatment centre?" Masika Ndungo had asked him.
paras.zh: “你为什么选择死在埃博拉治疗中心？”马西卡·恩东戈问过他。

paras.en: But as a doctor at Butembo's Katwa Hospital, he knew that if stayed at home, he was unlikely to survive.
paras.zh: 但作为布滕博卡瓦医院的医生，他知道如果呆在家里，他不太可能活下来。

paras.en: This was in July, two months after the World Health Organization (WHO) had declared the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo a public health emergency of international concern. Since then 5,400 people have died and 11,000 have been infected, making it the second-most deadly outbreak ever recorded.
paras.zh: 这是在 7 月，也就是世界卫生组织 (WHO) 宣布刚果民主共和国埃博拉疫情为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件两个月后。自那以来，已有 5,400 人死亡，11,000 人被感染，成为有记录以来第二致命的疫情。

paras.en: Butembo is in North Kivu province, the epicentre of the crisis, with the highest number of reported cases, according to the Congolese health ministry.
paras.zh: 据刚果卫生部称，布滕博位于北基伍省，是危机的中心，报告病例数最多。

paras.en: Dr Kamwanga is one of 3,031 people who have survived - and is evangelical about sharing his story in an effort to help stop the spread of infections devastating his community.
paras.zh: Kamwanga 博士是 3,031 名幸存者中的一员，他乐于分享自己的故事，以帮助阻止感染的蔓延，从而摧毁他的社区。

paras.en: After staring death in the face and overcoming ostracisation, he has even started writing a book about his experience.
paras.zh: 在直面死亡并克服排斥之后，他甚至开始写一本关于他的经历的书。

paras.en: "As someone who has recovered, I am living proof that the disease exists, but also that it is possible to recover from it," he tells the BBC outside Katwa Hospital where he still works.
paras.zh: “作为一个已经康复的人，我是这种疾病存在的活生生的证据，而且也是可以康复的，”他在卡瓦医院外告诉英国广播公司，他仍然在那里工作。

paras.en: The 30-year-old medic believes he contracted the virus through contact with a patient in a setting where protective measures are not always adequate.
paras.zh: 这位 30 岁的医生认为，他是通过在防护措施并不总是充分的环境中与患者接触而感染病毒的。

paras.en: The first symptoms appeared gradually: a bitter taste in his mouth, headaches and a general feeling of malaise. He contacted the Ebola response team.
paras.zh: 最初的症状逐渐出现：口苦、头痛和全身不适。他联系了埃博拉应对小组。

paras.en: After an initial consultation and some tests, he returned home, but his condition did not improve.
paras.zh: 经过初步咨询和一些检查后，他回到家中，但病情没有改善。

paras.en: Butembo does not have the equipment to quickly test for Ebola - samples need to be sent to the city of Beni, 54km (33 miles) north.
paras.zh: 布滕博没有快速检测埃博拉病毒的设备 - 样本需要送往北部 54 公里（33 英里）的贝尼市。

paras.en: This delays diagnosis as the condition of roads in this war-torn and underdeveloped part of DR Congo means it can take between 48 and 72 hours to travel even this relatively short distance.
paras.zh: 这会延误诊断，因为刚果民主共和国饱受战争蹂躏且欠发达地区的道路状况意味着，即使是相对较短的距离，也可能需要 48 至 72 小时才能行驶。

paras.en: After three days at home, Kamwanga felt extremely weak and experienced muscle pain. On the fourth day, he began vomiting and had diarrhoea.
paras.zh: 在家三天后，卡姆万加感到极度虚弱并出现肌肉疼痛。第四天，他开始呕吐、腹泻。

paras.en: This is when he gathered his family members - including his mother - to tell them he had to go to the Ebola treatment centre.
paras.zh: 这时，他召集了包括他母亲在内的家人，告诉他们他必须去埃博拉治疗中心。

paras.en: "She had started crying, along with my sisters. I told them everything would be alright, that I was a doctor and that I was confident. But they weren't reassured," he says.
paras.zh: “她和我的姐妹们一起哭了。我告诉她们一切都会好起来的，我是一名医生，我很自信。但她们并没有放心，”他说。

paras.en: Around 18:00, he set off on foot to the nearby centre but refused to use the main entrance.
paras.zh: 18:00左右，他步行前往附近的中心，但拒绝使用正门。

paras.en: He called his colleagues and asked them to put on their protective gear before they approached him and isolated him. The virus spreads from one person to another by contact with infected bodily fluids.
paras.zh: 他打电话给同事，要求他们穿上防护装备，然后才接近他并隔离他。病毒通过接触受感染的体液从一个人传播到另一个人。

paras.en: The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment.
paras.zh: 目前的疫情是由本迪布焦病毒引起的，目前尚无批准的疫苗或治疗方法。

paras.en: "The treatment given to Ebola patients is symptomatic - meaning that doctors treat the symptoms the patient presents," says Kamwanga, explaining that in his case it was severe vomiting and diarrhoea.
paras.zh: 卡姆旺加说：“对埃博拉患者的治疗是针对症状的，这意味着医生会根据患者出现的症状进行治疗。”他解释说，在他的病例中，症状是严重呕吐和腹泻。

paras.en: In some patients these symptoms can lead to organ failure and then some develop internal and external bleeding.
paras.zh: 在一些患者中，这些症状可能导致器官衰竭，然后一些患者会出现内出血和外出血。

paras.en: Kamwanga lost a lot of fluid and struggled to stay hydrated - he was terrified.
paras.zh: 卡姆万加失去了大量液体，并努力保持水分——他很害怕。

paras.en: "I was afraid for myself. Every day, patients were dying right before my eyes. But I stayed positive," he explains.
paras.zh: “我为自己担心。每天，病人就在我眼前死去。但我保持乐观，”他解释道。

paras.en: Over 13 days lying in his hospital bed, he tried to keep his spirits up by watching movies and TV shows on his phone, reading and scrolling through TikTok.
paras.zh: 躺在医院病床上的 13 天多里，他通过手机看电影和电视节目、阅读和浏览 TikTok 来试图保持精神振奋。

paras.en: The day he learned he had recovered, Kamwanga felt immense relief. He thanked the healthcare workers who had cared for him.
paras.zh: 当得知自己康复的那一天，卡姆万加感到无比轻松。他感谢一直以来照顾他的医护人员。

paras.en: However, even a certificate showing he was Ebola-free did not initially dispel the unease those around him felt after he was discharged.
paras.zh: 然而，即使是一份证明他没有感染埃博拉病毒的证书，最初也未能消除他出院后周围人的不安。

paras.en: "We welcomed him home warmly. But because of our fear, we didn't get close to him any more," Ndungo, his mother, tells the BBC.
paras.zh: “我们热情地欢迎他回家。但由于我们的恐惧，我们不再接近他，”他的母亲恩东戈告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: For 21 days - the incubation period of the virus - the doctor lived separately in another part of the family home, which was crowded at the time with at least 18 people living there, including several children and people displaced by recent fighting in the region.
paras.zh: 在病毒潜伏期的 21 天里，这位医生单独住在家里的另一部分，当时那里挤满了至少 18 人，其中包括几名儿童和因该地区最近的战斗而流离失所的人。

paras.en: He would only see them from afar when he went to pick up his meal, while other family members kept their distance.
paras.zh: 他只有去取饭的时候才能远远地看到他们，其他家人都保持着距离。

paras.en: Neighbour Kavugho Sifa shared these concerns.
paras.zh: 邻居 Kavugho Sifa 也有同样的担忧。

paras.en: "We were really afraid, but we prayed to God to protect him at the treatment centre. With God's help and the doctors' efforts, we saw him return in good health," she tells the BBC.
paras.zh: “我们真的很害怕，但我们在治疗中心向上帝祈祷保护他。在上帝的帮助和医生的努力下，我们看到他健康地康复了，”她告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: They all agree the experience changed their perception of Ebola.
paras.zh: 他们都同意这次经历改变了他们对埃博拉病毒的看法。

paras.en: Some do not believe the disease even exists - Ndungo says that witnessing Ebola first-hand helped to dispel some of that misinformation.
paras.zh: 有些人甚至不相信这种疾病存在——恩邓戈说，亲眼目睹埃博拉病毒有助于消除一些错误信息。

paras.en: After his recovery, Kamwanga threw himself into community outreach - sharing his story as a way of combatting rumours and mistrust.
paras.zh: 康复后，卡姆万加投身于社区外展活动，分享他的故事，以此作为对抗谣言和不信任的一种方式。

paras.en: "I started writing my book - The Price of Saving Lives - one week after recovering and leaving the hospital," he says. "However, it is not finished yet. What I currently use during my awareness-raising activities is the draft, and it is already making a significant impact."
paras.zh: “我在康复出院一周后开始写我的书《拯救生命的代价》，”他说。 “但是，它还没有完成。我目前在提高认识活动中使用的是草案，它已经产生了重大影响。”

paras.en: During these sessions, he also distributes photos taken while he was sick to help convince residents that Ebola is real.
paras.zh: 在这些会议期间，他还分发了他生病时拍摄的照片，以帮助让居民相信埃博拉病毒是真实的。

paras.en: But in Butembo, this mission remains difficult. Kamwanga explains that some people view awareness campaigns as a way for humanitarian organisations to profit from donor funding.
paras.zh: 但在布滕博，这项任务仍然艰巨。卡姆万加解释说，有些人将提高认识活动视为人道主义组织从捐助者资金中获利的一种方式。

paras.en: Such mistrust, which is also levelled at healthcare professionals, is often fuelled by poverty and trauma related to years of armed conflict, he says.
paras.zh: 他说，这种不信任也存在于医疗保健专业人员身上，而这种不信任往往是由于多年武装冲突造成的贫困和创伤而加剧的。

paras.en: "Ebola has come alongside the war," he says, explaining that some even interpret it as a way for those in authority to threaten a vulnerable population "to finish off those whom the war failed to exterminate".
paras.zh: 他说：“埃博拉病毒是伴随着战争而来的。”他解释说，有些人甚至将其解读为当权者威胁弱势群体的一种方式，“以消灭那些战争未能消灭的人”。

paras.en: He also believes that the number of deaths observed during epidemics - compared to recoveries, which are sometimes less visible - reinforce fear and suspicion.
paras.zh: 他还认为，与有时不太明显的康复人数相比，流行病期间观察到的死亡人数加剧了恐惧和怀疑。

paras.en: But putting himself on the front line also comes with risks - and Kamwanga says he receives death threats on his phone.
paras.zh: 但让自己站在第一线也伴随着风险——卡姆万加说，他在手机上收到了死亡威胁。

paras.en: Some residents accuse him of being paid to spread information about Ebola. He also reports that outreach workers have been attacked by members of the community.
paras.zh: 一些居民指责他收受报酬传播有关埃博拉病毒的信息。他还报告说，外展工作人员遭到了社区成员的袭击。

paras.en: He feels the authorities do not work effectively to address all these problems: "Our government is taking things lightly."
paras.zh: 他认为当局没有有效地解决所有这些问题：“我们的政府对事情掉以轻心。”

paras.en: He agrees too with the recent report by MÃ©decins Sans FrontiÃ¨res (MSF) that Ebola funds are going missing.
paras.zh: 他也同意无国界医生组织 (MSF) 最近的报告，即埃博拉资金正在失踪。

paras.en: "The money allocated to the Ebola response is being misappropriated by the government. We do not have enough protective equipment," the medic says.
paras.zh: “分配给埃博拉应对工作的资金被政府挪用。我们没有足够的防护设备，”这名医生说。

paras.en: The BBC has asked the Congolese government for comment.
paras.zh: BBC 已要求刚果政府发表评论。

paras.en: Despite the intimidation and the obstacles he and other medics face, he remains determined - his goal is to help put an end to the disease.
paras.zh: 尽管他和其他医务人员面临恐吓和障碍，但他仍然坚定不移——他的目标是帮助终结这种疾病。

paras.en: "Should we give up the fight against Ebola? No. We continue to do what we can with the resources available to us, which are unfortunately very limited."
paras.zh: “我们应该放弃抗击埃博拉病毒吗？不。我们将继续利用现有资源尽我们所能，但不幸的是，这些资源非常有限。”

articles.title: Pope Leo speaks of community 'suffering' on visit to remote Andes town

paras.en: On a visit to an isolated Andean village in his former diocese, Pope Leo XIV has spoken about the "suffering of those who are forced to leave their homeland in search of a better future", which he said had left communities under threat.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世在访问其前教区的一个偏僻的安第斯村庄时谈到了“那些被迫离开家园寻找更美好未来的人们的痛苦”，他说这使社区受到威胁。

paras.en: About 6,000 people live in Santa Cruz de Succhabamba, which is located in a remote part of the Andes mountains in northern Peru, but the Pope's visit drew a crowd of about 20,000, according to the Vatican.
paras.zh: 据梵蒂冈称，位于秘鲁北部安第斯山脉偏远地区的圣克鲁斯德苏恰班巴约有 6,000 人居住，但教皇的访问吸引了约 20,000 人。

paras.en: At an outdoor Mass, Pope Leo spoke of "declining birth rates that are emptying villages," and the unequal distribution of the land's resources.
paras.zh: 在一次户外弥撒中，教皇利奥谈到了“出生率下降导致村庄空无一人”以及土地资源分配不均。

paras.en: Over 40% of the population in the Cajamarca region, where the town is located, live in poverty - the highest figure in Peru, according to official data.
paras.zh: 根据官方数据，该镇所在的卡哈马卡地区超过 40% 的人口生活在贫困之中，这一数字在秘鲁是最高的。

paras.en: Cajamarca has lost the highest number of people to internal migration, with 729,000 people born there now living elsewhere in Peru.
paras.zh: 卡哈马卡因国内移民而流失的人口数量最多，有 729,000 名在那里出生的人现在居住在秘鲁其他地方。

paras.en: In his sermon, Pope Leo thanked those who had made the journey to him and emphasised the importance of never losing heart, despite life's difficulties.
paras.zh: 在布道中，教皇利奥感谢那些前来拜访他的人，并强调尽管生活困难，但永不灰心的重要性。

paras.en: Santa Cruz is within the Diocese of Chiclayo, where Pope Leo served as bishop from 2015 to 2023. During his tenure, he visited Santa Cruz several times a year to minister to the town's rural population.
paras.zh: 圣克鲁斯位于奇克拉约教区，教皇利奥于 2015 年至 2023 年间担任该教区的主教。在他任职期间，他每年多次访问圣克鲁斯，为该镇的农村人口服务。

paras.en: On Saturday he returned by helicopter, where he was greeted by singing and cheering. He later did a tour in a popemobile, where he waved to people who had travelled from across the region to see him.
paras.zh: 周六，他乘坐直升机返回，迎接他的是歌声和欢呼声。后来，他乘坐教皇专车进行了巡演，向来自该地区各地来看望他的人们挥手致意。

paras.en: Speaking at a local parish on Saturday, the Pope said he felt "joy" at being able to visit the small town once again.
paras.zh: 教皇周六在当地一个教区发表讲话时表示，他对能够再次访问这座小镇感到“高兴”。

paras.en: "It is like a very big dream that the Lord has allowed this servant to come here," he said.
paras.zh: “主允许这个仆人来到这里，这就像一个非常大的梦想，”他说。

paras.en: Rev. Kevin Noriega, who was ordained in 2018 by the then-bishop, told Reuters the visit had brought "enormous hope and emotion" to Santa Cruz.
paras.zh: 凯文·诺列加 (Kevin Noriega) 牧师于 2018 年被时任主教任命，他告诉路透社，这次访问给圣克鲁斯带来了“巨大的希望和情感”。

paras.en: He said: "People are eager to experience this Holy Mass ... because after so much time they will be able to see their bishop - 'Father Robert,' as they used to call him - now as the Holy Father."
paras.zh: 他说：“人们渴望体验这场弥撒……因为经过这么长时间，他们将能够见到他们的主教——‘罗伯特神父’，就像他们以前那样称呼他——现在是圣父。”

paras.en: Peru is the longest stop on the first tour of Latin America by the leader of the Catholic church, who was elected in May 2025.
paras.zh: 秘鲁是2025年5月当选的天主教会领袖首次拉丁美洲之行的最长一站。

paras.en: The 12-day trip has included stops in Argentina and Uruguay, but his time in Peru carries personal significance.
paras.zh: 为期 12 天的行程包括在阿根廷和乌拉圭停留，但他在秘鲁的经历具有个人意义。

paras.en: The US-born pope not only lived in Peru for long periods between 1985 and 2023 but also became a citizen of the country in 2015, forging close ties with local communities.
paras.zh: 这位出生于美国的教皇不仅在1985年至2023年期间长期居住在秘鲁，而且于2015年成为秘鲁公民，与当地社区建立了密切的联系。

paras.en: The pontiff is set to leave Chiclayo on Sunday, when he will head to Cusco, and then on to a Peruvian sector of the Amazon rainforest. His tour of the region will conclude on Monday, at which point Pope Leo will return to Rome.
paras.zh: 教皇定于周日离开奇克拉约，前往库斯科，然后前往秘鲁的亚马逊雨林地区。他对该地区的访问将于周一结束，届时教皇利奥将返回罗马。

articles.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from closing Washington DC golf course for renovation

paras.en: A federal judge has temporarily blocked the US government's closure of a historic golf course and park in Washington DC.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官暂时阻止美国政府关闭华盛顿特区一座历史悠久的高尔夫球场和公园。

paras.en: US District Judge Ana Reyes has been overseeing a months-long challenge to the president's plans for East Potomac Golf Links, which he said would be closed from 15 November for extensive renovations.
paras.zh: 美国地区法官安娜·雷耶斯 (Ana Reyes) 一直在监督对总统东波托马克高尔夫球场计划的长达数月的挑战，他表示东波托马克高尔夫球场将从 11 月 15 日起关闭，进行大规模翻修。

paras.en: Reyes has said Donald Trump cannot close the park or its golf course, but added that his administration was not required to actively manage either.
paras.zh: 雷耶斯表示，唐纳德·特朗普不能关闭公园或其高尔夫球场，但他补充说，他的政府不需要积极管理。

paras.en: Trump, an avid golfer, has said his plans to upgrade the 106-year-old course will create "one of the Best and Most Spectacular Golf Courses anywhere in the World". The BBC has contacted the White House for comment.
paras.zh: 特朗普是一名狂热的高尔夫球手，他表示，他计划升级这座拥有 106 年历史的球场，将打造“世界上最好、最壮观的高尔夫球场之一”。 BBC 已联系白宫请其置评。

paras.en: Declaring the current course "Trash Island", he announced in October it would be renovated over 15 months to create a space that "will be open to the Public while, at the same time, designed to the Highest Level of Golf and able to hold World Class Tournaments" - despite the ongoing litigation.
paras.zh: 他在 10 月份宣布当前的球场为“垃圾岛”，并宣布将在 15 个月内进行翻修，以打造一个“向公众开放，同时设计用于最高水平的高尔夫并能够举办世界级锦标赛”的空间——尽管诉讼仍在进行中。

paras.en: In a 30-page decision issued on Saturday, Reyes said the Trump administration's justifications for the proposed course closures were pretextual, and that the government violated at least two federal laws "to meet an arbitrary deadline."
paras.zh: 在周六发布的一份长达 30 页的决定中，雷耶斯表示，特朗普政府提议关闭课程的理由是借口，政府“为了在任意期限内完成任务”违反了至少两项联邦法律。

paras.en: "The Government proposes to close a historic park, daily enjoyed by Washingtonians of all stripes, indefinitely," Reyes wrote.
paras.zh: 雷耶斯写道：“政府提议无限期关闭一座历史悠久的公园，华盛顿各种阶层的人每天都可以享受这个公园。”

paras.en: She said the closure "runs counter to the public interest in utilising national parkland", adding that the government had not "plausibly identified any harm it would suffer from a temporary restraining order that preserves the status quo pending further proceedings".
paras.zh: 她表示，关闭“与公众利用国家公园的利益背道而驰”，并补充说，政府尚未“合理地确定在进一步诉讼期间维持现状的临时限制令会对其造成任何损害”。

paras.en: Her order will last until the 28 November.
paras.zh: 她的订单将持续到11月28日。

paras.en: The legal dispute dates back to February, when the DC Preservation League and others sued over redevelopment plans for the park.
paras.zh: 这场法律纠纷可以追溯到二月份，当时华盛顿特区保护联盟和其他组织就公园的重建计划提起诉讼。

paras.en: The historic course, which sits 2 miles (3km) south of the White House, is one of three public courses run by the National Park Service in the nation's capital.
paras.zh: 这座历史悠久的球场位于白宫以南 2 英里（3 公里）处，是国家公园管理局在美国首都运营的三个公共球场之一。

paras.en: The legal fight then escalated in October, when the NPS began to cut down hundreds of trees without notifying Reyes until 15 hours before work was set to begin.
paras.zh: 10 月份，法律斗争升级，NPS 开始砍伐数百棵树，但直到开工前 15 小时才通知雷耶斯。

paras.en: After the trees were cut, Reyes ordered the Trump administration to stop tree removal until at least 26 October and give her three business days' notice about making any other permanent changes.
paras.zh: 树木被砍伐后，雷耶斯命令特朗普政府至少在 10 月 26 日之前停止砍伐树木，并提前三个工作日通知她做出任何其他永久性改变。

paras.en: Despite the work stoppage, Trump announced that the course would be closed for 15 months from 15 November to accommodate the renovations. He also shared a rendering of the course redesign.
paras.zh: 尽管停工，特朗普还是宣布球场将从 11 月 15 日起关闭 15 个月，以适应翻修工程。他还分享了课程重新设计的效果图。

paras.en: "The current Course is old, broken, dilapidated, and of no further use or effect. It is in very poor condition, with falling, dangerous, and disease-infested trees and, importantly, a collapsing and hazardous seawall," he said in a post to Truth Social.
paras.zh: 他在《Truth Social》的一篇帖子中表示：“目前的球场陈旧、破损、破旧，没有进一步的用途或影响。它的状况非常糟糕，有倒塌、危险和疾病肆虐的树木，更重要的是，还有倒塌和危险的海堤。”

paras.en: Reyes has since separately opened an inquiry into whether the justice department attorneys "have made misrepresentations to the court and otherwise violated ethical rules".
paras.zh: 此后，雷耶斯单独启动调查，调查司法部律师是否“向法院做出了虚假陈述并违反了道德规则”。

paras.en: That included whether giving late notice to the court about the renovation plans was "done in bad faith" and whether the attorneys failed to correct previously false statements or withheld information.
paras.zh: 其中包括向法院迟交有关翻修计划的通知是否“恶意”，以及律师是否未能纠正之前的虚假陈述或隐瞒信息。

paras.en: She said she would carry out the inquiry with a special master, an independent third party.
paras.zh: 她表示，她将由一位特别的大师（独立的第三方）进行调查。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.

A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.

To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
