paras.en: The 2026 Kids’ Choice Awards lineup is bringing plenty of musical energy to the slime-filled stage. Jamie Miller will open the show with his viral hit “Babydoll,” while singer-songwriter Ashe will perform “Stop the Wedding!” Electronic music duo Sofi Tukker will also take the stage with their dance anthem “Tsunami,” a collaboration with Ryan Tedder. Hosted by Alex Warren, the ceremony will also feature special appearances from Antonio Cipriano and Victoria Justice during Miller’s opening performance.
paras.zh: 2026 年儿童选择奖阵容为充满粘液的舞台带来了充足的音乐能量。杰米·米勒 (Jamie Miller) 将以他的热门歌曲《Babydoll》拉开演出序幕，创作型歌手阿什 (Ashe) 将演唱《Stop the Wedding!》电子音乐二人组 Sofi Tukker 也将登台表演与 Ryan Tedder 合作的舞曲《Tsunami》。颁奖典礼由亚历克斯·沃伦 (Alex Warren) 主持，安东尼奥·西普里亚诺 (Antonio Cipriano) 和维多利亚·贾斯蒂斯 (Victoria Justice) 也将在米勒的开场表演中特别亮相。

articles.title: Simple Plan, Hoobastank & More Take Warped Tour Mid-Flight Amid FAA Ground Stop
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Several artists from this year’s Vans Warped Tour lineup gave passengers an unexpected in-flight concert en route to Orlando, Florida.
paras.zh: 今年 Vans Warped Tour 阵容中的几位艺术家在飞往佛罗里达州奥兰多的途中为乘客带来了一场意想不到的机上音乐会。

paras.en: On Friday (Nov. 13), Simple Plan, Hoobastank, The Used and LØLØ performed aboard a Southwest Airlines flight from Los Angeles to Orlando as an FAA ground stop halted departures across the country. The artists were headed to the city for Vans Warped Tour’s Saturday (Nov. 14) date at Camping World Stadium.
paras.zh: 周五（11 月 13 日），Simple Plan、Hoobastank、TheUsed 和 LØLØ 在西南航空从洛杉矶飞往奥兰多的航班上进行了表演，因为美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 地面站暂停了全国各地的航班。艺术家们前往该市参加周六（11 月 14 日）在露营世界体育场举行的 Vans Warped Tour 约会。

paras.en: Videos shared by passengers captured Hoobastank frontman Doug Robb performing an acoustic version of the band’s hit “The Reason,” which peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2004.
paras.zh: 乘客分享的视频显示，Hoobastank 主唱道格·罗伯 (Doug Robb) 表演了该乐队热门单曲《The Reason》的原声版本，该歌曲在 2004 年公告牌百强单曲榜上最高排名第二。

paras.en: “I’ve always said @hoobastank is one of the best live acts on the planet,” one person wrote over a clip on Instagram. “This is what they sound like over airplane speakers. Insane!”
paras.zh: “我一直说@hoobastank 是地球上最好的现场表演之一，”一个人在 Instagram 上的一段视频中写道。 “这就是飞机扬声器发出的声音。太疯狂了！”

paras.en: Simple Plan frontman Pierre Bouvier also performed acoustic versions of “Perfect” and “I’m Just a Kid.” The Used played “The Taste of Ink,” while LØLØ performed her track “hot girls in hell.”
paras.zh: Simple Plan 主唱 Pierre Bouvier 还表演了原声版本的“Perfect”和“I'm Just a Kid”。 The Use 演奏了《The Taste of Ink》，而 LØLØ 则演奏了她的歌曲《hot girls in hell》。

paras.en: Southwest shared several clips from the performance on its Instagram Stories. The concert was part of the airline’s Live at 35 series, which brings surprise live musical performances to passengers at a cruising altitude of approximately 35,000 feet.
paras.zh: 西南航空在其 Instagram Stories 上分享了演出的几个片段。这场音乐会是该航空公司“Live at 35”系列活动的一部分，该系列活动为在大约 35,000 英尺的巡航高度上的乘客带来惊喜的现场音乐表演。

paras.en: “Group therapy but it’s just singing perfect with Simple Plan on a plane,” another person wrote over a video of the band’s performance on Instagram, adding the caption, “Live at 35 is the best kind of therapy.”
paras.zh: 另一位网友在 Instagram 上的一段乐队表演视频中写道：“团体治疗，但在飞机上用 Simple Plan 唱歌就很完美了。”并加上了标题，“35 岁的生活是最好的治疗。”

paras.en: An influencer’s video also showed some of the activities passengers enjoyed before boarding, including airport photo opportunities, karaoke and meet-and-greets at the gate. Warped Tour-branded goodie bags were waiting on passengers’ seats before the surprise performances began at cruising altitude.
paras.zh: 一位网红的视频还展示了乘客在登机前享受的一些活动，包括机场拍照机会、卡拉 OK 和登机口的见面会。在巡航高度的惊喜表演开始之前，扭曲的巡回赛品牌礼品袋已经在乘客座位上等待着。

paras.en: Launched in 2011, Southwest’s Live at 35 series has featured several notable acts over the years, including Imagine Dragons, Barenaked Ladies, Plain White T’s, NEEDTOBREATHE, O.A.R. and Better Than Ezra.
paras.zh: 西南航空的 Live at 35 系列于 2011 年推出，多年来邀请了多位知名艺人，包括 Imagine Dragons、Barenaked Ladies、Plain White T’s、NEEDTOBREATHE、O.A.R.比以斯拉更好。

paras.en: The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop Friday, grounding flights for more than four hours and contributing to more than 12,500 cancellations across Friday and Saturday. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy attributed the disruption to outdated air traffic control technology and overloaded equipment, according to ABC News.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 周五在全国范围内发布了停飞令，导致航班停飞四个多小时，导致周五和周六超过 12,500 架次航班取消。据美国广播公司新闻报道，交通部长肖恩·达菲将这次中断归因于过时的空中交通管制技术和超载的设备。

paras.en: Vans Warped Tour Orlando is scheduled for Saturday, with performances by Simple Plan, Sublime, Third Eye Blind, 311, Hoobastank and others. Sunday’s lineup includes Jimmy Eat World, Taking Back Sunday, New Found Glory, The Used and Motion City Soundtrack.
paras.zh: Vans Warped Tour Orlando 定于周六举行，届时将有 Simple Plan、Sublime、Third Eye Blind、311、Hoobastank 等乐队的表演。周日的节目包括《Jimmy Eat World》、《Taking Back Sunday》、《New Found Glory》、《Theused》和《Motion City Soundtrack》。

paras.en: On Saturday morning, Warped Tour founder Kevin Lyman shared a video on Instagram discussing how the FAA ground stop could impact the festival weekend.
paras.zh: 周六早上，Warped Tour 创始人凯文·莱曼 (Kevin Lyman) 在 Instagram 上分享了一段视频，讨论美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 地面站对周末音乐节的影响。

paras.en: “We will have a few bands cancelling and we will be updating you on that,” Lyman said. “Not as many as we thought because the bands are working hard to change their flights. Some bands have jumped in vans and [are] driving from as far away as Chicago and Houston.
paras.zh: “我们将有一些乐队取消演出，我们将向您通报最新情况，”莱曼说。 “没有我们想象的那么多，因为乐队正在努力改变他们的航班。一些乐队已经跳上面包车，从遥远的芝加哥和休斯顿开车过来。

paras.en: He continued, “We’re going to push some bands that were playing today, [they] will be playing on Sunday. We’ve extended the sets out and giving bands more time to play. Bear with us. We’re all working hard.”
paras.zh: 他继续说道，“我们将推动一些今天演出的乐队，他们将在周日演出。我们已经延长了演出时间，给了乐队更多的演奏时间。请耐心等待。我们都在努力工作。”

articles.title: L.A.’s Most Celebrated French Chef Is Staging a Comeback
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: Ludo Lefebvre’s French accent hasn’t thinned much since the Burgundian’s arrival in Los Angeles three decades ago. Within a year of joining L’Orangerie, then the city’s finest temple of haute cuisine, in the mid-’90s, he had become its head chef at 25 years old, serving the likes of Kirk Douglas, Frank Sinatra and Michael Jackson. Soon his talent, charm and looks catapulted him to industry awards as well as TV, including several seasons of ABC’s The Taste alongside Anthony Bourdain and Nigella Lawson, plus cookbooks like Crave, featuring a mix of recipes and chiseled pecs.
paras.zh: 自从勃艮第人三十年前抵达洛杉矶以来，卢多·列斐伏尔的法国口音并没有减弱多少。 20 世纪 90 年代中期，25 岁​​的他加入了当时这座城市最好的高级美食殿堂 L’Orangerie，不到一年，就成为了该店的主厨，为柯克·道格拉斯 (Kirk Douglas)、弗兰克·辛纳屈 (Frank Sinatra) 和迈克尔·杰克逊 (Michael Jackson) 等明星提供服务。很快，他的才华、魅力和外表让他获得了行业奖项和电视节目，其中包括与安东尼·波登 (Anthony Bourdain) 和奈杰拉·劳森 (Nigella Lawson) 合作的美国广播公司 (ABC) 的《品味》(The Taste) 的几季，以及像《Crave》这样的烹饪书，其中混合了食谱和轮廓分明的胸肌。

paras.en: “L’Orangerie, I’ll never forget,” says Lisa Kudrow. “My husband’s French, and his parents were visiting when we went. He was so young and good-looking — I gasped. And, of course, the food was absolutely thrilling — just unbelievably good.”
paras.zh: “橙园，我永远不会忘记，”丽莎·库卓说。 “我丈夫是法国人，我们去的时候他的父母正在来看望他。他是如此年轻，又如此英俊——我倒吸了一口冷气。当然，食物绝对令人兴奋——好吃得令人难以置信。”

paras.en: After L’Orangerie, Lefebvre became L.A.’s pioneering practitioner of molecular gastronomy at Bastide. “Ludo was way, way, way ahead of his time, doing things like a deconstructed Bloody Mary, or foie gras lollipops, or mustard ice cream,” explains its owner, film and TV commercial director Joe Pytka. Later, Lefebvre legitimized pop-up dining with his roving, nationally acclaimed LudoBites dinners. “He brought this creative energy and nomadic spirit and classical training to places that had never seen it before,” says chef and restaurateur Jon Shook, who later partnered with him on the bistro Petit Trois (there are now locations in Hollywood and the Valley) and the since-shuttered avant-garde endeavor Trois Mec.
paras.zh: 继《橘园》之后，列斐伏尔成为洛杉矶巴斯蒂德分子美食的先驱实践者。 “Ludo 远远、远远、远远领先于他的时代，它所做的事情包括解构的血腥玛丽、鹅肝棒棒糖或芥末冰淇淋，”它的所有者、电影和电视广告导演乔·皮特卡 (Joe Pytka) 解释道。后来，列斐伏尔推出了享誉全国的巡回演出 LudoBites 晚餐，使快闪餐厅合法化。 “他将这种创造力、游牧精神和古典训练带到了以前从未见过的地方，”厨师兼餐厅老板乔恩·舒克 (Jon Shook) 说道，他后来与他合作开设了小酒馆 Petit Trois（现在在好莱坞和硅谷都有分店）以及后来关闭的前卫餐厅 Trois Mec。

paras.en: French food is no longer peerless in L.A.’s now-pluralistic fine dining scene, in which the most buzzed-about restaurants are riffing on Swedish, Korean and Mexican traditions. Compatriots such as Michel Richard and Alain Giraud once had the city saying oui, along with the town’s superstar French-trained chefs like Thomas Keller and Wolfgang Puck.
paras.zh: 在如今多元化的洛杉矶美食界，法国美食不再是无与伦比的，其中最热闹的餐厅都在模仿瑞典、韩国和墨西哥的传统。米歇尔·理查德 (Michel Richard) 和阿兰·吉罗 (Alain Giraud) 等同胞以及托马斯·凯勒 (Thomas Keller) 和沃尔夫冈·帕克 (Wolfgang Puck) 等受过法国培训的超级明星厨师都曾经让这座城市说“oui”。

paras.en: “I’m the last Jedi,” jokes the famously intense Lefebvre, who apprenticed under French masters including Alain Passard, Guy Martin and Pierre Gagnaire. Notes chef and restaurateur Nancy Silverton: “There are just so few people, particularly in Los Angeles, who have his knowledge. He really is the last of it — and yet he’s still doing it.”
paras.zh: “我是最后一个绝地武士，”以热情着称的列斐伏尔开玩笑说，他曾师从阿兰·帕萨德、盖伊·马丁和皮埃尔·加涅尔等法国大师。主厨兼餐馆老板南希·西尔弗顿 (Nancy Silverton) 指出：“只有很少的人，特别是在洛杉矶，拥有他的知识。他确实是最后一个——但他仍在这样做。”

paras.en: Lefebvre, now graying and mellowed, is on the verge of opening several fresh French concepts, including Hancock Park’s Le Petit Den, a glammed-up Chinese place inspired by Paris’ Yam’tcha and Le Cheval d’Or, where he’ll be serving such dishes as fried rice with bone marrow, orange chicken sweetbread and fried wonton boudin noir. (Lefebvre’s restaurant group also includes outposts in Denver, Dallas and Baja California — plus stalls in L.A.’s Crypto.com Arena.)
paras.zh: 列斐伏尔现在已经头发花白，性格成熟，即将开设几个新鲜的法国概念店，其中包括汉考克公园的 Le Petit Den，这是一家华丽的中式餐厅，灵感来自巴黎的 Yam’tcha 和 Le Cheval d’Or，他将在那里提供骨髓炒饭、橙鸡胸腺和炸馄饨等菜肴。 （Lefebvre 的餐厅集团还包括丹佛、达拉斯和下加利福尼亚州的前哨店，以及洛杉矶 Crypto.com Arena 的摊位。）

paras.en: The upcoming slate also includes a casual deli called Cornichon in Sherman Oaks as well as an opulent Provençal-style restaurant in Brentwood, to be called Ludo, featuring tableside preparations and multiple courtyards. “I’ve wanted to do a restaurant like Maxim’s for a long time, where people want to dress up nice,” he says of the venerable Parisian high-society haunt.
paras.zh: 即将开业的项目还包括位于谢尔曼奥克斯 (Sherman Oaks) 的一家名为 Cornichon 的休闲熟食店，以及位于布伦特伍德 (Brentwood) 的一家名为 Ludo 的豪华普罗旺斯风格餐厅，该餐厅以桌边准备工作和多个庭院为特色。 “我长期以来一直想开一家像马克西姆餐厅这样的餐厅，那里的人们都想打扮得漂漂亮亮的，”他谈到这家备受尊崇的巴黎上流社会常去的餐厅时说道。

paras.en: By Lefebvre’s reckoning, the new restaurants are less about peacocking than in the past. “I used to be about my ego — I was competitive with myself,” he explains. “I’m 55 now. I just want to cook what people like.” His wife and business partner, Krissy, adds: “He’s not as interested in shocking the palate and pushing limits as before. But you still don’t go out to eat Ludo’s food thinking you can eat the same thing at home.”
paras.zh: 根据列斐伏尔的计算，新餐厅不再像过去那样炫耀。 “我曾经很自负——我和自己竞争，”他解释道。 “我现在 55 岁了。我只想做人们喜欢的菜。”他的妻子兼商业伙伴 Krissy 补充道：“他不再像以前那样对刺激味觉和挑战极限感兴趣。但你仍然不会出去吃 Ludo 的食物，以为自己在家也能吃到同样的东西。”

paras.en: Lefebvre’s shift follows a stint in rehab several years ago, in the wake of the pandemic’s severe stresses on the restaurant business. He says he’d become dependent on prescription pills and alcohol. For a time, he’d lost his lifelong devouring passion. “I was not seeing enough happiness in my cooking,” he explains. Eventually, an encounter with a tomato on a trip to the farmers market brought him back: “I got excited again, thinking, ‘What can I do with it?’ I thought about the techniques I could use, the seasoning.” He adds, “I realized that I just wanted to give pleasure to people with my food again.”
paras.zh: 几年前，由于新冠病毒大流行给餐饮业带来了严重压力，列斐伏尔曾接受过一段时间的康复治疗。他说他已经开始依赖处方药和酒精。有一段时间，他失去了毕生的吞噬热情。 “我在烹饪中没有看到足够的快乐，”他解释道。最终，在去农贸市场时遇到西红柿让他回想起：“我再次兴奋起来，心想，‘我能用它做什么？’我想到了我可以使用的技术和调味料。”他补充道：“我意识到我只是想再次用我的食物给人们带来快乐。”

paras.en: His time in recovery has had him reflecting on his culinary education. “I was raised in these three-Michelin-star restaurants,” he says. “There was abuse: punching, screaming. I have PTSD about that. It did make me a tough chef and very demanding. I’m a perfectionist.” Lefebvre acknowledges, “I would scream too — I lost it sometimes,” adding, “I don’t lose it anymore.”
paras.zh: 康复期间，他开始反思自己的烹饪教育。 “我是在这些米其林三星级餐厅长大的，”他说。 “有虐待行为：拳打脚踢、尖叫。我因此患上了创伤后应激障碍。这确实让我成为了一名强硬的厨师，而且要求很高。我是一个完美主义者。”列斐伏尔承认，“我也会尖叫——有时我会失去它，”他补充道，“我不会再失去它了。”

paras.en: While Lefebvre traffics in Francophilic pleasures, he has spent more than half his life in L.A. and now considers himself far more American than French, just another successful Angeleno chauffeuring his children far and wide to their weekend sporting tournaments. He has no interest in repatriating in his retirement. “My dream is to buy a house in Montana,” he says. “You’ll find me in a pickup truck out there. I’ve always loved that cowboy life.”
paras.zh: 虽然列斐伏尔在兜售亲法乐趣，但他大半生都在洛杉矶度过，现在他认为自己更像是美国人，而不是法国人，只是另一个成功的洛杉矶人，载着他的孩子们远赴各地参加周末体育比赛。他没有兴趣在退休后回国。 “我的梦想是在蒙大拿州买房子，”他说。 “你会在外面的一辆皮卡车里找到我。我一直很喜欢那种牛仔生活。”

articles.title: Boston College vs. Notre Dame Livestream: Where to Watch the College Football Game Online for Free
articles.author: Tim Chan

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Viewers tuning in for NBC’s coverage of the Notre Dame vs. Boston College game today will see a new face in the booth, following the sudden passing Wednesday of longtime sportscaster Dan Hicks.
paras.zh: 继周三突然去世的长期体育播音员丹·希克斯之后，今天收看 NBC 圣母大学与波士顿学院比赛报道的观众将在展台上看到一张新面孔。

paras.en: At a Glance: How to Watch Notre Dame vs. Boston College Football
paras.zh: 概览：如何观看圣母大学对阵波士顿大学橄榄球队的比赛

paras.en: - When: Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026, 12 p.m. PT/3 p.m. ET
paras.zh: - 时间：2026 年 11 月 14 日星期六中午 12 点太平洋时间/下午 3 点ET

paras.en: - Stream online: DirecTV, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, Peacock (also available through Peacock’s two-month free trial via DirecTV or Peacock’s seven-day free trial via Prime Video)
paras.zh: - 在线流媒体：DirecTV、Fubo、Hulu + Live TV、Peacock（也可通过 DirecTV 的 Peacock 两个月免费试用或 Prime Video 的 Peacock 7 天免费试用）

paras.en: Jason Benetti will serve as the play-by-play announcer for today’s NCAA football game at Notre Dame Stadium in South Bend, Indiana. Best known as the play-by-play guy for Major League Baseball’s Detroit Tigers, Benetti will be joined by Jason Garrett in the TV booth for college football, with Caroline Pineda as the sideline reporter and Reggie Smith as rules analyst.
paras.zh: 杰森·贝内蒂 (Jason Benetti) 将担任今天在印第安纳州南本德圣母体育场举行的 NCAA 橄榄球比赛的实况播音员。贝内蒂以美国职业棒球大联盟底特律老虎队的实况报道而闻名，贾森·加勒特 (Jason Garrett) 将与大学橄榄球队的电视播位一起，卡罗琳·皮内达 (Caroline Pineda) 担任场边记者，雷吉·史密斯 (Reggie Smith) 担任规则分析师。

paras.en: Where to Watch Notre Dame vs. Boston College Game on TV
paras.zh: 哪里可以在电视上观看圣母大学对阵波士顿学院的比赛

paras.en: BC visits South Bend to face off against the Fighting Irish today at 3:30 p.m. ET. You can watch the football game live on TV through your local NBC affiliate.
paras.zh: BC 今天下午 3:30 造访南本德，迎战爱尔兰战斗队 (Fighting Irish)。等。您可以通过当地的 NBC 附属机构在电视上观看足球比赛直播。

paras.en: Where to Stream Notre Dame vs. Boston College Game Online Free
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费在线观看圣母大学对阵波士顿学院的比赛

paras.en: Don’t have cable? You can also watch the college football game live online with any streaming service that carries NBC, including DirecTV (with a five-day free trial), Fubo (with a five-day free trial), Sling and Hulu + Live TV.
paras.zh: 没有电缆？您还可以通过任何支持 NBC 的流媒体服务在线观看大学橄榄球比赛，包括 DirecTV（免费试用五天）、Fubo（免费试用五天）、Sling 和 Hulu + Live TV。

articles.title: Shane Gillis Addresses ‘SNL’ Monologue Backlash, Says He Promised the Show There Would Be “No Controversy”
articles.author: Lexi Carson

paras.en: Shane Gillis is finally addressing his controversial Saturday Night Live monologue.
paras.zh: 肖恩·吉利斯终于发表了他备受争议的《周六夜现场》独白。

paras.en: During the Oct. 10 episode of the NBC sketch comedy series, Gillis, who hosted the show, accused women of “dressing like whores” at the gym during his opening monologue. The joke drew backlash from audiences and fellow comedians.
paras.zh: 在 NBC 10 月 10 日的喜剧小品系列节目中，节目主持人吉利斯在开场独白中指责女性在健身房“穿得像妓女”。这个笑话引起了观众和喜剧演员的强烈反对。

paras.en: On a Friday episode of the Joe Rogan Experience, Gillis explained that SNL didn’t give him feedback on the material beforehand.
paras.zh: 在周五播出的《乔·罗根体验》节目中，吉利斯解释说《周六夜现场》没有事先向他提供有关该材料的反馈。

paras.en: “Not to defend SNL, they don’t approve it. I mean, they could shut it down. They could, but you don’t write your set and give it to them. Unless you’re not a comedian,” he said. “I’m sure non-comics, they write the set for them. They have writers that write the monologue for them.”
paras.zh: “不是为了捍卫《周六夜现场》，他们不批准它。我的意思是，他们可以关闭它。他们可以，但你不能写好你的节目并将其交给他们。除非你不是喜剧演员，”他说。 “我确信非漫画，他们会为他们写场景。他们有作家为他们写独白。”

paras.en: “The funniest part was, they were like, ‘What’s going on with the monologue?’ And I was like, ‘It’s not great, but I don’t say anything bad,'” Gillis continued. “The whole time, I was like, ‘Fellas, I’m giving you a solid C minus of a monologue, but I promise there’s no controversy. I’m calling myself fat for fucking 10 minutes. That’s it.'”
paras.zh: “最有趣的是，他们说，‘独白是怎么回事？’我说，‘这不太好，但我没有说任何不好的话，’”吉利斯继续说道。 “自始至终，我都在想，‘伙计们，我要给你们一段纯 C 减的独白，但我保证不会有争议。我他妈的说自己胖了 10 分钟。就是这样。’”

paras.en: Gillis said he thinks the backlash “obviously had a lot to do with the climate.”
paras.zh: 吉利斯说，他认为这种强烈反对“显然与气候有很大关系”。

paras.en: As for the clothing itself, Gillis added, “Don’t have a problem with it.”
paras.zh: 至于衣服本身，吉利斯补充道，“没问题。”

paras.en: The monologue drew criticism from Dan Levy, former SNL castmember Ego Nwodim and Obsession star Inde Navarrette, who took a dig at the joke during her opening monologue on the show’s Halloween episode.
paras.zh: 这段独白招致了丹·利维、《周六夜现场》前演员伊戈·恩沃迪姆和《痴迷》明星因德·纳瓦雷特的批评，后者在该剧万圣节剧集的开场独白中嘲笑了这个笑话。

paras.en: In 2019, Gillis was announced as a new SNL castmember but was fired before making his debut after past podcast comments resurfaced.
paras.zh: 2019 年，吉利斯被宣布成为《周六夜现场》的新演员，但在首次亮相之前，由于过去的播客评论重新浮出水面，他被解雇了。

articles.title: How Nvidia turmoil and a Democratic Congress could reshape the AI trade, according to ETF experts

paras.en: The largest technology stocks linked to the artificial intelligence trade could stand to benefit the most from Nvidia's woes and a Democratic-controlled Congress pushing back on data centers, according to investing experts interviewed on CNBC's "ETF Edge" earlier this week.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候接受 CNBC 节目“ETF Edge”采访的投资专家表示，与人工智能行业相关的最大科技股可能会从英伟达的困境和民主党控制的国会对数据中心的抵制中受益最多。

paras.en: "We may have been put in an environment, as much as investors have sort of been looking for areas outside of Big Tech, where net-net Big Tech ends up as the winner once again," said Roundhill Investments CEO Dave Mazza, whose firm manages the Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS).
paras.zh: Roundhill Investments 首席执行官戴夫·马扎 (Dave Mazza) 表示：“我们可能处于这样一种环境，就像投资者一直在寻找大型科技公司以外的领域一样，大型科技公司最终再次成为赢家。”他的公司管理着 Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS)。

paras.en: Part of his bull case: Other players in the AI trade are positioned to fill Nvidia's chip demand if investors lose trust in the company after a tumultuous week that saw its iconic founder and CEO Jensen Huang resign.
paras.zh: 他的看涨理由的一部分是：如果投资者在经历了英伟达标志性创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋辞职的动荡一周后失去了对该公司的信任，那么人工智能行业的其他参与者将能够满足英伟达的芯片需求。

paras.en: "If we get into an environment where people can't trust … Nvidia, they're going to look for other sources for these chips because they need them," Mazza said during the "ETF Edge" interview, which occurred Monday as the Nvidia scandal grew but before Huang had resigned.
paras.zh: 马扎在“ETF Edge”采访中表示：“如果我们进入一个人们无法信任……英伟达的环境，他们就会寻找这些芯片的其他来源，因为他们需要它们。”这次采访发生在周一，当时英伟达丑闻愈演愈烈，但黄仁勋还没有辞职。

paras.en: Discussing recent fund flow activity for the MAGS ETF, as well as for the Roundhill Neocloud ETF (NCLD) — which focuses on smaller market cap, specialized cloud computing companies — Mazza said, "In a weird way, [hyperscalers] may continue to benefit from this because they have the compute available. It's going to be more valuable if the demand is there."
paras.zh: 在讨论 MAGS ETF 以及 Roundhill Neocloud ETF (NCLD)（专注于市值较小的专业云计算公司）最近的资金流动活动时，Mazza 表示，“以一种奇怪的方式，[超大规模企业]可能会继续从中受益，因为他们拥有可用的计算能力。如果有需求，它会更有价值。”

paras.en: The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF ended the week in the green, albeit with a gain of less than 1%, while the Roundhill Neocloud ETF was up over 1%, though earnings from top holdings Coreweave and Nebius presented a mixed picture.
paras.zh: Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF 本周收盘上涨，尽管涨幅不到 1%，而 Roundhill Neocloud ETF 则上涨了 1% 以上，不过顶级持仓 Coreweave 和 Nebius 的盈利情况好坏参半。

paras.en: CoreWeave had its best day since April 2025 on Wednesday after its latest quarterly results, while Nebius shares sank after its Thursday report. The neocloud ETF remains deeply in the red since its August 2026 launch, down 39%, amid concerns about balance sheet strength, which could linger given Nvidia's role in financing the AI buildout. CoreWeave shares sank again on Friday, and Nvidia posted its longest losing streak since 2012 after its latest weekly losses.
paras.zh: 周三，CoreWeave 公布最新季度业绩后，迎来了自 2025 年 4 月以来最好的一天，而 Nebius 股价在周四公布报告后下跌。 Neocloud ETF 自 2026 年 8 月推出以来仍处于严重亏损状态，下跌了 39%，原因是人们对资产负债表实力的担忧，考虑到英伟达在为人工智能建设融资方面所扮演的角色，资产负债表实力可能会持续存在。 CoreWeave 股价周五再次下跌，Nvidia 在最近一周下跌后创下 2012 年以来最长的连续下跌纪录。

paras.en: Nvidia's interim CEO and current chief financial officer Colette Kress will have her first opportunity to reassure the market when Nvidia reports its third-quarter earnings next Tuesday. "Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders," Kress said in a statement issued on Thursday morning when the company announced Huang's exit.
paras.zh: 当英伟达下周二公布第三季度财报时，英伟达临时首席执行官兼现任首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯将首次有机会安抚市场。 “我们的重点仍然是为我们的客户、合作伙伴、开发商和股东提供服务，”克雷斯在周四上午公司宣布黄退出时发表的一份声明中表示。

paras.en: Yorkville Ives partner and senior managing director Dan Ives said on "ETF Edge" on Monday that the market will remain optimistic about other AI chip players, like AMD and Alphabet, if Nvidia faces prolonged headwinds. Ives helped create the Dan IVES Wedbush AI Revolution ETF (IVES) while at Wedbush Securities, where he served as the managing director and global head of technology research before departing Wedbush to form his own firm earlier this year.
paras.zh: Yorkville Ives 合伙人兼高级董事总经理 Dan Ives 周一在“ETF Edge”上表示，如果 Nvidia 面临长期阻力，市场将对 AMD 和 Alphabet 等其他 AI 芯片厂商保持乐观。艾夫斯在韦德布什证券 (Wedbush Securities) 期间帮助创建了 Dan IVES Wedbush AI Revolution ETF (IVES)，并在今年早些时候离开韦德布什 (Wedbush) 成立了自己的公司之前，他担任董事总经理兼全球技术研究主管。

paras.en: AMD finished trading this week up close to 13%, with Broadcom posting similar gains.
paras.zh: AMD 本周收盘上涨近 13%，博通 (Broadcom) 也录得类似涨幅。

paras.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq index posted its best week since August as Nvidia's slump reshuffled the AI trade.
paras.zh: 由于英伟达的低迷重新洗牌了人工智能行业，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数创下了自 8 月份以来最好的一周表现。

paras.en: Yorkville Ives lowered its price target on Nvidia to $225 from $300 on Thursday after Huang's resignation, but maintained a buy rating on the stock, which finished the week at $162.85 per share.
paras.zh: 周四，在黄仁勋辞职后，Yorkville Ives 将 Nvidia 的目标股价从 300 美元下调至 225 美元，但维持了该股的买入评级，该股本周收于每股 162.85 美元。

paras.en: "Nvidia remains the clear leader in GPU chips for the AI Revolution. They are roughly 2-3 years ahead of the nearest competitor and the demand trajectory the next few years is not changing because Jensen is gone," Ives wrote in a note to investors on Thursday. "The strategic roadmap is already essentially built around the next few family of chips and physical AI with 42k employees driving it. ... Valuation at roughly 10x 28 EPS is way too cheap once Nvidia gets through this storm and emerges on the other side."
paras.zh: “Nvidia 仍然是 AI 革命 GPU 芯片领域明显的领导者。他们大约领先最接近的竞争对手 2-3 年，而且未来几年的需求轨迹不会因为 Jensen 的离开而改变，”艾夫斯在周四给投资者的一份报告中写道。 “战略路线图基本上已经围绕接下来的几个芯片系列和物理人工智能而构建，由 4.2 万名员工驱动。......一旦 Nvidia 度过这场风暴并出现在另一边，大约 10 倍 28 EPS 的估值就太便宜了。”

paras.en: The compute that does exist could become even more indispensable against the backdrop of a potential slowdown to the data-center buildout by Congress after the Democratic Party gains of Nov. 3 swept control of Congress, Mazza said.
paras.zh: Mazza 表示，在民主党于 11 月 3 日横扫国会后，国会数据中心建设可能会放缓，因此现有的计算可能会变得更加不可或缺。

paras.en: Ives estimates that the "blue tidal wave" in Congress could mean 10% of planned data centers won't materialize on the low end, and 15%-20% on the high end, but he added that demand still outstrips supply four to one. "The compute is just that much more valuable in the capacity today than it was a week ago. So I could argue just more and more bullish, strong, get stronger," Ives said.
paras.zh: 艾夫斯估计，国会的“蓝色浪潮”可能意味着 10% 的低端数据中心计划无法实现，15%-20% 的高端数据中心无法实现，但他补充说，需求仍然超过供应，比例为四比一。艾夫斯说：“今天的计算能力比一周前更有价值。所以我可以说，它会变得越来越乐观、越来越强大、越来越强大。”

paras.en: "The game is going to change for Big Tech. It will slow it down. But there's no overbuild, no bubble concerns. And I view that as actually a positive thing," he added.
paras.zh: “对于大型科技公司来说，游戏规则将会改变。它会减慢速度。但不会出现过度建设，也不会出现泡沫问题。我认为这实际上是一件积极的事情，”他补充道。

articles.title: Nvidia board urged to consider 'potential return of Jensen Huang' by two major investors

paras.en: Two major Nvidia shareholders are calling on the board of directors to weigh all options for the company's future leadership, including "the potential return of Jensen Huang."
paras.zh: 英伟达的两大股东呼吁董事会权衡公司未来领导层的所有选择，包括“黄仁勋的潜在回报”。

paras.en: Altimeter Capital CEO Brad Gerstner posted a letter on X on Friday that urges Nvidia's board to "pursue a slow, measured, and deliberate process regarding the future leadership of Nvidia." The letter is also signed by Atreides Management's Gavin Baker.
paras.zh: Altimeter Capital 首席执行官布拉德·格斯特纳 (Brad Gerstner) 周五在 X 上发布了一封信，敦促 Nvidia 董事会“在有关 Nvidia 未来领导地位的问题上采取缓慢、谨慎和深思熟虑的流程”。这封信还由 Atreides Management 的 Gavin Baker 签署。

paras.en: Nvidia was Altimeter Capital's largest disclosed equity holding in its most recent SEC filing, with a 9.4 million-share stake worth nearly $1.9 billion as of June 30. Atreides held 1.2 million shares worth nearly $250 million at the end of June.
paras.zh: Nvidia 是 Altimeter Capital 在其最近向 SEC 提交的文件中披露的最大股权，截至 6 月 30 日，该公司持有 940 万股股票，价值近 19 亿美元。截至 6 月底，Atreides 持有 120 万股，价值近 2.5 亿美元。

paras.en: The letter said Nvidia will be "capably led" by interim CEO Colette Kress, who served as Nvidia's CFO for 13 years before the board announced Thursday that she'd lead the company in Huang's absence.
paras.zh: 信中称，英伟达将由临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)“有能力地领导”，科莱特·克雷斯曾担任英伟达首席财务官13年，之后董事会周四宣布，她将在黄仁勋缺席的情况下领导公司。

paras.en: "But the Founder and long time incredible leader of this extraordinary company has earned the right for a deliberate process that avoids any needless rush to replace him before all the facts are known," the letter concludes. The document did not call for Huang's immediate reinstatement.
paras.zh: 信中总结道：“但这家非凡公司的创始人和长期以来令人难以置信的领导者已经赢得了经过深思熟虑的程序的权利，以避免在了解所有事实之前不必要地急于更换他。”该文件没有要求黄立即复职。

paras.en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday amid multiple affair allegations, including one with suspected Chinese spy Alice Huang, who also worked with Nvidia customer Megaspeed. The Singapore-based company is being investigated by the Justice Department for possibly redirecting some of its supply of Nvidia's restricted artificial intelligence chips to China.
paras.zh: Nvidia 创始人黄仁勋周四因多项婚外情指控而辞职，其中包括涉嫌与中国间谍 Alice Huang 的一项指控，后者也与 Nvidia 客户 Megaspeed 合作。这家总部位于新加坡的公司正在接受司法部的调查，原因是其可能将部分英伟达受限人工智能芯片供应转移到中国。

paras.en: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk said on X Friday that he signed a petition asking to reinstate Huang. A petition circulating online called "Stand with Jensen" claims to have more than 100,000 signatures, including more than 5,000 current Nvidia employees.
paras.zh: SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 周五表示，他签署了一份请愿书，要求恢复黄的职位。网上流传的一份名为“与 Jensen 站在一起”的请愿书声称已有超过 10 万名签名，其中包括 5000 多名 Nvidia 现任员工。

paras.en: Musk said on X Saturday that without Huang, some "critical deals will be lost."
paras.zh: 马斯克周六表示，如果没有黄仁勋，一些“关键交易将会丢失”。

paras.en: Another letter sent Friday called on U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick to testify about Megaspeed before the House Intelligence Committee.
paras.zh: 周五发出的另一封信呼吁美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克在众议院情报委员会就 Megaspeed 问题作证。

paras.en: Lutnick has agreed to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on Dec. 10 about whether the Commerce Department is "properly performing its broader role of preventing China from acquiring advanced AI chips," according to the letter. Huang has also been asked to testify.
paras.zh: 信中称，卢特尼克已同意于 12 月 10 日在参议院银行委员会作证，说明商务部是否“正确履行了阻止中国获取先进人工智能芯片的更广泛职责”。黄也被要求出庭作证。

paras.en: The Commerce Department originally launched an investigation into Megaspeed that was moved to the Justice Department in 2025 after Nvidia's lawyer contacted a senior Commerce official, according to The New York Times.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，商务部最初对 Megaspeed 发起了调查，在 Nvidia 的律师联系了商务部高级官员后，该调查于 2025 年移交给司法部。

paras.en: President Donald Trump is scheduled to visit China on Thursday, but doesn't plan to raise Nvidia and the suspected spy affair during his meeting with Chinese president Xi Jinping, according to U.S. officials. Musk is expected to join Trump on the trip to Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit on Nov. 18 and 19.
paras.zh: 据美国官员称，唐纳德·特朗普总统定于周四访问中国，但不打算在与中国国家主席习近平会面时提及英伟达和涉嫌间谍事件。预计马斯克将与特朗普一起前往中国深圳，参加 11 月 18 日至 19 日举行的亚太经合组织峰会。

articles.title: Nationwide ground stop followed contractor upgrade to L3Harris telecommunication system: DOT’s Duffy

paras.en: The longest halt in flight departures to U.S. airports since 9/11 came after updates to a telecommunications system made by L3Harris Technologies, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Saturday, as travel disruptions lingered for thousands of passengers nationwide.
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 周六表示，由于全国数千名乘客的旅行受到影响，L3Harris Technologies 的电信系统更新后，美国机场起飞的航班出现了自 9/11 以来最长的一次停顿。

paras.en: There was "zero evidence" that the problem was caused by something "nefarious" or anything related to artificial intelligence, Bryan Bedford, the head of the Federal Aviation Administration, said at a press conference.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局局长布莱恩·贝德福德在新闻发布会上表示，“零证据”表明该问题是由“邪恶”行为或任何与人工智能相关的行为引起的。

paras.en: The updates were part of ongoing work of switching from a copper wire system to fiberoptic cable, Duffy said. When a router was switched to fiberoptic cable from copper, it had "flooded" other routers in the air traffic control system with over 1,000 connection attempts roughly every five seconds, Duffy said, creating problems with airplane communications and radar feeds.
paras.zh: 达菲说，这些更新是从铜线系统切换到光纤电缆的持续工作的一部分。 Duffy 表示，当路由器从铜缆切换到光纤电缆时，大约每 5 秒就有 1,000 多次连接尝试“淹没”了空中交通管制系统中的其他路由器，从而给飞机通信和雷达馈送带来了问题。

paras.en: Bedford said no FAA facilities went dark but that officials decided to ground flights because of "instability" in information feeds to air traffic control centers that handle en route aircraft at high altitudes and eventually to others closer to airports.
paras.zh: 贝德福德表示，美国联邦航空局的设施没有关闭，但官员们决定停飞航班，因为空中交通管制中心的信息“不稳定”，这些中心负责处理高空飞行的飞机，并最终传送到距离机场较近的其他飞机。

paras.en: "We were unwilling to take any risk that this propagation could actually result in a center losing connectivity with aircraft," said Bedford.
paras.zh: 贝德福德说：“我们不愿意冒任何风险，因为这种传播实际上可能会导致中心失去与飞机的连接。”

paras.en: L3Harris didn't immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: L3Harris 没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Duffy told the press conference that the FAA is investigating.
paras.zh: 达菲在新闻发布会上表示，美国联邦航空局正在调查。

paras.en: "What we're working to determine was whether we had incompetence, meaning was it user error, installator error from L3 Harris, or did they install a faulty router," he said.
paras.zh: “我们正在努力确定我们是否有能力不足，这意味着是用户错误、L3 Harris 安装程序错误，还是他们安装了有故障的路由器，”他说。

paras.en: Flight disruptions continued on Saturday. More than 3,700 U.S. flights were canceled Saturday and close to 2,000 were delayed as of 9:40 a.m. ET, according to flight-tracking site FlightAware. That's on top of about 9,000 U.S. flight cancellations and more than 7,000 delays on Friday, though some disruptions were due to bad weather.
paras.zh: 周六航班继续受到干扰。根据航班跟踪网站 FlightAware 的数据，截至美国东部时间上午 9:40，周六已有 3,700 多架美国航班被取消，近 2,000 架航班延误。除此之外，周五还有大约 9,000 架美国航班取消和 7,000 多架航班延误，不过也有一些航班延误是由于恶劣天气造成的。

paras.en: Part of untangling from the ground stop includes getting aircraft where they need to be. The ground stop forced many planes to divert to other airports.
paras.zh: 摆脱地面停留的一部分包括让飞机到达它们需要的地方。地面停靠迫使许多飞机改道至其他机场。

paras.en: Airlines run one of the lightest schedules on Saturday and are deploying as many spare planes and crews as possible to get travelers and employees where they need to be as they're eager to start fresh for the upcoming Thanksgiving holiday period.
paras.zh: 周六，航空公司的航班安排最为宽松，并正在部署尽可能多的备用飞机和机组人员，以将旅客和员工送到他们需要的地方，因为他们渴望在即将到来的感恩节假期期间重新开始。

paras.en: American Airlines, for example, is offering flight attendants extra pay to pick up trips, according to a person familiar with the airline's plans.
paras.zh: 例如，据一位熟悉美国航空计划的人士透露，美国航空正在向空乘人员提供接机的额外报酬。

paras.en: Delta Air Lines was offering crews double pay to pick up trips and gave them confirmed seats on flights to get them into position, according to internal company messages seen by CNBC. United Airlines was also offering pilots and flight attendants extra pay to pick up flights through Sunday, according to people familiar with the matter.
paras.zh: 据 CNBC 看到的公司内部消息，达美航空向机组人员提供双倍工资来接机，并为他们提供了航班上已确认的座位，让他们就位。据知情人士透露，联合航空还向飞行员和空乘人员提供额外报酬，以便在周日之前接机。

paras.en: American and other airlines said they would change customers' tickets at no fee or fare difference if the outage affected their plans.
paras.zh: 美国航空和其他航空公司表示，如果停电影响了他们的计划，他们将免费为客户改签机票，也不收取票价差额。

paras.en: Around 3 million people were scheduled to fly on Saturday, according to aviation data firm Cirium.
paras.zh: 根据航空数据公司 Cirium 的数据，周六约有 300 万人计划乘坐飞机。

paras.en: The FAA had halted departing U.S. flights around 4 p.m. ET on Friday, a ground stop that lasted more than four hours, the longest such pause on departing flights in 25 years.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 于下午 4 点左右停止了从美国起飞的航班。美国东部时间周五，地面停留持续了四个多小时，是 25 年来离港航班停留时间最长的一次。

paras.en: Duffy on Friday blamed outdated U.S. infrastructure for the problem and said Congress needs to approve more money to overhaul the country's air traffic control. Aging equipment and a shortage of air traffic controllers have angered airline executives for years, who have complained about the cost of resulting disruptions.
paras.zh: 达菲周五将这一问题归咎于美国基础设施过时，并表示国会需要批准更多资金来彻底改革该国的空中交通管制。多年来，设备老化和空中交通管制员短缺一直激怒航空公司高管，他们抱怨由此造成的中断成本。

paras.en: It was the second time the FAA has issued a nationwide ground stop since the Sept. 11, 2001, terror attacks. Trump administration officials have repeatedly said it did not appear to be a cyberattack.
paras.zh: 这是自 2001 年 9 月 11 日恐怖袭击以来，美国联邦航空局第二次在全国范围内发布地面停飞令。特朗普政府官员一再表示这似乎不是网络攻击。

paras.en: The U.S. has the world's busiest airspace.
paras.zh: 美国拥有世界上最繁忙的空域。

paras.en: "Before clearing flights to resume, we thoroughly tested our systems to confirm they were stable and that operations remain reliable," the FAA said late Friday.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局周五晚表示：“在批准航班恢复之前，我们彻底测试了我们的系统，以确认它们稳定且运行仍然可靠。”

paras.en: The disruption also upended travel for NBA, NHL and college teams, which struggled to reach their destinations in time for games this weekend.
paras.zh: 这次中断还影响了 NBA、NHL 和大学球队的出行，他们很难及时到达目的地参加本周末的比赛。

paras.en: Duffy said college football teams traveling on charter flights could receive priority.
paras.zh: 达菲说，乘坐包机旅行的大学橄榄球队可以得到优先考虑。

paras.en: "I would encourage those football teams to reach out to the FAA to schedule their flight times and make sure they have games going off tomorrow," he said during a Friday press briefing.
paras.zh: 他在周五的新闻发布会上说：“我鼓励这些橄榄球队联系美国联邦航空管理局安排他们的飞行时间，并确保他们明天有比赛。”

paras.en: The Southeastern Conference announced on X that some games had been moved to Sunday due to the flight disruption.
paras.zh: 东南联盟于 X 日宣布，由于航班中断，部分比赛已移至周日。

paras.en: "We are in close communication with our member institutions to assess potential disruptions and coordinate appropriate responses," the SEC said in a statement shared on X.
paras.zh: 美国证券交易委员会在 X 上分享的一份声明中表示：“我们正在与我们的成员机构保持密切沟通，以评估潜在的干扰并协调适当的应对措施。”

paras.en: The National Football League said that it is putting in three backup referees for three games on Sunday because of the ground stop, "reassigning officials to games within driving distance of their hometowns."
paras.zh: 美国国家橄榄球联盟表示，由于停地，将在周日的三场比赛中安排三名替补裁判，“将官员重新分配到距其家乡车程范围内的比赛中。”

paras.en: — CNBC's April Roach and Jessica Golden contributed to this article.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 April Roach 和 Jessica Golden 对本文有贡献。

articles.title: Is there a better way of diagnosing obesity than BMI?

paras.en: For decades, doctors have relied on body mass index, or BMI, to diagnose obesity. The calculation—simply a person’s weight divided by their squared height—gained popularity because it was quick and easy to use in a doctor's office. But BMI is far from perfect. It reveals little about an individual’s body composition—is the weight fat or muscle, for example?—and perhaps most importantly, it says little about whether excess body fat is actually affecting a person’s health.
paras.zh: 几十年来，医生一直依靠体重指数（BMI）来诊断肥胖。这种计算方法——简单地用一个人的体重除以身高的平方——得到了普及，因为它在医生办公室中使用起来既快捷又方便。但 BMI 还远非完美。它几乎没有透露一个人的身体成分——例如，体重是脂肪还是肌肉？——也许最重要的是，它几乎没有透露过多的身体脂肪是否真的会影响一个人的健康。

paras.en: Despite these shortcomings, scientists have struggled to come up with a different way to diagnose obesity. But a landmark study published in Nature this week tests an alternative vision that would distinguish between what researchers call clinical obesity—when excess body fat impairs organ function or everyday activities—and preclinical obesity, in which excess body fat is present but function remains intact.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些缺点，科学家们仍在努力想出一种不同的方法来诊断肥胖。但本周在《自然》杂志上发表的一项具有里程碑意义的研究测试了另一种观点，该观点将区分研究人员所说的临床肥胖（体内过多的脂肪损害器官功能或日常活动）和临床前肥胖（体内存在过多的脂肪但功能完好无损）。

paras.en: The idea was first proposed in January 2025 by an international research group writing in the Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology. The new study is the first major test of whether it could supplant BMI—and the results are encouraging.
paras.zh: 这一想法最初由一个国际研究小组于 2025 年 1 月在《柳叶刀糖尿病与内分泌学》上发表文章提出。这项新研究是对其是否可以取代体重指数的首次重大测试，结果令人鼓舞。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The 2025 Lancet study recommended supplementing BMI with measurements such as waist circumference and waist-to-height ratio to better identify excess body fat. It also proposed assessing whether that fat was causing measurable organ dysfunction.
paras.zh: 2025 年《柳叶刀》研究建议通过腰围和腰高比等测量值来补充 BMI，以更好地识别体内多余的脂肪。它还建议评估脂肪是否导致可测量的器官功能障碍。

paras.en: In the new study, by analyzing health data from more than 844,000 adults across four countries, the researchers found that BMI both overestimated and underestimated obesity in certain groups compared with the new framework. They also found that people with clinical and preclinical obesity faced markedly different long-term health risks. Most people with preclinical obesity did not go on to develop clinical obesity over a decade, while those with clinical obesity faced a substantially higher risk of death.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，通过分析四个国家超过 844,000 名成年人的健康数据，研究人员发现，与新框架相比，BMI 既高估又低估了某些群体的肥胖情况。他们还发现，临床肥胖者和临床前肥胖者面临明显不同的长期健康风险。大多数临床前肥胖症患者在十年内不会继续发展为临床肥胖症，而临床肥胖症患者则面临更高的死亡风险。

paras.en: The researchers also found that most people identified as having obesity under the new framework did not actually meet the definition of clinical obesity. They estimated that just 22.7 to 31.3 percent of people who met the BMI criteria for obesity had clinical obesity. The remainder were classified as having preclinical obesity.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，在新框架下被认定为肥胖的大多数人实际上并不符合临床肥胖的定义。他们估计，符合 BMI 肥胖标准的人中，只有 22.7% 至 31.3% 患有临床肥胖。其余的人被归类为患有临床前肥胖。

paras.en: The findings suggest that assessing obesity based on both the presence of excess body fat and its actual effects on the body, rather than just BMI alone, could help doctors better diagnose people experiencing obesity-related disease and those at risk of developing it.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，根据体内多余脂肪的存在及其对身体的实际影响（而不仅仅是体重指数）来评估肥胖，可以帮助医生更好地诊断患有肥胖相关疾病的人和有患肥胖症风险的人。

paras.en: “This work tells us that the BMI system is not accurate in identifying the health status of an individual,” said Francesco Rubino, chair of metabolic and bariatric surgery at King’s College London and a senior author of the study, at a press briefing. “Diseases are normally defined in medicine by the way they look at the bedside,” he explained, but obesity has historically been defined using measurements that reflect population-level health risks—not the health of an individual patient.
paras.zh: 该研究的资深作者、伦敦国王学院代谢和减肥外科主任 Francesco Rubino 在新闻发布会上表示：“这项研究告诉我们，BMI 系统在识别个人健康状况方面并不准确。”他解释说：“医学上通常通过观察床边的情况来定义疾病，”但肥胖症历来是通过反映人群健康风险的测量来定义的，而不是单个患者的健康。

paras.en: Obesity has long been associated with an increased risk of conditions such as cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes and certain cancers. Under the BMI guidelines, adults with a BMI of 30 or higher are classified as obese. But BMI cannot distinguish fat from muscle, account for differences in fat distribution or determine whether excess fat is interfering with normal biological functions.
paras.zh: 长期以来，肥胖一直与心血管疾病、2 型糖尿病和某些癌症等疾病的风险增加有关。根据 BMI 指南，BMI 为 30 或更高的成年人被归类为肥胖。但体重指数无法区分脂肪和肌肉、解释脂肪分布的差异或确定过多的脂肪是否干扰正常的生物功能。

paras.en: An Pan, a professor of epidemiology at Huazhong University of Science and Technology in China and co-lead author of the study, said at the same press event that more work needs to be done before the new framework might be implemented in clinical practice. Specifically, he said, the researchers want to better understand what factors could help predict which individuals with preclinical obesity will go on to develop clinical obesity.
paras.zh: 该研究的共同主要作者、中国华中科技大学流行病学教授潘安在同一新闻发布会上表示，在新框架应用于临床实践之前，还需要做更多的工作。他说，具体而言，研究人员希望更好地了解哪些因素可以帮助预测哪些临床前肥胖患者将继续发展为临床肥胖。

paras.en: But in the future, the findings could have implications for how doctors approach obesity treatment, the researchers said. For example, if these guidelines were implemented more broadly in clinical medicine, then rather than treating everyone who meets a particular BMI threshold as having the same condition, doctors could tailor care according to whether excess body fat is already impairing health or represents a risk of future disease. That would bring the process of diagnosing obesity more in line with diagnosing other complex health conditions, Rubino said.
paras.zh: 但研究人员表示，在未来，这些发现可能会对医生如何治疗肥胖症产生影响。例如，如果这些指南在临床医学中得到更广泛的实施，那么医生就可以根据体内过多的脂肪是否已经损害健康或代表未来疾病的风险来调整治疗方案，而不是将每个达到特定体重指数阈值的​​人都视为患有相同的疾病。鲁比诺说，这将使诊断肥胖的过程与诊断其他复杂的健康状况更加一致。

paras.en: “The fact that [physicians] will have to work harder to make a diagnosis is certainly true compared to what we’re used to,” he said.
paras.zh: “与我们习惯的情况相比，[医生]必须更加努力地做出诊断，这一事实肯定是正确的，”他说。

articles.title: See new images from the Euclid space telescope, spanning one billion cosmic objects

paras.en: Fans of space, data and pretty pictures, rejoice: Euclid, the European Space Agency’s (ESA) newest space telescope, has released its first major batch of observations, replete with cosmic mysteries and breathtaking views.
paras.zh: 太空、数据和精美图片的爱好者们有福了：欧洲航天局 (ESA) 最新的太空望远镜欧几里得已经发布了第一批主要观测数据，其中充满了宇宙奥秘和令人惊叹的景观。

paras.en: “These are far more than beautiful pictures; today marks a scientific milestone in our study of the cosmos,” said Carole Mundell, the agency’s director of science, in a statement. “This major Euclid data release represents the largest space-based survey of its kind, laying the foundation of future discovery in a new regime for astronomy and demonstrating the excellence of European technology, science and international collaboration.”
paras.zh: 该机构科学主任卡罗尔·蒙代尔在一份声明中表示：“这些不仅仅是美丽的图片；今天标志着我们宇宙研究的一个科学里程碑。” “这一重要的欧几里得数据发布代表了同类中最大的天基调查，为天文学新体制中的未来发现奠定了基础，并展示了欧洲技术、科学和国际合作的卓越性。”

paras.en: Euclid launched in 2023 with the aim of capturing wide panoramic views of space with high resolution—in its operational lifetime, it aims to image one third of the entire sky. In this release, the telescope recorded more than a billion objects over 13 months of observation.
paras.zh: Euclid 于 2023 年发射，旨在以高分辨率捕捉广阔的太空全景——在其使用寿命内，它的目标是对整个天空的三分之一进行成像。在此版本中，该望远镜在 13 个月的观测中记录了超过 10 亿个物体。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Here are just some of our favorite new images from Euclid:
paras.zh: 以下是我们最喜欢的一些来自 Euclid 的新图像：

paras.en: This mosaic forms the basis of what could one day be a full cosmic map. It spans nearly 500 gigapixels in size—equivalent to at least 10,000 high-quality smartphone images. It’s made up of 740 observations and includes more than 900 million galaxies.
paras.zh: 这幅马赛克构成了有一天可能成为完整宇宙地图的基础。它的大小接近 500 十亿像素，相当于至少 10,000 张高质量智能手机图像。它由 740 个观测结果组成，包括 9 亿多个星系。

paras.en: This image shows Abell 3128, a cluster that includes hundreds of galaxies of various shapes and forms. Around 800 million light-years away from Earth, it is a part of the Horologium Supercluster.
paras.zh: 这张图片显示了 Abell 3128，这是一个包含数百个形状和形式各异的星系的星团。它距离地球约 8 亿光年，是钟表超星系团的一部分。

paras.en: The full Horologium Supercluster, which includes more than 30 smaller galaxy clusters, is shown here. This image, taken by Euclid over 18 days, stretches across time and space: its distant objects are from the early universe, as far as 10 billion light-years away.
paras.zh: 此处显示了完整的钟表超星系团，其中包括 30 多个较小的星系团。这张由欧几里得花了 18 天拍摄的图像跨越了时间和空间：它的遥远物体来自早期宇宙，远至 100 亿光年。

paras.en: Messier 81, seen on the right side of the image, is a “grand-design” spiral galaxy and lies around 12 million light-years away from us. Other galaxies, including NGC 3077, are also in this image, which Euclid only needed around an hour to take.
paras.zh: 梅西耶 81，如图像右侧所示，是一个“宏伟设计”的螺旋星系，距我们约 1200 万光年。其他星系，包括 NGC 3077，也出现在这张图像中，欧几里得只花了大约一个小时就拍摄了这张图像。

paras.en: This image offers a closer view of Messier 81, alongside a slew of individual stars captured in stunning detail.
paras.zh: 这张图片提供了梅西耶 81 的近距离观察，以及大量以令人惊叹的细节捕捉到的单个恒星。

paras.en: This image shows a collection of gravitational lenses—which are created when light from far-out galaxies is distorted by nearer galaxies. Euclid has assembled the largest catalog to date of these lenses, which are primarily used to measure the masses of different galaxy components.
paras.zh: 该图像显示了一组引力透镜，当来自遥远星系的光被较近的星系扭曲时，就会产生引力透镜。欧几里得收集了迄今为止最大的这些透镜目录，这些透镜主要用于测量不同星系组成部分的质量。

paras.en: This close-up view of NGC 1291, a ring galaxy, shows off Euclid’s eye for detail. Also known as the Golden Eye galaxy, it lies around 33 million light-years away.
paras.zh: 这张环状星系 NGC 1291 的特写视图展示了欧几里得对细节的敏锐洞察力。它也被称为金眼星系，距离我们约 3300 万光年。

articles.title: Do ice baths help muscles recover after a workout? A new study suggests not

paras.en: Ice baths have become one of the most popular recovery strategies in sport. They are used by elite athletes and recreational gym-goers to reduce soreness and recuperate more quickly after exercising.
paras.zh: 冰浴已成为运动中最受欢迎的恢复策略之一。精英运动员和休闲健身爱好者使用它们来减轻运动后的酸痛并更快地恢复。

paras.en: It has often been claimed that ice baths help to reduce pain and repair the muscle damage that intense exercise can cause. Yet when we look at the evidence, it isn’t clear that ice baths really are the best way to recover post exercise.
paras.zh: 人们经常声称，冰浴有助于减轻疼痛并修复剧烈运动可能造成的肌肉损伤。然而，当我们查看证据时，并不清楚冰浴是否真的是运动后恢复的最佳方法。

paras.en: In a recent study, my colleagues and I compared ice baths against heat-based recovery methods. What we found suggests recovery is far more complex than simply cooling things down.
paras.zh: 在最近的一项研究中，我和我的同事将冰浴与基于热的恢复方法进行了比较。我们的发现表明，恢复远比简单地降温要复杂得多。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Strenuous or unfamiliar exercise can cause damage to our muscle fibers. This is particularly the case after doing “eccentric exercises”, where muscles lengthen while generating force. Activities such as downhill running, descending the stairs or lowering a weight under control (while doing a barbell squat for instance) are all examples of eccentric exercise.
paras.zh: 剧烈或不熟悉的运动会对我们的肌肉纤维造成损害。在进行“离心运动”后尤其如此，即肌肉在产生力量的同时拉长。下坡跑、下楼梯或有控制地降低重量（例如杠铃深蹲）等活动都是离心运动的例子。

paras.en: This exercise-induced muscle damage can leave your muscles feeling sore and weak. To repair the damage, the body triggers what’s known as an “inflammatory repair response”, where immune cells move into the muscle tissue to clear away damaged cellular material and stimulate regeneration.
paras.zh: 这种运动引起的肌肉损伤会让您的肌肉感到酸痛和虚弱。为了修复损伤，身体会触发所谓的“炎症修复反应”，免疫细胞进入肌肉组织，清除受损的细胞物质并刺激再生。

paras.en: Other molecules are also released to help coordinate repair. However, these molecules can also increase the sensitivity of pain receptors, which may further contribute to the muscle soreness that people experience up to 72 hours after an intense workout.
paras.zh: 其他分子也被释放以帮助协调修复。然而，这些分子也会增加疼痛感受器的敏感性，这可能会进一步加剧人们在剧烈运动后长达 72 小时的肌肉酸痛感。

paras.en: These responses are an important part of how the body repairs itself and becomes stronger.
paras.zh: 这些反应是身体自我修复和变得更强的重要组成部分。

paras.en: We wanted to better understand what effect different recovery methods had on this repair process after a strenuous workout. So we recruited 40 healthy, physically active adults (31 men and nine women) and asked them to complete a specific exercise.
paras.zh: 我们希望更好地了解不同的恢复方法对剧烈运动后的修复过程有何影响。因此，我们招募了 40 名健康、身体活跃的成年人（31 名男性和 9 名女性），并要求他们完成一项特定的练习。

paras.en: This involved repeatedly targeting the quadriceps—the large muscles at the front of the thigh – using a specialized machine that allowed us to carefully control the movement and measure muscle strength. This particular movement is known to cause temporary muscle damage and soreness—making it useful for studying how different recovery methods influence the body’s repair process.
paras.zh: 这涉及到使用专门的机器反复瞄准股四头肌（大腿前部的大肌肉），使我们能够仔细控制运动并测量肌肉力量。众所周知，这种特殊的运动会导致暂时的肌肉损伤和酸痛，这对于研究不同的恢复方法如何影响身体的修复过程非常有用。

paras.en: Participants were then randomly assigned to one of four recovery methods: cold-water immersion (in water that was 10 C), hot-water immersion (in water that was 42 C), hot air exposure (60 C, similar to a sauna) and “passive recovery” which involved sitting and doing nothing for 30 minutes. Each method was carried out immediately after the workout.
paras.zh: 然后，参与者被随机分配到四种恢复方法中的一种：冷水浸泡（在10摄氏度的水中）、热水浸泡（在42摄氏度的水中）、热空气暴露（60摄氏度，类似于桑拿）和“被动恢复”，即坐着30分钟什么也不做。每种方法都在锻炼后立即进行。

paras.en: Over the following 72 hours, we monitored recovery by looking at several measures—including muscle strength, pain and soreness, alongside various biological markers linked to muscle damage, inflammation and cellular stress.
paras.zh: 在接下来的 72 小时内，我们通过观察多种指标来监测恢复情况，包括肌肉力量、疼痛和酸痛，以及与肌肉损伤、炎症和细胞应激相关的各种生物标记。

paras.en: All participants showed the expected signs of exercise-induced muscle damage. Strength declined immediately after exercise and soreness increased.
paras.zh: 所有参与者都表现出了预期的运动引起的肌肉损伤迹象。运动后力量立即下降，酸痛加剧。

paras.en: But when we looked at the effects of the recovery techniques, we were surprised to find that none of them restored muscle strength significantly faster than the others.
paras.zh: 但当我们观察恢复技术的效果时，我们惊讶地发现，没有一个技术恢复肌肉力量的速度明显快于其他技术。

paras.en: If strength had been the only outcome measured, we might have concluded the recovery methods made little difference. But the physiological data told a different story.
paras.zh: 如果力量是测量的唯一结果，我们可能会得出结论，恢复方法几乎没有什么区别。但生理数据却讲述了不同的故事。

paras.en: Participants who completed hot-water immersion were shown to have higher levels of a substance called “heat shock protein 72” (HSP72) which acts as a cellular maintenance and protection system, supporting repair processes and protecting cells during periods of physiological stress. It’s widely believed that HSP72 plays an important role in recovery and adaptation following exercise.
paras.zh: 完成热水浸泡的参与者体内一种名为“热休克蛋白 72”（HSP72）的物质含量较高，该物质充当细胞维护和保护系统，在生理应激期间支持修复过程并保护细胞。人们普遍认为 HSP72 在运动后的恢复和适应中发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: The heat-based recovery methods were also associated with more favorable changes in biological markers linked to muscle damage and inflammation.
paras.zh: 基于热的恢复方法还与与肌肉损伤和炎症相关的生物标志物的更有利的变化有关。

paras.en: So our findings suggest that exposure to heat may be better at stimulating the biological processes involved in recovery.
paras.zh: 因此，我们的研究结果表明，暴露在高温下可能更能刺激恢复过程中涉及的生物过程。

paras.en: Cold-water immersion was not shown to improve any of the recovery markers measured in the study. It also showed the slowest recovery, with strength returning to around 82% of pre-exercise levels after 72 hours, compared with 88-89 percent in the other groups.
paras.zh: 冷水浸泡并未显示出可以改善研究中测量的任何恢复指标。它还表现出恢复最慢的情况，72 小时后力量恢复到运动前水平的 82% 左右，而其他组为 88-89%。

paras.en: But cold-water immersion appeared more effective at reducing perceptions of muscle soreness. This highlights how feeling recovered and actually being physiologically recovered are not always the same thing.
paras.zh: 但冷水浸泡似乎能更有效地减少肌肉酸痛的感觉。这凸显了感觉恢复和实际生理恢复并不总是同一件事。

paras.en: These findings should be interpreted with some caution, however. The study involved 40 healthy, physically active adults—with just ten participants in each intervention group. While the study was adjusted to detect moderate effects, the sample size wasn’t large enough to explore potential differences between men and women.
paras.zh: 然而，对这些发现的解释应谨慎。该研究涉及 40 名健康、身体活跃的成年人，每个干预组只有 10 名参与者。虽然该研究进行了调整以检测中等影响，但样本量不足以探索男性和女性之间的潜在差异。

paras.en: One of the most important lessons from our study is that recovery cannot be measured using a single outcome.
paras.zh: 我们研究中最重要的教训之一是，不能使用单一结果来衡量恢复情况。

paras.en: A person may feel less sore but may still have reduced muscle function. Also, important repair processes may be occurring inside the body without producing immediate improvements in performance.
paras.zh: 一个人可能会感觉疼痛减轻，但肌肉功能仍然可能下降。此外，重要的修复过程可能发生在体内，但不会立即改善性能。

paras.en: This distinction may help explain why recovery research has produced mixed findings over the years. Different interventions may influence different aspects of recovery.
paras.zh: 这种区别可能有助于解释为什么多年来恢复研究得出的结果好坏参半。不同的干预措施可能会影响康复的不同方面。

paras.en: If your priority is reducing how sore you feel after a workout, cold-water immersion may be the most beneficial. But if your goal is to influence the biological processes that help your muscles to repair and adapt, heat-based recovery may be a better choice.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是减轻锻炼后的酸痛感，那么冷水浸泡可能是最有益的。但如果您的目标是影响帮助肌肉修复和适应的生物过程，那么热恢复可能是更好的选择。

paras.en: Our findings don’t suggest that ice baths are completely ineffective. Ice baths were still found to help people feel better.
paras.zh: 我们的研究结果并不表明冰浴完全无效。人们仍然发现冰浴可以帮助人们感觉更好。

paras.en: What our study shows is that recovery is about far more than how you feel the next day. Sometimes the most important changes are happening beneath the surface.
paras.zh: 我们的研究表明，康复远不只是您第二天的感受。有时，最重要的变化发生在表面之下。

paras.en: This article was first published by The Conversation. Read the original article here.
paras.zh: 本文最初由《对话》发表。在这里阅读原文。

articles.title: Science to restore speech is moving fast. Here’s what’s next
articles.author: Laura Sanders

paras.en: Scientists are racing to restore people’s ability to communicate. Powerful AI-based methods to decode speech signals and predict words, along with advances in technology, promise success.
paras.zh: 科学家们正在竞相恢复人们的沟通能力。强大的基于人工智能的方法来解码语音信号和预测单词，加上技术的进步，有望取得成功。

paras.en: This episode of The Deep End: Talk to Me takes listeners through the breadth of scientific efforts to restore words, emotions and even gestures to people who can’t move or talk.
paras.zh: 这一集《深渊：对我说话》将带领听众了解科学努力的广度，以帮助无法移动或说话的人恢复言语、情感甚至手势。

paras.en: We’ll hear from Casey Harrell, a man with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis who can no longer talk. A user of today’s technology, Harrell has a unique perspective on what he’d like to see improved for the technology of tomorrow.
paras.zh: 我们将听到凯西·哈雷尔 (Casey Harrell) 的来信，他患有肌萎缩侧索硬化症，无法说话。作为当今技术的用户，哈勒尔对于他希望看到未来技术的改进有着独特的视角。

paras.en: And as season two wraps up, listeners will be left with a reminder of the power of a voice: a piece of comedy from Jules Rodriguez, performed with his voice clone in front of a live crowd.
paras.zh: 随着第二季的结束，听众将记住声音的力量：朱尔斯·罗德里格斯的一部喜剧，在现场观众面前用他的声音克隆表演。

paras.en: “Being backstage and then seeing him come out, like, roll out his wheelchair, and everybody goes nuts because they’re like, ‘What is going on here? This doesn’t make sense,’” says Jules’ wife, Maria Aleandra Fernandez. “And every time I was like, ‘This is life. This is love. This is passion. What else is there?’ I don’t know that there’s anything else more powerful than what this guy is doing here.”
paras.zh: “在后台，然后看到他出来，就像推出轮椅一样，每个人都疯了，因为他们会说，‘这里发生了什么事？这没有道理，’”朱尔斯的妻子玛丽亚·阿利安德拉·费尔南德斯 (Maria Aleandra Fernandez) 说道。 “每次我都会想，‘这就是生活。这就是爱。这就是激情。还有什么？’我不知道还有什么比这个家伙在这里所做的事情更强大的了。”

paras.en: Laura Sanders: OK, I want to ask who your favorite comedians are and why. Who makes you all laugh?
paras.zh: 劳拉·桑德斯：好的，我想问你最喜欢的喜剧演员是谁以及为什么。谁让大家笑了？

paras.en: Jules Rodriguez: Pete Holmes and Mike Birbiglia are some of my favorites.
paras.zh: 朱尔斯·罗德里格斯：皮特·霍尔姆斯和迈克·比尔比利亚是我的最爱。

paras.en: [Audio] He was just like, I’m a bear, et cetera.
paras.zh: [音频]他就像，我是一只熊，等等。

paras.en: [Audio] The best part of sleep is falling asleep. That’s the only part you’re there for.
paras.zh: [音频] 睡眠最好的部分就是入睡。这是你唯一要做的事情。

paras.en: Jules: Their styles are different, but I have always gravitated towards their authenticity.
paras.zh: Jules：他们的风格不同，但我一直偏向于他们的真实性。

paras.en: Sanders: There’s another comedian who is extra meaningful for Jules: Conan O’Brien.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：还有一位喜剧演员对朱尔斯来说特别有意义：柯南·奥布莱恩。

paras.en: [Audio] Today is a bit of a different sort of episode. I’ll be talking to Jules and Maria.
paras.zh: [音频] 今天的情节有点不同。我要和朱尔斯和玛丽亚说话。

paras.en: Sanders: After MA had reached out, Conan invited the couple onto his podcast, where they connected about comedy. Conan still checks in on Jules every so often.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：MA 联系后，柯南邀请这对夫妇加入他的播客，他们在那里谈论喜剧。柯南仍然时不时地来看望朱尔斯。

paras.en: [Audio] It’s incredible to me that in our conversations, you’re very frank about the pain that you go through, and how intense it is. But you’re also always so positive and funny and, frankly, you give me a lot of [beep]. Which I find to be, well I hate it, by the way, first of all. Oh, get over it, Conan.
paras.zh: [音频]令我难以置信的是，在我们的谈话中，你非常坦率地讲述了你所经历的痛苦，以及它有多么强烈。但你也总是那么积极、有趣，坦率地说，你给了我很多[嘟嘟]。我发现，顺便说一句，首先，我讨厌它。哦，克服它，柯南。

paras.en: Jules: Conan is very special to me. Watching and listening to him helped me disconnect from the harsh reality of my life. And when I got to meet him and chat with him, it meant the world to me.
paras.zh: 朱尔斯：柯南对我来说很特别。观看和聆听他的讲话帮助我摆脱了生活中严酷的现实。当我见到他并与他聊天时，这对我来说意味着整个世界。

paras.en: Maria Aleandra Fernandez: Having the most normal conversation with Conan O’Brien is something I will never get over.
paras.zh: 玛丽亚·阿利安德拉·费尔南德斯：与柯南·奥布莱恩进行最正常的对话是我永远无法克服的事情。

paras.en: [Audio] So he has a bunch of banked phrases. He’s going to play a few of our favorites. OK. I’m fine. I’m perfectly [beep] fine. [laughter] Come on man, are we doing this or not? Oh my God, oh my God. I’m destroying this marriage.
paras.zh: [音频]所以他有一堆储存的短语。他将演奏一些我们最喜欢的曲目。好的。我很好。我很好[哔]很好。 [笑声]来吧伙计，我们到底要不要这样做？天啊，天啊。我正在毁掉这段婚姻。

paras.en: MA: He really is so genuine and like, not only willing to talk to us, but really looks forward to talking. Like, I love talking to you guys. I’m not just doing it to be a nice person, which feels, you know, feels wonderful.
paras.zh: MA：他真的很真诚，很喜欢，不仅愿意和我们交谈，而且真的很期待交谈。就像，我喜欢和你们聊天。我这样做不仅仅是为了成为一个好人，这感觉，你知道，感觉很棒。

paras.en: [Audio] You have my love, my respect and we’re thinking about you guys all the time.
paras.zh: [音频]你们拥有我的爱、我的尊重，我们一直在想着你们。

paras.en: Sanders: As you were talking earlier, it made me think about what it means to make somebody laugh and to entertain them, and like how actually very, very special that must be. Just kind of, at its heart, it’s, it is joy and humans connecting. And so, extra special.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：正如你之前所说，这让我思考让别人发笑并娱乐他们意味着什么，并且喜欢这实际上是非常非常特别的。从本质上讲，它是快乐和人类的联系。所以，格外特别。

paras.en: MA: That’s the other thing I’ve learned mainly through Jules, about humor and comedy. And who were we watching yesterday? The NPR interview with Dave Chappelle.
paras.zh: MA：这是我主要通过朱尔斯学到的另一件事，关于幽默和喜剧。昨天我们看谁了？美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 采访戴夫·查佩尔 (Dave Chappelle)。

paras.en: [Audio] Dave Chappelle says he is very clear about his role as a comedian.
paras.zh: [音频]戴夫·查普尔说他非常清楚自己作为喜剧演员的角色。

paras.en: MA: And Dave Chappelle said something that is so spot-on. He said that comedians are how people metabolize things.
paras.zh: MA：戴夫·查佩尔（Dave Chappelle）说了一些非常准确的话。他说喜剧演员就是人们代谢事物的方式。

paras.en: [Audio] We’re like the nation’s kidney. We help everyone metabolize not just facts, but feelings around facts, or ideas. And jokes are just a shorthand for all of that.
paras.zh: [音频]我们就像国家的肾脏。我们不仅帮助每个人代谢事实，还帮助每个人代谢事实或想法的感受。笑话只是所有这一切的简写。

paras.en: MA: And I’m also a nerd and I’ve been reading some Greek tragedies and studying about how, you know, that’s also like the artists that help people metabolize feelings and emotions. And when he said that, I was like, that’s exactly it. And that’s what Jules has done.
paras.zh: MA：我也是一个书呆子，我一直在读一些希腊悲剧，并研究如何，你知道，这也像艺术家一样帮助人们代谢感觉和情绪。当他这么说时，我想，就是这样。这就是朱尔斯所做的。

paras.en: It’s something that heals. And it’s not even like it’s self-deprecating. It’s not like, oh, let’s make fun. And the way he does it is so smart and genuine, but also not taking himself seriously. It just disarms everything. You’re just like, oh, OK. And that idea of metabolizing the really hard feelings that come around grief, mortality, losing a person, seeing how he’s trapped in his body, but he chooses not to be trapped in that really big way is so profound.
paras.zh: 这是一种可以治愈的东西。而且这甚至不像是自嘲。这不像是，哦，让我们开玩笑吧。他的做法是如此聪明和真诚，但也不把自己当回事。它只会解除一切武装。你就像，哦，好吧。代谢掉悲伤、死亡、失去一个人所带来的真正痛苦的感觉，看到他如何被困在自己的身体里，但他选择不被困在那个真正的大方式中，这种想法是如此深刻。

paras.en: Sanders: Science is iterative. It builds. It may take a wrong turn or two, but overall, it’s moving toward a deeper understanding of our world and of ourselves.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：科学是迭代的。它建立了。它可能会走一两个错误的弯路，但总的来说，它正在朝着对我们的世界和我们自己有更深入的了解的方向发展。

paras.en: By using their voices, by telling their stories, by telling their jokes, Jules and MA are helping me, and maybe you too, metabolize the pain – and the joy – of living. Welcome to The Deep End, Talk to Me.
paras.zh: 通过使用他们的声音，通过讲述他们的故事，通过讲他们的笑话，朱尔斯和马正在帮助我，也许你也是，代谢生活中的痛苦和快乐。欢迎来到深渊，跟我说话。

paras.en: [Voices] Hey mom, can I tell you something? Hi. Do you want to talk? That added layer of it being you. Hello? Your voice. Hi.
paras.zh: [声音] 嘿妈妈，我可以告诉你一件事吗？你好。你想说话吗？那增加的一层就是你。你好？你的声音。你好。

paras.en: Sanders: I’m Laura Sanders and today, we’re going to look ahead to what’s coming next for the human voice and efforts to restore it.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：我是劳拉·桑德斯，今天，我们将展望人类声音的下一步发展以及恢复它的努力。

paras.en: Sanders: In some ways, this podcast is a story of progress, of figuring out, little by little, more about the brain, and more about technology and more about people. Today, Jules can type with his eyes, and his son can hear his dad’s voice say I love you. In earlier episodes, you heard from Casey Harrell. Casey can think about saying a word to his daughter, and boom, they’re off playing a game together.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：从某些方面来说，这个播客是一个关于进步的故事，一个关于一点一点地弄清楚更多关于大脑、更多关于技术和更多关于人的故事。今天，朱尔斯可以用眼睛打字，他的儿子可以听到父亲的声音说我爱你。在之前的剧集中，您听到了凯西·哈勒尔的来信。凯西可以考虑对他的女儿说一句话，然后，他们就一起去玩游戏了。

paras.en: Casey Harrell: So this has kept me still in touch with people and the world, and it is not hyperbole to frame it this way.
paras.zh: 凯西·哈勒尔：所以这让我仍然与人们和世界保持联系，这样说并不夸张。

paras.en: Sanders: Casey has ALS and can no longer speak. He volunteered for a clinical trial, and now he has a device implanted in his brain that detects neural patterns as he tries to say a word. This system has changed his life.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：凯西患有肌萎缩侧索硬化症，无法说话。他自愿参加一项临床试验，现在他的大脑中植入了一个装置，可以在他试图说话时检测神经模式。这个系统改变了他的生活。

paras.en: Casey: It is the ability to parent my daughter. It is the ability to connect with my wife. It is the ability to make a wry joke with my friends. Timing is everything, and that is why having nothing, this is completely revolutionary.
paras.zh: 凯西：这是养育女儿的能力。这是与我妻子联系的能力。这是与朋友开玩笑的能力。时机就是一切，这就是为什么什么都没有，这是完全革命性的。

paras.en: Sanders: But there aren’t many people like Casey. Leigh Hochberg is the director of the BrainGate clinical trials consortium, the trial that Casey is participating in. I asked him how many people might have participated in similar sorts of research projects. How many people have electrodes in their brain that can help them speak?
paras.zh: 桑德斯：但是像凯西这样的人并不多。 Leigh Hochberg 是 BrainGate 临床试验联盟的主任，Casey 正在参与该试验。我问他可能有多少人参与过类似的研究项目。有多少人的大脑中有可以帮助他们说话的电极？

paras.en: Leigh Hochberg: In terms of actually decoding attempted speech, I’m almost sure it’s still less than 10. It may be closer to five or six, so far, and that number undoubtedly is going to increase fairly quickly.
paras.zh: Leigh Hochberg：就实际解码尝试的语音而言，我几乎可以肯定它仍然少于 10 个。到目前为止，它可能接近 5 个或 6 个，而且这个数字无疑会很快增加。

paras.en: Sanders: So this is a small but growing number. Growing, because we now have a solid scientific understanding of the brain’s speech signals, and other signals too. And neurotech companies are very interested.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：所以这是一个很小但不断增长的数字。不断增长，因为我们现在对大脑的语音信号和其他信号有了扎实的科学理解。神经科技公司对此非常感兴趣。

paras.en: Hochberg: About 10 years ago or so, the academic research had de-risked this field sufficiently that it allowed for the entry of now likely a dozen or more companies that are actively pursuing their own version of an implantable brain-computer interface.
paras.zh: Hochberg：大约十年前，学术研究已经充分降低了这一领域的风险，以至于现在可能有十几家或更多的公司进入该领域，这些公司正在积极开发自己的可植入脑机接口版本。

paras.en: What I anticipate will happen, what I guess I hope will happen, is that the companies will continue to very carefully, thoughtfully and in a very focused manner, create their systems, and test them rigorously. And hopefully they’ll be demonstrated to be safe and effective. And at the same time, the academic groups have the opportunity to continue to demonstrate what’s possible, to push beyond that, and to show hopefully what those medical devices, once they’re actually available to market, might be able to do next.
paras.zh: 我预计将会发生的事情，我想我希望将会发生的事情是，这些公司将继续非常仔细、深思熟虑、以非常专注的方式创建他们的系统，并严格测试它们。希望它们能被证明是安全有效的。与此同时，学术团体有机会继续展示可能性，超越这一点，并希望展示这些医疗设备一旦真正推向市场，下一步可能能够做什么。

paras.en: Sanders: I talked with Vikash Gilja, a neural engineer who works at a company called Paradromics. He sees this momentum that Hochberg describes too.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：我与 Vikash Gilja 进行了交谈，他是一名神经工程师，在一家名为 Paradromics 的公司工作。他也看到了霍赫伯格所描述的这种势头。

paras.en: Vikash Gilja: And, you know, we can see all the pieces coming together. These tools weren’t available even five years ago. And what we’re seeing is like, you know, month over month, there are new tools available. So we’re able to leverage those and move faster.
paras.zh: Vikash Gilja：而且，你知道，我们可以看到所有的部分都整合在一起。这些工具在五年前还没有出现。我们看到的是，你知道，每个月都有新的工具可用。因此，我们能够利用这些并更快地采取行动。

paras.en: Sanders: Paradromics has developed its own brain-computer interface for communication. The device is about the size of a dime, and it sits on the motor cortex. That’s the part of the brain that creates speech signals. The chip then detects these signals as a person thinks about saying a word.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：Paradromics 开发了自己的用于通信的脑机接口。该设备大约有一毛钱大小，位于运动皮层上。这是大脑中产生语音信号的部分。当一个人想要说一个词时，芯片就会检测到这些信号。

paras.en: Matthew Willsey: So the cortical module has 421 tiny little sensors.
paras.zh: Matthew Willsey：皮质模块有 421 个微小的传感器。

paras.en: Sanders: That’s neurosurgeon and biomedical engineer Matthew Willsey, of the University of Michigan Health. He’s describing the device from Paradromics here.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：这是密歇根大学健康分校的神经外科医生和生物医学工程师马修·威尔西。他在这里描述了 Paradromics 的设备。

paras.en: Willsey: They’re about one and a half millimeters long. And you know, it’s smaller than your thumbnail, like kind of all the way around. It’s like a cylinder. And at the bottom of the cylinder are the electrodes, is what we call them. And we get them really close to the brain. And then when we deploy it, what it does is it pushes those electrodes down into the brain.
paras.zh: 威尔西：它们大约一毫米半长。你知道，它比你的缩略图还要小，就像周围一样。它就像一个圆柱体。圆柱体的底部是电极，就是我们所说的电极。我们让它们非常接近大脑。然后当我们部署它时，它的作用是将这些电极向下推入大脑。

paras.en: Sanders: Those tiny sensors are listening to the nearby neurons that control the muscles required for speech.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：这些微小的传感器正在聆听附近控制言语所需肌肉的神经元的声音。

paras.en: Willsey: The principle is to try and get these things as small as possible to disrupt the least amount of tissue as possible, and then to get them really, really close to the individual cells, the neurons themselves that have the information we’re trying to record.
paras.zh: Willsey：原则是尝试让这些东西尽可能小，以尽可能少地破坏组织，然后让它们真正非常接近单个细胞，即拥有我们试图记录信息的神经元本身。

paras.en: Sanders: The goal here is to restore a person’s ability to talk.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：这里的目标是恢复一个人的说话能力。

paras.en: Willsey: So in the ideal situation, the electrodes would sit, you know, right next to those neurons. This type of technology that’s very intuitive, that can record activity from the brain in kind of a high-throughput way, can put the words up at a good speed and a good accuracy, allows them to kind of regain the ability to communicate with others close to how they maybe were before they had the illness. So that truly is very powerful.
paras.zh: 威尔西：所以在理想情况下，电极应该位于那些神经元旁边。这种非常直观的技术，可以以高通量的方式记录大脑的活动，可以以良好的速度和良好的准确性说出单词，使他们能够重新获得与他人沟通的能力，接近他们患病之前的状态。所以这确实是非常强大的。

paras.en: Sanders: You might remember that Casey’s implant, called the BrainGate 2 system, requires ports on his head that are connected to external wires.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：你可能还记得凯西的植入物，称为 BrainGate 2 系统，需要他头上的端口连接到外部电线。

paras.en: Casey: What is annoying about this device is really easy to answer. It is not portable, and it is not implanted only inside my head.
paras.zh: 凯西：这个设备令人烦恼的地方很容易回答。它不是便携式的，也不是只植入我的脑袋里。

paras.en: Sanders: Unlike Casey’s implant, the Paradromics device is fully implantable. That means it’s wireless. This summer, Willsey implanted Paradromic’s device in a volunteer’s brain. The brain belonged to a 68-year-old woman who lives in Michigan. She has primary lateral sclerosis, a disease that has taken away most of her ability to talk. So far, the Paradromics system is up and running, and the volunteer is testing her abilities out.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：与凯西的植入物不同，Paradromics 设备是完全可植入的。这意味着它是无线的。今年夏天，威尔西将 Paradromic 的设备植入一名志愿者的大脑中。大脑属于一位居住在密歇根州的 68 岁女性。她患有原发性侧索硬化症，这种疾病剥夺了她大部分说话的能力。到目前为止，Paradromics 系统已经启动并运行，志愿者正在测试她的能力。

paras.en: Here she is talking with Willsey and other researchers in a video provided by Paradromics. You’ll hear her natural voice, which is hard to understand, and then a digital voice speaking the words her brain implant decoded.
paras.zh: 在 Paradromics 提供的视频中，她正在与威尔西和其他研究人员交谈。你会听到她自然的声音，这很难理解，然后是一个数字声音，说出她的大脑植入解码的单词。

paras.en: [Audio] I love the change of seasons in Michigan. And my favorite one is the fall. I love the change of seasons in Michigan. And my favorite one is the fall. Yeah, it’s good.
paras.zh: [音频]我喜欢密歇根州的季节变化。我最喜欢的是秋天。我喜欢密歇根州的季节变化。我最喜欢的是秋天。是的，这很好。

paras.en: Sanders: This volunteer has used the device to talk to her grandkids on the phone. But this is just the very beginning for this research project. There’s so much more to test.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：这位志愿者使用该设备与她的孙子们通电话。但这只是这个研究项目的开始。还有很多东西需要测试。

paras.en: Casey is still working on his system, too — particularly, streamlining the process. When Casey uses his brain-computer interface, it decodes speech signals from his brain, then puts words on a screen. Casey then selects a button, using his eye movements or his brain-computer interface, to say these words out loud with a digital voice. Here’s Casey.
paras.zh: 凯西仍在研究他的系统，特别是简化流程。当凯西使用他的脑机接口时，它会解码来自他大脑的语音信号，然后将文字显示在屏幕上。然后凯西使用他的眼球运动或脑机接口选择一个按钮，用数字声音大声说出这些词。这是凯西。

paras.en: Casey: It is not fast enough to provide enough instant conversation with other people that need to slow down to talk to me.
paras.zh: 凯西：它的速度不够快，无法与其他需要放慢速度与我交谈的人提供足够的即时对话。

paras.en: Sanders: But scientists want to skip this middle part — the words written on a screen. They want instead to go straight to speech, and perhaps make conversations faster. Casey says this goal to go directly from brain signals to a speaking digital voice would be his top priority.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：但是科学家们想跳过中间部分——屏幕上写的文字。相反，他们希望直接开始讲话，也许可以让对话更快。凯西表示，将大脑信号直接转化为数字语音的目标将是他的首要任务。

paras.en: Casey: That one is the holy grail of what this will become in terms of speech. It will allow you to have a seamless conversation. I am talking about, yes, I will intend to talk, and then it will just translate that automatically into speech, like we do, and you are doing right now.
paras.zh: 凯西：这就是演讲方面的圣杯。它将使您能够进行无缝的对话。我说的是，是的，我打算说话，然后它会自动将其转化为言语，就像我们所做的那样，而你现在正在做的事情。

paras.en: Sanders: In an earlier episode, we talked about attempts to do just this with Casey’s system, to push it to do what they call brain-to-voice. Early attempts were hard to decipher. But it has already improved, by a lot. In the latest tests, this brain-to-voice process produces words that are understandable – reaching about 95 percent accuracy for listeners. Here’s Casey speaking test sentences. It comes from a preprint manuscript posted on the website bioRxiv.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：在之前的一集中，我们谈到了尝试用凯西的系统来做到这一点，推动它做他们所谓的大脑到声音的事情。早期的尝试很难破译。但它已经改善了很多。在最新的测试中，这种大脑到声音的过程产生了可以理解的单词——对于听众来说，准确率达到了 95% 左右。这是凯西口语测试句子。它来自 bioRxiv 网站上发布的预印本手稿。

paras.en: [Audio] The day is not over yet. Please come in with me.
paras.zh: [音频] 这一天还没有结束。请跟我进来。

paras.en: Sanders: Scientists have another thing on their to-do list. And this one goes beyond the words themselves. Here’s Gilja, from Paradromics.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：科学家们的待办事项清单上还有另一件事。这超出了言语本身。这是来自 Paradromics 的 Gilja。

paras.en: Gilja: Let’s say I identify whether a sentence is a statement or a question. Well, now you can pass that information on to speech synthesis, so that you get these two different versions.
paras.zh: Gilja：假设我识别一个句子是陈述还是问题。好吧，现在您可以将该信息传递给语音合成，以便获得这两个不同的版本。

paras.en: Sanders: The same words could be a statement or a question. You see what he means. You see what he means? And that information can be pulled out from a person’s brain activity.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：同样的词可以是陈述，也可以是问题。你明白他的意思。你明白他的意思吗？这些信息可以从一个人的大脑活动中提取出来。

paras.en: Gilja: If I’m decoding prosodic information, if I’m decoding speed, when a word is meant to appear, that can also be passed on to modern speech synthesis systems, so that you’re more accurately capturing the prosody that somebody intends. Same thing with loudness, right? So you can see how as that information becomes available from the neural channels, it can be provided to the AI speech synthesis to get closer to the intended voice in the moment that the individual wants to generate.
paras.zh: Gilja：如果我正在解码韵律信息，如果我正在解码速度，当一个单词应该出现时，它也可以传递到现代语音合成系统，这样你就可以更准确地捕捉某人想要的韵律。响度也是一样，对吧？因此，您可以看到，当神经通道提供这些信息时，如何将其提供给人工智能语音合成，以更接近个人想要生成的时刻的预期声音。

paras.en: Sanders: All of these signals can be collected and used to build a more accurate voice — one that says things exactly how a person intends to say them, like a Minnesotan’s ooftah or a slow southern hey y’all. Now, today’s voice clones can add these emotional layers onto words already. Here’s what Jules told me when I asked him about whether his voice clone can do it.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：所有这些信号都可以被收集并用来构建更准确的声音——一种完全按照一个人想要说的方式说话的声音，就像明尼苏达州的“ooftah”或缓慢的南方“嘿，大家”。现在，今天的语音克隆已经可以将这些情感层添加到单词中。当我问朱尔斯他的声音克隆能否做到这一点时，这是朱尔斯告诉我的。

paras.en: Jules: Oh, there are plenty of things it does that are all the above. But one thing in particular is how it inserts tone and inflections on words. Sometimes my wife will get mad because my response can come off with some sass.
paras.zh: Jules：哦，它做了很多事情，就是上面提到的。但特别的一件事是它如何在单词中插入语气和变化。有时我的妻子会生气，因为我的回答可能有些无礼。

paras.en: Sanders: So there’s loudness, emphasis, pitch — all of these things contribute to what words means. But imagine if a brain implant can pick up these cues directly — no typing required. Here’s Hochberg.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：所以有响度、强调、音调——所有这些因素都有助于表达单词的含义。但想象一下，如果大脑植入物可以直接接收这些线索——无需打字。这是霍赫伯格。

paras.en: Hochberg: There’s a lot that can be conveyed through the emphasis, through the tone, through even the humor that can sometimes be conveyed by the way that somebody who’s able-bodied may speak a particular sentence. All of those, I think, really can be captured by these implantable brain-computer interfaces by harnessing the rich neural activity that’s available from the brain. We should be able to restore a lot of that.
paras.zh: 霍赫伯格：通过强调、语气、甚至幽默，可以传达很多东西，有时可以通过身体健全的人说某个特定句子的方式来传达。我认为，所有这些都可以通过利用大脑丰富的神经活动，通过这些植入式脑机接口来捕获。我们应该能够恢复很多。

paras.en: Sanders: Sergey Stavisky is one of the UC Davis researchers working with Casey and Hochberg. He and his colleagues are working on some of these ideas.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：谢尔盖·斯塔维斯基是加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员之一，与凯西和霍赫伯格一起工作。他和他的同事正在研究其中一些想法。

paras.en: Stavisky: And even now we’re continuing to improve that and actually adding additional layers. So we have one forward-looking project where we can maybe decode the kind of emotional valence of how he’s trying to say it. Is he trying to say something in an angry way or in a surprised way or in a happy-sounding way, to kind of further make it more expressive.
paras.zh: Stavisky：即使是现在，我们仍在继续改进这一点，并实际上添加了额外的层。因此，我们有一个前瞻性的项目，我们也许可以解读他试图表达的情感价值。他是否试图以愤怒的方式、惊讶的方式或听起来快乐的方式说某事，以进一步使其更具表现力。

paras.en: Sanders: They’re even trying to decode singing. Well, OK, it’s really more of a hum at this point, he says. But those sorts of tone shifts could, in theory, be deciphered.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：他们甚至试图解码歌唱。好吧，好吧，现在更多的是嗡嗡声，他说。但从理论上讲，这些语气转变是可以被解读的。

paras.en: Stavisky: We definitely have our work cut out for us on the singing and melody side of things.
paras.zh: 斯塔维斯基：在歌唱和旋律方面，我们确实有很多工作要做。

paras.en: Sanders: All sorts of voice signals could be pulled from brain activity.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：各种声音信号都可以从大脑活动中提取。

paras.en: Stavisky: Ultimately, we want people to be in full control of what they’re communicating. This should come from their intent. So, yeah, we are trying to decode all of the aspects of his voice, whether it’s the pitch, the timbre, the loudness, the intonation, which word he’s stressing. All of that, ideally, we would decode from brain activity, including kind of all of that emotional nuance.
paras.zh: 斯塔维斯基：最终，我们希望人们能够完全控制他们所交流的内容。这应该是出于他们的意图。所以，是的，我们正在尝试解码他声音的所有方面，无论是音调、音色、响度、语调，还是他强调的单词。理想情况下，我们可以从大脑活动中解码所有这些，包括所有情感上的细微差别。

paras.en: Sanders: Voice clones can speak with various emotions. You heard my voice clone do just that in earlier episodes. But the difference here is that a person wouldn’t have to type in the instructions. They would come straight from their brain, seamlessly. Other nonverbal signals can be pulled from the brain, too.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：声音克隆可以表达各种情绪。你在之前的剧集中听到我的声音克隆就是这样做的。但这里的区别在于，人们不必输入说明。它们会直接来自他们的大脑，无缝地。其他非语言信号也可以从大脑中提取。

paras.en: Samantha Brosler: In the past five years or so, there have been a lot of advancements in the field of BCIs for restoring individual functions to people with paralysis.
paras.zh: Samantha Brosler：在过去五年左右的时间里，脑机接口领域在帮助瘫痪患者恢复个人功能方面取得了很多进展。
