articles.title: This Week In Space podcast: Episode 236 — Alienspotting
articles.author: Space.com Staff

paras.en: On Episode 236 of This Week In Space, Tariq Malik and Rod Pyle are joined by Mikhail Tikhonov to talk about how life can take more unusual forms, ones we might not even recognize.
paras.zh: 在《本周太空》第 236 集中，塔里克·马利克和罗德·派尔与米哈伊尔·吉洪诺夫一起谈论生命如何采取更不寻常的形式，我们甚至可能不认识这些形式。

paras.en: When we think of extraterrestrials, our minds generally go from the latex-suited bipedal aliens seen in Star Trek and Star Wars to more exotic critters in sci-fi movies. Scientists think in terms of carbon-based microbial life and other lower life forms.
paras.zh: 当我们想到外星人时，我们的脑海通常会想到《星际迷航》和《星球大战》中穿着乳胶衣的双足外星人，再到科幻电影中更奇特的生物。科学家们从碳基微生物生命和其他低等生命形式的角度进行思考。

paras.en: But some researchers, such as Tikhonov from Washington University, suggest that life can take more unusual forms, ones we might not even recognize. He further suggests a new definition of life: something that takes in and transforms energy and replicates. His ideas radically expand our notions of alien life and how it might be recognized.
paras.zh: 但一些研究人员，例如华盛顿大学的吉洪诺夫，认为生命可以采取更不寻常的形式，我们甚至可能不认识。他进一步提出了生命的新定义：吸收、转化能量并复制的东西。他的想法从根本上扩展了我们对外星生命以及如何识别外星生命的观念。

paras.en: Get episodes ad-free with Club TWiT at https://twit.tv/clubtwit
paras.zh: 通过 Club TWiT 获取无广告的剧集：https://twit.tv/clubtwit

paras.en: Finally, did you know you can launch your own SpaceX rocket? Model rocket maker Estes' stunning scale model of a Falcon 9 rocket that you can pick up now. The launchable model is a detailed recreation of the Falcon 9 and retails for $149.99. You can save 10% by using the code IN-COLLECTSPACE at checkout, courtesy of our partners collectSPACE.com.
paras.zh: 最后，您知道您可以发射自己的 SpaceX 火箭吗？火箭模型制造商 Estes 制作的令人惊叹的猎鹰 9 号火箭比例模型，您现在就可以购买。该可发射模型是 Falcon 9 的详细重现，零售价为 149.99 美元。您可以在结帐时使用代码 IN-COLLECTSPACE 节省 10%，这是由我们的合作伙伴collectSPACE.com 提供的。

paras.en: This Week in Space covers the new space age. Every Friday we take a deep dive into a fascinating topic. What's happening with the new race to the moon and other planets? When will SpaceX really send people to Mars?
paras.zh: 本周太空周涵盖了新太空时代。每个星期五我们都会深入探讨一个有趣的话题。新一轮的月球和其他行星竞赛发生了什么？ SpaceX什么时候才能真正把人送上火星？

paras.en: Rod Pyle is an author, journalist, television producer and Editor-in-Chief of Ad Astra magazine. He has written 18 books on space history, exploration, and development, including Space 2.0, Innovation the NASA Way, Interplanetary Robots, Blueprint for a Battlestar, Amazing Stories of the Space Age, First On the Moon, and Destination Mars
paras.zh: 罗德·派尔 (Rod Pyle) 是一位作家、记者、电视制片人和《Ad Astra》杂志的主编。他撰写了 18 本有关太空历史、探索和发展的书籍，包括《Space 2.0》、《Innovation the NASA Way》、《Interplanetary Robots》、《Battlestar 蓝图》、《Amazing Stories of the Space Age》、《First On the Moon》和《Destination Mars》

paras.en: In a previous life, Rod produced numerous documentaries and short films for The History Channel, Discovery Communications, and Disney. He also worked in visual effects on Star Trek: Deep Space Nine and the Battlestar Galactica reboot, as well as various sci-fi TV pilots. His most recent TV credit was with the NatGeo documentary on Tom Wolfe's iconic book The Right Stuff.
paras.zh: 罗德曾为历史频道、探索传播公司和迪士尼制作了大量纪录片和短片。他还参与了《星际迷航：深空九号》和《太空堡垒卡拉狄加》重启以及各种科幻电视试播集的视觉效果工作。他最近的电视作品是在国家地理频道 (NatGeo) 纪录片中拍摄的，该纪录片讲述了汤姆·沃尔夫 (Tom Wolfe) 的标志性著作《The Right Stuff》。

paras.en: Responsible for Space.com's editorial vision, Tariq Malik has been the Editor-in-Chief of Space.com since 2019 and has covered space news and science for 18 years. He joined the Space.com team in 2001, first as an intern and soon after as a full-time spaceflight reporter covering human spaceflight, exploration, astronomy and the night sky. He became Space.com's managing editor in 2009. As on-air talent has presented space stories on CNN, Fox News, NPR and others.
paras.zh: Tariq Malik 负责 Space.com 的编辑愿景，自 2019 年起担任 Space.com 的主编，报道太空新闻和科学已有 18 年。他于 2001 年加入 Space.com 团队，首先作为实习生，不久之后成为全职航天记者，报道载人航天、探索、天文学和夜空。 2009 年，他成为 Space.com 的总编辑。作为播音人才，他在 CNN、福克斯新闻、NPR 等媒体上讲述太空故事。

paras.en: Tariq is an Eagle Scout (yes, he earned the Space Exploration merit badge), a Space Camp veteran (4 times as a kid, once as an adult), and has taken the ultimate "vomit comet" ride while reporting on zero-gravity fires. Before joining Space.com, he served as a staff reporter for The Los Angeles Times covering city and education beats. He has journalism degrees from the University of Southern California and New York University.
paras.zh: 塔里克是一名鹰级童子军（是的，他获得了太空探索奖章），一名太空营老兵（小时候四次，成年一次），并在报道零重力火灾时乘坐了终极“呕吐彗星”。在加入 Space.com 之前，他曾担任《洛杉矶时报》的特约记者，报道城市和教育动态。他拥有南加州大学和纽约大学的新闻学学位。

paras.en: Space.com is the premier source of space exploration, innovation and astronomy news, chronicling (and celebrating) humanity's ongoing expansion across the final frontier. Originally founded in 1999, Space.com is, and always has been, the passion of writers and editors who are space fans and also trained journalists. Our current news team consists of Editor-in-Chief Tariq Malik; Editor Hanneke Weitering, Senior Space Writer Mike Wall; Senior Writer Meghan Bartels; Senior Writer Chelsea Gohd, Senior Writer Tereza Pultarova and Staff Writer Alexander Cox, focusing on e-commerce. Senior Producer Steve Spaleta oversees our space videos, with Diana Whitcroft as our Social Media Editor.
paras.zh: Space.com 是太空探索、创新和天文学新闻的主要来源，记录（并庆祝）人类在最后疆域的持续扩张。 Space.com 最初成立于 1999 年，一直以来都是太空迷作家和编辑以及训练有素的记者的热情所在。我们目前的新闻团队由主编塔里克·马利克 (Tariq Malik) 组成；编辑 Hanneke Weitering、高级空间作家 Mike Wall；资深作家梅根·巴特尔斯；高级作家 Chelsea Gohd、高级作家 Tereza Pultarova 和特约作家 Alexander Cox，专注于电子商务。高级制作人 Steve Spaleta 负责监督我们的太空视频，Diana Whitcroft 担任我们的社交媒体编辑。

articles.title: ESCAPADE on its way to Mars after Earth flybys
articles.author: Jeff Foust

paras.en: WASHINGTON — Two NASA smallsats are headed toward Mars after completing flybys of Earth nearly a year after their launch.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——美国宇航局的两颗小型卫星在发射近一年后完成了对地球的飞越，目前正飞往火星。

paras.en: The second of two Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers, or ESCAPADE, spacecraft, nicknamed Gold, flew by Earth at about 6 a.m. Eastern Nov. 9, coming within about 1,050 kilometers of Earth. That took place a little more than 48 hours after the first ESCAPADE spacecraft, Blue, made a similar flyby at an altitude of about 1,600 kilometers.
paras.zh: 两艘逃逸与等离子体加速与动力学探测器（ESCAPADE）中的第二艘，昵称“黄金”，于 11 月 9 日东部时间早上 6 点左右飞过地球，距离地球约 1,050 公里。距离第一艘 ESCAPADE 太空飞船“蓝色”号在大约 1,600 公里高度进行类似飞越 48 小时多一点。

paras.en: During both flybys, the Rocket Lab-built spacecraft fired their engines, using a principle called the Oberth effect to maximize the performance of the maneuver. It was the first time a NASA spacecraft used such a powered flyby to go to Mars.
paras.zh: 在两次飞越过程中，火箭实验室制造的航天器都启动了发动机，利用奥伯特效应原理来最大限度地提高机动性能。这是美国宇航局航天器首次使用这种动力飞越火星。

paras.en: “This is the first time NASA has used a powered Earth flyby to propel a spacecraft toward Mars, and we’ve now executed this maneuver twice, flawlessly, in just two days,” Asal Naseri, acting associate flight director in NASA’s heliophysics division, said in an agency statement.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局太阳物理部门代理飞行副主任阿萨尔·纳塞里（Asal Naseri）在一份机构声明中表示：“这是美国宇航局第一次使用动力飞越地球来推动航天器飞向火星，我们现在已经在短短两天内完美地执行了两次这种机动。”

paras.en: ESCAPADE is taking a nontraditional approach to going to Mars. Rather than launch during short windows that open roughly every two years, ESCAPADE launched last November on the second flight of Blue Origin’s New Glenn. The two spacecraft loitered around the Earth-sun L-2 Lagrange point for nearly a year before swinging around Earth in a final maneuver before heading to Mars.
paras.zh: ESCAPADE 正在采取一种非传统的方式前往火星。 ESCAPADE 并没有在大约每两年开放一次的短暂窗口期间发射，而是于去年 11 月在蓝色起源公司 New Glenn 的第二次飞行中发射。这两艘航天器在地球-太阳 L-2 拉格朗日点周围徘徊了近一年，然后在前往火星之前进行最后一次绕地球摆动。

paras.en: That trajectory was developed by Advanced Space as a means of opening up Mars mission launch opportunities outside of traditional windows. “This method provides the flexibility to launch almost anytime and then use Earth’s gravity to get a boost to Mars, rather than waiting every two years to launch there directly when the planets are aligned,” said Jeff Parker of Advanced Space in a statement.
paras.zh: 该轨道由 Advanced Space 开发，作为在传统窗口之外开辟火星任务发射机会的一种手段。高级太空公司的杰夫·帕克在一份声明中表示：“这种方法提供了几乎随时发射的灵活性，然后利用地球引力来推动火星，而不是每两年等待一次，当行星对齐时直接发射到火星。”

paras.en: That approach, though, required a precise burn by each spacecraft’s main engine as they flew by Earth. “These burns were critical in the same way a Mars orbit insertion burn is,” Rob Lillis, principal investigator for ESCAPADE, said during a Nov. 9 meeting of the Mars Exploration Program Analysis Group. “I’m happy to report that they went well. They were executed perfectly.”
paras.zh: 然而，这种方法需要每艘航天器飞过地球时其主发动机进行精确燃烧。 ESCAPADE 首席研究员 Rob Lillis 在 11 月 9 日的火星探索计划分析小组会议上表示：“这些烧伤的重要性与火星轨道插入烧伤的重要性相同。” “我很高兴地报告，他们进展顺利。他们被完美地执行了。”

paras.en: The maneuvers put both spacecraft on trajectories to Mars, arriving two days apart in September 2027. Each spacecraft will perform an 11-minute burn of its main engine to go into orbit around Mars, later maneuvering into its planned science orbit.
paras.zh: 此次演习使两艘航天器都沿着飞往火星的轨道，于 2027 年 9 月抵达，相隔两天。每艘航天器将对其主发动机进行 11 分钟的燃烧，以进入火星轨道，随后机动进入其计划的科学轨道。

paras.en: The two spacecraft will study space weather at Mars, examining how the solar wind interacts with the planet’s magnetosphere and atmosphere. The spacecraft will first perform those observations in the same orbit, separated from each other by up to 30 minutes to measure variations in space weather over time. They will later shift into separate orbits, with one spacecraft focusing on the incoming solar wind and the other on the effects on Mars.
paras.zh: 这两艘航天器将研究火星的太空天气，研究太阳风如何与火星磁层和大气层相互作用。该航天器将首先在同一轨道上进行这些观测，轨道之间的间隔最多为 30 分钟，以测量空间天气随时间的变化。随后，它们将转移到不同的轨道，其中一艘航天器专注于传入的太阳风，另一艘则关注对火星的影响。

paras.en: ESCAPADE is the last surviving mission of a NASA program called SIMPLEx, or Small Innovative Missions for Planetary Exploration, intended to support low-cost planetary science missions. NASA selected ESCAPADE for development in 2019 alongside two other SIMPLEx missions, the Janus asteroid flyby spacecraft and the Lunar Trailblazer orbiter.
paras.zh: ESCAPADE 是 NASA 计划 SIMPLEx（即行星探索小型创新任务）中最后一个幸存的任务，旨在支持低成本的行星科学任务。 NASA 选择在 2019 年开发 ESCAPADE 以及另外两项 SIMPLEx 任务：“杰纳斯”小行星飞越航天器和“月球开拓者”轨道飞行器。

paras.en: However, NASA canceled Janus in 2023 after delays in the launch of the Psyche asteroid mission, on which Janus was a rideshare, prevented it from carrying out its planned asteroid flybys. Lunar Trailblazer malfunctioned shortly after its launch in February 2025, and NASA formally ended the mission five months later after efforts to recover it were unsuccessful.
paras.zh: 然而，NASA 于 2023 年取消了 Janus，原因是 Janus 共享乘车的 Psyche 小行星任务发射延迟，导致其无法执行计划中的小行星飞越任务。月球开拓者号于 2025 年 2 月发射后不久就发生故障，五个月后，美国宇航局在回收努力失败后正式结束了这次任务。

paras.en: Two previous cubesat-class SIMPLEx missions, LunaH-Map and Q-PACE, also failed after their launches. NASA, citing budget pressures, has not solicited proposals for new SIMPLEx missions and has not stated any plans to do so for the foreseeable future.
paras.zh: 之前的两次立方体卫星级 SIMPLEx 任务 LunaH-Map 和 Q-PACE 在发射后也失败了。 NASA 以预算压力为由，尚未征求有关新 SIMPLEx 任务的建议，也没有表示在可预见的未来有任何这样做的计划。

articles.title: Kratos and Seagate Space Partner to Advance Mobile Offshore Launch Capabilities for National Security Missions
articles.author: Seagate Space

paras.en: SAN DIEGO, CA, November 10, 2026 – Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc., a technology company in defense, national security, and global markets, today announced a long-term agreement with Seagate Space for use of the company’s first Gateway offshore launch platform. The agreement supports Kratos’ planned first mission from the platform in 2027, with multiple additional launches anticipated in each subsequent year.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，2026 年 11 月 10 日 – 国防、国家安全和全球市场的技术公司 Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. 今天宣布与 Seagate Space 达成长期协议，使用该公司的首个 Gateway 海上发射平台。该协议支持 Kratos 计划于 2027 年在该平台执行首次任务，预计随后每年还会进行多次发射。

paras.en: The partnership aligns Kratos’ experience delivering real, mission-relevant products and systems, including hypersonic test vehicles, rocket systems, propulsion technologies, target vehicles, and launch services, with Seagate Space’s modular, mobile offshore platform infrastructure. The Gateway series vessels are designed to provide flexible sea-based platforms to complement traditional land-based launch sites and test ranges.
paras.zh: 此次合作将 Kratos 提供真实任务相关产品和系统（包括高超音速测试飞行器、火箭系统、推进技术、目标飞行器和发射服务）的经验与 Seagate Space 的模块化移动海上平台基础设施结合起来。 Gateway系列船舶旨在提供灵活的海基平台，以补充传统的陆基发射场和测试场。

paras.en: The announcement coincides with Seagate Space’s execution of its first Gateway platform construction contract, advancing into physical construction and toward future operational readiness.
paras.zh: 这一公告恰逢 Seagate Space 执行其第一份 Gateway 平台建设合同，推进物理建设并为未来的运营做好准备。

paras.en: “Kratos’ agreement with Seagate Space creates an important new pathway for supporting our customers’ evolving launch and test requirements,” said Dave Carter, President of Kratos Defense & Rocket Support Services. “We are focused on delivering affordable, responsive, and mission-critical solutions. Gateway has the potential to provide our customers with additional launch flexibility, expanded operating locations, and responsive access to mission-relevant test environments.”
paras.zh: Kratos 国防与火箭支持服务总裁 Dave Carter 表示：“Kratos 与 Seagate Space 达成的协议为支持客户不断变化的发射和测试需求开辟了一条重要的新途径。” “我们专注于提供经济实惠、响应迅速且关键任务的解决方案。Gateway 有潜力为我们的客户提供额外的启动灵活性、扩大的运营地点以及对任务相关测试环境的响应式访问。”

paras.en: Seagate Space’s Gateway platform is being developed as a modular and mobile offshore system to support government and commercial launch, testing, and recovery missions. Its maritime mobility can provide mission planners with added flexibility in launch geometry, range access, and scheduling while reducing dependence on fixed terrestrial infrastructure.
paras.zh: Seagate Space 的 Gateway 平台正在开发为模块化移动海上系统，以支持政府和商业发射、测试和回收任务。其海上机动性可以为任务规划者提供发射几何、范围访问和调度方面的更大灵活性，同时减少对固定地面基础设施的依赖。

paras.en: Kratos plans to use the Gateway platform initially in support of defense-related launch and target missions. The companies expect their collaboration to establish a foundation for expanded offshore mission operations as demand grows for hypersonic testing, ballistic-missile targets, responsive launch capabilities, and other national security relevant missions.
paras.zh: 奎托斯计划首先使用网关平台来支持与国防相关的发射和目标任务。随着高超音速测试、弹道导弹目标、响应发射能力和其他国家安全相关任务的需求不断增长，两家公司希望通过合作为扩大海上任务运营奠定基础。

paras.en: “From the beginning, our vision has been to make access to space as open as the ocean itself,” said Sean Fortener, President, Chief Operating Officer and Co-Founder of Seagate Space. “Partnering with Kratos and moving our first Gateway platform into construction represents a major step towards making that vision a reality. Kratos brings real mission requirements and decades of defense experience, and Seagate Space is bringing the maritime infrastructure to support them. With our first build contract signed, we are putting steel behind the vision and moving closer to delivering a capability the industry needs.”
paras.zh: “从一开始，我们的愿景就是让太空进入像海洋本身一样开放，”Seagate Space 总裁、首席运营官兼联合创始人 Sean Fortener 说道。 “与 Kratos 合作并将我们的第一个 Gateway 平台投入建设，是实现这一愿景的重要一步。Kratos 带来了真正的任务要求和数十年的防御经验，而 Seagate Space 则带来了海事基础设施来支持它们。随着我们签署的第一份建造合同，我们正在将钢铁作为愿景的后盾，并更接近于提供行业所需的能力。”

paras.en: Kratos has internally invested in rapidly developing and fielding affordable systems for demanding national security missions. Kratos’ approach is based on the belief that affordability is a technology: designing proven, leading-edge products and systems from the outset for rapid production, operational deployment, and scalable manufacturing.
paras.zh: 奎托斯在内部投资快速开发和部署负担得起的系统，以满足要求严格的国家安全任务。 Kratos 的方法基于这样的信念：可负担性是一项技术：从一开始就设计经过验证的领先产品和系统，以实现快速生产、运营部署和可扩展制造。

paras.en: “Kratos is committed to being first to market with affordable, mission-focused technologies that address the urgent requirements of the United States and its allies,” said Eric DeMarco, Kratos President and CEO. “This partnership with Seagate Space supports that strategy by creating an additional option for our customers to conduct critical launch and test missions. Sea-based launch infrastructure can provide flexibility, responsiveness, and operational choice—capabilities increasingly important to national security missions.”
paras.zh: Kratos 总裁兼首席执行官埃里克·德马科 (Eric DeMarco) 表示：“Kratos 致力于率先向市场推出价格实惠、以任务为中心的技术，以满足美国及其盟国的迫切需求。” “与 Seagate Space 的合作伙伴关系为我们的客户提供了执行关键发射和测试任务的额外选择，从而支持了这一战略。海基发射基础设施可以提供灵活性、响应能力和操作选择，这些能力对国家安全任务越来越重要。”

paras.en: The companies will continue to advance Gateway through construction, integration, and operational-readiness activities in preparation for Kratos’ first planned mission in 2027.
paras.zh: 两家公司将继续通过建设、集成和运营准备活动推进 Gateway，为 Kratos 于 2027 年执行的首次计划任务做好准备。

paras.en: About Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc.
paras.zh: 关于克雷托斯防御与安全解决方案公司

paras.en: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: KTOS) is a technology, products, system and software company addressing the defense, national security, and commercial markets. At Kratos, affordability is a technology, and Kratos makes true internally funded research, development, capital and other investments, to rapidly develop, produce and field affordable solutions that address our customers’ mission critical needs and requirements. For more information, visit www.KratosDefense.com and follow Kratos on LinkedIn and X.
paras.zh: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：KTOS）是一家致力于国防、国家安全和商业市场的技术、产品、系统和软件公司。在 Kratos，经济实惠是一项技术，Kratos 进行真正的内部资助研究、开发、资本和其他投资，以快速开发、生产和部署经济实惠的解决方案，以满足客户的关键任务需求和要求。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.KratosDefense.com 并在 LinkedIn 和 X 上关注 Kratos。

paras.en: Seagate Space is space’s maritime partner: reinventing offshore launch, optimizing recovery, and innovating for emerging logistics needs. The company’s cutting-edge designs enable rapid, cost-effective development of offshore launch assets that can operate without the constraints of traditional land-based ranges. Seagate Space is a spARK Labs by ARK Invest member company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida. Learn more at www.seagatespace.com and follow on LinkedIn.
paras.zh: Seagate Space 是太空的海事合作伙伴：重塑海上发射、优化回收并针对新兴物流需求进行创新。该公司的尖端设计能够快速、经济高效地开发海上发射资产，这些资产可以在不受传统陆基射程限制的情况下运行。 Seagate Space 是 spARK Labs by ARK Invest 的成员公司，总部位于佛罗里达州圣彼得堡。如需了解更多信息，请访问 www.seagatespace.com 并关注 LinkedIn。

articles.title: UARX Space Marks a Milestone for Spain’s Space Industry with the Maiden Flight of OSSIE-D, Featuring a Complete Power Subsystem Supplied by DHV Technology
articles.author: UARX Space

paras.en: Nigrán, Spain | November 12 2026 – UARX Space has achieved a major milestone for Spain’s space industry with the deployment of OSSIE-D, an Orbital Transfer Vehicle (OTV) designed and manufactured entirely in Spain, with 75% of its components developed in-house by the company. Launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, OSSIE-D was deployed using SAU&RON 24, UARX Space’s proprietary separation system. The achievement marks a world first, bringing together an orbital transfer vehicle and a separation system developed by the same company in a single mission.
paras.zh: 西班牙尼格兰| 2026 年 11 月 12 日 – UARX Space 部署了 OSSIE-D，实现了西班牙航天工业的一个重要里程碑。OSSIE-D 是一种完全在西班牙设计和制造的轨道传输飞行器 (OTV)，其 75% 的组件由该公司内部开发。 OSSIE-D 由 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射，并使用 UARX Space 的专有分离系统 SAU&RON 24 进行部署。这一成就标志着世界首创，将同一家公司开发的轨道传输飞行器和分离系统结合在一次任务中。

paras.en: The mission represents a significant advance in Spain’s space technology capabilities, demonstrating the ability to develop and integrate key technologies for in-space transportation and orbital operations. By combining its OTV with its own SAU&RON 24 separation system, UARX Space reinforces its integrated approach to spacecraft development, spanning the vehicle itself and the technology required for its deployment into orbit.
paras.zh: 该任务代表了西班牙空间技术能力的重大进步，展示了开发和集成空间运输和轨道运行关键技术的能力。通过将其 OTV 与其自己的 SAU&RON 24 分离系统相结合，UARX Space 强化了其航天器开发的集成方法，涵盖航天器本身及其部署到轨道所需的技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D also highlights the importance of collaboration between specialized companies across the European space industry. For this mission, DHV Technology designed, qualified and manufactured the vehicle’s complete electrical power subsystem, including the solar arrays, Power Conditioning and Distribution Unit (PCDU), main battery modules, SADA (Solar Array Drive Assembly) and additional supporting subsystems required to meet the mission’s power requirements.
paras.zh: OSSIE-D 还强调了欧洲航天工业专业公司之间合作的重要性。对于此次任务，DHV Technology 设计、鉴定和制造了车辆的完整电力子系统，包括太阳能电池阵列、功率调节和配电单元 (PCDU)、主电池模块、SADA（太阳能阵列驱动组件）以及满足任务电力要求所需的其他支持子系统。

paras.en: “OSSIE-D represents a milestone for the Spanish aerospace industry and shows how collaboration between companies with complementary capabilities can turn ambitious missions into reality. DHV Technology has been a key partner, with its expertise, highly reliable solutions and team commitment making a significant contribution to the mission’s energy capabilities. This partnership also highlights the potential of the Spanish space sector to innovate and compete at both European and global level,” said Dr. Andrés Villa, CTO and Co-Founder of UARX Space.
paras.zh: UARX Space 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrés Villa 博士表示：“OSSIE-D 代表了西班牙航空航天业的一个里程碑，展示了具有互补能力的公司之间的合作如何能够将雄心勃勃的任务变为现实。DHV Technology 一直是关键合作伙伴，其专业知识、高度可靠的解决方案和团队承诺为任务的能源能力做出了重大贡献。这种合作伙伴关系还凸显了西班牙航天部门在欧洲和全球层面的创新和竞争潜力。”

paras.en: Following launch, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem is operating nominally in orbit, starting from the generation of the power with the solar arrays, control and distribution with the PCDU and storage with the battery, including initial telemetry which confirms that the system is performing as expected. This represents an important milestone for DHV Technology’s engineering team and for the OSSIE-D mission as a whole.
paras.zh: 发射后，DHV Technology 的电力子系统名义上在轨道上运行，从太阳能电池阵列发电、PCDU 控制和分配以及电池存储开始，包括确认系统按预期运行的初始遥测。这对于 DHV Technology 的工程团队和整个 OSSIE-D 任务来说是一个重要的里程碑。

paras.en: “Seeing the full electrical power subsystem fully developed by DHV for OSSIE-D operating as expected in orbit is an important milestone for our team and for our collaboration with UARX Space,” said Dr. Vicente Díaz, Managing Director and Co-Founder of DHV Technology. “This achievement reflects the close cooperation between both engineering teams and the work invested throughout the design, manufacturing, testing and integration phases. We are proud to contribute to this mission and look forward to OSSIE-D continuing to deliver positive results for UARX Space and all the partners involved.”
paras.zh: DHV Technology 董事总经理兼联合创始人 Vicente Díaz 博士表示：“看到 DHV 完全开发的用于 OSSIE-D 的完整电力子系统在轨道上按预期运行，对于我们的团队以及我们与 UARX Space 的合作来说是一个重要的里程碑。” “这一成就反映了两个工程团队之间的密切合作以及在整个设计、制造、测试和集成阶段所投入的工作。我们很自豪能为这一任务做出贡献，并期待 OSSIE-D 继续为 UARX Space 和所有相关合作伙伴带来积极的成果。”

paras.en: Beyond supplying the electrical power subsystem, DHV Technology is using OSSIE-D as a platform to test innovative technological concepts in orbit. The results obtained during the mission will help increase the technological maturity of several of the company’s solutions, extending the value of the mission beyond its immediate operational objectives. These developments include novel electrical interconnection methods, improved solar panel deployment and hinge mechanisms, as well as advanced photovoltaic technologies.
paras.zh: 除了提供电力子系统之外，DHV Technology 还使用 OSSIE-D 作为在轨测试创新技术概念的平台。任务期间获得的结果将有助于提高公司多个解决方案的技术成熟度，使任务的价值超出其直接运营目标。这些发展包括新颖的电气互连方法、改进的太阳能电池板部署和铰链机构以及先进的光伏技术。

paras.en: The collaboration between UARX Space and DHV Technology underscores the importance of combining specialized engineering capabilities to deliver increasingly advanced space missions. While UARX Space leads the development of the OTV and its deployment architecture, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem provides a critical element for the vehicle’s operation while enabling the evaluation of new technologies under real space operating conditions.
paras.zh: UARX Space 和 DHV Technology 之间的合作强调了结合专业工程能力来交付日益先进的太空任务的重要性。虽然 UARX Space 引领 OTV 及其部署架构的开发，但 DHV Technology 的电力子系统为车辆的运行提供了关键要素，同时能够在真实的空间运行条件下评估新技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D therefore represents progress on two fronts: it strengthens UARX Space’s capabilities and position in the in-space transportation sector, while providing an opportunity to validate technologies that could support future missions. The combination of an OTV developed in Spain, a proprietary separation system and a complete electrical power subsystem supplied by DHV Technology demonstrates the potential of Spain’s space industry to deliver increasingly complex technological projects.
paras.zh: 因此，OSSIE-D 代表了两个方面的进展：它增强了 UARX Space 在太空运输领域的能力和地位，同时提供了验证可支持未来任务的技术的机会。西班牙开发的 OTV、专有的分离系统和 DHV Technology 提供的完整电力子系统的结合展示了西班牙航天工业交付日益复杂的技术项目的潜力。

paras.en: About DHV Technology https://dhvtechnology.com/
paras.zh: 关于 DHV 技术 https://dhvtechnology.com/

articles.title: New platform aims to get money moving before disaster strikes

paras.en: New platform aims to get money moving before disaster strikes
paras.zh: 新平台旨在在灾难发生之前让资金转移

paras.en: UN agencies on Thursday launched a joint platform at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, that aims to secure access to more than $3 billion in risk financing to protect 75 million people and their livelihoods from climate shocks and natural hazards by 2030.
paras.zh: 联合国机构周四在土耳其安塔利亚举行的 COP31 上启动了一个联合平台，旨在确保到 2030 年获得超过 30 亿美元的风险融资，以保护 7500 万人及其生计免受气候冲击和自然灾害的影响。

paras.en: “Disasters are increasingly predictable, yet the financing needed to act ahead of them remains slow and fragmented,” said Lisa Doughten, Director of Financing and Outreach at UN aid coordination office, OCHA.
paras.zh: “灾害越来越可预测，但在灾害发生之前采取行动所需的融资仍然缓慢且分散，”联合国人道协调厅援助协调办公室融资和外联主任丽莎·道滕 (Lisa Doughten) 表示。

paras.en: - make disaster response funding more predictable,
paras.zh: - 使救灾资金更加可预测，

paras.en: - increase the money available for early action during major crises
paras.zh: - 增加重大危机期间可用于早期行动的资金

paras.en: - and maximize the impact of every dollar further by combining existing resources with private sector support
paras.zh: - 通过将现有资源与私营部门的支持相结合，进一步最大化每一美元的影响

paras.en: Agencies will share expertise, pool data and coordinate joint solutions, pairing predictive analysis with funds so that early warnings can be turned into anticipatory action. Working with the insurance industry and financial markets will be key to keeping costs down as financing scales up.
paras.zh: 各机构将共享专业知识、汇集数据并协调联合解决方案，将预测分析与资金结合起来，以便将早期预警转化为预期行动。随着融资规模的扩大，与保险业和金融市场的合作将是降低成本的关键。

paras.en: The initiative has already delivered its first results: with support from WFP’s specialist insurance teams, OCHA and UNICEF have put in place insurance policies that provide a financial safety net for their anticipatory action programmes.
paras.zh: 该倡议已经取得了初步成果：在粮食计划署专业保险团队的支持下，人道协调厅和联合国儿童基金会制定了保险政策，为其预期行动计划提供了财务安全网。

paras.en: “A robust forecast can give us days, sometimes even weeks, to act before a flood, storm or heatwave puts children at risk,” said Gernot Laganda, UNICEF Global Practice Director for Climate and Environment.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会气候与环境全球实践总监格诺特·拉甘达 (Gernot Laganda) 表示：“准确的预测可以让我们在洪水、风暴或热浪将儿童置于危险之中之前几天甚至几周的时间采取行动。”

paras.en: “Insurance ensures we have the money available to act on that warning, even in a year when several disasters come at once.”
paras.zh: “即使在多场灾难同时发生的一年里，保险也能确保我们有足够的资金来应对这一警告。”

paras.en: Yet pre-arranged financing still accounts for less than two per cent of global humanitarian financing, far short of what is needed.
paras.zh: 然而，预先安排的融资仍占全球人道主义融资的不到百分之二，远远低于所需的水平。

paras.en: UN emergency food agency, WFP, the UN’s largest user of such financing, has helped secure nearly $211 million in pre-arranged finance this year to protect up to 9.6 million people in more than 50 countries.
paras.zh: 联合国紧急粮食机构粮食计划署是联合国此类融资的最大用户，今年已帮助获得近 2.11 亿美元的预先安排资金，以保护 50 多个国家的多达 960 万人。

paras.en: “For millions of refugees already on the frontlines of the climate crisis, acting early can save lives, protect livelihoods and prevent further displacement,” said Antón Leis García, UNHCR Assistant High Commissioner for Operations.
paras.zh: 难民署负责行动的助理高级专员安东·莱斯·加西亚表示：“对于已经处于气候危机前线的数百万难民来说，尽早采取行动可以挽救生命、保护生计并防止进一步流离失所。”

paras.en: The UN Disaster Risk Financing (DRF) Platform brings together the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), the International Organization for Migration (IOM), the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF), the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) and the World Food Programme (WFP)
paras.zh: 联合国灾害风险融资（DRF）平台汇集了粮食及农业组织（FAO）、国际移民组织（IOM）、联合国人道主义事务协调办公室（OCHA）、联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）、联合国难民署（UNHCR）和世界粮食计划署（WFP）

articles.title: Aid is the ‘only hope’ for millions in Sudan, WFP chief warns, as funding cuts deepen hunger crisis

paras.en: Aid is the ‘only hope’ for millions in Sudan, WFP chief warns, as funding cuts deepen hunger crisis
paras.zh: 粮食署署长警告称，随着资金削减加剧饥饿危机，援助是苏丹数百万人的“唯一希望”

paras.en: The World Food Programme’s (WFP) new Executive Director has warned that funding cuts are worsening Sudan’s hunger crisis following his first field mission to the country, where he met families displaced by conflict and struggling to feed their children.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）新任执行主任警告说，资金削减正在加剧苏丹的饥饿危机，此前他首次前往苏丹实地考察，在那里他见到了因冲突而流离失所、难以养活孩子的家庭。

paras.en: Sudan is facing one of the world’s largest humanitarian crises. Since civil war erupted in 2023, millions have been displaced, hundreds of thousands have been killed and famine has become widespread.
paras.zh: 苏丹正面临世界上最大的人道主义危机之一。自2023年爆发内战以来，数百万人流离失所，数十万人被杀，饥荒蔓延。

paras.en: “People facing acute hunger have three unfortunate choices: rebel, migrate or starve,” WFP Luke Lindberg warned, calling for an end to the fighting and greater international support.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署卢克·林德伯格警告说：“面临严重饥饿的人们面临三种不幸的选择：叛乱、移民或挨饿。”他呼吁结束战斗并提供更多国际支持。

paras.en: “For many, WFP is their only hope in a time of unprecedented conflict,” he stressed. The UN emergency food agency has been a key humanitarian intervener in the country.
paras.zh: “对于许多人来说，粮食计划署是他们在前所未有的冲突时期唯一的希望，”他强调。联合国紧急粮食机构一直是该国的主要人道主义干预机构。

paras.en: In August, WFP was providing food assistance to more than four million people, including 880,000 in areas at risk of famine.
paras.zh: 8 月份，粮食计划署向超过 400 万人提供粮食援助，其中包括面临饥荒风险地区的 88 万人。

paras.en: But funding cuts have forced the agency to scale back its operations. It now reaches just over three million people, with an estimated 900,000 vulnerable people having lost their food assistance.
paras.zh: 但资金削减迫使该机构缩减其业务规模。目前，这一影响已超过 300 万人，估计有 90 万弱势群体失去了粮食援助。

paras.en: Insecurity, blocked roads and flood damage are further hampering aid deliveries as the conflict intensifies.
paras.zh: 随着冲突加剧，不安全局势、道路堵塞和洪水破坏进一步阻碍了援助的运送。

paras.en: WFP urgently needs $520 million to provide lifesaving food and nutrition assistance to 5.4 million people through April 2027.
paras.zh: 粮食署迫切需要 5.2 亿美元，以便在 2027 年 4 月之前向 540 万人提供救生粮食和营养援助。

paras.en: “In the simplest of terms, peace opens the door to food while conflict opens the door to hunger,” said Mr. Lindberg.
paras.zh: “用最简单的话来说，和平为获得食物打开了大门，而冲突则为饥饿打开了大门，”林德伯格先生说。

paras.en: “With collective action and additional resources, we can turn this crisis around. WFP has teams on the ground and stands ready to scale our assistance.”
paras.zh: “通过集体行动和额外资源，我们可以扭转这场危机。粮食计划署在当地设有团队，随时准备扩大我们的援助规模。”

articles.title: Six killed in Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital

paras.en: Six killed in Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital
paras.zh: 以色列空袭加沙纳赛尔医院六人死亡

paras.en: Ramiz Alakbarov, the UN Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process ad interim, on Thursday said he was deeply alarmed by the attack.”
paras.zh: 联合国中东和平进程临时特别协调员拉米兹·阿拉克巴罗夫周四表示，他对这次袭击深感震惊。

paras.en: The strike hit the hospital’s surgical department. A medical worker, patients and their companions were among the dead, according toon the World Health Organization (WHO).
paras.zh: 罢工袭击了医院的外科部门。据世界卫生组织（WHO）称，死者包括一名医务人员、患者及其同伴。

paras.en: “The ongoing violence and recent increase in military operations exacerbate the immense human suffering in Gaza and jeopardize the increasingly fragile ceasefire,” Mr. Alakbarov said.
paras.zh: 阿拉克巴罗夫先生说：“持续的暴力和最近增加的军事行动加剧了加沙人民的巨大痛苦，并危及日益脆弱的停火。”

paras.en: Under international humanitarian law, all parties are obliged to protect and respect medical personnel and facilities, including hospitals, which must not be targeted or used for military purposes, he stressed.
paras.zh: 他强调，根据国际人道法，各方都有义务保护和尊重包括医院在内的医务人员和设施，不得将其作为军事目的或用于军事目的。

paras.en: Mr. Alakbarov reiterated his call for rapid, safe and unimpeded humanitarian access.
paras.zh: 阿拉克巴罗夫先生再次呼吁人道主义援助快速、安全和不受阻碍地准入。

paras.en: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said Gaza’s health facilities are lifelines for its people that must be protected and never militarized or attacked.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞表示，加沙的卫生设施是人民的生命线，必须受到保护，不得军事化或受到攻击。

paras.en: Yet since October 2023, WHO has documented more than 1,000 assaults on healthcare in the Strip.
paras.zh: 然而，自 2023 年 10 月以来，世卫组织已记录了拉斯维加斯大道上 1000 多起针对医疗保健的袭击事件。

paras.en: “The best medicine is peace,” he said, stressing that health needs in the enclave “remain immense” as winter sets in.
paras.zh: 他说：“最好的良药是和平。”他强调，随着冬季的到来，这片飞地的健康需求“仍然巨大”。

paras.en: On Thursday, a separate strike hit the vicinity of UN facilities in Deir al-Balah where staff are sheltering. All staff were accounted for.
paras.zh: 周四，代尔巴拉赫的联合国设施附近发生了另一次袭击，工作人员正在那里避难。所有工作人员均已清点。

paras.en: The strike comes as families struggle with the aftermath of heavy storms that battered Gaza last weekend, causing widespread flooding and a deadly sand dune collapse.
paras.zh: 这次袭击发生之际，上周末袭击加沙的暴风雨导致大面积洪水和致命的沙丘崩塌，许多家庭正在艰难应对。

paras.en: An estimated 65 per cent of Gaza’s population, some 1.4 million people, live in tents or makeshift shelters, according to the UN aid coordination office (OCHA).
paras.zh: 据联合国援助协调办公室 (OCHA) 称，估计加沙 65% 的人口（约 140 万人）居住在帐篷或临时避难所中。

paras.en: Reports indicate that a nine-month-old baby has died of the cold following days of heavy rain and flooding.
paras.zh: 报道称，连日大雨和洪水过后，一名九个月大的婴儿因寒冷死亡。

paras.en: As of Wednesday, humanitarian partners had provided tents, tarpaulins, blankets and other essential supplies to about 1,800 families, roughly a third of some 5,200 families whose immediate needs had been assessed.
paras.zh: 截至周三，人道主义合作伙伴已向约 1,800 个家庭提供了帐篷、防水油布、毯子和其他必需品，约占 5,200 个家庭的直接需求已得到评估的三分之一。

paras.en: They have also pumped out standing water, dug drainage channels and cleaned affected areas.
paras.zh: 他们还抽出了积水，挖掘了排水沟并清理了受影响的地区。

paras.en: But the rainy season has only just begun and is expected to last several months. Across Gaza, families are exposed to standing water contaminated with sewage, while available pumps, sandbags and other equipment fall short of needs.
paras.zh: 但雨季才刚刚开始，预计将持续几个月。在加沙各地，许多家庭都面临着被污水污染的积水，而可用的水泵、沙袋和其他设备却无法满足需求。

paras.en: Essential laboratory supplies and medical equipment also continue to be denied entry, hampering the detection of disease outbreaks – a risk that grows significantly in winter.
paras.zh: 基本的实验室用品和医疗设备也继续被拒绝入境，阻碍了疾病爆发的发现——这一风险在冬季显着增加。

paras.en: A group of 53 countries and organizations on Thursday urged Israel’s incoming government to let aid into Gaza at scale, as winter sets in.
paras.zh: 周四，由 53 个国家和组织组成的小组敦促以色列新政府在冬季来临之际向加沙大规模提供援助。

paras.en: Speaking outside the Security Council in New York on behalf of the Gaza Call to Action, UK Ambassador Sarah MacIntosh said the full aid flows promised under the peace plan endorsed by resolution 2803 had “not yet been realised”.
paras.zh: 英国大使莎拉·麦金托什在纽约代表加沙行动呼吁在安理会外发表讲话时表示，第 2803 号决议批准的和平计划所承诺的全额援助“尚未实现”。

articles.title: A new No 1? How to stop Lamine Yamal? Tuchel's selection issues

paras.en: Spain vs England: James Trafford set to replace Jordan Pickford as goalkeeper? And how does Thomas Tuchel stop Lamine Yamal?
paras.zh: 西班牙 vs 英格兰：詹姆斯·特拉福德将取代乔丹·皮克福德担任门将？托马斯·图切尔如何阻止拉明·亚马尔？

paras.en: Key selection issues analysed ahead of England's Nations League clash with Spain in Madrid; Three Lions will win Group A3 with victory over world champions; Follow Spain vs England in our live blog on the Sky Sports website and App on Sunday, kick-off 7.45pm
paras.zh: 英格兰国家联赛在马德里对阵西班牙之前分析的关键选择问题；三狮军团战胜世界冠军，获得A3组冠军；在天空体育网站和应用程序上的直播博客中关注西班牙对阵英格兰的比赛，周日晚上 7.45 开球

paras.en: Against the best team in the world, Thomas Tuchel's defensive decisions will be key. And he has many to make.
paras.zh: 面对世界上最好的球队，托马斯·图赫尔的防守决定将是关键。他还有很多事情要做。

paras.en: The England head coach said before Croatia at Wembley on Thursday that he was quite happy to go full-strength in both matches, despite the three-day gap, and he was true to his word. All the big guns were out for Harry Kane's big night.
paras.zh: 这位英格兰主教练周四在温布利对阵克罗地亚之前表示，尽管有三天的空档期，但他很高兴能够在两场比赛中全力以赴，而且他也兑现了自己的诺言。所有的大人物都在为哈里·凯恩的重要夜晚出动。

paras.en: Barring unexpected late injury or illness, the best player in the world will lead the line against the world champions. Morgan Rogers should start at right wing, Anthony Gordon left wing. England's Madrid maestro Jude Bellingham will play No 10, and Elliot Anderson and Declan Rice will form the double-pivot at No 8.
paras.zh: 除非出现意外的后期伤病，否则世界上最好的球员将在对阵世界冠军的比赛中领先。摩根·罗杰斯应该首发右翼，安东尼·戈登首发左翼。英格兰马德里大师裘德·贝林汉姆将出战10号位，埃利奥特·安德森和德克兰·赖斯将组成8号位的双中卫。

paras.en: But behind that, is where Tuchel and his assistant Anthony Barry will be pondering their options.
paras.zh: 但在那之后，图赫尔和他的助手安东尼·巴里将考虑他们的选择。

paras.en: The decision Tuchel makes about his goalkeeper could be one of the most important we have seen for eight years.
paras.zh: 图赫尔对门将做出的决定可能是我们八年来看到的最重要的决定之一。

paras.en: Since the World Cup of 2018 in Russia, Jordan Pickford's consistent brilliance has seen him largely unchallenged as England's first-choice keeper. Not so now.
paras.zh: 自 2018 年俄罗斯世界杯以来，乔丹·皮克福德始终如一的出色表现使他成为英格兰队的首选门将。现在不是这样了。

paras.en: As he nears his century of international caps (Pickford has 94) there is a new pretender to his throne, James Trafford. In the last international camp, Tuchel shared the four games out equally between the two and he has hinted he will do the same this time round.
paras.zh: 当他的国家队出场次数接近一个世纪时（皮克福德有 94 场比赛），他的王位出现了新的觊觎者，詹姆斯·特拉福德。在上一次国际训练营中，图赫尔两人平分了四场比赛，他暗示这一次他也会做同样的事情。

paras.en: Seeing Pickford walk out at Wembley on Thursday, in the lesser of the two matches, was a surprise. Most onlookers expected him to get the nod against the world champions in Madrid. He may yet do so. But if he doesn't, if Tuchel sticks to the plan he outlined at the start of the camp and brings Trafford in then it will feel like a real "changing of the guard" moment for the England No 1 shirt.
paras.zh: 周四，在两场比赛中较小的一场比赛中，看到皮克福德在温布利出局，真是令人惊讶。大多数旁观者都希望他能在马德里对阵世界冠军。他可能还会这样做。但如果他不这样做，如果图赫尔坚持他在训练营开始时制定的计划，并把特拉福德带来，那么对于英格兰一号球衣来说，这将是一个真正的“换岗”时刻。

paras.en: In terms of outfielders, no decision is bigger than who should play left-back, to try to combat the most potent of Spain's threats, Lamine Yamal. The man who finished third in the Ballon d'Or rankings stayed in Barcelona for treatment on a troublesome right knee rather than travelling to Prague on Thursday night. He was being saved for England and he is fit and back with the national team now.
paras.zh: 就外野手而言，没有什么决定比谁应该打左后卫更重要，以对抗西班牙最有力的威胁拉明·亚马尔。这位在金球奖排名中获得第三名的男子留在巴塞罗那接受右膝的治疗，而不是在周四晚上前往布拉格。他被保留为英格兰队，现在他已经康复并回到了国家队。

paras.en: Most likely, Lewis Hall will be given the task of keeping Lamine Yamal quiet, keeping his place on the left side of England's defence. Tuchel said after his performance against Croatia that Hall is "doing all he needs to do" to nail down the role as England's first choice and that he is playing "top level".
paras.zh: 最有可能的是，刘易斯·霍尔将承担让拉明·亚马尔保持安静的任务，保持他在英格兰后防线左侧的位置。图赫尔在对阵克罗地亚的比赛后表示，霍尔正在“尽他所需要做的一切”来确定英格兰队的第一选择，并且他正在发挥“顶级水平”。

paras.en: The Newcastle defender has already proved himself against Barcelona's wondrous winger. In the spring of this year, in the Champions League, he put in a performance that led the Spanish-based newspaper Mundo Deportivo to label Hall the "anti-Lamine".
paras.zh: 这位纽卡斯尔后卫已经在对阵巴塞罗那神奇边锋的比赛中证明了自己。今年春天，在欧冠联赛中，他的出色表现让西班牙《世界体育报》将霍尔称为“反拉明”。

paras.en: On the other side of England's defence, it feels like a straight shoot-out between Ben White and Djed Spence, with Trent Alexander-Arnold no doubt expecting to be dropped. Tuchel has consistently questioned his defending and so he is likely to sit out the test in Spain.
paras.zh: 在英格兰队防守的另一边，感觉就像是本·怀特和杰德·斯彭斯之间的直接点球大战，特伦特·亚历山大·阿诺德无疑预计会被淘汰。图赫尔一直质疑他的防守，因此他很可能会缺席西班牙的考验。

paras.en: Spence missed two England training sessions and Thursday night's game against Croatia as he nursed himself to be ready for this one. He was one of England's most formidable finds of the World Cup, proving himself to be the team's best one-on-one defender.
paras.zh: 斯彭斯缺席了英格兰队的两场训练以及周四晚上对阵克罗地亚的比赛，因为他正在为这一场训练做好准备。他是英格兰队在世界杯上最强大的球员之一，证明了自己是球队最好的一对一后卫。

paras.en: White has only started one game for his country since before the 2022 World Cup in Qatar and that was the 1-0 home defeat to Japan. If he does get the nod over Spence, both he and Tuchel will hope he avoids the boos which marked his substitute appearance against Croatia on Thursday night.
paras.zh: 自2022年卡塔尔世界杯之前以来，怀特只为国家队首发过一场比赛，那就是主场0-1负于日本队的比赛。如果他确实获得了斯宾塞的认可，他和图赫尔都希望他能避免周四晚上对阵克罗地亚的比赛中替补出场时所引起的嘘声。

paras.en: Alex Baena, who is likely to be Spain's left winger, doesn't pose the same threat as Lamine Yamal on the other flank but he did score against Czech Republic a few days ago - and against England at Wembley.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·巴埃纳（Alex Baena）很可能成为西班牙的左翼球员，他在另一侧的威胁并不像拉明·亚马尔（Lamine Yamal）那样，但他在几天前对阵捷克共和国和温布利对阵英格兰的比赛中确实取得了进球。

paras.en: In the centre of England's defence, again, Tuchel has some big calls. If Ezri Konsa, rested against Croatia, is now fully fit, as he seems to be, he will almost certainly be recalled straight to the heart of the defence. In the absence of the injured Marc Guehi and John Stones he is England's most senior and most influential defender.
paras.zh: 作为英格兰后防线的中锋，图赫尔再次做出了一些重要的决定。如果埃兹里·孔萨在对阵克罗地亚的比赛中休息，现在已经完全康复，就像他看起来的那样，那么他几乎肯定会被召回到后防线的核心位置。在马克·盖伊和约翰·斯通斯受伤缺席的情况下，他是英格兰最资深、最有影响力的后卫。

paras.en: Jarell Quansah, who had a howler for Croatia's equalising goal, may well drop out because he is considered a right-sided centre-back, as is Konsa. So that would mean the left-leaning Dan Burn or Jarrad Branthwaite coming in alongside the Arsenal man. Best bet there is Burn.
paras.zh: 为克罗地亚扳平比分而大喊大叫的贾雷尔·夸萨很可能会退出，因为他和孔萨一样被认为是右路中卫。因此，这意味着左倾的丹·伯恩或贾拉德·布兰斯韦特将与阿森纳球员并肩作战。最好的选择是 Burn。

paras.en: A significant match for Tuchel's England 2.0
paras.zh: 对于图赫尔的英格兰2.0来说，这是一场意义重大的比赛

paras.en: Significantly, Trafford was the preferred choice when Tuchel's men played Spain in September.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，当图赫尔的球队九月对阵西班牙时，特拉福德是首选。

paras.en: For that reason, and also because this is England's final game of 2026, and because it is their last until the Nations League quarter-finals in March - it feels a hugely significant match.
paras.zh: 出于这个原因，也因为这是英格兰 2026 年的最后一场比赛，也是他们在 3 月份的国家联赛四分之一决赛之前的最后一场比赛 - 感觉这是一场非常重要的比赛。

paras.en: The animosity from large chunks of England's support, and from some England players, towards Tuchel for those now infamous tactical choices of the World Cup semi-final against Argentina, have melted away. The national team's autumn performances have reignited hope and belief.
paras.zh: 英格兰大部分支持者以及一些英格兰球员对图赫尔在世界杯半决赛对阵阿根廷时臭名昭著的战术选择的敌意已经消失。国家队秋季赛的表现，重新点燃了希望和信念。

paras.en: Which way the result - and the performance - goes against the World Cup winners, will almost certainly dictate the mood and the direction of travel for England from here on in.
paras.zh: 与世界杯冠军相比，结果和表现几乎肯定会决定英格兰队今后的情绪和前进方向。

paras.en: In the persistent rain of Madrid, the game will be a barometer of where England are, in project Thomas Tuchel 2.0.
paras.zh: 在托马斯·图赫尔 2.0 项目中，在马德里持续下雨的情况下，这场比赛将成为英格兰队的晴雨表。

articles.title: Meetmebythesea gives McManus a first Paddy Power Gold Cup

paras.en: Meetmebythesea gives McManus a first Paddy Power Gold Cup
paras.zh: Meetmebythesea 为麦克马纳斯赢得了第一个 Paddy Power 金杯

paras.en: Harry Cobden gained his biggest success in his new role with JP McManus as Meetmebythesea stormed to success in the Paddy Power Gold Cup at Cheltenham, and now bigger targets await Ben Pauling's up-and-coming star
paras.zh: 哈里·科布登 (Harry Cobden) 在 JP 麦克马纳斯 (JP McManus) 的新角色中取得了最大的成功，Meetmebythesea 在切尔滕纳姆 (Cheltenham) 的帕迪电力金杯 (Paddy Power Gold Cup) 中取得了成功，现在还有更大的目标等待着本·鲍林 (Ben Pauling) 的后起之秀

paras.en: Ben Pauling’s Meetmebythesea showed his liking for Cheltenham once more and delivered owner JP McManus with his first victory in the prestigious Paddy Power Gold Cup.
paras.zh: 本·鲍林 (Ben Pauling) 的 Meetmebythesea 再次表达了他对切尔滕纳姆 (Cheltenham) 的喜爱，并为业主 JP 麦克马纳斯 (JP McManus) 在著名的帕迪电力金杯赛 (Paddy Power Gold Cup) 中赢得了首场胜利。

paras.en: Sent off the heavily backed 2-1 favourite on his first run since winning as a novice at the Festival in March, he put in some tremendous leaps on the way round for Harry Cobden.
paras.zh: 自从三月份在音乐节上以新手身份获胜以来，他在第一次比赛中以 2-1 的比分淘汰了备受支持的热门球队，他在为哈利·科布登 (Harry Cobden) 的比赛中实现了一些巨大的飞跃。

paras.en: Blueking d'Oroux, having his first run for Dan Skelton, looked the biggest danger after long-time leader Quebecois faded but Meetmebythesea powered away up the hill to win by two and a half lengths to give Cobden a second big victory in two days in the McManus colours.
paras.zh: 丹·斯凯尔顿 (Dan Skelton) 的首场比赛中，蓝王多鲁 (Blueking d'Oroux) 看起来是最大的危险，因为长期领先的魁北克 (Quebecois) 队黯然失色，但 Meetmebythesea 发力上山，以两马半马位的优势获胜，为科布登 (Cobden) 在两天内以麦克马努斯 (McManus) 颜色赢得了第二场重大胜利。

paras.en: Pauling said: "Harry wanted to ride him forward because not many are coming from behind today and he jumped brilliantly and travelled so well.
paras.zh: 鲍林说：“哈利想骑着他向前走，因为今天没有多少人从后面赶来，他跳得非常出色，走得也很好。

paras.en: "I was a little worried turning for home that Dan's horse was going so well but he showed a lot of guts and then won well. Jumping the last he had plenty left and he has so much pace for a big horse.
paras.zh: “我有点担心丹的马跑得这么好，但他表现出了很大的勇气，然后赢得了胜利。在最后一跳时，他还剩下很多时间，而且对于一匹大马来说，他的速度如此之快。

paras.en: "He needed to do that today and he showed a lot more than we have seen from him so far because he found plenty for pressure. He's just really good and you don't know what you have got until you run in races like that - that was cool, very cool.
paras.zh: “他今天需要做到这一点，他表现出了比我们迄今为止从他身上看到的更多的东西，因为他发现了足够的压力。他真的很棒，你不知道自己有什么，直到你参加这样的比赛 - 这很酷，非常酷。

paras.en: "I didn't get nervous until 20 minutes before as you just want it so much when you believe in them so much and it's great that it has all come off.
paras.zh: “直到20分钟前我才感到紧张，因为当你如此相信他们时，你会非常想要它，这一切都实现了真是太棒了。

paras.en: "This is the race that really made me tick growing up and I've been coming to this meeting since I was 14. This has always been a big race for me and to have the favourite was a dream so to win it is even better.
paras.zh: “这是一场真正让我成长的比赛，我从 14 岁起就开始参加这场比赛。这对我来说一直是一场重要的比赛，拥有最爱是我的梦想，所以赢得比赛就更好了。

paras.en: "I had so much faith in this horse and I talked him up plenty in the lead-up. It's all well sitting on the fence but I knew he was good, just not how good. You just have to believe he is going to keep on improving and hopefully that puts him bang there for some of the better races."
paras.zh: “我对这匹马非常有信心，在赛前我对他进行了很多的宣传。观望一切都很好，但我知道他很好，只是不知道有多好。你只需要相信他会继续进步，希望这能让他在一些更好的比赛中表现出色。”

paras.en: BetVictor make Meetmebythesea 12-1 from 25s to now step up to the highest level at Kempton on Boxing Day where he could be given the opportunity to replicate The Jukebox Man's King George VI Chase heroics for Pauling last Christmas.
paras.zh: BetVictor 使 Meetmebythesea 从 25 秒到现在的 12-1 战绩，在节礼日在肯普顿达到了最高水平，他将有机会在去年圣诞节为鲍林复制自动点唱机人乔治六世大通的英雄事迹。

paras.en: "I suppose we have to think about Kempton at Christmas and I think he's going to stay every yard of three miles," added the local handler.
paras.zh: “我想我们必须在圣诞节考虑坎普顿，我认为他会每隔三英里待一码，”当地经纪人补充道。

paras.en: "To keep a horse like this improving is cool and we need these types of horses to keep us going the right way. It's not easy when you're in the top 10 and you need to find horses of this calibre. He looks to be one of them.
paras.zh: “让一匹马保持这样的进步是很酷的，我们需要这些类型的马来让我们走上正确的道路。当你进入前十名并且你需要找到这种水平的马时，这并不容易。他看起来就是其中之一。

paras.en: "It's one of the big ones of my career and he has a bright future. I hope he could be as good as any I've trained but we've a long way to go. He might have to improve another 10 to 15lb to be winning a big one.
paras.zh: “这是我职业生涯中最重要的比赛之一，他有着光明的未来。我希望他能和我训练过的任何人一样出色，但我们还有很长的路要走。他可能还需要再提高 10 到 15 磅才能赢得一场大比赛。

paras.en: "I think this might be his trip or a nice flat three (miles) for now. Kempton felt nice last year, so who knows."
paras.zh: “我认为这可能是他的旅行，或者现在是一次不错的三英里（英里）平坦之旅。肯普顿去年感觉很好，所以谁知道呢。”

paras.en: Having provided McManus with one of the major races absent from his trophy cabinet, a trip to Kempton at Christmas could represent the chance to tick off another missing from the mantlepiece.
paras.zh: 麦克马纳斯在他的奖杯柜中缺席了一场主要比赛，圣诞节期间前往肯普顿可能意味着有机会在壁炉架上勾画出另一场缺失的比赛。

paras.en: However, festive dreams may be on hold for the Irishman, who was content to relish yet another fantastic result at Prestbury Park.
paras.zh: 然而，爱尔兰人的节日梦想可能会被搁置，他满足于在普雷斯特伯里公园再创辉煌。

paras.en: "I left it to Ben and this was his plan, you have to give him all the credit," said McManus.
paras.zh: “我把它留给了本，这是他的计划，你必须把所有的功劳都归功于他，”麦克马纳斯说。

paras.en: "It's always nice to win a race at Cheltenham and I've tried to win this race many times but just come up short. Today thankfully it happened.
paras.zh: “在切尔滕纳姆赢得一场比赛总是很高兴，我多次尝试赢得这场比赛，但都未能成功。值得庆幸的是，今天它发生了。

paras.en: "You don't get tired of days like this and I've never won the King George, Champion Chase and Arkle, so we've got to try get those next.
paras.zh: “你不会厌倦这样的日子，而且我从来没有赢得过乔治国王赛、冠军蔡斯赛和阿克尔赛，所以我们接下来必须努力争取这些。

paras.en: "He could be a King George horse, but this was the plan for this lad today and he's only six. I know six-year-old's have won it before but we'll just have to see."
paras.zh: “他可能是一匹乔治王马，但这就是这个小伙子今天的计划，他只有六岁。我知道六岁的马以前赢过它，但我们只需要看看。”

paras.en: Atomic City lays down credentials in Triumph Trial
paras.zh: 原子城在凯旋审判中提供证据

paras.en: Atomic City laid down an early marker for his division in the JCB Triumph Trial Juvenile Hurdle at Cheltenham when displaying a smart turn of foot.
paras.zh: 原子城队在切尔滕纳姆举行的 JCB Triumph Trial 少年跨栏比赛中，凭借一脚漂亮的转身，为自己的组别早早奠定了基础。

paras.en: Joseph O'Brien's three-year-old was ridden with great confidence by J J Slevin at the back of the field and the 88-rated performer from the Flat jumped with aplomb bar one sticky leap at the second last.
paras.zh: 约瑟夫·奥布莱恩 (Joseph O'Brien) 的三岁马在赛场后方被 J·J·斯莱文 (J J Slevin) 自信地骑着，这位来自平地 (Flat) 的评分为 88 的赛马在倒数第二名中以一记粘性飞跃从容地完成了跳跃。

paras.en: Charles Darnay hit the front off the home bend under Harry Cobden but Slevin had him in his sights and brought his mount up against the rail before quickening clear to win by four lengths and justify 11-10 favouritism.
paras.zh: 查尔斯·达内 (Charles Darnay) 在哈利·科布登 (Harry Cobden) 的指挥下，在直冲弯处击中前方，但斯莱文 (Slevin) 将他的视线锁定在他的视线中，并将他的坐骑拉到栏杆上，然后加快步伐，以四马位获胜，并以 11-10 证明了自己的偏袒。

paras.en: Coral cut him to 14-1 from 25s for the Triumph Hurdle in March with his rider suitably impressed.
paras.zh: 在三月份的凯旋栏比赛中，科洛尔以 25 秒的成绩将他打成了 14-1，他的骑手给他留下了深刻的印象。

paras.en: Slevin said: "He's a high-class Flat horse who was quite good in Cork the first day and the aim today was to get him to spit it (the bridle) out today.
paras.zh: 斯莱文说：“它是一匹高级平底马，第一天在科克表现得非常好，今天的目标是让它吐掉缰绳。”

paras.en: "He would be high up in Joseph's pecking order I would say, at least this stage, and I'd say he's going to be a Triumph Hurdle horse, he's a fair horse.
paras.zh: “我想说，至少在这个阶段，他在约瑟夫的排名中会很高，而且我会说他将成为一匹凯旋跨栏马，他是一匹漂亮的马。

paras.en: "I'd say he will be better with softer ground. He's jumped and travelled well and he couldn't have been better there.
paras.zh: “我想说他在更软的地面上会表现得更好。他的跳跃和移动都很好，他在那里再好不过了。

paras.en: "He's won easy and it's still early days. A lot of the lads won't have gone to the well yet with their juveniles and as the year goes on we'll find out more. But he was very impressive today."
paras.zh: “他轻松获胜，现在还为时过早。很多小伙子还没有和他们的幼崽一起去井里，随着时间的推移，我们会发现更多。但他今天的表现非常令人印象深刻。”

articles.title: McKenna to defend world title live on Sky Sports on December 4

paras.en: Aaron McKenna to defend IBF middleweight world title against Jevgenijs Aleksejevs live on Sky Sports on December 4
paras.zh: 亚伦·麦肯纳 (Aaron McKenna) 将于 12 月 4 日在天空体育直播中对阵耶夫根尼斯·阿列克谢耶夫斯 (Jevgenijs Aleksejevs)，捍卫 IBF 中量级世界冠军头衔

paras.en: Aaron McKenna won the IBF middleweight world title, beating Etinosa Oliha on a memorable night in Dublin in August; He will now make the first defence of his title against Jevgenijs Aleksejevs; Watch McKenna vs Aleksejevs on Friday December 4 live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 亚伦·麦肯纳 (Aaron McKenna) 八月在都柏林度过了一个难忘的夜晚，击败艾蒂诺萨·奥利哈 (Etinosa Oliha)，赢得了 IBF 中量级世界冠军；现在，他将首次卫冕冠军，对手是耶夫根尼斯·阿列克谢耶夫斯 (Jevgenijs Aleksejevs)。观看 12 月 4 日周五天空体育直播麦肯纳对阵阿列克谢耶夫斯的比赛

paras.en: Aaron McKenna will defend his middleweight world title on Friday December 4, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 亚伦·麦肯纳 (Aaron McKenna) 将于 12 月 4 日星期五在天空体育 (Sky Sports) 直播中卫冕中量级世界冠军头衔。

paras.en: IBF champion McKenna will fight unbeaten Latvian Jevgenijs Aleksejevs at The Venue in Riyadh in the main event of Riyadh Season Zuffa Boxing 14.
paras.zh: IBF 冠军麦肯纳将在利雅得 The Venue 举行的利雅得赛季 Zuffa Boxing 14 的主赛事中与不败的拉脱维亚人耶夫根尼斯·阿列克谢耶夫斯 (Jevgenijs Aleksejevs) 进行比赛。

paras.en: It will be McKenna's first defence of the world title belt he won by beating Etinosa Oliha on a memorable night in Dublin.
paras.zh: 这将是麦肯纳首次卫冕世界冠军腰带，他在都柏林度过了一个难忘的夜晚，击败了埃蒂诺萨·奥利哈。

paras.en: McKenna, 21-0 (10), who hails from Monaghan, Ireland, is a nine-year pro who vaulted into title contention with his April 2025 decision over former world champion Liam Smith.
paras.zh: 麦肯纳 (McKenna)，战绩 21 胜 0 负 (10)，来自爱尔兰莫纳汉，是一名拥有九年职业生涯的职业球员，他在 2025 年 4 月击败前世界冠军利亚姆·史密斯 (Liam Smith) 后进入了冠军争夺战。

paras.en: While McKenna fought many times in Ireland as a top amateur, he returned home for the first time as a pro in August, capturing the world title with a one-sided victory over Oliha at Dublin's 3Arena.
paras.zh: 虽然麦肯纳作为一名顶级业余选手在爱尔兰多次参赛，但他于八月首次以职业选手身份回到家乡，并在都柏林 3Arena 以一边倒的方式战胜奥利哈，夺得世界冠军。

paras.en: Aleksejevs, a world-ranked contender who has had 10 stoppage victories in his 20 professional wins, will be challenging for a world title for the first time.
paras.zh: 阿列克谢耶夫斯是一位世界排名有力的竞争者，在他的 20 场职业比赛中取得了 10 场比赛的胜利，他将首次挑战世界冠军头衔。

paras.en: A former kickboxing standout, Aleksejevs has been perfect in gloved combat, securing a regional title last October with a unanimous decision over Przemyslaw Zysk. In February, he outlasted Italy's Damiano Falcinelli over 10 tense rounds.
paras.zh: 阿列克谢耶夫斯曾是跆拳道界的佼佼者，在戴手套格斗中表现出色，去年 10 月以一致判定战胜了普热米斯瓦夫·齐斯克 (Przemyslaw Zysk)，获得了地区冠军。 2月份，他在10轮紧张的比赛中击败了意大利选手达米亚诺·法尔西内利(Damiano Falcinelli)。

paras.en: Former European champion and world title challenger Jack Massey returns to action against Andrew Tabiti.
paras.zh: 前欧洲冠军、世界冠军挑战者杰克·梅西重返赛场，对阵安德鲁·塔比蒂。

paras.en: Massey, 23-4 (13), is looking to rebound from a stunning defeat to Chev Clarke on June's Zuffa Boxing 07 bill. He had Clarke on the deck twice in round four before being stopped in the seventh.
paras.zh: 梅西，23胜4负（13分），希望从六月的Zuffa Boxing 07账单上惨败给切夫·克拉克（Chev Clarke）中恢复过来。他在第四轮中两次让克拉克上场，然后在第七轮被拦下。

paras.en: America's Tabiti, who fought Yuniel Dorticos for the world title, has been operating at heavyweight and now returns to the cruiserweight division.
paras.zh: 美国选手塔比蒂曾与尤尼尔·多蒂科斯争夺世界冠军，她一直在重量级比赛，现在又回到了轻量级。

paras.en: New light-heavyweight signing Zak Chelli has his first bout for Zuffa Boxing on the bill. He takes on Jesse Hart.
paras.zh: 新签约的轻重量级扎克·切利将参加祖法拳击队的首场比赛。他对阵杰西·哈特。

paras.en: London's Chelli is coming off a stunning upset knockout victory over David Morrell.
paras.zh: 伦敦选手切利以惊人的淘汰赛战胜了大卫·莫雷尔。

paras.en: The son of renowned Philadelphia contender Eugene "Cyclone" Hart, Jesse Hart has twice challenged Gilberto Ramirez for the WBO super-middleweight world title. He is coming off a controversial decision loss to touted prospect Khalil Coe.
paras.zh: 杰西·哈特是费城著名拳手“旋风”尤金·哈特的儿子，他曾两次挑战吉尔伯托·拉米雷斯争夺 WBO 超中量级世界拳王头衔。他刚刚结束了一场有争议的决定，输给了备受推崇的新秀卡里尔·科(Khalil Coe)。

paras.en: After his thrilling battle with Chris Billam-Smith, huge punching cruiserweight Ryan Rozicki will fight France's 12-2 Gaetan Ntambwe, a two-division French champion who has yet to be stopped in the paid ranks.
paras.zh: 在与克里斯·比拉姆-史密斯进行了一场惊心动魄的战斗后，重拳轻量级瑞恩·罗齐基将与法国选手盖坦·恩坦布韦（Gaetan Ntambwe）展开较量，后者是法国两个级别的冠军，在付费行列中尚未被阻止，而恩坦布韦则是 12 胜 2 负的对手。

paras.en: Rising welterweight prospect Alex "The Villain" MacMillan, 5-0 (4), returns against an opponent to be named in a six-rounder.
paras.zh: 冉冉升起的次中量级新星亚历克斯·“恶棍”·麦克米伦以 5-0 (4) 的战绩，在六轮比赛中迎战一位将被提名的对手。

paras.en: In a preliminary bout, former heavyweight titlist and Anthony Joshua opponent, "Prince" Charles Martin will fight Vladyslav Sirenko, the dangerous Ukrainian with a 23-1 (20) record, who is fresh off his knockout win over Otto Wallin in July.
paras.zh: 在预赛中，前重量级拳王、安东尼·约书亚的对手、“王子”查尔斯·马丁将迎战危险的乌克兰选手弗拉迪斯拉夫·西连科 (Vladyslav Sirenko)，他的战绩为 23 比 1 (20)，刚刚在 7 月份淘汰了奥托·沃林 (Otto Wallin)。

paras.en: Rising cruiserweight Jamar Talley, 7-0 (6), will fight Britain's Sherif Musah, while 18-year-old Nigerian phenom Raheem Animashaun, 20-0 (12), competes in a six-round welterweight bout.
paras.zh: 新晋轻量级选手贾马尔·塔利 (Jamar Talley) 将与英国选手谢里夫·穆萨 (Sherif Musah) 交锋，战绩 7 胜 0 负 (6 胜)，而 18 岁的尼日利亚天才选手拉希姆·阿尼玛肖恩 (Raheem Animashaun)，战绩 20 胜 0 负 (12 负)，将参加一场六回合的次中量级比赛。

paras.en: Watch McKenna vs Aleksejevs on Friday December 4 live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 观看 12 月 4 日周五天空体育直播麦肯纳对阵阿列克谢耶夫斯的比赛。

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills at least six people, officials say
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: An Israeli airstrike on a hospital in southern Gaza overnight killed at least six people, the Health Ministry in the Palestinian enclave said Thursday.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦飞地卫生部周四表示，以色列夜间对加沙南部一家医院的空袭造成至少六人死亡。

paras.en: The strike hit a surgery building at Nasser Hospital, with medical staff and patients among those killed, including a surgeon and a 13-year-old boy, health officials said. The Israeli military said it was targeting a Hamas commander and other militants.
paras.zh: 卫生官员称，袭击袭击了纳赛尔医院的一座手术大楼，造成医务人员和患者死亡，其中包括一名外科医生和一名 13 岁男孩。以色列军方表示，其目标是一名哈马斯指挥官和其他武装分子。

paras.en: The strike — the latest despite an ongoing U.S.-backed ceasefire — shattered ceilings and left debris strewn across wards inside the hospital, which is one of the few functioning medical facilities left in Gaza after the destruction of Israel’s yearslong military assault.
paras.zh: 这次袭击是尽管美国支持的停火仍在进行中的最新一次袭击，但医院内的天花板被震碎，病房内散落着碎片。该医院是以色列多年的军事袭击被摧毁后，加沙仅存的少数仍在运转的医疗设施之一。

paras.en: Palestinian surgeon Dr. Rizk Abu Shaira was among those killed, the Health Ministry said. He was featured in the 2026 documentary “American Doctor,” which followed three American doctors helping to provide medical care in Gaza.
paras.zh: 卫生部称，巴勒斯坦外科医生里兹克·阿布·谢拉博士是遇难者之一。他出现在 2026 年纪录片《美国医生》中，该片讲述了三名美国医生在加沙提供医疗服务的故事。

paras.en: An array of munitions debris was displayed at the hospital site as media visited on Thursday. Two munitions experts said an image supplied to NBC News appeared to show debris from a GBU-39 Small Diameter Bomb. The U.S. is known to supply Israel with GBU-39 munitions, which are produced by Boeing in the United States and sold to a number of countries.
paras.zh: 周四媒体探访时，医院现场展示了一系列弹药碎片。两名军火专家表示，向 NBC 新闻提供的一张图像似乎显示了 GBU-39 小直径炸弹的碎片。据了解，美国向以色列供应GBU-39弹药，该弹药由美国波音公司生产，销往多个国家。

paras.en: The IDF and Pentagon did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether U.S.-manufactured munitions were used in the strike. While the image was captured at Nasser Hospital following the strike, NBC News is not able to independently confirm that they were the munitions used in the attack or how they came to be displayed there.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军和五角大楼没有立即回应就此次袭击是否使用美国制造的弹药发表评论的请求。虽然该图像是在袭击后在纳赛尔医院拍摄的，但 NBC 新闻无法独立确认它们是袭击中使用的弹药，也无法确认它们是如何在那里展示的。

paras.en: Justin Bronk, a senior research fellow for airpower and technology in the military sciences at the Royal United Services Institute, a think tank based in London, said he made that determination based on the “wing section visible,” adding that the GBU-39 “is a U.S. supplied weapon.”
paras.zh: 总部位于伦敦的皇家联合三军研究所的军事科学空中力量和技术高级研究员贾斯汀·布朗克表示，他是根据“可见的机翼部分”做出这一决定的，并补充说GBU-39“是美国提供的武器”。

paras.en: Brian Castner, a crisis researcher at Amnesty International, also identified the munitions as belonging to a GBU-39, adding that Israel has used the bomb “in many strikes in Gaza.”
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织危机研究员布莱恩·卡斯特纳 (Brian Castner) 也确认这些弹药属于 GBU-39，并补充说以色列“在加沙的多次袭击中”使用了该炸弹。

paras.en: Sam Lair, a fellow at the Foreign Policy Research Institute who manages and conducts investigations into nuclear and missile programs, said NBC News’ imagery appeared inconclusive, but “the wings, tail actuation system, lugs, and warhead” shown in other photos appear to match “a GBU-39 series small diameter bomb.”
paras.zh: 负责管理和开展核计划和导弹计划调查的外交政策研究所研究员萨姆·莱尔表示，NBC新闻的图像似乎没有结论，但其他照片中显示的“机翼、尾部驱动系统、凸耳和弹头”似乎与“GBU-39系列小直径炸弹”相符。

paras.en: “It looks to be some kind of glide bomb or cruise missile, and the English on the frame suggests it could be U.S.-origin, but I don’t see anything conclusive,” he said.
paras.zh: “它看起来是某种滑翔炸弹或巡航导弹，框架上的英文表明它可能来自美国，但我没有看到任何结论，”他说。

paras.en: Dr. Ayman Abu Obeid, head of the surgery department at Nasser Hospital, said there was no “notice, warning or anything” before the hospital was attacked. “Suddenly, there was fire and shelling and walls were brought down instantly,” he said.
paras.zh: 纳赛尔医院外科主任艾曼·阿布·奥贝德医生表示，在医院遭到袭击之前没有任何“通知、警告或任何事情”。 “突然间，发生了火灾和炮击，墙壁立即倒塌，”他说。

paras.en: He said he was not aware of any “resistance fighters or combatants present — only a medical team treating patients.”
paras.zh: 他说，他不知道有任何“抵抗战士或战斗人员在场——只有一支医疗队在治疗病人。”

paras.en: NBC News also spoke with two surgeons who travelled to Gaza from the U.K. earlier this month to assist with medical care, and were said were in the hospital when the missile struck.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻还采访了两名本月早些时候从英国前往加沙协助医疗护理的外科医生，据说导弹袭击时他们正在医院里。

paras.en: Both Dr. Goher Rahbour, a consultant general and colorectal surgeon, and Dr. Stephan Verborg, a limb reconstruction surgeon, said they were also not aware of any warning from the Israeli military before the strike, which hit the hospital shortly after midnight.
paras.zh: 总顾问兼结直肠外科医生 Goher Rahbour 博士和肢体重建外科医生 Stephan Verborg 博士均表示，他们也不知道以色列军方在午夜过后不久袭击医院之前发出过任何警告。

paras.en: “I heard the impact and I felt the explosion because the whole hospital shook,” Verborg said in a phone interview Thursday. He said he was about 15 to 20 meters away from the point of impact, adding: “You could smell the smoke. You could see the dust.”
paras.zh: “我听到了撞击声，也感觉到了爆炸，因为整个医院都在震动，”维尔堡在周四的电话采访中说。他说他距离撞击点大约 15 到 20 米，并补充道：“你可以闻到烟雾的味道。你可以看到灰尘。”

paras.en: Rahbour said he had been operating with Abu Shaira, whom he described as a “lovely” and “affable” person, earlier that day. He said they had been laughing and joking together Wednesday evening in the hours just before the Palestinian surgeon was killed.
paras.zh: 拉布尔说，当天早些时候，他一直在与阿布·沙伊拉一起做手术，他形容阿布·沙伊拉是一个“可爱”、“和蔼可亲”的人。他说，周三晚上，就在巴勒斯坦外科医生被杀之前的几个小时里，他们在一起有说有笑。

paras.en: Both doctors had traveled to Gaza early this month through the organization IDEALS, a U.K. charity seeking to provide sustainable humanitarian aid to regions affected by conflict or natural disasters. They said they had not seen any indication of a Hamas presence in the hospital.
paras.zh: 两名医生均于本月初通过理想组织前往加沙，理想是一家英国慈善机构，致力于为受冲突或自然灾害影响的地区提供可持续的人道主义援助。他们说，他们没有看到哈马斯出现在医院的任何迹象。

paras.en: Tributes were paid to Abu Shaira. “Dr. Rizq was at the hospital during the entire war,” Dr. Mohammed Zaqout, director general of the Health Ministry in Gaza, could be seen telling a crowd of mourners, surrounding a body covered in a shroud, in a video captured for NBC News on Thursday. “He didn’t abandon his duties for even one day.”
paras.zh: 向阿布沙伊拉致敬。在周四为 NBC 新闻拍摄的一段视频中，加沙卫生部长穆罕默德·扎克特 (Mohammed Zaqout) 博士对围着一具裹着裹尸布的尸体的哀悼者说道：“整个战争期间，里兹克医生都在医院里。” “他一天也没有放弃自己的职责。”

paras.en: Nasser Hospital said a 13-year-old boy, identified as Jihad Naeem Muhammad Abu Tilikh, was also among those killed.
paras.zh: 纳赛尔医院表示，死者中还包括一名 13 岁男孩，他的名字是吉哈德·纳伊姆·穆罕默德·阿布·蒂利赫 (Jihad Naeem Muhammad Abu Tilikh)。

paras.en: The Israeli military and the Israel Security Agency said they struck a senior Hamas member, along with other militants, who they said had “advanced” attacks from the hospital in the southern Gaza Strip overnight. In a later statement, they identified the senior member as Muhammad Abu Ismail, who they said served as the commander of Hamas’ Khan Younis Brigade and had also been responsible for holding hostages in Gaza.
paras.zh: 以色列军方和以色列安全局表示，他们袭击了一名哈马斯高级成员以及其他武装分子，称他们连夜从加沙地带南部的医院“推进”了袭击。在后来的声明中，他们确认这名高级成员是穆罕默德·阿布·伊斯梅尔，他们说他曾担任哈马斯汗尤尼斯旅的指挥官，还负责在加沙扣押人质。

paras.en: The IDF and ISA said Hamas had “established a presence within the hospital complex and used it as a command center” and stored weapons and conducted interrogations and torture from within the medical complex.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军和以色列安全局表示，哈马斯“在医院大楼内建立了存在，并将其用作指挥中心”，并在医疗大楼内储存武器并进行审讯和酷刑。

paras.en: The IDF claimed the hospital’s second floor “serves as a Hamas military HQ, where civilians are not permitted to enter,” alleging that “dozens of hostages were held captive” there earlier in the war. It shared undated photos of weapons that it alleged were found within the complex and others.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军声称该医院的二楼“是哈马斯军事总部，不允许平民进入”，并声称战争初期“有数十名人质被扣押”在那里。它分享了据称在建筑群和其他地方发现的武器的未注明日期的照片。

paras.en: The IDF and ISA said steps had been taken to “mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precision munitions and aerial surveillance.” They also later said “advance warnings were issued to the population.” The IDF said it was looking into reports that medical workers, including Abu Shaira, and patients were killed.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军和国际安全局表示，已采取措施“减轻对平民的伤害，包括使用精确弹药和空中监视”。他们后来还表示“已向民众发出提前警告”。以色列国防军表示正在调查有关包括阿布·沙伊拉在内的医务人员和患者被杀的报道。

paras.en: One woman, Tahani Ibrahim Abu Anza, said her brother, Khaled Abu Anza, was killed in the strike, with Nasser Hospital separately confirming his death.
paras.zh: 一名名叫塔哈尼·易卜拉欣·阿布·安扎 (Tahani Ibrahim Abu Anza) 的妇女说，她的兄弟哈立德·阿布·安扎 (Khaled Abu Anza) 在罢工中丧生，纳赛尔医院单独证实了他的死亡。

paras.en: A number of media outlets, including Israeli media outlet Ynet, reported that a commander in Hamas’ Khan Younis Brigade of that same name was killed in the strike. Asked to confirm that and whether he was directly targeted, the IDF said it would get back on the matter.
paras.zh: 包括以色列媒体Ynet在内的多家媒体报道称，哈马斯汗尤尼斯旅的一名同名指挥官在袭击中丧生。当被要求确认这一点以及他是否是直接攻击目标时，以色列国防军表示将就此事进行回应。

paras.en: Tahani Ibrahim Abu Anza did not directly identify her brother, 53, as a Hamas member, but said she believed he was targeted. He had been at the hospital for physical therapy after undergoing surgery, she said.
paras.zh: 塔哈尼·易卜拉欣·阿布·安扎 (Tahani Ibrahim Abu Anza) 没有直接指认她 53 岁的兄弟是哈马斯成员，但表示她相信他是袭击目标。她说，他在接受手术后一直在医院接受物理治疗。

paras.en: “He did not come to the hospital to engage in combat or resistance. He came for medical treatment,” she said.
paras.zh: “他来医院不是为了战斗或抵抗。他是来接受治疗的，”她说。

paras.en: Hamas condemned the allegations that it was using the hospital for military operations as “lies of the criminal enemy” and called the attack a “war crime.”
paras.zh: 哈马斯谴责有关其利用该医院进行军事行动的指控是“犯罪敌人的谎言”，并称这次袭击是“战争罪”。

paras.en: Hospitals have protected status under international law, but they have been heavily targeted under Israel’s yearslong offensive in Gaza. The Israeli military has repeatedly accused Hamas of operating within medical facilities, a charge the militant group has denied.
paras.zh: 医院享有国际法的保护地位，但在以色列多年来对加沙的攻势下，医院成为了重点攻击目标。以色列军方多次指责哈马斯在医疗设施内开展活动，但该武装组织否认了这一指控。

paras.en: The overnight attack was not the first time that Nasser Hospital itself has been targeted.
paras.zh: 这次夜间袭击并不是纳赛尔医院第一次成为攻击目标。

paras.en: In August 2025, the hospital was hit by a double tap Israeli strike that killed at least 20 people, including journalists and health workers. The deadly attack sparked international outrage.
paras.zh: 2025 年 8 月，该医院遭到以色列两次袭击，造成至少 20 人死亡，其中包括记者和卫生工作者。这起致命袭击引发了国际社会的愤怒。

paras.en: Of Gaza’s 37 hospitals, just two are considered to be “fully functioning,” while 18 are partially functioning and 17 are considered nonfunctioning after much of the enclave’s healthcare system was devastated under Israel’s offensive, according to data published by the World Health Organization.
paras.zh: 根据世界卫生组织公布的数据，加沙的 37 家医院中，只有 2 家被认为“完全运转”，18 家部分运转，17 家被认为无法运转，因为飞地的大部分医疗系统在以色列的攻势下遭到破坏。

paras.en: Israeli strikes have continued in Gaza despite a ceasefire agreement reached in October of last year.
paras.zh: 尽管去年十月达成停火协议，以色列仍在加沙继续发动袭击。

paras.en: More than 1,600 people have been killed since the truce came into effect, according to the Palestinian Health Ministry in the enclave. Israel says four of its soldiers have been killed in that time.
paras.zh: 据飞地的巴勒斯坦卫生部称，自停火协议生效以来，已有 1,600 多人死亡。以色列称，当时有四名士兵被杀。

paras.en: Both Israel and Hamas have accused each other of violating the ceasefire.
paras.zh: 以色列和哈马斯都指责对方违反停火协议。

paras.en: More than 74,600 people, including thousands of children, have been killed overall in Gaza since Israel launched its offensive in the enclave following the Hamas-led Oct. 7, 2023, attacks, in which some 1,200 people were killed and around 250 taken hostage.
paras.zh: 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击造成约 1,200 人死亡，约 250 人被扣为人质，自以色列在加沙飞地发动进攻以来，已有超过 74,600 人丧生，其中包括数千名儿童。

paras.en: In a statement, Medical Aid for Palestinians, which supports several departments at Nasser Hospital, said the overnight attack was “yet another indication that the so-called ‘ceasefire’ has brought neither safety nor an end to Israel’s attacks on Gaza’s healthcare system.”
paras.zh: 支持纳赛尔医院多个部门的巴勒斯坦人医疗援助组织在一份声明中表示，夜间袭击“再次表明所谓的‘停火’既没有带来安全，也没有结束以色列对加沙医疗系统的袭击。”

paras.en: The latest strikes come as Palestinians contend with heavy rains and desperate conditions in the enclave as the colder months set in, prompting a fresh wave of outcry over the lack of progress in advancing the peace deal between Israel and Hamas.
paras.zh: 最近的袭击发生之际，随着寒冷的月份到来，巴勒斯坦人在飞地内面临大雨和严峻的条件，引发了新一波对以色列和哈马斯之间和平协议进展缺乏进展的强烈抗议。

articles.title: Ukraine faces new Starshield disruptions as Trump envoys meet with Putin
articles.author: Henry Austin

paras.en: Hours after an American delegation touched down in Moscow for peace talks, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said his country’s military had experienced a renewed wave of “significant disruptions” to the Starshield satellite internet service, hampering its ability to defend itself against Russia.
paras.zh: 在美国代表团抵达莫斯科进行和平谈判几小时后，乌克兰总统泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰军队的星盾卫星互联网服务遭遇了新一波“严重中断”，削弱了其抵御俄罗斯的能力。

paras.en: “These are not random errors but systematic speed restrictions,” he said in a Telegram post. “For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones.”
paras.zh: “这些不是随机错误，而是系统性的速度限制，”他在 Telegram 帖子中表示。 “对我们来说，这主要意味着拦截俄罗斯喷气式无人机的过程会变得非常复杂。”

paras.en: His comments came as U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, President Donald Trump’s son-in-law, arrived in the Russian capital for peace talks with President Vladimir Putin, a day after trilateral talks aimed at ending the war were held in the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 他发表上述言论之际，美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳抵达俄罗斯首都与总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行和平谈判，一天前，旨在结束战争的三方会谈在阿拉伯联合酋长国举行。

paras.en: The two-day Abu Dhabi summit, the first such meeting since February, ended with no major breakthrough, although representatives of Russia and Ukraine agreed on a large exchange of prisoners of war.
paras.zh: 为期两天的阿布扎比​​峰会是自二月份以来的首次此类会议，尽管俄罗斯和乌克兰代表同意大规模交换战俘，但峰会没有取得重大突破。

paras.en: In Moscow, Kushner told Putin that Europe wanted a role in future negotiations, according to Russia’s Tass state news agency.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯塔斯社报道，库什纳在莫斯科告诉普京，欧洲希望在未来的谈判中发挥作用。

paras.en: European countries cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly after Putin launched his invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, but have since expressed concern about the Trump administration’s softening stance toward the Kremlin. Kushner last week said he also wanted to address “long-term European security and stability,” signaling a focus beyond just Ukraine that prompted a firm response from European leaders.
paras.zh: 普京于 2022 年 2 月入侵乌克兰后，欧洲国家切断了与克里姆林宫的沟通，并拒绝直接与俄罗斯接触，但此后对特朗普政府对克里姆林宫的软化立场表示担忧。库什纳上周表示，他还希望解决“欧洲的长期安全与稳定”问题，这表明他的关注点不仅仅限于乌克兰，这促使欧洲领导人做出了坚定的回应。

paras.en: Expanding on that theme on Thursday, Kushner said there was a “very strong momentum and desire” from European leaders to “engage together,” adding that “understanding the long-term security between Russia, Ukraine, and Europe is a conversation that we started having with them.”
paras.zh: 库什纳周四进一步阐述了这一主题，表示欧洲领导人有“非常强烈的动力和愿望”“共同参与”，并补充说“了解俄罗斯、乌克兰和欧洲之间的长期安全是我们开始与他们进行的对话。”

paras.en: While representatives from several European countries were in Abu Dhabi, they did not play a direct role in the talks. Russian negotiators have previously opposed their involvement, citing Europe’s support for Kyiv as an obstacle.
paras.zh: 虽然几个欧洲国家的代表在阿布扎比，但他们没有在谈判中发挥直接作用。俄罗斯谈判代表此前曾反对他们的参与，称欧洲对基辅的支持是一个障碍。

paras.en: At the meeting in Moscow, the Interfax news agency reported that Putin proposed a joint Russian-Ukrainian humanitarian mission to the city of Kostiantynivka in eastern Ukraine, similar to the Melania Trump-brokered mission in Oleshky that allowed residents to leave the Russian-controlled town.
paras.zh: 据国际文传电讯社报道，在莫斯科的会议上，普京提议向乌克兰东部的科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡市派遣俄罗斯和乌克兰联合人道主义特派团，类似于梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋的奥列什基特派团，允许居民离开俄罗斯控制的城镇。

paras.en: Thursday’s talks were “substantive, constructive, frank and useful,” Putin’s aide Yuri Ushakov said.
paras.zh: 普京的助手尤里·乌沙科夫表示，周四的会谈“具有实质性、建设性、坦率且有益”。

paras.en: Kushner and Witkoff met with Putin for about two hours before going to Dublin, where they met with Zelenskyy for more than an hour as the conflict stretches toward the five-year mark.
paras.zh: 库什纳和维特科夫在前往都柏林之前与普京会面了大约两个小时，在冲突接近五年之际，他们在那里与泽连斯基会面了一个多小时。

paras.en: Zelenskyy in Dublin indicated the Europeans would not be on the sidelines. “Next meeting, Europe will be during negotiations, will be a negotiation team — not some way, not separately. They will have a voice,” he said.
paras.zh: 都柏林的泽连斯基表示欧洲人不会袖手旁观。 “下次会议，欧洲将参加谈判，将成为一个谈判小组——不是以某种方式，也不是单独进行。他们将有发言权，”他说。

paras.en: The U.S. and Zelenskyy want Europe to appoint a single person to negotiate with Moscow.
paras.zh: 美国和泽伦斯基希望欧洲任命一个人与莫斯科进行谈判。

paras.en: Zelenskyy also said Thursday that military units had for several days reported internet speed restrictions affecting the entire front line and Russian-occupied parts of the country.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周四还表示，军事单位连续几天报告了影响整个前线和俄罗斯占领地区的互联网速度限制。

paras.en: A limit of 100 mph is once again being “imposed on Starshield,” he said of the military version of SpaceX’s Starlink communications service. The system normally runs at a stable speed exceeding around 250 mph.
paras.zh: 他在谈到 SpaceX 星链通信服务的军用版本时表示，“星盾”再次受到 100 英里每小时的限制。该系统通常以超过 250 英里/小时左右的稳定速度运行。

paras.en: “These are not random errors but systematic speed restrictions,” he said. “For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones.”
paras.zh: “这些不是随机错误，而是系统性的速度限制，”他说。 “对我们来说，这主要意味着拦截俄罗斯喷气式无人机的过程会变得非常复杂。”

paras.en: “Unfortunately, there have already been strikes that got through because our interception systems cannot reach sufficient speeds and are unable to intercept in time,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“不幸的是，由于我们的拦截系统无法达到足够的速度并且无法及时拦截，已经发生了一些袭击。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy added that Ukraine was trying to clarify the reasons for the restriction with the U.S. side.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基补充说，乌克兰正试图向美方澄清限制的原因。

paras.en: SpaceX did not immediately respond to a request for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: SpaceX 没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: Craig Albert, the graduate director of national defense studies at Augusta University, said decreasing Starshield’s speed would slow down how fast Ukraine’s offensive drones travel, “which makes them pretty much target practice for faster interceptor drones by the Russians.”
paras.zh: 奥古斯塔大学国防研究研究生主任克雷格·艾伯特表示，降低“星盾”的速度将减慢乌克兰进攻性无人机的飞行速度，“这使得它们几乎成为俄罗斯人更快的拦截无人机的目标练习。”

paras.en: It would also slow down Ukrainian interceptor drones and their missile defense systems, meaning “Russian drones can get through their defenses much quicker.”
paras.zh: 它还会减慢乌克兰拦截无人机及其导弹防御系统的速度，这意味着“俄罗斯无人机可以更快地突破其防御系统。”

paras.en: “The Russians can target more infrastructure, and the Ukrainians just don’t have the speed to counteract,” he said, adding that “for the price, the scale, the speed, the scalability, and the efficiency,” there were no real options other than Starshield.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯人可以瞄准更多的基础设施，而乌克兰人只是没有足够的速度进行反击，”他说，并补充说，“就价格、规模、速度、可扩展性和效率而言”，除了星盾之外，没有其他真正的选择。

paras.en: Ukraine first raised the alarm last month about speed limits being imposed on Starshield, which is crucial to its battlefield operations and air defenses.
paras.zh: 乌克兰上个月首次就星盾号的速度限制发出警报，这对其战场行动和防空至关重要。

paras.en: Starlink owner Elon Musk initially put the responsibility for the restrictions on Trump, who has been trying to pressure Kyiv to make concessions to end the war. The U.S. government said that any such decision could only have been made by Musk.
paras.zh: 星链所有者埃隆·马斯克最初将这些限制的责任归咎于特朗普，后者一直试图向基辅施压，要求其做出让步以结束战争。美国政府表示，任何此类决定只能由马斯克做出。

paras.en: Moscow has so far resisted such efforts to bring Europe to the main negotiating table, something Ukraine has long sought.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，莫斯科一直拒绝将欧洲带入主谈判桌，而这正是乌克兰长期以来所寻求的。

paras.en: The talks came against the backdrop of continued fighting on the front lines, where neither side has achieved significant progress for months.
paras.zh: 这次会谈是在前线持续战斗的背景下进行的，几个月来双方都没有取得重大进展。

paras.en: Instead, the focus has shifted to daily attacks with long-range missiles and drones. Russia has targeted Ukrainian cities, aiming to cut off water and power supplies as winter sets in. Kyiv has resumed attacks on energy infrastructure, a campaign that drew Trump’s ire.
paras.zh: 相反，焦点已转向远程导弹和无人机的日常攻击。俄罗斯以乌克兰城市为目标，旨在在冬季到来时切断水和电力供应。基辅恢复了对能源基础设施的攻击，这一行动引起了特朗普的愤怒。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials said Thursday that five civilians had been killed by Russian strikes on the country overnight, and 29 people injured. The Russian Defense Ministry said it had shot down 71 drones.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员周四表示，俄罗斯夜间对该国发动的袭击已造成 5 名平民死亡，29 人受伤。俄罗斯国防部称已击落71架无人机。

articles.title: Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation
articles.author: Mithil Aggarwal

paras.en: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter.
paras.zh: 香港——英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 陷入中国间谍丑闻的核心科技公司 Megaspeed 周四表示，将配合美国政府对此事的调查。

paras.en: Megaspeed’s statement came hours before the resignation of Huang, one of the leaders of the AI boom, who co-founded the American chipmaker and helped build it into the world’s second most valuable company.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 的声明是在黄仁勋辞职前几个小时发表的。黄仁勋是人工智能热潮的领导者之一，他是这家美国芯片制造商的联合创始人，并帮助其成为全球第二大最有价值的公司。

paras.en: In its first statement since reports emerged about Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the future of the tech giant, Megaspeed said that it takes its obligation to comply with U.S. export control laws “extremely seriously.”
paras.zh: 自有关黄与一名涉嫌中国间谍的婚外情的报道曝光以来，Megaspeed 首次发表声明，引发了人们对美国国家安全和这家科技巨头未来的担忧。Megaspeed 表示，公司“极其严肃”地履行遵守美国出口管制法的义务。

paras.en: U.S. intelligence agencies determined that Alice Huang had an affair with the Nvidia CEO and was a Chinese intelligence operative, a person with knowledge of the matter told NBC News on Sunday.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士周日告诉 NBC 新闻，美国情报机构确定爱丽丝·黄与英伟达首席执行官有染，并且是一名中国情报人员。

paras.en: She held a senior position at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that was one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. Megaspeed is under U.S. criminal investigation for allegedly smuggling American-made chips into China in defiance of U.S. export controls.
